TL;DR: 提出了基于自由能量原理的FEP-Diff轨迹预测框架，通过双重分支时空编码器、目标条件信念学习器和残差扩散生成器，在部分可观测条件下实现了认知合理的轨迹预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有轨迹预测方法依赖全局状态假设，在部分可观测条件下信念推断不足，且预测中缺乏认知行为约束，严重影响了实际部署可行性和物理合理性。

Method: 提出FEP-Diff框架，包含：(1)双重分支时空编码器从局部观测中提取自运动动态和社交交互线索；(2)目标条件信念学习器通过自由能量目标推断多模态潜在信念分布，并在局部邻域图上施加社交一致性约束；(3)基于学习信念表示的残差扩散轨迹生成器，采用token级代理条件生成精确多样的未来预测。

Result: 在五个公共基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，FEP-Diff在受限可观测性条件下持续优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: FEP-Diff框架成功实现了在现实约束下的认知合理轨迹预测，有效解决了部分可观测性、信念推断和行为约束等关键问题，为实际部署提供了更可行和物理合理的解决方案。

Abstract: Trajectory prediction methods have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in capturing complex motion patterns. However, existing methods rely on global state assumptions, suffer from insufficient belief inference under partial observability, and lack cognitive behavioral constraints in prediction. These limitations severely compromise both deployment feasibility and physical plausibility in real-world settings. In this work, we propose FEP-Diff, an agent-centric trajectory prediction framework grounded in the Free Energy Principle, aimed at achieving cognitively plausible predictions under realistic constraints. Specifically, a dual-branch spatiotemporal encoder extracts ego-motion dynamics and social interaction cues from local observations. Building upon this, a goal-conditioned belief learner infers multimodal latent belief distributions optimized via a free-energy objective, with a social consistency constraint on the local neighborhood graph to promote cognitive alignment among neighboring agents. Finally, a residual diffusion trajectory generator is conditioned on the learned belief representations with token-level proxy conditioning, producing precise and diverse future predictions. Extensive experiments on five public benchmarks demonstrate that FEP-Diff consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods under restricted observability. Code: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/FEP-Diff-8876.

</details>


### [152] [When Can We Trust Early Warnings? Leakage-Excluded Early Outcome Prediction from LMS Interaction Logs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25794)
*Ngoc Luyen Le,Marie-Hélène Abel,Bertrand Laforge*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了LEAP协议，用于解决学习管理系统早期预警模型中普遍存在的时间泄露问题，确保评估的真实早期性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于学习管理系统日志的早期预警模型报告的"早期"性能往往因时间泄露而被夸大，即使用了在预测时间点尚不可用的信息。作者旨在解决这一方法学问题，建立真正符合时间可用性约束的早期预测评估框架。

Method: 提出了LEAP（Leakage-Excluded Early-Availability Protocol）协议，该协议包括：1）形式化基于截止点的早期结果预测及时间可用性约束；2）在连接和聚合操作前强制执行截止优先截断；3）审计特征来源以防止截止后的证据进入基准测试。作者在公开的Open University Learning Analytics Dataset（OULAD）上实例化LEAP，构建跨周截止点的泄露控制评估协议。

Result: 使用多种标准学习方法（随机森林、梯度提升等），通过ROC-AUC、PR-AUC、Brier分数和F1@0.5指标评估发现：随着观察窗口扩大性能持续改善，第3周左右出现显著提升；随机森林在最早截止点表现最佳，而梯度提升在此后占主导地位。泄露消融实验进一步表明，时间违规（尤其是通过评估信息）会夸大表面的"早期"性能。

Conclusion: LEAP协议有效识别并防止了早期预警模型中的时间泄露问题，确保了评估的可靠性。该研究揭示了以往研究中早期性能可能被高估的问题，为未来学习分析研究提供了严格的方法学基准，有助于开发真正可用于早期干预的预测模型。

Abstract: Early-warning models built from Learning Management System (LMS) logs aim to predict end-of-course outcomes early enough to enable timely learner support. However, reported "early" performance is often inflated by temporal leakage. This occurs when the pipeline uses information that would not yet be available at the time of prediction. We formalize cutoff-based early outcome prediction under a temporal availability constraint and introduce LEAP (Leakage-Excluded Early-Availability Protocol), which enforces cutoff-first truncation prior to joins and aggregation and audits feature provenance to prevent post-cutoff evidence from entering the benchmark. We instantiate LEAP on the public Open University Learning Analytics Dataset (OULAD) as a multi-step protocol for leakage-controlled evaluation across weekly cutoffs. Using several standard learning methods, we evaluate performance using ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, Brier score, and F1@0.5. Results show improving performance as the observation window expands, with a marked gain around week~3; Random Forest performs best at the earliest cutoffs, while Gradient Boosting dominates thereafter. Leakage ablations further show that temporal violations, especially through assessment information, can inflate apparent "early" performance.

</details>


### [153] [MuCRASP: Multimodal Chain-of-thought Reasoning aware Structured Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25842)
*Aritra Dutta,Somak Aditya*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了MuCRASP框架，一种针对视觉语言模型链式思维推理的结构化剪枝方法，在保持推理能力的同时显著降低模型参数量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有剪枝方法在压缩视觉语言模型时会导致链式思维推理准确率严重下降，主要原因是：(1)CoT推理依赖生成轨迹中的稀疏关键转折点，而现有方法对此不敏感；(2)针对单模态LLM设计的剪枝方法忽视了视觉与文本模态间的激活分布差异。

Method: 提出MuCRASP结构化剪枝框架，通过识别并保留推理关键组件，同时维护跨模态对齐，在全局参数预算约束下考虑层级敏感性差异。

Result: 在四个VLM和三个推理基准测试上验证：30%剪枝率下Qwen2.5-VL-7B在物理推理任务上LLM-as-a-Judge得分达8.87（最强基线7.32）；50%剪枝率下仍保持高推理一致性，困惑度退化更低。

Conclusion: MuCRASP成功解决了VLM剪枝中CoT推理能力保持的难题，在显著压缩模型规模的同时有效保留了多模态推理性能，为VLM的高效部署提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly rely on chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning to solve complex multimodal tasks, but their large parameter sizes make deployment expensive. Structured pruning offers a natural solution; however, existing methods fail to preserve CoT reasoning accuracy in VLMs. We identify two key reasons: (1) CoT consistency depends on sparse transition points (pivot tokens) in the generation trajectory, while existing pruning methods are CoT-agnostic; and (2) pruning methods designed for unimodal LLMs do not account for activation-distribution differences across visual and textual modalities. Motivated by these observations, we propose MuCRASP, a structured pruning framework that targets reasoning-critical components while preserving cross-modal alignment and accounting for layer-wise sensitivity under a global parameter budget. Experiments on four VLMs across three reasoning benchmarks show that MuCRASP consistently preserves reasoning quality under increasing compression. At 30% pruning on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, MuCRASP achieves an LLM-as-a-Judge score of 8.87 versus 7.32 for the strongest baseline on physical reasoning tasks. Furthermore, MuCRASP maintains high reasoning consistency up to 50% pruning, significantly outperforming prior pruning approaches while exhibiting lower perplexity degradation.

</details>


### [154] [From Accounting to Coordination: A Virtual Water-Aware Electricity-Computation-Water Nexus Framework for Data Center Dispatch](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25854)
*Haiyang You,Chengwei Lou,Jin Zhao,Yue Zhou,Lu Zhang,Jin Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种电力-计算-水（ECW）协同框架，通过将虚拟水影响内化到电力系统调度优化中，实现了水资源约束下的工作负载迁移和电力调度优化，在IEEE测试系统上减少了约3-5%的发电相关淡水取用量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据中心扩张导致电力需求持续增长，进而增加了发电侧的水资源消耗。现有的静态统计核算方法无法捕捉调度优化和工作负载迁移对水资源消耗的动态影响，导致水资源核算与优化过程脱节，无法指导工作负载迁移或电力调度以缓解水资源压力。

Method: 构建电力-计算-水（ECW）协同框架，将调度优化表示为嵌入深度学习架构的可微分优化层，在保持运行可行性的同时实现端到端的协调策略学习；结合不动点协调方法，确保虚拟水归因与发电侧实际取水之间的一致性。

Result: 在IEEE 30节点和118节点测试系统上的案例研究表明，该方法具有可靠的收敛性、精确的电力-水资源一致性，在水资源约束条件下能够减少约3-5%的发电相关淡水取用量。

Conclusion: 所提出的ECW协同框架成功将虚拟水影响内化到电力系统调度中，克服了静态统计核算方法的局限性，为数据中心工作负载迁移和电力调度提供了有效的决策支持，有助于缓解水资源压力。

Abstract: The expansion of data centers (DCs) drives a sustained increase in electricity demand and associated water withdrawals at generation sites. These withdrawals occur at generation sites and are virtually allocated to demand based on network power flows. Consequently, the actual water footprint of a specific load varies dynamically with generation dispatch and network conditions. Existing approaches typically rely on static statistical accounting to quantify these water footprints. However, such static methods fail to capture how dispatch optimization and workload relocation dynamically affect water withdrawals. As a result, static statistical accounting approaches remain decoupled from the optimization process, rendering them incapable of guiding workload relocation or power dispatch to mitigate water stress. To address this limitation, this paper develops an operational electricity-computation-water (ECW) nexus framework that internalizes virtual water impacts directly into power system dispatch. The framework represents dispatch optimization as a differentiable optimization layer embedded within a deep learning architecture, enabling efficient end-to-end learning of coordination policies while preserving operational feasibility. Combined with fixed-point coordination, the framework enforces consistency between virtual water attribution and physical generation-side withdrawals. Case studies on the IEEE 30-bus and 118-bus test systems demonstrate reliable convergence, exact power-water consistency, and reductions of approximately 3-5% in generation-related freshwater withdrawals under water-constrained conditions.

</details>


### [155] [$D^2$-Monitor: Dynamic Safety Monitoring for Diffusion LLMs via Hesitation-Aware Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25893)
*Aoxi Liu,Yupeng Chen,James Oldfield,Guanzhe Hong,Junchi Yu,Baoyuan Wu,Philip Torr,Adel Bibi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出了D²-Monitor，一种针对扩散大语言模型的双层安全监控系统，利用模型生成过程中的“安全犹豫”现象动态分配监控资源，在保持轻量级的同时实现了SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散大语言模型（D-LLMs）作为自回归大语言模型的替代方案逐渐兴起，但针对D-LLMs的安全监控研究却严重缺失。与AR-LLMs不同，D-LLMs通过多步去噪过程生成文本，会暴露中间隐藏表示，这些表示可能包含单步监控无法获取的安全相关信息。研究旨在探索如何利用这一特性进行高效的安全监控。

Method: 研究首先分析轨迹级信号，发现最具信息量的信号是“安全犹豫”——即中间隐藏状态反复落在探针决策边界的小范围内。基于此，提出了D²-Monitor双层监控框架：第一层采用轻量级探针进行实时监控并估计犹豫程度；当犹豫水平超过阈值时，激活第二层表达能力更强但计算量更大的探针。这种动态路由机制实现了监控资源的按需分配。

Result: 在WildguardMix、ToxicChat、OpenAI-Moderation三个数据集和四个D-LLM模型上的实验表明，D²-Monitor达到了最先进性能。模型参数量控制在0.85M以内，相比8个基线方法，在有效性和效率之间取得了最佳平衡。犹豫步骤的数量能有效预测探针失效，可作为样本难度的代理指标。

Conclusion: 论文成功填补了D-LLMs安全监控的研究空白，证明了利用扩散模型多步生成过程中的中间信息进行安全监控的可行性。D²-Monitor通过动态资源分配机制，实现了轻量级与高性能的统一，为D-LLMs的实际部署提供了有效的安全保障方案。

Abstract: Despite the emergence of diffusion large language models (D-LLMs) as an alternative to autoregressive large language models (AR-LLMs), safety monitoring for D-LLMs remains largely unexplored. Unlike AR-LLMs, D-LLMs generate text through a multi-step denoising process, exposing intermediate hidden representations that may contain safety-relevant information unavailable in standard single-step monitoring setups. Motivated by the suitability of lightweight probes for always-on monitoring, we analyze which trajectory-level signals best indicate when such probes are likely to struggle. We find that the most informative signal is safety hesitation: intermediate hidden states repeatedly falling within a small margin of the probe's decision boundary. The number of such hesitation steps in D-LLM's trajectory predicts probe failure effectively, providing a proxy of sample difficulty. Building on this analysis, we propose $D^2$-Monitor, a bi-level safety monitor for D-LLMs. $D^2$-Monitor adopts a lightweight probe as an always-on monitor to jointly estimate hesitation and perform base classification. When the hesitation level exceeds a threshold, a more expressive but computationally heavier probe is activated. This dynamic routing mechanism allocates monitoring resources efficiently at test time. Evaluated on 3 datasets (WildguardMix, ToxicChat, OpenAI-Moderation) across 4 D-LLMs, $D^2$-Monitor achieves state-of-the-art performance with a compact parameter footprint ($\leq$ 0.85M parameters), and exhibits the best trade-off between effectiveness and efficiency relative to 8 baselines.

</details>


### [156] [Explore Before You Solve: The Speed--Depth Trade-off in Epistemic Agents for ARC-AGI-3](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25931)
*Liew Keong Han*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文揭示了ARC-AGI-3公开基准测试存在严重缺陷：所有25个公开游戏均可通过非智能策略通关，无法区分智能探索与简单启发式方法。作者提出AERA智能体框架，在真实测试中取得有意义的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者发现ARC-AGI-3公开评估集存在根本性问题——虽然声称测试智能探索能力，但实际上所有25个公开游戏都可以通过非智能的平凡策略（如盲操作、重复动作、漏洞利用等）完成，无法有效衡量真实的智能推理能力。这一发现促使作者重新审视交互式推理基准的有效性，并开发真正需要智能探索的解决方案。

Method: 提出AERA（自适应认知推理智能体）框架，采用三阶段EXPLORE/VERIFY/PLAN架构：先探索环境获取信息，再验证发现的规律，最后制定行动计划。理论上建立了速度-深度权衡框架，证明RHAE指标的二次型形式是对偏离帕累托前沿的惩罚。使用Qwen2.5-0.5B小模型验证框架有效性，对比随机基线和无需探索基线。

Result: 基准测试分析：25个公开游戏中，10个单步盲操作可达、5个一步探测可达、1个重复按键可达、1个多样化探索可达、8个在预算内重复单一动作可达，另有库级漏洞可绕过18个游戏。AERA在25个公开游戏上达到RHAE=0.2116（解决4个），而随机和无探索基线均为0.0000。在完整55个私有游戏评估中达到RHAE=0.30。

Conclusion: 当前公开交互式推理基准无法有效衡量其声称需要的探索能力，私有评估集才是真正的智能测试。AERA框架证明了EXPLORE-before-PLAN策略和模型能力×探索交互的重要性，为构建真正测试智能探索能力的基准提供了方向。

Abstract: We systematically investigate all 25 public ARC-AGI-3 games and find that every one is reachable through non-intelligent strategies: 10 in a single blind step, 5 after one probing action, 1 via repeated ACTION1 presses, 1 via diverse exploration, and 8 via single repeated actions with sufficient budget (50-200 steps). A library-level null-coordinate vulnerability additionally bypasses 18 games in 1 step. This benchmark critique implies the public evaluation set cannot discriminate intelligent exploration from trivial heuristics - the private 55-game evaluation is the only genuine intelligence test. Against this backdrop, we present AERA (Adaptive Epistemic Reasoning Agent), a three-phase (EXPLORE / VERIFY / PLAN) agent achieving RHAE=0.2116 (4/25 solved) on these 25 games with Qwen2.5-0.5B, while random and no-explore baselines score 0.0000. We formalise AERA through a Speed--Depth trade-off framework: under a convexity assumption (proved for a class of environments in the Appendix), RHAE's quadratic form emerges as a second-order penalty for deviating from the Pareto frontier between action efficiency and information gain. Contributions: (i) a benchmark validity analysis showing that current interactive reasoning benchmarks fail to measure the exploration they claim to require, and (ii) the EXPLORE-before-PLAN framework and model-capability x exploration interaction. The linked code track entry achieves RHAE=0.30 on the full 55-game private evaluation. Code: CC0.

</details>


### [157] [LECTOR: Joint Optimization of Scientific Reasoning Graphs and Introduction Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25964)
*Jiabei Xiao,Yizhou Wang,Chen Tang,Pengze Li,Wanli Ouyang,Shixiang Tang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出LECTOR框架，通过逻辑-表达协同强化学习解决AI自动撰写科学论文引言的难题，在逻辑忠实度和生成质量上取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI辅助论文写作方法将引言生成视为文本生成任务而非推理与结构化过程，导致逻辑性差、引用幻觉等严重问题。引言写作不仅需要语言流畅性，更要求逻辑合理性和可验证的忠实度，这是当前方法的瓶颈。

Method: 1. 形式化定义内容条件引言生成(CCIG)任务，要求引言必须基于论文核心证据生成；2. 提出LECTOR框架：首先从论文主体构建逻辑推理图作为可验证的逻辑蓝图，然后设计逻辑-表达协同奖励机制，联合优化图结构的忠实度和最终叙述的质量。

Result: 在Nature Communications论文数据集上的实验表明，LECTOR在逻辑忠实度和引言生成质量上持续提升：图质量提升26.7%，引用质量提升8.6%，论文一致性提升3.3%。

Conclusion: LECTOR通过将逻辑推理与表达生成相结合，有效解决了AI科学论文写作中引言生成的关键挑战，为AI辅助科研提供了更可靠的方法，证明了基于逻辑蓝图的结构化生成优于纯文本生成方法。

Abstract: AI Scientists have shown promising progress across multiple stages of the research pipeline, among which automatic scientific paper writing remains a formidable challenge. The Introduction writing is especially challenging, which demands not only linguistic fluency, but logical soundness and verifiable faithfulness. Most AI-assisted methods treat the task as text generation instead of reasoning and structuring, leading to severe drawbacks, e.g., hallucinating citations. To address this, we first formulate the Content-Conditional Introduction Generation (CCIG) task, which requires grounding the Introduction in the paper's core evidence. We then propose LECTOR, a novel Logic-Expression Co-Reinforcement Learning framework that can strictly follow the scientist's logic, add high-quality citations and keep structured expressions. LECTOR first constructs a logic-reasoning graph from the paper's main body to serve as a verifiable logical blueprint. Subsequently, it employs a Logic-Expression Co-Rewarding mechanism to jointly optimize for both the graph's structural fidelity and the final narrative's quality. We conduct a dataset from Nature Communications papers to assess our method. Extensive experiments show consistent improvements in both logic fidelity and Introduction generation quality metrics, e.g., Graph Quality (+26.7%), Citation Quality (+8.6%), and Paper Consistency (+3.3%). Code and data are available at https://github.com/Xiao-Youth/LECTOR.

</details>


### [158] [Neural Scalable Symbolic Search Framework for Complex Logical Queries with Multiple Free Variables](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25985)
*Weizhi Fei,Hang Yin,Zihao Wang,Shukai Zhao,Wei Zhang,Yangqiu Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了NS3框架，用于高效回答知识图谱中包含多个自由变量的复杂查询(EFO_k)，通过预算控制的超节点合并策略实现联合排名，在保持边际排名准确率的同时显著提升联合排名性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的复杂查询回答方法主要依赖边际排名来近似联合排名，但边际排名是真实元组联合排名的一个较差代理。随着自由变量数量k的增长，直接对实体集进行联合排名在计算上变得不可行，因此需要一种可扩展的方法来近似联合排名。

Method: 提出神经可扩展符号搜索(NS3)框架：(i)回答边际化子查询以获取必要候选集，(ii)将多个自由变量合并为超节点，并通过动态预算B来修剪和控制其域，(iii)逐步将EFO_k查询简化为在预算缩减域上的EFO_{k-1}查询。

Result: 在三个标准知识图谱数据集上，NS3在保持强边际排名准确率的同时，显著提升了联合排名性能。同时发布了将现有EFO_1数据集扩展到k=3的联合排名基准测试。

Conclusion: NS3框架成功解决了多自由变量复杂查询的可扩展性问题，实现了无需枚举所有可能元组的高效联合排名，为知识图谱上的复杂查询回答提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: Complex Query Answering (CQA) is a fundamental knowledge representation and reasoning task over incomplete knowledge graphs (KGs). Answering existential first-order queries with $k$ free variables (i.e., $\text{EFO}_k$ queries) is a crucial yet challenging problem, as it requires ranking answer tuples in $\mathcal{E}^k$, where $\mathcal{E}$ denotes the entity set of a KG. This quickly becomes intractable as $k$ grows. Consequently, existing benchmarks and methods rely on marginal rankings over individual variables; however, marginal rankings are a poor proxy for the true joint ranking of tuples. Building on neural symbolic search for $\text{EFO}_1$ queries, we propose Neural Scalable Symbolic Search (NS3), a budgeted framework that approximates joint ranking without enumerating $\mathcal{E}^k$. NS3 (i) answers marginalized sub-queries to obtain necessary candidate sets, (ii) merges multiple free variables into hypernodes whose domains are pruned and controlled by a dynamic budget $B$, and (iii) progressively reduces an $\text{EFO}_k$ query to an $\text{EFO}_{k-1}$ query over a budgeted reduced domain. Across three standard KG datasets, NS3 substantially improves joint ranking performance while retaining strong marginal accuracy. We further release a joint-ranking benchmark that extends existing $\text{EFO}_1$ datasets to $k=3$, enabling systematic evaluation of multi-variable queries. Our code is provided in https://github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/NS3_KDD2026.

</details>


### [159] [CausaLab: A Scalable Environment for Interactive Causal Discovery Toward AI Scientists](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26029)
*Junlin Yang,Dylan Zhang,Xiangchen Song,Qirun Dai,Xiao Liu,Yuen Chen,Aniket Vashishtha,Jing Shi,Chenhao Tan,Hao Peng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了CausaLab，一个用于评估LLM智能体交互式因果发现的可扩展环境，揭示了预测成功与因果理解之间的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估方法仅关注智能体能否解决问题，而未评估其答案是否基于正确的因果机制假设。缺乏能够区分预测成功与机制恢复能力、并支持交互式因果发现评估的环境。

Method: 构建合成实验室环境，每个回合中智能体接收先验测量记录、对操控晶体进行干预，预测由相同机制支配的反应器晶体的共振频率。隐藏的数据生成过程为随机采样的结构因果模型（SCM），成功需要恢复因果图和结构方程。引入领域特定语言记录智能体演化的SCM假设，使轨迹可检查并与真值比较。

Result: 在纯观测6节点设置中，GPT-5.2-high达到92%任务准确率但仅0.471的全边F1值；混合观测-干预策略在6节点设置中使任务准确率和全边F1值均达80%；纯干预策略表现不佳；识别出过早停止是智能体的主要弱点，验证假设与历史数据一致性可缓解该问题。

Conclusion: CausaLab成功分离了预测成功与因果理解，暴露了当前LLM智能体作为实验因果推理者的局限性，混合交互策略可提升结构保真度，但智能体在设计信息性干预方面仍有困难。

Abstract: We introduce CausaLab, a scalable environment for evaluating interactive causal discovery by LLM agents. Unlike prior evaluations, CausaLab evaluates both whether an agent can solve a problem using causal evidence and whether its answer is supported by a correct hypothesis about the underlying causal mechanism. Each episode places an agent in a synthetic laboratory: it receives prior measurement records, intervenes on a manipulator crystal, and predicts the resonance frequency of a held-out reactor crystal governed by the same mechanism. The hidden data-generating process is a randomly sampled structural causal model (SCM), so success requires recovering both a causal graph and structural equations rather than recalling prior knowledge. CausaLab also includes a domain-specific language that records the agent's evolving SCM hypothesis, making trajectories inspectable and comparable with ground truth. Experiments show a persistent gap between prediction and mechanism recovery: in the purely observational 6-node setting, GPT-5.2-high reaches 92% task accuracy but only 0.471 all-edge $F_1$. This observation further motivates our exploration of different interaction strategies: Mixed observation--intervention strategies improve structural fidelity: in the mixed 6-node setting, GPT-5.2-high achieves 80% on both task accuracy and all-edge $F_1$. Yet even strong agents struggle to design informative interventions, as pure intervention strategies perform poorly on both task accuracy and all-edge $F_1$. We identify premature stopping as a major weakness of agents, and show that asking the model to verify the consistency between its hypothesis and past data can help mitigate this issue. CausaLab therefore separates predictive success from causal understanding and exposes current LLM agents' limits as experimental causal reasoners.

</details>


### [160] [CITYREP: A Unified Benchmark for Urban Representations Across Cities, Tasks, and Modalities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26036)
*Junyuan Liu,Xinglei Wang,Zichao Zeng,Jiazhuang Feng,Quan Qin,Ilya Ilyankou,Guangsheng Dong,Tao Cheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了CityRep，一个跨8个城市、8个任务的城市表征学习统一基准，采用基于块的空间划分解决空间泄漏问题，发现随机划分会导致性能高估和模型排名变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有城市表征学习评估存在明显局限性：通常只关注一两个城市/任务，且使用随机划分引入空间泄漏，导致性能虚高，难以支持跨位置泛化和公平比较。

Method: CityRep包含三个核心组件：(1)空间单元无关的评估框架，通过标准化对齐模块支持异质城市表征；(2)统一的评估协议，使用基于块的空间划分缓解空间泄漏；(3)可扩展的多城市多任务基准套件，覆盖8个城市和8个任务（回归、分类、分布预测）。

Result: 评估了11个代表性城市表征模型。发现性能对划分协议高度敏感，随机划分导致分数虚高并改变模型排名；同时观察到跨城市和任务存在显著变异性，强调了泛化感知评估的必要性。

Conclusion: CityRep作为可复现基准发布，包含数据集、评估流程和诊断工具，为城市表征学习乃至城市基础模型的未来研究提供公平比较支持。

Abstract: Urban representation learning encodes complex urban environments into general-purpose embeddings for diverse downstream tasks and emerging urban foundation models. However, current evaluations are limited, typically focusing on one or two cities and tasks and relying on random splits that introduce spatial leakage, leading to inflated performance and weak support for cross-location generalization and fair comparison. To address this, we propose CityRep, a unified benchmark that evaluates urban representations across data modalities, cities, and tasks using spatially structured splits. CityRep consists of three key components: (1) a spatial unit-agnostic evaluation framework that supports heterogeneous urban representations through a standardized alignment module; (2) a unified evaluation protocol using block-based spatial splits to mitigate spatial leakage and enable rigorous model comparison; and (3) an extensible multi-city, multi-task benchmark suite spanning 8 cities and 8 tasks across regression, classification, and distribution prediction. We evaluate 11 representative urban representation models. Results show that performance is highly sensitive to the split protocol, with random splits inflating scores and altering model rankings. We also observe substantial variability across cities and tasks, underscoring the need for generalization-aware evaluation. CityRep is released as a reproducible benchmark with datasets, evaluation pipelines, and diagnostic tools to facilitate fair comparison and support future research in urban representation learning towards urban foundation models.

</details>


### [161] [L2IR: Revealing Latent Intent in Graph Fraud Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26040)
*Jinsheng Guo,Zhenhao Weng,Yibo Liu,Yan Qiao,Meng Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出L2IR框架，利用大语言模型揭示潜在意图并解决欺诈者伪装问题，在有限监督下实现图欺诈检测性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图神经网络在欺诈检测中面临欺诈者通过伪造大量与良性用户连接进行伪装的问题，导致欺诈信号在邻域聚合中被稀释；同时，标注欺诈样本稀缺限制了检测器的鲁棒性；现有利用大语言模型的方法未充分探索可疑连接背后的潜在意图。

Method: 提出LLM驱动的潜在意图揭示框架L2IR：1）从原始行为轨迹中提取意图感知表示；2）推理个体连接的真实目的，区分支持性链接和误导性链接；3）引入自适应自训练机制以增强有限监督下的鲁棒性。

Result: 在两个具有普遍伪装特性的真实数据集上，L2IR超越强基线方法；作为插件增强多种基于GNN的检测器，AUPRC提升高达8.27%。

Conclusion: L2IR通过揭示潜在意图有效解决了图欺诈检测中的伪装问题，在有限标注数据下保持鲁棒性，可作为通用插件提升现有GNN检测器的性能。

Abstract: Graph fraud detection has long depended on Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to propagate and aggregate information across relational data. A critical obstacle in practice, however, is that fraudsters frequently disguise themselves by forging numerous connections with benign users, causing fraud signals to be progressively diluted during neighborhood aggregation and undermining detection reliability. While recent efforts have used Large Language Models (LLMs) to provide rich semantic cues for fraud detection, the underlying intent behind suspicious connections remains insufficiently explored. Compounding this issue, the scarcity of annotated fraud samples makes it difficult to train detectors that remain robust under heavy camouflage. To address these gaps, we propose L2IR, an LLM-driven Latent Intent Revealing framework for graph fraud detection. By uncovering latent intent from both user behaviors and suspicious connections, L2IR extracts intent-aware representations from raw behavioral traces and reasons about the true purpose behind individual connections, effectively distinguishing supportive links from misleading ones. It further incorporates adaptive self-training to enhance robustness under limited supervision. Evaluations on two real-world datasets characterized by pervasive camouflage demonstrate that L2IR surpasses strong baselines and can function as a plug-in enhancement for a range of GNN-based detectors, improving AUPRC by up to 8.27%.

</details>


### [162] [Retrying vs Resampling in AI Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26047)
*James Lucassen,Adam Kaufman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 重采样显著提升AI代码安全性，但重试机制存在漏洞，审计策略应取最大怀疑分数而非最小值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究AI编码脚手架中重试（retrying）和重采样（resampling）机制的安全性，从AI控制视角评估这些防御策略在面对潜在对抗性模型时的有效性，以及重新审视之前工作中被混淆的设计选择。

Method: 在BashArena环境中，以Claude Opus 4.6作为不可信模型，MiMo-V2-Flash作为可信监控器，对比研究重试机制（封锁风险操作并继续轨迹）和重采样机制（从相同上下文抽取多样本）的安全效果，并解构先前工作中混淆的设计参数。

Result: 重采样使安全性从61%提升至71%（审计预算0.3%），仅重采样可疑步骤可恢复6.2个百分点的增益且仅需10%的额外样本。发现最大怀疑分数审计优于最小怀疑分数，执行最低可疑样本的安全增益仅+3.9pp（置信区间包含零）。

Conclusion: 重采样有效提升安全性且不损失有用性，但重试机制因泄漏监控逻辑反而可能被攻击者利用，先前工作中取最小怀疑分数和执行最低可疑样本的策略在本文设置中效果有限或相反。

Abstract: AI coding scaffolds like Claude Code and Codex use \textit{retrying}: blocking actions flagged as risky and continuing the trajectory. We study retrying from an AI control perspective, which treats the model as potentially adversarial. We find that while retrying reduces honest suspicion scores, the untrusted model can exploit monitor rationale to construct sneakier attacks, negating safety gains. We also study \textit{resampling}: drawing multiple samples from the same context, which does not leak exploitable information. We disentangle design choices that previous work on resampling had bundled together. In BashArena, with Claude Opus 4.6 as the untrusted model and MiMo-V2-Flash as the trusted monitor, drawing five samples per step and auditing on the maximum suspicion score raises safety from 61\% to 71\% at a 0.3\% audit budget, at no cost to usefulness. Selectively resampling only the steps that look suspicious on the first draw recovers 6.2 percentage points of the gain while drawing only 10\% as many extra samples. Two of our findings in this setting contradict earlier work on resampling. The first is that auditing based on the maximum across resampled suspicion scores outperforms using the minimum, which is the opposite of what Ctrl-Z found. The second is that executing the least suspicious sample, which is the central mechanism in earlier defer-to-resample protocols, gives only a small empirical safety gain in our setting (+3.9 pp, with the confidence interval overlapping zero).

</details>


### [163] [VeriTrace: Evolving Mental Models for Deep Research Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26081)
*Haolang Zhao,Yunbo Long,Lukas Beckenbauer,Alexandra Brintrup*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出VeriTrace认知图框架，通过显式反馈循环调节代理的心理模型演化，在DeepResearch Bench和DeepConsult上显著超越现有最强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度研究代理依赖LLM隐式推理演化中间表示，缺乏显式调节导致中间层易受混合质量信息污染并沿依赖传播错误，模型规模往往成为缺失调节的替代方案。

Method: 提出显式反馈机制持续对齐任务理解与现实，识别三种调节循环：解释更新、偏差反馈和模式修订，并在VeriTrace认知图框架中显式实现这三个循环。

Result: 使用匹配的Qwen3.5-27B骨干网络，VeriTrace在DeepResearch Bench Insight上比最强匹配基线提升4.22个百分点（总体1.49个百分点），在DeepConsult上提升5.9个百分点总体胜率；使用Config-DeepSeek在DRB上达到最强可复现开源结果。

Conclusion: 代理的心理模型应通过显式反馈演化，而非依赖LLM隐式推理，显式调节机制能有效提升深度研究代理的性能。

Abstract: Deep research agents face vast, interdependent, and pervasively uncertain information. Existing systems explore what evolving intermediate representations should look like, but leave their evolution to the LLM's implicit reasoning. Without explicit regulation, the intermediate layer is easily contaminated by mixed-quality information and propagates errors along its dependencies, so model scale often ends up substituting for absent regulation. We argue that an agent's mental model should instead evolve through explicit feedback that continuously aligns task understanding with reality, and identify three regulatory loops: interpretive update, deviation feedback, and schema revision. We realise this in VeriTrace, a cognitive-graph framework that explicitly implements the three loops. Using matched Qwen3.5-27B backbones, VeriTrace improves over the strongest matched baseline by 4.22 pp on DeepResearch Bench (DRB) Insight (1.49 pp Overall) and by 5.9 pp Overall win rate on DeepConsult. With Config-DeepSeek, it achieves the strongest reproducible open-source result on DRB.

</details>


### [164] [Claw-Anything: Benchmarking Always-On Personal Assistants with Broader Access to User's Digital World](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26086)
*Yusong Lin,Xinyuan Liang,Haiyang Wang,Qipeng Gu,Siqi Cheng,Jiangui Chen,Shuzhe Wu,Feiyang Pan,Lue Fan,Sanyuan Zhao,Dandan Tu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了Claw-Anything基准测试，用于评估大语言模型代理在持续在线个人助手场景下的能力，涵盖长期活动历史、相互依赖的后端服务以及多设备GUI和CLI交互。实验显示GPT-5.5的pass@1仅为34.5%，表明当前模型与真实需求存在显著差距。同时发布了自动化数据生成管道，将基础模型性能提升23.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大语言模型代理系统仅能访问用户数字世界的狭窄片段，缺乏对广泛、持续在线场景的支持。现有基准测试同样只提供部分用户状态，无法评估代理在丰富上下文环境中的表现，特别是在需要跨长期历史、多服务、多设备协同推理的场景下。这种局限性阻碍了对持续在线个人助手能力的准确评估与提升。

Method: 提出Claw-Anything基准测试，沿三个维度扩展代理上下文：长期活动历史、相互依赖的后端服务、跨多设备的GUI与CLI集成交互。通过多轮事件注入模拟数月的用户活动，生成复杂的世界状态和现实噪声（包括无关事件和冲突信号）。代理需要在丰富上下文环境中进行推理，同时保持对噪声的鲁棒性。此外，还发布了自动化数据生成管道，创建了2,000个训练环境。

Result: 实验结果表明，GPT-5.5在Claw-Anything基准上的pass@1仅为34.5%，显著低于先前基准测试的成绩，揭示了当前代理能力与持续在线个人助手需求之间的巨大差距。使用自动化数据生成管道产生的训练环境可将基础模型性能提升23.7%，证明了可扩展数据基础设施的有效性。

Conclusion: 当前大语言模型代理在处理长期、多维度上下文和主动协助方面存在明显不足，远未达到持续在线个人助手的要求。Claw-Anything基准测试为评估和推动该领域发展提供了更真实、更具挑战性的测试环境，而可扩展的数据生成基础设施对提升模型性能具有重要价值。

Abstract: Large language model agents are increasingly envisioned as always-on personal assistants with access to anything relevant in the user's digital world. Yet current systems operate over only narrow slices of that world, limiting context-sensitive reasoning and effective assistance. Existing benchmarks similarly provide only partial user state and therefore fail to capture performance in such a broad, always-on setting. To address this gap, we introduce Claw-Anything, a benchmark that expands agent context along three dimensions: long-horizon activity histories, interdependent backend services, and integrated GUI and CLI interaction across multiple devices. To instantiate this setting, we simulate months of user activity through multi-round event injection, producing complex world states and realistic noise, including irrelevant events and conflicting signals. Agents must reason over rich contextual environments while remaining robust to such noise. This expanded scope also enables the evaluation of proactive assistance, requiring agents to anticipate user needs and deliver timely recommendations. Experiments show that GPT-5.5 achieves only 34.5% pass@1, substantially below prior benchmarks, underscoring a gap between current agent capabilities and the demands of always-on personal assistance. Alongside the benchmark, we release an automated data-generation pipeline that yields 2,000 training environments and improves the base model by 23.7%, demonstrating its utility of scalable data infrastructure.

</details>


### [165] [From Model Scaling to System Scaling: Scaling the Harness in Agentic AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26112)
*Shangding Gu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出智能体AI的下一个瓶颈是系统架构扩展而非模型扩展，强调需要将围绕基础模型的执行层（称为"智能体束"）作为一等对象进行设计、评估和优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前智能体评估过于以模型为中心，将内存、检索、工具使用、编排、验证和治理视为次要实现细节，但这种框架已不再适用，因为智能体性能源于基础模型、内存基板、上下文构造器、技能路由层、编排循环和验证治理层之间的交互作用。

Method: 研究智能体束扩展的三个核心瓶颈：上下文治理、可信赖内存和动态技能路由，以及协调和约束它们的编排与治理机制；提出超越单次任务成功的束级基准测试议程；开发Python原生参考束CheetahClaws并与Claude Code和OpenClaw进行对比。

Result: 识别出智能体束作为将模型能力转化为长期行为的关键架构，通过上下文治理、可信赖内存和动态技能路由三个瓶颈的分析，以及CheetahClaws的实现验证了系统设计的重要性。

Conclusion: 未来智能体AI的进步将同等依赖于系统设计和更强大的基础模型，智能体束的设计、评估和优化应成为研究的核心焦点。

Abstract: This paper studies the next major bottleneck in agentic AI as system scaling, not only model scaling: the design of auditable, persistent, modular, and verifiable architectures around foundation models. We refer to this shift as scaling the harness: treating the structured execution layer around a foundation model as a first-class object of design, evaluation, and optimization. Although recent large language models enable agents to use tools, retrieve information, maintain memory, and execute long-horizon workflows, evaluation remains largely model-centric, often reducing agents to final-task success while treating memory, retrieval, tool use, orchestration, verification, and governance as secondary implementation details. This framing is increasingly inadequate because agent performance emerges from the interaction among the foundation model, memory substrate, context constructor, skill-routing layer, orchestration loop, and verification-and-governance layer. Together, these components form the agent harness, which translates model capability into long-horizon agent behavior. We study scaling the harness through three core bottlenecks: context governance, trustworthy memory, and dynamic skill routing, together with the orchestration and governance mechanisms that coordinate and constrain them. We further outline a research agenda for harness-level benchmarks that go beyond one-shot task success to measure trajectory quality, memory hygiene, context efficiency, communication fidelity, verification cost, and safe evolution over time. To make the discussion concrete, we develop CheetahClaws: https://github.com/SafeRL-Lab/cheetahclaws, a Python-native reference harness, and compare it with Claude Code and OpenClaw. Our main claim is that future progress in agentic AI will depend as much on system design as on stronger foundation models.

</details>


### [166] [MobileGym: A Verifiable and Highly Parallel Simulation Platform for Mobile GUI Agent Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26114)
*Dingbang Wu,Rui Hao,Haiyang Wang,Shuzhe Wu,Han Xiao,Zhenghong Li,Bojiang Zhou,Zheng Ju,Zichen Liu,Lue Fan,Zhaoxiang Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了MobileGym，一个针对日常移动应用的浏览器托管轻量级环境，支持可验证的结果信号和可扩展的在线强化学习，并通过实验验证了其在真实设备上的高保真迁移效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有移动应用交互环境存在两大局限性：缺乏可验证的任务结果信号（通常依赖不稳定的自由文本匹配），以及难以支持大规模并行在线强化学习训练（受限于昂贵的模拟器资源开销）。作者旨在构建一个轻量级、完全可控的环境，以实现高保真交互、确定性评估和可扩展训练。

Method: 提出MobileGym环境：1）采用结构化JSON状态表示，支持完整状态捕获、配置、分支和对比；2）设计分层状态模型和声明式任务定义框架，保证大规模下的状态可编程性和任务创建实用性；3）通过单一程序化评判机制，基于确定性状态判断提供评估结论和密集RL奖励；4）单服务器可托管数百个并行实例（每实例约400 MB内存，约3秒冷启动）。配套MobileGym-Bench包含416个参数化任务模板（28个应用），采用结构化AnswerSheet协议避免自由文本匹配失败。

Result: 在Sim-to-Real案例研究中：1）Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct通过GRPO训练，在256任务测试集上提升12.8个百分点；2）在59任务真实设备信号子集上，真实设备执行保留了模拟端训练收益的95.1%，验证了环境的高保真迁移能力。

Conclusion: MobileGym成功解决了日常移动应用环境中可验证评估和可扩展训练两大核心挑战，其轻量级设计、确定性评判机制和高并行能力使其成为移动智能体研究和Sim-to-Real迁移的有效工具。

Abstract: We present MobileGym, a browser-hosted, lightweight, fully controllable environment for everyday mobile use, targeting interaction fidelity without replicating proprietary backends. It enables two capabilities previously out of reach for everyday apps: verifiable outcome signals through deterministic state-based judging over structured JSON state, and scalable online RL through low-cost parallel rollouts. The full environment state is captured, configured, forked, and compared as structured JSON, and a single server can host hundreds of parallel instances, with about 400 MB memory per instance and about 3 s cold start. A layered state model and a declarative task-definition framework keep state programmability and task creation practical at scale, and a single programmatic judging mechanism delivers both deterministic evaluation verdicts and dense RL rewards. The accompanying MobileGym-Bench provides 416 parameterized task templates, including 256 test and 160 train templates, over 28 apps, with deterministic judges and a structured AnswerSheet protocol that avoids free-text matching failures. In a Sim-to-Real case study, GRPO on Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct gains +12.8 percentage points on the 256-task test set, and on a 59-task real-device signal subset, real-device execution retains 95.1% of the simulation-side training gain. Project page: https://mobilegym.github.io.

</details>

# cs.MA [[Back]](#toc)

### [167] [TEAM-SimHRA: A Team-Based Simulation Framework for Human Reliability Analysis Using Multi-Agent Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23927)
*Xingyu Xiao,Jiejuan Tong,Jingang Liang,Haitao Wang*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本研究提出了TEAM-SimHRA框架，利用多智能体大语言模型模拟核控制室团队故障，成功复现了三哩岛和切尔诺贝利事故中的团队交互动力学特征，为安全关键系统的动态概率风险评估提供了新途径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统人因可靠性分析方法存在结构性局限，无法建模核控制室中团队层面的故障机制，包括交互动力学、诊断延迟、异议压制和权威驱动的错误传播等现象。这些团队层面的故障并非源于孤立的操作员错误，而是涌现的交互属性。

Method: 开发了TEAM-SimHRA多智能体大语言模型仿真框架，将人因可靠性重新定义为控制室团队的交互驱动涌现属性，而非静态的个体属性。该框架能够复现集体认知、角色条件化的权威动态、实时沟通压制，并在时序演化的事故进程中运行。以三哩岛（1979）和切尔诺贝利（1986）事故进行验证。

Result: 在三哩岛和切尔诺贝利事故案例验证中，表面效度通过率分别为43.5%和52.6%；成功复现了接近历史的决策延迟时间（134.8分钟 vs. 138分钟）；实现了完美的沟通压制稳定性和完全的权威压力级联，传播深度符合历史准确性。

Conclusion: 多智能体模拟能够提取传统方法无法获得的定量团队层面可靠性指标，为安全关键社会技术系统的基于仿真的动态概率风险评估开辟了可行路径。

Abstract: Team-level failure in nuclear control rooms arises not from isolated operator error, but from emergent interaction dynamics, delayed diagnosis, suppressed dissent, and authority-driven error propagation, that conventional human reliability analysis methods are structurally unable to model. This study introduces TEAM-SimHRA, a multi-agent large language model simulation framework that reconceptualizes human reliability as an interaction-driven emergent property of control room teams rather than a static individual attribute. Unlike existing approaches that assign fixed error probabilities to predefined tasks, TEAM-SimHRA reproduces collective cognition, role-conditioned authority dynamics, and real-time communication suppression across temporally evolving accident progressions. Validated against the Three Mile Island (1979) and Chernobyl (1986) accidents, the two most extensively documented nuclear team failures , the framework achieves face-validity pass rates of 43.5% and 52.6% respectively, reproducing near-historical decision delay (134.8 vs. 138 min), perfect communication suppression stability, and full authority pressure cascade at historically accurate propagation depth. These results demonstrate that multi-agent simulation can extract quantitative team-level reliability indicators that are inaccessible to traditional methods, opening a viable path toward simulation-based dynamic probabilistic risk assessment for safety-critical sociotechnical systems.

</details>


### [168] [comokit4py : a python package to ease COMOKIT agent based model simulation integration into a high performance computing workflow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23948)
*Arthur Brugière,Kévin Chapuis*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文开发了一个Python软件包，用于支持基于智能体的模型COMOKIT在高性能计算（HPC）环境中开展COVID-19干预措施的仿真实验与报告生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: COMOKIT用于模拟越南各城市居民的日常生活并评估COVID-19非药物干预措施，但此类仿真需处理大量参数组合与重复模拟，对计算资源要求极高，亟需工具支持其在HPC上的高效部署与分析。

Method: 设计并实现了一个Python包，使用户能够便捷地生成COMOKIT实验配置、在HPC基础设施上大规模探索参数空间并自动构建实验报告。

Result: 提供了可扩展的流程与工具，显著简化了COMOKIT在HPC上的实验设计、执行与结果分析，提升了仿真效率与可重复性。

Conclusion: 该Python包为基于ABM的流行病学政策评估提供了高效、易用的HPC支持，有助于加速公共卫生决策相关的大规模仿真研究。

Abstract: Agent-based model (ABM) are a kind of computer model that makes it possible to simulate a set of autonomous interacting programs called agents in a shared virtual environment. Among other application field, it has been commonly used to simulate social phenomena such as urban segregation, opinion dynamic or epidemiological crisis [1]. Recently, a research emphasis has been put on ABM to study in silico the impact of non-pharmaceutical interventions to mitigate the SARS-CoV-2 outbreak of 2020, with few of them that had a great impact on global political responses [2]. Among the model used COMOKIT [3] has been design to simulate the every-day-life of inhabitant of various cities in Vietnam and test policy interventions for various COVID-19 spread scenarios. Such endeavor required huge computational power to handle a huge number of simulation replication over a large set of parameters. In this proposal we present a python package that enables to easily generate, explore and build reports for any COMOKIT experiment to be launched over High-Performance Computing (HPC) infrastructure.

</details>


### [169] [SODE: Analyzing Social Dynamics in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23949)
*Inseo Jung,Yoonseok Oh,Kyungryul Back,Jinkyu Kim,Jungbeom Lee*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出SODE框架，从直接互惠、间接互惠和群体动态三个进化维度评估LLM智能体的社会行为，发现指令微调模型存在"被动顺从"易被利用，推理模型优先短期优化破坏长期合作，而长视野框架可激发推理模型的互惠能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究主要依赖结果导向的指标（如平均分数）评估LLM智能体的博弈行为，忽视了促进可持续合作的机制，因为相同分数可能来自完全不同的策略。需要建立机制导向的评估框架来理解LLM在人类社会动态中的行为对齐。

Method: 引入SODE（Social Dynamics Evaluation）框架，从三个进化维度评估LLM智能体：直接互惠（策略适应性）、间接互惠（声誉敏感性）和群体动态（合作韧性）。通过该框架系统性分析不同类型LLM的社会行为模式。

Result: 发现系统性差异：指令微调模型常表现出"被动顺从"，使其容易受到剥削；推理模型优先进行短期视野优化，破坏长期合作稳定性。重要的是，证明了"长视野框架"可以激发推理模型的互惠能力。

Conclusion: SODE提供了一个系统的、基于机制的基准，用于将AI智能体与复杂的人类社会动态对齐，为理解和改进LLM的社会行为对齐提供了新的评估范式。

Abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) evolve into interactive agents, understanding their behavioral alignment within human social dynamics becomes essential. While behavioral game theory offers a framework to study these interactions, previous work has predominantly relied on outcome-based metrics such as average scores. This focus overlooks the mechanisms that facilitate sustainable cooperation, as identical scores can be derived from vastly different strategies. To bridge this gap, we introduce SODE (Social Dynamics Evaluation), a framework that evaluates LLM agents across three evolutionary dimensions: Direct Reciprocity for strategy adaptation, Indirect Reciprocity for reputation sensitivity, and Group Dynamics for cooperative resilience. Applying SODE reveals systematic divergences: instruction-tuned models often exhibit "passive compliance" that renders them vulnerable to exploitation, while reasoning models prioritize short-horizon optimization, destabilizing long-term cooperation. Notably, we demonstrate that a "long-horizon framing" can unlock reciprocal capabilities in reasoning models. Thus, SODE offers a systematic, mechanism-grounded benchmark for aligning AI agents with complex human social dynamics.

</details>


### [170] [ProofAgent Harness: Open Infrastructure for Adversarial Evaluation of AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24134)
*Fouad Bousetouane*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 论文提出了ProofAgent Harness，一个用于AI智能体的可扩展、可审计、对抗性评估开源框架，通过多轮对抗试验、多评审评分和证据链接报告，发现优秀智能体在特定压力和场景下仍会出现选择性失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI智能体正进入高风险生产环境，需要使用工具、保持上下文、遵循策略、处理隐私数据并进行多轮交互。然而现有评估方法仍停留在孤立输出或静态任务层面，无法发现通过轨迹、压力和对抗交互产生的失败模式，亟需能够模拟真实生产环境压力的评估基础设施。

Method: 提出ProofAgent Harness开源基础设施，核心包含对抗性多评审评分与轮次级审计机制。系统围绕智能体提供完整评估流程：策划评估情报、运行对抗性多轮试验、捕获行为轨迹、应用后验多评审评分、解决分歧并生成证据链接报告。开放设计允许扩展领域、陷阱、指标、评审角色、评分规则和报告格式。

Result: 在客户支持、医疗分诊、隐私安全、代码生成等多个智能体上的实验表明：强智能体通过弱指标、脆弱轮次、不安全重构和操纵路径等方式选择性失败。同时发现小型量化的本地Harness LLM能够挑战由顶级大型LLM驱动的生产智能体，表明评估能力来源于完整Harness流程而非仅依赖模型规模。

Conclusion: ProofAgent Harness将AI智能体评估从静态评分转变为可重复、有证据支撑、可扩展且可操作的对抗性评估基础设施，能够在部署前系统性地发现智能体在复杂场景下的潜在问题，为高风险环境中的AI智能体部署提供安全保障。

Abstract: AI agents are entering high-risk production settings, where they use tools, retain context, follow policies, handle private data, and interact with users over multiple turns. Yet many evaluation methods still judge isolated outputs or static tasks, missing failures that emerge through trajectory, pressure, and adversarial interaction. We introduce ProofAgent Harness, open infrastructure for scalable, auditable, and adversarial AI agent evaluation. The harness provides evaluation infrastructure around an agent: it curates evaluation intelligence, runs adversarial multi-turn trials, captures behavioral traces, applies post-hoc multi-juror scoring, resolves disagreement, and produces evidence-linked reports. Its open design allows developers and researchers to extend domains, traps, metrics, juror personas, scoring rules, and reporting formats. At its core is Adversarial Multi-Juror Scoring with Turn-Level Audit, which evaluates completed agent behavior under pressure using calibrated juror personas, consensus checks, and turn-level evidence. Experiments across customer support, medical triage, privacy and security, and code generation agents show that strong agents fail selectively through weak metrics, fragile turns, unsafe reframing, and manipulation paths. We also find that a small quantized local Harness LLM can challenge production agents powered by best-in-class large LLMs, suggesting that evaluation capability emerges from the full harness pipeline rather than model scale alone. ProofAgent Harness turns AI agent evaluation from a static score into scalable adversarial evaluation infrastructure: repeatable, evidence-backed, extensible, and actionable before deployment.

</details>


### [171] [A Reinforcement Learning Inspired Latent Yield Based Adaptive Algorithm Switching Mechanism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24436)
*Jayprakash S. Nair,Jimson Mathew,Shivashankar B. Nair*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结合强化学习和遗传算法的高效算法选择方法，通过潜在收益聚合性能以实现稳定、自适应的算法切换。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在在线或动态环境中，问题特性随时间演变，仅依赖瞬时性能指标进行算法选择会导致反应过度、不稳定且次优的算法切换行为。

Method: 借鉴强化学习思想，将奖励和惩罚封装为潜在收益以触发探索与利用；引入遗传算法中的岛屿模型，实现算法种群间的并行探索与性能交换。

Result: 在排序算法和机器人避障任务上的实验评估表明，该方法具有可行性与有效性。

Conclusion: 该技术在需要自适应算法选择的领域中具有重要应用潜力。

Abstract: Selecting the most suitable algorithm for a given problem instance remains a challenging task, particularly in online or dynamic environments where problem characteristics evolve over time. Relying solely on instantaneous performance metrics can result in a reactive and unstable behaviour, often leading to suboptimal algorithm switching. This paper introduces a computationally efficient approach for aggregating an algorithm's performance across multiple problem instances that is fairly immune to erratic variations in instance features. Inspired by features inherent to Reinforcement Learning (RL), this technique encapsulates rewards and penalties into a latent yield that, in turn, triggers exploitation and exploration, consequently resulting in adaptive algorithm switching. The proposed technique employs island models, inspired by Genetic Algorithms, to facilitate parallel exploration and performance exchanges among algorithm populations inhabiting local repertoires. Experimental evaluations on sorting algorithms and robotic obstacle avoidance tasks demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of the approach, highlighting its potential in domains where adaptive algorithm selection is critical.

</details>


### [172] [Adaptive Punishment for Cooperation in Mixed-Motive Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24516)
*Min Tang,Fanqi Kong,Linyuan Lü,Xue Feng*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出了自适应惩罚机制(APC)，通过动态调整惩罚概率和强度来平衡惩罚效果与成本，有效促进了混合动机场景下的合作行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在现实世界的多智能体交互中，混合动机场景普遍存在。自利智能体往往为了即时奖励选择背叛，忽视了利他合作对长期收益和集体福利的提升。虽然同伴惩罚可以抑制背叛，但作为成本高昂的二阶利他行为，持续惩罚可能损害惩罚者的利益。现有方法难以有效实施惩罚来促进合作。

Method: 提出自适应惩罚机制(APC)，这是一种分布式方法，根据动态惩罚概率和背叛严重程度来确定惩罚强度。该动态概率显著减少了高成本且低效的惩罚。同时引入背叛感知模块，在游戏奖励的指导下学习准确评估背叛行为及其严重程度。

Result: 理论分析和实证结果表明，APC在重复公共物品博弈中表现有效。实验证明，APC在序列社会困境中显著优于现有基线方法，能够学习理性和有效的惩罚策略，通过策略性地抑制背叛来促进合作。

Conclusion: APC成功解决了惩罚效果与成本之间的平衡问题，为混合动机场景下的多智能体合作提供了一种有效的解决方案，通过自适应和策略性的惩罚机制实现了集体福利的优化。

Abstract: Mixed-motive scenarios are ubiquitous in real-world multi-agent interactions, where self-interested agents often defect for immediate rewards, overlooking the potential of altruistic cooperation to improve long-term gains and collective welfare. Peer punishment can deter defection, but as costly second-order altruism, its persistent imposition may undermine the punisher's interests. Existing approaches often struggle to effectively implement punishment to promote cooperation. To balance the efficacy and cost of punishment, we propose Adaptive Punishment for Cooperation (APC), a distributed method that determines punishment intensity based on both a dynamic punishment probability and the severity of defection. This dynamic probability substantially reduces costly and ineffective punishment while also promotes cooperation. To accurately assess defection and its severity, we use a defection awareness module, whose learning is guided by game reward. Theoretical analysis and empirical results show APC performs effectively in iterated public goods game. Empirically, APC also significantly outperforms existing baselines across sequential social dilemmas, learning rational and effective punishment policies that foster cooperation by strategically deterring defection.

</details>


### [173] [Recursive Multi-Agent Trading System: Iterative Optimized Portfolio Strategy Under Geopolitical Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25311)
*Jing Yang,Yichao Wu,Jianan Liu,Penghao Liang,Mengwei Yuan,Xianyou Li,Weiran Yan*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: RMATS是一种递归多智能体交易系统，通过四个专业智能体和递归管理器协同工作，在561个交易日测试中实现了9.62%的最大回撤，优于传统方法，并在地缘政治压力情景下表现出色，是一种以风险控制为导向的交易架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对传统投资方法在地缘政治不确定性和市场压力情景下风险控制能力不足的问题，本文旨在开发一种能够有效保护资本、降低回撤风险的多智能体交易系统，以满足优先考虑资本保全的机构投资者需求。

Method: 提出递归多智能体交易系统(RMATS)，集成情感分析、报告、分析和风险四个专业智能体，通过递归管理器智能体进行协调，并引入迭代反馈循环机制，实现多智能体间的协同决策与风险管控。

Result: 在2023年1月至2025年3月的561个交易日、24个资产多类别投资组合测试中，RMATS实现了9.62%的最大回撤，显著优于MVO(15.49%)和FinBERT情感分析(15.28%)；在5个地缘政治压力情景中的3个展现出最低的事件期回撤；消融研究证实了每个智能体组件对下行保护的具体贡献。

Conclusion: RMATS定位为一种以风险控制为导向的交易架构，虽然在持续牛市环境中收益表现不及收益最大化基准，但其卓越的下行保护能力使其特别适合在地缘政治不确定性环境下优先考虑资本保全的机构投资者。

Abstract: Recursive Multi-Agent Trading System (RMATS) integrates four specialized agents -- Sentiment, Report, Analysis, and Risk -- coordinated through a recursive Manager Agent with iterative feedback loops. Experimental evaluation over a 561-trading-day period (January 2023 to March 2025) across a 24-asset multi-class universe demonstrates that RMATS achieves a maximum drawdown of 9.62%, lower than MVO (15.49%) and FinBERT Sentiment (15.28%), and exhibits the lowest event-period drawdown in 3 of 5 geopolitical stress scenarios tested. While RMATS underperforms return-maximizing baselines in a sustained bull market environment, ablation studies confirm the individual contribution of each agent component to downside protection. These results position RMATS as a risk-control-oriented architecture suitable for institutions prioritizing capital preservation under geopolitical uncertainty.

</details>


### [174] [Collaborative Threat-Aware Autonomy (CTAA)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25741)
*Rajnikant Sharma,Abhinav Sinha,Isaac Weintraub*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种角色差异化的多智能体框架，通过为自主协作平台（ACP）分配拦截、护航和诱饵三种角色，结合考虑最小转弯半径约束的反应式制导律（CSBEZ），实现了在动态对抗性武器交战区（WEZ）中的协同威胁感知轨迹规划，提高了团队任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在包含动态对抗性武器交战区（WEZ）的环境中，单个无人车辆无论其机载制导能力如何强大，都存在单点故障风险，这构成了任务成功的根本挑战。因此需要开发多智能体协同框架来提高团队级别的任务成功概率。

Method: 提出角色差异化的多智能体框架，将自主协作平台（ACP）编队分配为三种不同角色：主要拦截、护航和诱饵。每个ACP独立采用基于碰撞球边界逃逸零集（CSBEZ）的反应式制导律，该制导律考虑了最小转弯半径施加的追踪者机动性约束，引导车辆朝向最安全的航向前进。角色分配和空间路径分离产生两个互补效应：概率冗余（N条独立路径提高团队成功概率）和威胁饱和（低优先级护航和诱饵吸引敌方注意力，使主要车辆能够不受阻碍地通过）。

Result: 通过角色分配和空间路径分离实现了两个互补效应：概率冗余效应使得N条独立路径提高了团队成功概率；威胁饱和效应使低优先级的护航和诱饵吸引敌方注意力，从而释放主要车辆使其能够不受阻碍地通过区域，在管理个体WEZ暴露风险的同时提高了团队级别的任务成功概率。

Conclusion: 该框架通过角色差异化和协同制导策略，成功解决了无人车辆编队在对抗性环境中的导航问题，实现了概率冗余和威胁饱和的协同效应，为提高多智能体系统在动态威胁环境中的任务成功率提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Navigating teams of unmanned vehicles through environments containing dynamic, adversarial Weapon Engagement Zones~(WEZs) poses a fundamental challenge to mission success: a single vehicle, however capable its onboard guidance, remains a single point of failure. This paper presents a role-differentiated multi-agent framework for collaborative threat-aware trajectory planning in which a fleet of Autonomous Collaborative Platforms~(ACPs) is assigned distinct roles primary intercept, escort, and decoy to improve team-level mission success probability while managing individual WEZ exposure. Each ACP independently employs a reactive guidance law derived from the Collision Sphere Boundary for Evader Zero-Set~(CSBEZ), which accounts for pursuer maneuverability constraints imposed by minimum turn radius, and steers the vehicle toward the safest heading that also makes progress toward its goal. Role assignment and spatial route separation induce two complementary effects: probabilistic redundancy, in which $N$ independent paths raise the team success probability and threat saturation, in which lower-priority escorts and decoys draw adversary attention and free the primary vehicle to transit uncontested.

</details>


### [175] [Multi-Agent Coordination Adaptation via Structure-Guided Orchestration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25746)
*Haoran Li,Shulun Chen,Shaoyuan Sun,Hanchen Wang*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出MACA框架，通过概率视角将多智能体协调建模为结构与编排联合分布的后验推断，实现了比自适应基线平均提升8.42%的性能，同时减少43.19%的token使用量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM多智能体系统在扩展至复杂任务时面临结构稳定性与动态适应性的平衡难题：以结构为中心的方法缺乏细粒度控制，以编排为中心的方法则导致协调结构隐式且不稳定。

Method: 从概率视角重新审视多智能体协调，将其建模为结构与编排联合分布的后验推断问题。提出MACA框架，学习任务和预算条件的结构先验来引导基于策略的编排，作为后验推断的近似，从而实现高效求解与细粒度控制。

Result: 在多个基准测试中，MACA相比自适应多智能体基线平均性能提升8.42%，同时token使用量减少43.19%。进一步分析表明，结构与编排的联合适应抑制了冗余交互，使协调收敛至任务有效的执行方式。

Conclusion: MACA通过概率建模实现了结构稳定性与动态适应性的有效平衡，为大规模LLM多智能体系统的协调提供了新范式。

Abstract: As large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems scale to handle increasingly complex tasks, balancing structural stability and dynamic adaptability becomes increasingly challenging. Existing systems typically adopt either structure-centric methods, committing to structures determined upfront that limit fine-grained control, or orchestration-centric methods, adapting decisions dynamically while leaving coordination structure implicit and unstable. To address this challenge, we revisit multi-agent coordination from a probabilistic perspective, casting it as posterior inference over the joint distribution of structure and orchestration. We introduce MACA, an automated coordination framework that learns a task- and budget-conditioned structural prior over agent participation and interactions. This prior guides a policy-based orchestration as an approximation to posterior inference, enabling efficient solutions with fine-grained control. Across benchmarks, MACA outperforms adaptive multi-agent baselines by an average of 8.42% while using 43.19% fewer tokens. Further investigation reveals that joint adaptation of structure and orchestration suppresses redundant interactions, converging coordination toward task-effective execution.

</details>


### [176] [Multi-Agent Systems are Mixtures of Experts: Who Becomes an Influencer?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25929)
*Franka Bause,Jonas Niederle,Martin Pawelczyk,Rebekka Burkholz*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文通过Friedkin-Johnsen意见动态模型研究多智能体LLM协商机制，发现FJ参数具有输入依赖性，使多智能体系统成为专家混合模型，当路由反映智能体能力时可超越单一智能体和静态集成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究多智能体LLM协商的有效性不仅取决于单个智能体的预测能力，还取决于它们如何进行沟通和协作。现有研究缺乏对协商机制的深入理解，需要理论框架分析多智能体系统中的固执程度、影响力和意见变化模式。

Method: 采用Friedkin-Johnsen (FJ) 意见动态模型作为理论框架，该模型能够捕捉经验观察到的协商模式。研究FJ参数的输入依赖性，将多智能体协商建模为专家混合模型。通过观察代理分析影响力的建立机制：智能体的自我评估置信度、感知置信度以及与其他智能体观点的初始一致性。

Result: FJ参数具有输入依赖性，使得多智能体协商转变为专家混合模型。当路由机制能够反映智能体能力时，多智能体系统可以超越单一智能体和静态集成方法。由于能力在实践中是潜在的，影响力通过可观察的代理变量建立：自我评估置信度、感知置信度和初始观点一致性。

Conclusion: 多智能体LLM协商的有效性可以通过FJ意见动态模型进行理论分析和预测。该框架揭示了多智能体系统相对于单一智能体和静态集成的优势条件，为理解和改进多智能体协商机制提供了理论基础。影响力的建立依赖于可观察的代理变量，这为设计更好的多智能体协商协议提供了实践指导。

Abstract: The effectiveness of multi-agent LLM deliberation depends not only on the agents' individual predictions, but also on how they communicate and collaborate. We study this mechanism through the lens of Friedkin-Johnsen (FJ) opinion dynamics, a tractable model for analyzing stubbornness, influence, and opinion change in multi-agent systems that captures empirically observed deliberation patterns. We show that the FJ parameters are input-dependent, turning multi-agent deliberation into a mixture of experts. This perspective implies that multi-agent systems can outperform single agents and static ensembles when routing reflects agent competence. Since competence is latent in practice, we analyze how influence is established through observable proxies: agents' self-assessed confidence, their perceived confidence, and initial alignment with other agents' views.

</details>


<div id='cs.DC'></div>

# cs.DC [[Back]](#toc)

### [177] [Cross-Platform Fused MoE Dispatch in Triton: Portable Expert Routing Without CUDA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23911)
*Subhadip Mitra*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出了TritonMoE，一个用OpenAI Triton编写的便携式MoE前向传播内核，在NVIDIA A100上达到CUDA优化内核89-131%的性能，并在AMD MI300X上实现零代码修改的跨平台运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MoE优化内核（如Megablocks、Tutel、FasterMoE）均基于CUDA实现，被锁定在NVIDIA硬件上，缺乏跨平台可移植性；同时MoE推理受限于不规则的内存访问模式和专家路由开销。

Method: 使用OpenAI Triton原语实现完整的MoE前向传播（路由评分、token置换、专家GEMM、加权输出组合）。核心优化为融合gate+up GEMM内核，利用共享的L2缓存输入块和寄存器内SiLU激活同时计算两个SwiGLU投影，减少35%的全局内存流量。

Result: 在NVIDIA A100上，针对推理批次大小（≤512 tokens），TritonMoE在Mixtral-8x7B、DeepSeek-V3和Qwen2-MoE配置下达到CUDA优化Megablocks 89-131%的吞吐量。所有162项正确性测试在NVIDIA A100和AMD MI300X上均通过，验证了跨平台可移植性。发现在极端Zipf偏斜分布下，64+专家时固定块调度性能不如Megablocks的块稀疏布局。

Conclusion: 证明了完全基于Triton实现便携式高性能MoE内核的可行性，实现了接近CUDA优化内核的性能与真正的跨平台支持，并指出了在极端负载不平衡场景下的改进方向（动态块到专家分配）。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures power the majority of frontier large language models, but their inference is bottlenecked by irregular memory access patterns and expert routing overhead. Existing optimized MoE kernels (Megablocks, Tutel, FasterMoE) are implemented in CUDA and locked to NVIDIA hardware. We present TritonMoE, a fused MoE dispatch kernel written entirely in OpenAI Triton that performs the complete forward pass -- router scoring, token permutation, expert GEMMs, and weighted output combination -- using only portable Triton primitives. Our key optimization is a fused gate+up GEMM kernel that computes both SwiGLU projections from shared L2-cached input tiles with in-register SiLU activation, eliminating 35% of global memory traffic. On an NVIDIA A100, TritonMoE achieves 89-131% of the throughput of the CUDA-optimized Megablocks at inference batch sizes (<= 512 tokens) across Mixtral-8x7B, DeepSeek-V3, and Qwen2-MoE configurations. All 162 correctness tests pass on both NVIDIA A100 and AMD MI300X with zero code changes, validating cross-platform portability. We additionally characterize sensitivity to routing imbalance under Zipfian-skewed expert assignments and identify the regime -- 64+ experts under extreme skew -- where our fixed-tile scheduling underperforms Megablocks' block-sparse layout, motivating dynamic block-to-expert assignment as future work. Code is available at https://github.com/bassrehab/triton-kernels.

</details>


### [178] [Can LoRA Fusion Support Cross-Domain Tasks in Cloud-Edge Collaboration?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23913)
*Yatong Wang,Fali Wang,Naibin Gu,Zheng Lin,Zhengxiao Liu,Dingyu Yao,Zhiwei Zhang,Jianxin Shi,Weiping Wang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文针对云边协作场景下的跨域问题求解，提出剪枝-训练-恢复框架实现本地LoRA训练，构建MMLU-CD基准测试，揭示现有LoRA融合方法因参数冲突在跨域任务上表现不佳，并提出LoRA-CR模块缓解冲突，性能提升达3.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 云托管大语言模型通过LoRA进行领域适应，但领域数据分布在多个边缘设备且因隐私约束无法上传，这引发了一个根本性问题：如何将多个私有边缘的知识整合到云端LLM中以实现跨域问题求解？现有方案假设边缘设备能承载云端规模LLM且主要在单域任务上评估，存在不切实际的假设和评估局限。

Method: 提出剪枝-训练-恢复框架，使本地能在剪枝模型上训练LoRA适配器并实现隐私保护的云端集成；构建MMLU-CD跨域基准测试，将多个领域样本组合为单个实例以显式评估跨域问题求解能力；针对现有LoRA融合方法的参数冲突问题，提出简单的冲突解决模块LoRA-CR以缓解冲突更新。

Result: 现有LoRA融合方法在MMLU-CD上表现较差，往往低于基础LLM性能，表明其无法支持跨域问题求解；提出的LoRA-CR模块能够缓解冲突更新，将LoRA融合性能提升高达3.8%。

Conclusion: 参数冲突是云边LoRA融合中关键但长期被忽视的因素，冲突缓解对跨域任务至关重要，值得在未来研究中进一步探索；现有融合方法在跨域场景下存在明显缺陷。

Abstract: Cloud-hosted large language models (LLMs) commonly rely on LoRA for domain adaptation, yet domain data are distributed across multiple edge devices and cannot be uploaded due to privacy constraints. This raises a fundamental question: how can knowledge from multiple private edges be integrated into a cloud LLM for cross-domain problem solving? A natural solution is to train LoRA adapters locally and fuse them in the cloud; however, existing pipelines rely on unrealistic assumptions that edge devices can host cloud-scale LLMs and are evaluated mainly on single-domain tasks. To address these limitations, we propose a prune-train-recover framework that enables local LoRA training on pruned models and privacy-preserving cloud integration. We further introduce MMLU-CD, a cross-domain benchmark that composes multiple domain samples into a single instance, enabling explicit evaluation of cross-domain problem solving. This allows us to ask a concrete question: Can existing LoRA fusion methods support cross-domain tasks in cloud-edge collaboration? Our empirical answer is negative. Existing LoRA fusion methods perform poorly on MMLU-CD, often underperforming the base LLM, revealing their inability to support cross-domain problem solving. We attribute this failure to parameter conflicts among LoRA adapters and propose a simple conflict-resolution module, LoRA-CR, which mitigates conflicting updates and improves LoRA fusion performance by up to 3.8%. These results identify conflict mitigation as a critical yet largely overlooked factor in cloud-edge LoRA fusion, warranting further investigation in future research.

</details>


### [179] [VineLM: Trie-Based Fine-Grained Control for Agentic Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23914)
*Nikos Pagonas,Matthew Lou,Tianyi Peng,Dan Rubenstein,Kostis Kaffes*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: VineLM是一种新型工作流管理器，通过在运行时动态选择每个阶段的模型，在成本或延迟预算下最大化准确性，相比静态工作流方法准确率提升高达18%，离线分析成本降低98-99.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作流管理器采用离线静态分析，为每个请求分配固定的工作流级计划，将可配置LLM阶段绑定到单一模型，在循环迭代中重复使用该模型，且运行时不重新评估这些选择。这种粗粒度方法缺乏灵活性，无法根据运行时情况动态优化。

Method: VineLM将可行执行表示为模型选择前缀的标注字典树，使用检查点和级联分析来估计路径准确性、成本和延迟，无需对每个请求的每条路径进行详尽分析。运行时在每个阶段调用后重新定位字典树，利用已实现的执行前缀和剩余延迟预算在剩余子树上重新规划。

Result: 在NL2SQL和数学推理工作流上，VineLM相比粗粒度工作流基线改善了成本-延迟-准确性前沿。在相同每请求预算下准确率提高高达18%，稀疏分析相比详尽分析将离线分析成本降低98-99.8%。

Conclusion: 通过细粒度的运行时模型选择和基于字典树的自适应重规划，VineLM成功突破了静态工作流规划的限制，实现了更优的成本-延迟-准确性权衡，大幅降低了离线分析开销。

Abstract: Agentic workflows interleave configurable LLM stages with tool stages and often include retries or refinement loops. Existing workflow managers profile full workflow configurations offline and assign each request a static workflow-level plan that binds each configurable LLM stage to a single model, reuses that model across repeated loop iterations, and does not revisit those choices at runtime. We present VineLM, a workflow manager that enables fine-grained control by choosing the model for each stage invocation as execution unfolds under request-level objectives such as maximizing accuracy under cost or latency budgets. VineLM represents feasible executions as an annotated trie of model-choice prefixes and uses checkpointing and cascade profiling to estimate path accuracy, cost, and latency without exhaustively profiling every request on every path. At runtime, VineLM re-roots the trie after each stage invocation and replans over the remaining subtrie using the realized execution prefix and remaining latency budget. On NL2SQL and math reasoning workflows, VineLM improves the cost-latency-accuracy frontier over coarse workflow-level baselines, achieving up to 18% higher accuracy at the same per-request budget with its sparse profiling reducing offline profiling cost by 98-99.8% when compared to exhaustive profiling.

</details>


### [180] [The Model Parking Tax: Quantifying the Hidden Energy Cost of Always-On GPU Model Deployment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23918)
*Sai Sathvik Vadari*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: GPU空闲功率由CUDA上下文触发的DVFS状态决定，而非显存占用量；跨架构实验表明“驻留税”的98%以上来自上下文开销（26-66W），显存的边际影响可忽略不计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI推理行业为避免冷启动延迟而将模型常驻GPU内存，将空闲功耗视为固定的“就绪成本”，但这一成本结构从未被实证分解，更未跨越不同GPU架构进行研究。本文旨在首次跨架构测量VRAM分配对空闲GPU功耗的影响，揭示“驻留税”的真实来源。

Method: 结合18天的生产遥测数据（335,267个样本，14块H100 GPU）与控制实验，跨越三种GPU架构和三种内存技术：NVIDIA H100（HBM3，80GB）、A100（HBM2e，80GB）和L40S（GDDR6，48GB）。通过剂量-响应实验测量空闲功率与VRAM分配的关系，并使用真实HuggingFace模型（Qwen2.5-7B）验证发现，同时捕获模型加载期间的冷启动功率曲线。

Result: 三种架构上空闲功率均呈分段常数特性：CUDA上下文强制触发离散DVFS跃迁，导致比裸空闲状态多消耗26-66W（HBM架构26-50W，GDDR6架构66W）；边际VRAM效应在所有设备上都低于测量相关性阈值（|β| < 0.02 W/GB）。CUDA上下文贡献了超过98%的“驻留税”，与内存技术无关。真实模型验证显示与空张量的功耗差异小于0.5W。冷启动盈亏平衡模型表明最优行为取决于请求到达率和加载延迟（而非模型大小），盈亏平衡区间为1-5分钟。

Conclusion: 在所有测试架构中存在一致性约束：带上下文的空闲功率由DVFS状态决定，而非内存占用。这一发现对GPU资源管理和能耗优化策略具有重要意义，挑战了将模型大小作为能耗决策主要因素的既有认知。

Abstract: The AI inference industry keeps models loaded in GPU memory around the clock to avoid cold-start latency, implicitly treating idle power as a fixed cost of readiness. Yet the structure of this cost has never been empirically decomposed - and never across GPU architectures. We present the first cross-architecture measurement of idle GPU power as a function of VRAM allocation, combining 18 days of production telemetry (335,267 samples, 14 H100 GPUs) with controlled dose-response experiments on three GPU architectures spanning three memory technologies: NVIDIA H100 (HBM3, 80 GB), A100 (HBM2e, 80 GB), and L40S (GDDR6, 48 GB). We observe that idle power is piecewise constant on all three architectures: the CUDA context forces a discrete DVFS transition consuming +26-66 W over bare idle (26-50 W on HBM architectures, 66 W on GDDR6), while the marginal VRAM effect is bounded below measurement relevance ($|β| < 0.02$ W/GB) on every device tested. The CUDA context accounts for >98% of the parking tax regardless of memory technology. We validate this finding with a real HuggingFace model (Qwen2.5-7B) on all three architectures, confirming <0.5 W difference from empty tensors on every device, and capture cold-start power profiles during model loading. We derive a cold-start breakeven model showing energy-optimal behavior depends on request arrival rate and loading latency - not model size - with breakeven intervals of 1-5 minutes. Our results identify a constraint consistent across all tested architectures: idle-with-context power is determined by DVFS state, not memory occupancy.

</details>


### [181] [RASC: Region-Aware Self-Calibration for Dense 2D Sensor Arrays](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23963)
*Yinglei Ma,Fei Xiao*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出RASC算法，通过区域分解和鲁棒交替估计解决BJT二维温度传感器阵列部署后的参数漂移问题，在无实验室重新标定条件下将非均匀性降低71%，恢复±0.1°C精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于BJT的二维温度传感器阵列出厂标定精度为±0.1°C，但部署后的热应力和机械应力导致单个传感器的增益-偏移参数漂移一个数量级，而实验室重新标定在实际应用中不可行。

Method: RASC算法包含五个阶段：将全局不适定问题分解为局部簇级别问题；在每个簇内运行鲁棒交替估计（截断均值场重建 + Huber IRLS）；通过簇重叠图上的线性共识协调重叠估计，具有可证明的指数收敛性。

Result: 在16×16阵列的7,632帧数据上（非均匀性为出厂标准的约5倍），RASC将局部非平滑固定模式残差降低71±5%（10折交叉验证），恢复±0.1°C精度，对已标定场的扰动仅为0.041°C RMSE；边缘区域残差降低78%，内部区域降低55%。在8×8至32×32阵列仿真中，RASC与集中式EKF oracle的差异在0.10°C以内，带宽降低约4倍。

Conclusion: RASC成功解决了部署后传感器阵列参数漂移问题，实现了无需实验室重新标定的自校准，在精度恢复和带宽效率方面表现优异，为实际部署的温度传感器阵列提供了一种实用的解决方案。

Abstract: BJT-based 2D temperature-sensor arrays are factory-calibrated to +/-0.1 degC, but post-deployment thermal and mechanical stresses drift their per-sensor gain-offset parameters by an order of magnitude, and in-lab recalibration is impractical. We present RASC (Region-Aware Self-Calibration), a five-stage algorithm that decomposes the global ill-posed problem into local cluster-level problems, runs robust alternating estimation (trimmed-mean field reconstruction + Huber IRLS) inside each cluster, and reconciles overlapping estimates by linear consensus on the cluster-overlap graph with provable exponential convergence. On 7,632 frames from a deployed 16x16 array exhibiting ~5x factory-spec non-uniformity, RASC cuts the locally-non-smooth fixed-pattern residual by 71+/-5% (10-fold CV), restoring +/-0.1 degC accuracy while perturbing the calibrated field by only 0.041 degC RMSE; reduction concentrates at the edges (78% vs 55% interior). In simulations on 8x8 to 32x32 arrays, RASC matches an oracle centralized EKF within 0.10 degC with ~4x lower bandwidth.

</details>


### [182] [TSFLora: Token-Compressed Split Fine-Tuning for Wireless Edge Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23988)
*Xianke Qiang,Zheng Chang,Li Wang,Ying-Chang Liang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: TSFLora通过注意力引导的token选择、合并和低比特量化，在分割联邦学习框架下实现了大模型边缘适配的通信效率与内存节省。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型在边缘设备个性化适配面临内存、计算和上行容量受限的挑战。现有联邦微调需设备承载完整模型，而分割学习虽降低内存但传输开销大。

Method: 提出TSFLora框架，结合注意力引导token选择、token合并、低比特激活量化与LoRA适配，在分割联邦训练流程中压缩传输前的中间token序列，保持冻结骨干网络不变。

Result: 在ViT模型上对CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和TinyImageNet的实验表明，TSFLora实现最高6.8倍通信减少和41%内存节省，同时保持竞争性精度。

Conclusion: TSFLora有效解决了边缘设备上大模型适配的通信与内存瓶颈，在分割联邦学习框架下实现了高效、通信友好的个性化微调，为边缘智能部署提供了新方案。

Abstract: Adapting large AI models (LAMs) to personalized edge data is challenging because wireless devices have limited memory, computation, and uplink capacity. Federated fine-tuning preserves data privacy but still requires each device to host the full model, while split learning reduces device memory at the cost of heavy activation transmission. This paper proposes TSFLora, a token-compressed split fine-tuning framework for communication-efficient LAM adaptation at the edge. TSFLora combines attention-guided token selection, token merging, low-bit activation quantization, and LoRA-based adaptation within a split federated training pipeline. The key idea is to compress the intermediate token sequence before transmission so that the system reduces both uplink traffic and server-side processing without changing the frozen backbone. Experiments on ViT models over CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and TinyImageNet show that TSFLora achieves up to \textbf{6.8$\times$} communication reduction and \textbf{41\%} memory saving while maintaining competitive accuracy.

</details>


### [183] [A Tabular Schedule Abstraction for Communication-Aware Evaluation of Pipeline-Parallel LLM Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24006)
*Daniel Barley,Jonathan Leis,Benjamin Klenk,Holger Fröning*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种统一的表格化调度抽象和多抽象分析方法，用于比较大型语言模型分布式训练中的流水线并行调度。发现调度优劣取决于具体的执行环境，仅靠气泡分析的结论可能被通信开销推翻。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的流水线并行调度比较方法存在局限性：解析模型只能揭示气泡比例等结构特性，而端到端的硬件实验成本高昂且具有系统特异性，因此难以公平、高效地比较不同流水线调度方案。

Method: 提出了一种表格化调度抽象和统一的多抽象分析方法，该方法将基于公式的推理、理想化调度表和通信感知的执行仿真结合起来，在多个建模系统配置下对GPipe、1F1B、Chimera和受限模式下的Hanayo进行比较分析。

Result: 1. 调度排名并非抽象不变量，通信开销可能抵消仅通过气泡分析得出的结构性优势；2. 在本文假设下，GPipe和1F1B运行时等效，但1F1B激活内存峰值更低；3. Chimera主要在微批次数量少和通信有利的场景下有优势；4. Hanayo在其设计的工作点有效但对网络瓶颈敏感；5. 非对称Chimera式布局虽在浅层流水线有有限运行时收益，但未降低全局峰值内存需求。

Conclusion: 流水线调度的质量只有在建模执行环境的上下文中才有意义，通信特性对调度性能至关重要，不能仅依赖理论结构分析。

Abstract: Pipeline parallelism is a key technique for distributed training of large language models because it reduces per-device parameter and activation memory. However, comparing pipeline schedules is difficult: analytical models expose structural quantities such as bubble ratios, while end-to-end hardware experiments are costly and system-specific. In this work, we introduce a tabular schedule abstraction and a unified multi-abstraction methodology that connects formula-based reasoning, idealized schedule tables, and communication-aware execution simulation.
  Using this framework, we compare GPipe, 1F1B, Chimera, and Hanayo in its restricted regime across multiple modeled system configurations. Our results show that schedule rankings are not abstraction-invariant: communication can negate structural advantages suggested by bubble analysis alone. Under the assumptions considered here, GPipe and 1F1B are runtime-equivalent, but 1F1B achieves a lower activation-memory peak. Chimera is advantageous mainly at low microbatch counts and in communication-favorable regimes, while Hanayo is effective in its intended restricted operating point but remains sensitive to network bottlenecks. We further study an asymmetric Chimera-style placement, which does not reduce the global peak memory requirement but reveals limited runtime gains in shallow pipelines. Overall, pipeline schedule quality is meaningful only in the context of the modeled execution environment.

</details>


### [184] [Polar: Agentic RL on Any Harness at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24220)
*Binfeng Xu,Hao Zhang,Shaokun Zhang,Songyang Han,Mingjie Liu,Jian Hu,Shizhe Diao,Zhenghui Jin,Yunheng Zou,Michael Demoret,Jan Kautz,Yi Dong*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出了Polar，一个可扩展的异步强化学习框架，通过将agent harness视为黑箱并重构token-faithful轨迹，解决了将复杂agent harness移植到RL环境接口的难题，在SWE-Bench上取得了显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言智能体的强化学习日益依赖于管理长时上下文、多轮工具使用和多智能体编排的自定义harness，但将这些harness移植到RL环境接口仍然困难且常丢失重要训练信号。

Method: Polar框架将agent harness视为黑箱，代理LLM API调用，记录token级模型交互，并重构token-faithful轨迹用于训练。每个rollout节点高效并行管理运行时预热、智能体执行、轨迹重构和评估，暴露可被独立训练器大规模消费的异步服务端点。这种解耦设计使Polar对agent harness、训练基础设施和RL算法无关。

Result: 在SWE-Bench Verified上，使用简单GRPO，Polar将Qwen3.5-4B在Codex、Claude Code、Qwen Code和Pi harness上分别提升了22.6、4.8、0.6和6.2个百分点。进一步验证了Polar在自定义harness上的离线数据生成能力。

Conclusion: Polar成功弥合了agent harness与RL环境接口之间的鸿沟，通过异步解耦设计提高了长期运行智能体工作负载的计算利用率，已作为NeMo Gym环境之一注册。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning for language agents increasingly depends on custom harnesses that manage long-running context, multi-turn tool use and multi-agent orchestration. However, porting these harnesses into RL environment interfaces remains difficult and often loses important training signals. We bridge this gap with polar, a rollout framework for scalable asynchronous RL over arbitrary agent harnesses. Polar treats the agent harness as a black box: it proxies LLM API calls, records token-level model interactions, and reconstructs token-faithful trajectories for training. Each rollout node efficiently manages runtime prewarming, agent execution, trajectory reconstruction, and evaluation in parallel, exposing asynchronous service endpoints that can be consumed by independent trainers at scale. This decoupled design makes Polar agnostic to agent harnesses, training infrastructure, and RL algorithms while improving compute utilization for long-running agent workloads. We validate polar by training agents on software-engineering tasks with popular coding harnesses. Using simple GRPO, polar improves Qwen3.5-4B by 22.6, 4.8, 0.6 and 6.2 points on SWE-Bench Verified with the Codex, Claude Code, Qwen Code and Pi harnesses, respectively. We further demonstrate Polar for offline data generation over custom harnesses and ablate trajectory reconstruction strategies. Polar rewrites its preceding work, Prorl Agent, and has been registered as one of NeMo Gym environments.

</details>


### [185] [Resident KV Claims: A Conformance Contract for Future Reuse under Active KV Pressure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24259)
*Lukas Stepanek*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了resident KV claims机制，一种运行时一致性合约，用于解决KV-cache重用中常驻缓存与活跃请求冲突时的仲裁问题，将未被报告的常驻缓存丢失转化为可追溯的调度决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的KV-cache重用机制虽然暴露了优先级、持续时间、卸载、路由提示等机制，但缺乏一个可移植的合约来定义当常驻KV和活跃KV无法同时容纳时，如何处理可接受的未来重用状态。现有机制无法有效保护可重用前缀，可能导致重要的常驻缓存被意外驱逐。

Method: 引入resident KV claims（常驻KV声明）机制，这是一个一致性合约，将未来重用意图与以下内容绑定：物化谓词、生命周期状态、活跃/常驻可行性结果以及声明级别的遥测数据。在vLLM分配器中进行受控探测，使用硬保护声明将失败模式转换为调度器可见的活跃拒绝，并提供直接的阻塞声明归因。开发了MicroRuntime和vLLM litmus测试套件来区分各种场景。

Result: 在vLLM原型中，当60块的常驻声明和70块的活跃预填充超过80块可用KV池时，write no-admit模式会阻止活跃请求成为未来可重用状态，但仍允许活跃分配驱逐共享池中的常驻缓存。硬保护的常驻声明能将此失败模式转换为带有阻塞声明归因的调度器可见活跃拒绝。测试套件成功区分了普通驱逐、软优先级、write no-admit、接受的硬声明、物化失败、降级、过期、活跃拒绝等多种场景。

Conclusion: 这不是一个生产加速方案或新的缓存替换算法，而是一个运行时合约，它将未报告的常驻丢失转化为可重构的活跃/常驻仲裁。该合约为KV-cache管理提供了可追溯性和透明度，使调度器能够做出知情决策，而非盲目驱逐重要的常驻缓存。

Abstract: KV-cache reuse mechanisms increasingly expose priority, duration, offload, routing hints, scheduler modes, and event streams. These mechanisms help preserve reusable prefixes, but they do not by themselves define a portable contract for accepted future-reuse state when resident KV and active live KV cannot both fit. We introduce resident KV claims, a conformance contract that binds future-reuse intent to a materialization predicate, lifecycle state, active/resident feasibility outcome, and claim-level telemetry. In controlled vLLM allocator probes, a 60-block resident claim and a 70-block active prefill exceed an 80-block usable KV pool. Write no-admit prevents the active request from becoming future reusable state, but it still allows active allocation to evict residents from the shared pool. A minimal vLLM prototype shows that hard protected resident claims convert this failure mode into scheduler-visible active refusal with direct blocking-claim attribution. The result is not a production speedup or a new cache-replacement algorithm. It is a runtime contract that turns unreported resident loss into reconstructable active/resident arbitration. A companion MicroRuntime and vLLM litmus suite distinguish ordinary eviction, soft priority, write no-admit, accepted hard claims, materialization failure, demotion, expiry, active refusal, and trace-level outcome reconstruction.

</details>


### [186] [ScaleAcross Explorer: Exploring Communication Optimization for Scale-Across AI Model Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24326)
*Minghao Li,Alicia Golden,Samuel Hsia,Michael Kuchnik,Adi Gangidi,Xu Zhang,Ashmitha Jeevaraj Shetty,Zachary DeVito,Weiwei Chu,Dong He,Haoci Zhang,Yuchen Hao,Ruoming Pang,James Hongyi Zeng,Ying Zhang,Minlan Yu,Carole-Jean Wu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出ScaleAcross Explorer优化器，针对跨多数据中心的“scale-across”大模型训练范式，通过系统化地优化并行性布局、并行性调度和网络层技术三个关键设计维度，实现了相比生产配置最高64.62%的训练加速，相比最先进基线最高37.59%的训练加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型训练规模的快速增长，需要将GPU资源分布在多个数据中心建筑和区域中。这种跨规模训练范式面临基础设施扩展带来的设计空间复杂性增加，包括新的模型架构、硬件异构性以及不断演变的通信模式等挑战。为了加速大型设计空间的探索并为前沿模型开发实现高效训练，需要系统性地优化跨规模训练。

Method: 基于Meta的生产环境经验，深入刻画了三个关键设计维度：并行性布局（parallelism placement）、并行性调度（parallelism scheduling）和网络层技术（network layer technologies）。提出了ScaleAcross Explorer优化器，该优化器考虑各设计维度之间的相互作用，实现对跨规模训练的整体性优化。通过测试平台实验和模拟仿真进行验证。

Result: 实验结果表明，在广泛的设计点上，相比生产配置实现了最高64.62%的训练加速，相比最先进的基线实现了最高37.59%的训练加速。证明了该方法在跨数据中心大规模训练场景下的有效性。

Conclusion: ScaleAcross Explorer能够有效解决跨数据中心大规模训练的复杂性挑战，通过整体优化关键设计维度显著提升训练效率。该方法为大模型基础设施的部署和优化提供了实用的解决方案，有助于推动前沿模型的发展。

Abstract: The rapid scaling of large language model training requires distributing GPU resources across multiple data center buildings and regions. We refer to such paradigm as "scale-across" training. As infrastructure expands, the system design space becomes increasingly intricate, encompassing new model architectures, hardware heterogeneity, and evolving communication patterns. Drawing from Meta's production experience, we highlight the complexities of deploying training jobs across a few data centers housing hundreds of thousands of GPUs.
