To accelerate exploration of the large design space and to enable efficient training for frontier model development, we conduct in-depth characterization of three key design dimensions: parallelism placement, parallelism scheduling, and network layer technologies. We then propose ScaleAcross Explorer, an optimizer that considers the interplay of design dimensions and holistically optimizes scale-across training. Testbed experiments and simulations demonstrate up to 64.62% training speedups over production configuration and up to 37.59% training speedups over the state-of-the-art baseline across a wide range of design points.

</details>


### [187] [Energy-Aware Computing in the Year 2026](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24569)
*Roblex Nana Tchakoute,Claude Tadonki*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文综述了Exascale时代高性能计算（HPC）和大规模AI应用面临的能耗挑战，提出了一套涵盖硬件、软件、测量、调度、冷却等多维度的能效计算分类体系，并展望了可持续计算的未来发展路线图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着HPC进入Exascale时代，大规模应用（如生成式AI训练与推理）的能耗急剧攀升，已成为关键系统性瓶颈。除经济成本外，气候变化、碳排放、能源生产供应限制等环境与社会因素推动了对绿色计算的迫切需求，亟需对整个云-边-HPC连续体的能效问题进行系统性解决。

Method: 基于对最新重要研究成果的全面调研，设计并描述了一个整体性分类体系（holistic taxonomy）。该分类框架围绕多个视角构建，包括：硬件与软件层面、测量仪器、软件优化、动态任务调度、电压调节、负载整合、联邦学习以及冷却技术。

Result: 提供了一份全面的能效计算综述，系统梳理了现有研究贡献，构建了结构化的多维分类法。特别强调大规模AI领域的资源需求问题，对相关研究进行了重点分析。

Conclusion: 提出了面向可持续计算的前瞻性发展路线图分析，为未来ICT活动的能耗监管和绿色计算技术发展指明了主要方向和视角。

Abstract: High-Performance Computing (HPC) has recently entered the Exascale era, and considerable efforts are being made to fully harness this potential power for large-scale applications, such as cutting-edge generative AI (training and exploitation). The corresponding energy consumption is very high, and forecasts are alarming, making this metric a critical systemic bottleneck. Addressing this issue presents a genuine challenge for the entire cloud-edge-HPC continuum at all scales, from low-power IoT microcontrollers to multi-megawatt data centers. Beyond financial costs, green computing is driven by considerations related to climate change and environmental concerns such as carbon footprint ($CO_2e$), as well as constraints on energy production and supply, leading to a real need to regulate {\em information and communication technology} (ICT) activities. This article presents a comprehensive overview of energy-efficient computing, taking into account the most recent and significant contributions. Based on this exploration of the state of the art, we design and describe a holistic taxonomy of the aforementioned publications, structured around various perspectives, including {\em hardware and software aspects, measurement instrumentation, software optimizations, dynamic task scheduling, voltage scaling, workload consolidation, federated learning}, and {\em cooling}. Particular emphasis is placed on large-scale AI, which receives significant attention due to its considerable resource requirements. We conclude with an analysis of a forward-looking roadmap that considers the main perspectives of sustainable computing.

</details>


### [188] [Optimus: Elastic Decoding for Efficient Diffusion LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24832)
*Chiyue Wei,Cong Guo,Bowen Duan,Junyao Zhang,Haoxuan Shan,Yifei Wang,Yangjie Zhou,Hai "Helen" Li,Danyang Zhuo,Yiran Chen*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出了Optimus系统，通过动态调整扩散大模型的解码粒度来适应运行时负载，解决了固定块大小解码在高负载下性能下降的问题，实现了最高6.1倍吞吐量提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散大模型（DLLMs）采用固定块大小解码，存在严重的负载敏感性：低负载时大块解码能利用闲置GPU资源，但高负载时过早饱和并产生大量冗余计算，导致吞吐量增益消失，单一解码粒度无法在动态服务负载下保持良好性能。

Method: 提出Optimus系统，将解码粒度作为运行时控制变量。核心技术包括：(1)分块解码（chunked decoding），无需重新训练即可实现细粒度执行；(2)饱和感知调度（saturation-aware scheduling），基于运行时条件的闭环机制选择块大小；(3)系统级优化和定制注意力内核。

Result: 相比自回归解码实现高达6.1倍吞吐量提升，相比固定块扩散大模型实现4.3倍提升；在不同负载条件下保持稳定性能；在延迟约束下提升端到端服务能力。

Conclusion: 通过弹性解码机制动态适配解码粒度，Optimus成功平衡了GPU利用率和令牌效率，解决了扩散大模型服务中的负载敏感性难题，显著提升了服务系统性能。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) serving is fundamentally limited by inefficient hardware utilization. Autoregressive (AR) decoding underutilizes GPUs due to its strictly sequential execution, while diffusion LLMs (DLLMs) improve throughput by decoding multiple tokens per iteration. However, fixed block-size diffusion decoding exhibits strong load sensitivity: large blocks exploit idle GPU resources under low load, but saturate early and incur substantial redundant computation under high load. As a result, throughput gains vanish beyond saturation, and no single decoding granularity performs well across dynamic serving workloads.
  We present Optimus, a serving system that enables elastic decoding for diffusion LLMs by dynamically adapting decoding granularity to runtime load. The key idea is to treat decoding granularity as a runtime control variable, balancing GPU utilization and token efficiency. Optimus combines chunked decoding, which enables fine-grained execution without retraining, with saturation-aware scheduling, a closed-loop mechanism that selects chunk sizes based on runtime conditions. Together with system-level optimizations and customized attention kernels, Optimus achieves significant performance improvements while preserving model accuracy. Experiments show that Optimus delivers up to 6.1x throughput improvement over AR decoding and 4.3x improvement over fixed-block diffusion LLM, while maintaining stable performance across diverse load regimes and improving end-to-end serving capacity under latency constraints. The source code is available at https://github.com/dubcyfor3/Optimus.

</details>


### [189] [Kavier: Exploring Performance, Sustainability, and Efficiency of LLM Ecosystems under Inference through Cache-Aware Discrete-Event Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25247)
*Radu Nicolae,Alexandru Iosup,Animesh Trivedi,Jesse Donkervliet*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出了LLM生态系统推理阶段的参考架构(RA)和首个仿真工具Kavier，能够预测大规模语言模型系统的性能、可持续性和效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在社会中广泛应用但带来可持续性、性能和成本问题，推理工作负载不断增长。缺乏LLM生态系统的参考架构导致设计和运维困难，亟需仿真工具来辅助决策。

Method: 1. 综合、提出并验证LLM生态系统推理阶段的参考架构(RA)；2. 基于该架构设计Kavier仿真工具，采用离散事件仿真和缓存感知模拟，重点关注KV-Caching和提示前缀缓存策略。

Result: 通过Kavier原型和真实轨迹实验：(i)验证了仿真准确性和大规模仿真能力；(ii)比较了不同KV-Caching策略的性能；(iii)分析了不同前缀缓存策略下LLM生态系统的性能、可持续性和效率。

Conclusion: Kavier能够以时间高效、性能高效和成本高效的方式预测LLM生态系统，为运营商、研究人员和工程师提供了有价值的决策工具。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are widely used by our increasingly digitalized society, but raise sustainability, performance, and financial concerns, especially as inference workloads grow. To improve the design and operation of LLM ecosystems, we envision simulators and simulation-based digital twins becoming primary decision-making tools. LLM ecosystems leverage many heterogeneous components, making simulation a non-trivial, yet critical operation. The simulation challenge is exacerbated by the absence of a comprehensive reference architecture of LLM ecosystems; the lack of such a conceptual model can be costly and could misguide the designers and engineers. Without a reference architecture, even the most experienced stakeholders could tinker in researching, engineering, or maintaining LLM ecosystems. In this work, we bring a three-fold contribution to the scientific community. Firstly, we synthesize, propose, and validate a reference architecture (RA) of LLM ecosystems under inference. Then, adhering to the reference architecture, we design Kavier, the first simulation instrument able to predict the performance, sustainability, and efficiency of LLM ecosystems under inference, through discrete-event and cache-aware simulation, focusing on Key-Value-(KV-)Caching and prompt prefix caching policies. Through experiments with a Kavier prototype and real-world traces, (i) we measure the accuracy of Kavier and its performance in massive-scale simulations, (ii) we compare the performance of different KV-Caching policies, and (iii) we analyze the performance, sustainability, and efficiency of LLM ecosystems under various prefix caching policies. Overall, we show that Kavier enables operators, researchers, and engineers to predict LLM ecosystems in a time, performance, and cost-efficient way.

</details>


### [190] [DECICE: AI-Driven Scheduling and Digital Twin Integration for the Cloud-HPC-Edge Compute Continuum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25292)
*Aasish Kumar Sharma,Felix Stein,Mirac Aydin,Michael Bidollahkhani,Sachin P. Nanavati,Mohsen Seyedkazemi Ardebili,Giorgi Mamulashvili,Mojtaba Akbari,Jonathan Decker,Zoya Masih,Julian M. Kunkel*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: DECICE项目开发了开源框架，通过AI驱动调度和数字孪生技术实现云-HPC-边缘计算连续体的智能工作负载调度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了解决跨云-HPC-边缘计算连续体的智能工作负载调度挑战，需要开发能够支持异构计算环境协同的统一调度框架。

Method: 开发了两个核心技术贡献：(1)集成AI调度器(IAIS)，采用基于RNN的预测和形式化工作流建模实现约束感知的工作负载映射；(2)数字孪生系统，聚合实时指标、碳强度和异常预测实现能耗感知调度。框架运行于Kubernetes环境，支持多格式统一工作流导入，并通过Slurm集成层连接云原生和HPC编排。

Result: 完成了包含12个合作伙伴、6个工作包的项目实施，覆盖AI驱动调度、数字孪生基础设施、系统架构集成、监控、用例验证和成果推广。框架已开源发布并提供了定量评估结果。

Conclusion: DECICE成功构建了开源的智能工作负载调度框架，实现了云-HPC-边缘计算连续体的协同编排，为异构计算环境的统一管理提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: This paper presents the DECICE project (Device Edge Cloud Intelligent Collaboration framEwork), a Horizon Europe Research and Innovation Action (Grant No. 101092582, December 2022 to November 2025) that developed an open-source framework for intelligent workload scheduling across the cloud-HPC-edge compute continuum. A consortium of 12 partners across 6 European countries organized the work into six work packages covering AI-driven scheduling, digital twin infrastructure, system architecture and integration, monitoring, use case validation, and dissemination. The two core technical contributions are an Integrated AI Scheduler (IAIS) employing RNN-based prediction and formal workflow modeling for constraint-aware workload mapping, and a Digital Twin aggregating real-time metrics with carbon intensity and anomaly prediction for energy-aware scheduling. The framework operates within Kubernetes environments, supports unified workflow ingestion from multiple formats, and bridges cloud-native and HPC orchestration through a Slurm integration layer. We present the project vision, the overall architecture, contributions from each work package, quantitative evaluation results, and the open-source release.

</details>


### [191] [Beyond Thread States: Diagnosing Performance Degradation with eBPF and Thread Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25298)
*Diogo Landau,Jorge G. Barbosa,Nishant Saurabh*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种应用无关的性能退化分析方法，通过扩展线程状态分析（TSA）并捕获细粒度线程动态，实现了对性能退化根因的精准定位。该方法在六个内核子系统中实现了16个eBPF指标，利用选择性线程跟踪算法成功诊断了CPU、磁盘、锁和外部服务争用等问题，且开销极小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线数据密集型（ODI）应用常因负载变化和资源干扰导致性能下降。现有的基于线程状态分析（TSA）的方法虽然能够识别受约束的子系统，但缺乏揭示传播性能退化的线程间依赖关系的粒度，因此无法深入分析性能问题的传播路径。

Method: 作者提出了一种应用无关的性能退化分析方法，核心在于扩展TSA以捕获细粒度的线程动态。具体实现包括：在调度、VFS、网络、futex、多路复用IO和块IO六个内核子系统中实现了16个基于eBPF的指标，用于追踪线程与特定资源（如futex、套接字、磁盘）的交互。该方法利用性能退化沿线程间依赖关系传播的特性，采用选择性线程跟踪算法，从入口线程追踪性能问题直至受限资源，从而捕获常见的退化模式。

Result: 实验结果表明，该方法能够在多变的工作负载和资源争用条件下，成功诊断CPU、磁盘、锁和外部服务争用等多种性能瓶颈，并能揭示应用内部的约束。同时，该方法具有极小的运行开销，证明了其实用性和高效性。

Conclusion: 本文提出的方法通过结合细粒度的线程动态捕获与选择性跟踪算法，有效弥补了现有TSA方法在粒度上的不足，能够精准定位性能退化的传播路径和根因，为在线数据密集型应用的性能诊断提供了一种高效、低开销的解决方案。

Abstract: Online Data-Intensive applications face performance degradation from load variability and resource interference. While Thread State Analysis (TSA) based approaches enable identifying constrained subsystems, they lack the granularity to reveal the inter-thread dependencies that propagate degradation. In this paper, we present an application-agnostic performance degradation analysis method that extends TSA by capturing fine-grained thread dynamics. We implemented $16$ eBPF-based metrics across six kernel subsystems, including scheduling, VFS, networking, futex, multiplexing IO, and block IO which enables tracing thread interactions with specific resources like futexes, sockets, and disks. Our method leverages the fact that performance degradation propagates along inter-thread dependencies, and a subset of thread-resource interactions can enable capturing common degradation patterns. To this end, we employ a selective thread tracking algorithm that traces performance issues from entry-point threads to constrained resources. Experimentation with diverse applications under variable workloads and resource contention shows our method successfully diagnoses CPU, disk, lock, and external service contention with minimal overhead, while also revealing internal application constraints.

</details>


### [192] [Multithreaded Fine-Grained Asynchronous BSP for Integer Sorting with LCI and OpenMP](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25340)
*Minyu Cheng,Jiakun Yan,Marc Snir*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结合LCI和OpenMP的多线程FA-BSP方法，通过细粒度零拷贝活跃消息实现高效计算通信重叠，显著提升了不规则负载应用的性能和可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统BSP模型在处理不规则工作负载时受限于全局通信的刚性；现有的FA-BSP实现通常依赖单进程单核心模型，无法充分利用多核架构。

Method: 提出多线程FA-BSP方法，结合轻量级通信接口（LCI）和OpenMP；用OpenMP多线程和LCI的细粒度、零拷贝活跃消息替代同步MPI集合操作；使用NAS并行基准测试中的整数排序（IS）进行评估，保留原始不规则高斯分布以严格测试负载均衡。

Result: 多线程FA-BSP在计算通信重叠方面表现高效；相比传统批量同步MPI实现，性能显著提升；为不规则科学应用提供了可扩展的解决方案。

Conclusion: 多线程FA-BSP方法成功解决了传统BSP模型在不规则工作负载下的局限性，为不规则科学计算应用提供了一种高效、可扩展的实现方案。

Abstract: The bulk synchronous parallel (BSP) model struggles with irregular workloads due to rigid global communication. While fine-grained asynchronous BSP (FA-BSP) improves overlap, existing implementations typically rely on a limiting one-process-per-core model. This paper proposes a multithreaded FA-BSP approach combining Lightweight Communication Interface (LCI) and OpenMP to fully exploit multicore architectures. We evaluate this design using the NAS Parallel Benchmark Integer Sort (IS), retaining the original irregular Gaussian distribution to rigorously test load balancing. By replacing synchronous MPI collectives with OpenMP multithreading and LCI's fine-grained, zero-copy active messages, we enable efficient computation-communication overlap. Our evaluation demonstrates that multithreaded FA-BSP significantly outperforms traditional bulk-synchronous MPI implementations, offering a scalable solution for irregular scientific applications.

</details>


### [193] [An Empirical Evaluation of Quantum-Inspired QUBO Methods for Heterogeneous HPC Workflow Mapping and Scheduling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25350)
*Aasish Kumar Sharma,Christian Boehme,Julian Kunkel*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了量子启发的QUBO方法在异构HPC工作流调度中的表现，发现经典求解器在可扩展性和鲁棒性上仍优于QUBO方法，特别是在任务数超过10-15个且约束复杂的场景中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异构HPC工作流调度在多重硬约束下是一个复杂的组合优化问题。经典精确求解器虽能保证最优性但面临可扩展性限制，这促使研究者探索量子启发的QUBO作为替代优化范式。需要系统评估QUBO方法与经典方法的性能差异。

Method: 评估了三种QUBO变体（单次模拟退火、多次尝试退火、QAOA启发式调度）及混合增强策略，与MILP、CP-SAT、GA、HEFT等经典基准进行对比。在验证工作流（3-4任务）和合成扩展实例（5-20任务）上，通过统一流水线追踪可行性、完工时间和资源利用率，采用渐进式约束激活和受控惩罚参数扫描进行评估。

Result: 所有求解器在验证实例上均能恢复预期最优完工时间，验证了公式的正确性。但随着约束交互加剧（特别是引入通信成本），特定QUBO变体出现可行性退化。惩罚分析显示QUBO-SA存在明显的可行性阈值。在扩展性实验中，经典求解器在所有测试规模下保持鲁棒性，而QUBO-SA在超过15任务时失去可行性，QAOA启发式变体在超过10任务时失效。

Conclusion: 研究提供了量子启发QUBO公式在HPC调度中可靠性边界的清晰实证特征，并识别出在当前求解器能力下，经典方法在某些场景下仍保持优势的适用范围，为实际应用提供了重要指导。

Abstract: Heterogeneous HPC workflow scheduling under multiple hard constraints poses a challenging combinatorial optimization problem. Classical exact solvers guarantee optimality but face scalability limits, motivating interest in quantum-inspired Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) as an alternative optimization paradigm. This work presents a systematic empirical evaluation of QUBO-based scheduling methods against classical baselines including MILP, CP-SAT, GA, and HEFT. We evaluate three QUBO variants, single-run simulated annealing, multi-attempt annealing, and a layered QAOA-inspired schedule, with hybrid enhancement strategies on validation workflows (3-4 tasks) and synthetic scaling instances (5-20 tasks). All solvers are assessed through a unified pipeline tracking feasibility, makespan, and resource utilization under progressive constraint activation and controlled penalty sweeps. All approaches recover the expected optimal makespan on validation instances, confirming formulation correctness. However, feasibility degradation emerges for specific QUBO variants as constraint interactions intensify, particularly when communication costs are introduced. Penalty analysis reveals a sharp feasibility threshold for QUBO-SA, where insufficient penalties consistently fail and moderate-to-strong penalties restore feasibility. Scaling experiments show that classical solvers remain robust across all tested sizes, while QUBO-SA loses feasibility beyond 15 tasks and the QAOA-inspired variant beyond 10 tasks. The study provides a clear empirical characterization of the reliability boundaries of quantum-inspired QUBO formulations for HPC scheduling and identifies regimes where classical approaches remain preferable under current solver capabilities.

</details>


### [194] [Bandwidth-Aware and Cost-Efficient Pipeline Parallel Scheduling in Geo-Distributed LLM Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25375)
*Han Zhang,Jianchun Liu,Hongli Xu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出BACE-Pipe框架，通过动态作业优先级机制、带宽感知路径查找器和成本最小化分配器，解决跨地域LLM训练中的流水线调度问题，同时降低作业完成时间(JCT)和电力成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型(LLM)快速发展导致单一云区域GPU资源不足，跨区域训练成为必要。现有流水线并行调度器在异构跨区域带宽和区域电价差异下存在不足：延迟优先的调度器导致高昂电力成本，成本优先的调度器依赖刚性资源分配而延长JCT；多租户环境中长运行和带宽密集型作业导致队头阻塞(HoL)，降低整体性能。

Method: BACE-Pipe包含三个核心组件：(1)动态作业优先级机制，联合考虑作业特性（如计算时间）和实时网络利用率来优化执行顺序；(2)带宽感知路径查找器，识别满足通信约束的可行跨区域流水线路径，防止通信阻塞流水线；(3)成本最小化分配器，优先将资源分配至低电价区域，确定最优GPU放置策略。

Result: 广泛仿真实验表明，与最先进基线相比，BACE-Pipe将平均JCT降低27.9%--64.7%，总电力成本降低12.6%--30.6%。该方法有效缓解了队头阻塞问题，提升了资源利用率。

Conclusion: BACE-Pipe成功实现了带宽感知和成本高效的跨地域流水线调度，在保证通信效率的同时兼顾成本优化，为地理分布式LLM训练提供了实用的调度解决方案。

Abstract: The rapid evolution of large language models (LLMs) has made geographically distributed training necessary due to GPU scarcity within a single cloud region. In such cross-region settings, Pipeline Parallelism (PP) is communication-efficient, yet scheduling PP remains challenging under heterogeneous inter-region bandwidth and regional electricity prices. Existing schedulers are either delay-first, incurring high electricity cost, or cost-first, relying on rigid resource allocation that prolongs Job Completion Time (JCT). They are also ineffective at optimizing execution order in multi-tenant environments, where long-running and bandwidth-intensive jobs can cause head-of-line (HoL) blocking and degrade overall performance. To this end, we propose BACE-Pipe, a bandwidth-aware and cost-efficient pipeline scheduling framework for LLM training across geo-distributed clusters. BACE-Pipe first introduces a dynamic job prioritization mechanism that optimizes execution order by jointly considering job characteristics (e.g., computation time) and real-time network utilization. It then employs a bandwidth-aware pathfinder to identify feasible cross-region pipeline paths that satisfy communication constraints, thereby preventing communication from stalling the pipeline. Among all feasible paths, a cost-minimizing allocator determines the optimal GPU placement strategy by preferentially assigning resources to regions with lower electricity prices. Consequently, BACE-Pipe mitigates HoL blocking, improves resource utilization, and simultaneously reduces both JCT and total electricity cost. Extensive simulations show that BACE-Pipe reduces average JCT by 27.9%--64.7% and total electricity cost by 12.6%--30.6% compared with state-of-the-art baselines.

</details>


### [195] [DisagFusion: Asynchronous Pipeline Parallelism and Elastic Scheduling for Disaggregated Diffusion Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25550)
*Hantian Zha,Teng Ma,Yang Yong,Haiwen Fu,Ruiyang Ma,Wei Gao,Ruihao Gong,Xianglong Liu,Wei Wang,Yunpeng Chai*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出DisagFusion系统，通过异步流水线并行和弹性调度策略解决大规模扩散模型部署中的内存瓶颈和负载不平衡问题，显著提升了吞吐量和降低了延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型在生产环境中部署面临严峻挑战：模型权重常超过商用GPU内存容量，且编码器、扩散变换器(DiT)和解码器三个阶段存在计算与内存占用高度不平衡的问题。虽然将各阶段作为独立服务运行在异构GPU上（解耦服务）是自然解决方案，但引入了新的瓶颈，包括阶段间切换开销和快速变化的工作负载导致跨阶段资源调配与调度变得脆弱。

Method: DisagFusion采用两大核心技术：（1）异步流水线并行机制，通过重叠计算和阶段间通信来减少流水线气泡并缓解网络抖动；（2）混合实例调度策略，结合轻量级性能预测与运行时反馈，在工作负载变化时持续重新平衡各阶段的实例比例。

Result: 在现代扩散模型上的评估表明：与单体基线相比，DisagFusion将吞吐量提升3.4x-20.5x，端到端延迟降低18.5x，同时实现了跨异构GPU的灵活且成本高效的部署。

Conclusion: DisagFusion成功解决了大规模扩散模型服务部署中的关键瓶颈，证明了异步流水线并行与弹性调度在异构GPU环境中的有效性，为生产环境中的扩散模型部署提供了高效、灵活且经济的解决方案。

Abstract: Diffusion-based generation is increasingly powering production content pipelines; however, deploying these models at scale remains a significant challenge. Model weights frequently exceed the memory capacity of commodity GPUs, while the encoder, diffusion transformer (DiT), and decoder stages exhibit highly imbalanced computational and memory footprints. A natural remedy is disaggregated serving-running stages as separate services on heterogeneous GPUs-yet this introduces new bottlenecks, including stage handoff overheads and fast-changing workloads that make cross-stage provisioning and scheduling brittle.
  This paper presents DisagFusion, enabling asynchronous pipeline parallelism and elastic scheduling for disaggregated diffusion serving. First, DisagFusion introduces asynchronous pipeline parallelism that overlaps computation and stage-to-stage communication to reduce pipeline bubbles and mitigate network jitter. Second, DisagFusion employs a hybrid instance scheduling strategy that combines lightweight performance prediction with runtime feedback to continuously rebalance instance ratio across stages under workload shifts. We implement DisagFusion and evaluate it with modern diffusion models. Compared to a monolithic baseline, DisagFusion improves throughput by 3.4x-20.5x and reduces end-to-end latency by 18.5x, while enabling flexible, cost-efficient deployment across heterogeneous GPUs.

</details>


### [196] [Fine-Tuning and Serving Gemma 4 31B on Google Cloud TPU: A Technical Comparison with GPU Baselines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25645)
*Jatin Kishnani,Mayank Goel,Amit Singh,Pulkit Agrawal,Sairanjan Mishra*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文首次展示了在TPU上端到端微调和服务Google Gemma 4 31B模型的完整流程。相比2xH100 GPU基线，TPU训练速度提升1.61倍、成本降低2.12倍；推理吞吐量相当，但首token延迟降低2倍（235ms vs 475ms）。综合训练+服务负载，TPU配置便宜1.82倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 填补开源工具生态中的关键空白，为实践者提供在TPU基础设施上部署Gemma 4的可复现、生产级方案，并进行TPU与GPU平台在大语言模型适配上的实证对比。

Method: 在Google TPU v5p-8上使用LoRA进行训练，在TPU v6e-8 (Trillium)上进行推理。将基于PyTorch、HuggingFace TRL和FSDP的GPU原生训练配方移植到JAX + Tunix/Qwix技术栈，涉及网格配置、LoRA模块命名规范、分片标注修正、梯度检查点、数据流水线重构，以及自定义Orbax到safetensors检查点合并流程。推理使用vLLM-TPU Docker环境。

Result: 与2xH100 GPU基线在相同超参数下对比：TPU训练完成速度快1.61倍，成本低2.12倍。推理吞吐量在两平台间差异在3%以内，TPU的首token时间（TTFT）降低2倍（235ms vs 475ms）。综合训练+服务工作负载，TPU配置便宜1.82倍。

Conclusion: 本工作提供了在TPU上部署Gemma 4的完整、可复现的生产级方案，证明了TPU在大型语言模型训练和推理中相比GPU具有显著的成本和性能优势，为实践者提供了实用的技术参考。

Abstract: We present the first end-to-end demonstration of fine-tuning and serving Google's Gemma 4 31B model on TPU hardware, providing an empirical comparison of TPU and GPU platforms for large language model adaptation. Using LoRA on a Google TPU v5p-8 for training and TPU v6e-8 (Trillium) for inference, we document the full set of code-level adaptations required to port a GPU-native training recipe, built on PyTorch, HuggingFace TRL, and FSDP, to the JAX + Tunix/Qwix stack. These adaptations span mesh configuration, LoRA module naming conventions, sharding annotation corrections, gradient checkpointing, data pipeline restructuring, and a custom Orbax-to-safetensors checkpoint merging procedure.
  For inference, we detail the vLLM-TPU Docker setup necessary to serve Gemma 4 on v6e-8 and characterize the resulting latency and throughput profile. Compared with a 2xH100 GPU baseline under identical hyperparameters, TPU training completes 1.61x faster at 2.12x lower cost. Inference throughput is within 3% across platforms, while TPU achieves 2x lower time-to-first-token (235 ms vs. 475 ms). Together, the TPU configuration is 1.82x cheaper for a representative train-plus-service workload.
  Our work removes a critical gap in the open tooling ecosystem and provides practitioners with a reproducible, production-ready recipe for Gemma 4 deployment on TPU infrastructure.

</details>


### [197] [When Agents Control Robots: A Zero Trust Policy Model for Agentic Cyber-Physical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25653)
*Tharindu Ranathunga,Kavishka Fernando,Susan Rea*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文分析了基于大基础模型的多智能体系统在工业机器人控制中的安全威胁，提出了一种零信任策略模型ZTPM，用于在物理执行边界进行策略级强制执行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着基于大基础模型的多智能体系统越来越多地通过自然语言控制工业机器人，安全故障会导致物理后果，需要针对这种新型代理网络物理系统威胁进行分析和防护。

Method: 通过已部署的四智能体系统Cobot-Claw（控制UR3e机械臂）识别出五种针对代理网络物理系统的攻击类别；提出ZTPM零信任策略模型，包含五个执行域中的25个类型化原语，并以物理影响层级作为运行时策略维度。

Result: 在两个LFM后端上对60个执行轨迹的实证评估表明，致动参数选择具有模型依赖性和非确定性，这为在物理致动边界进行策略级强制执行提供了初步证据。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明需要在物理致动边界实施策略级强制执行，以应对基于大基础模型的多智能体系统控制工业机器人时的安全挑战。

Abstract: Multi-agent systems powered by large foundation models (LFMs) are increasingly deployed to control industrial robots through natural language, creating deployments in which security failures produce physical consequences. We analyse this threat landscape through Cobot-Claw, a deployed four-agent system for UR3e robotic arm control, and identify five attack classes specific to agentic cyber-physical systems. We propose ZTPM, a Zero Trust Policy Model comprising 25 typed primitives across five enforcement domains with Physical Impact Tiers as a runtime policy dimension. An empirical evaluation across 60 execution traces on two LFM backends provides initial evidence that actuation parameter selection is model-dependent and non-deterministic, motivating the need for policy-level enforcement at the physical actuation boundary.

</details>


### [198] [Neural Router: Semantic Content Matching for Agentic AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25701)
*Lauri Lovén,Abhishek Kumar,Alexander Engelhardt,Alaa Saleh,Roberto Morabito,Xiaoli Liu,Naser Hossein Motlagh,Sasu Tarkoma*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文研究LLM作为内容发布/订阅代理的语义匹配引擎，发现两个关键交叉点：上下文窗口交叉点（以下CoverAndMerge压缩可减少LLM调用）和判别能力交叉点（以上匹配精度崩溃且压缩无法恢复），模型选择比管道调优更重要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的关键词和嵌入过滤器在代理AI跨边云计算连续体的内容发布/订阅系统中存在词汇和模态差距问题，无法有效匹配。需要探索LLM作为语义匹配引擎的可行性和成本-精度权衡。

Method: 将问题建模为离线多标签检索任务，在三个公共数据集（社交媒体、法律、智能家居传感器领域）上进行实验，使用六个LLM和七个基线方法。提出CoverAndMerge压缩管道，进行成本-精度的双交叉特征分析，并开发了三个可组合算法和每集群体验质量框架。

Result: 发现两个关键交叉点：(1)分析性上下文窗口交叉点，低于此点压缩管道可减少LLM调用；(2)实证判别能力交叉点，高于此点匹配精度独立于上下文预算崩溃，崩溃程度取决于参数数量和训练生成。压缩无法恢复判别交叉点以上的精度损失，只有前沿规模模型能处理大型订阅集。

Conclusion: 后端选择主导配置选择，模型选择而非管道调优是主要的操作杠杆。需要通过模型选择来确保系统性能，并使用自主LLM层选择框架来优化体验质量。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can serve as the semantic-matching engine of a content-based publish/subscribe broker for agentic AI across the edge-cloud computing continuum, bridging the vocabulary and modality gaps that defeat keyword and embedding filters. Framed as offline multi-label retrieval over three public datasets spanning social-media, legal, and smart-home sensor domains (six LLMs, seven baselines), our central contribution is a two-crossover cost-accuracy characterisation: an analytical context-window crossover below which a CoverAndMerge compression pipeline reduces LLM invocations, and an empirical discrimination-capacity crossover above which matching accuracy collapses independently of context budget, by a model-dependent factor of parameter count and training generation. Two findings carry practical weight: above the discrimination crossover, compression cannot recover accuracy and only frontier-scale models clear large subscription sets; and there backend choice dominates configuration choice, so model selection, not pipeline tuning, is the primary operator lever. We accompany this with three composable algorithms and a per-cluster Quality-of-Experience framework for autonomic LLM-tier selection.

</details>


### [199] [Bandwidth-Aware LLM Inference on Heterogeneous Many-Core Supercomputers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25655)
*Yao Lu,Zhongzhi Luan,Gen Li,Jiaxing Qi,Shiqing Ma,Bin Han,Shizhe Shang,Hailong Yang,Depei Qian*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了THInfer框架，通过硬件感知的优化策略，在异构众核处理器上实现了高效的大语言模型推理，相比主流GPU框架吞吐量提升62%-84%，并在70B模型上实现了GPU无法实现的稳定运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型推理面临高计算成本和内存带宽需求的挑战，在异构众核处理器上部署困难。以天河超算中的MT-3000处理器为例，其有限的主存带宽和分布式存储层次结构成为瓶颈，现有基于GPU的推理框架难以直接迁移。

Method: THInfer框架采用软硬件协同设计和并行策略优化，包含三项关键技术：（1）针对VLIW SIMD架构的高性能算子库，提供手工优化的FP16内核；（2）密度驱动的计算图融合与统一内核调度机制，结合分阶段流水线注意力融合方法；（3）Prefill-Buffer-Decode流水线和有界缓冲区管理策略，支持混合并行和基于MPI与hthreads的两级通信的多集群协作。

Result: 在Llama模型系列上的实验表明，THInfer在7B模型上相比双V100S GPU上的DeepSpeed吞吐量提升62%-73%，相比A800 GPU提升67%-84%；13B和30B模型表现出相当或更好的性能；在70B模型上保持稳定性能，而典型的GPU框架在相同设置下无法运行。

Conclusion: THInfer显著提升了吞吐量、降低了延迟并改善了可扩展性，为异构众核架构上高效可扩展的大语言模型推理提供了可行的系统解决方案。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference is limited by high computational cost and memory bandwidth demands, making deployment on heterogeneous many-core processors challenging. Taking the MT-3000 processor used in the Tianhe supercomputer as an example, its limited main-memory bandwidth and distributed memory hierarchy exemplify these bottlenecks, making it difficult to directly migrate existing GPU-based inference frameworks. To address this problem, we propose THInfer, a hardware-aware inference framework that maximizes data locality under bandwidth-constrained conditions through hardware-software co-design and parallel strategy optimization. THInfer incorporates three key techniques: (1) a high-performance operator library for the VLIW SIMD architecture, providing hand-optimized FP16 kernels that achieve up to 70 percent of the peak performance per cluster; (2) a density-driven computation graph fusion and unified kernel scheduling mechanism, combined with a staged pipelined attention fusion method; and (3) a Prefill-Buffer-Decode (P-B-D) pipeline and bounded buffer management strategy, which supports hybrid parallelism and enables efficient multi-cluster collaboration through two-level communication based on MPI and hthreads. Experiments on the Llama model series show that THInfer improves throughput on the 7B model by 62 percent to 73 percent over DeepSpeed on two V100S GPUs and by 67 percent to 84 percent over the A800 GPU. The 13B and 30B models also demonstrate comparable or better performance. Moreover, THInfer maintains stable performance on the 70B model, whereas typical GPU-based frameworks fail to run under the same setting. Overall, THInfer significantly enhances throughput, reduces latency, and improves scalability, providing a feasible system solution for efficient and scalable LLM inference on heterogeneous many-core architectures.

</details>


### [200] [Profiling-Driven Adaptive Distributed Transformer Inference on Embedded Edge Deployment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25682)
*Muhammad Azlan Qazi,Alexandros Iosifidis,Qi Zhang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 在嵌入式边缘设备上分布式Transformer推理面临严重的CPU-GPU通信开销，本文提出Prism框架通过结合压缩技术和离线性能分析，自适应选择本地或分布式执行模式，显著降低了延迟和能耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分布式Transformer推理研究主要依赖仿真，忽视了真实硬件的通信开销。在嵌入式设备上进行分布式推理的实际效益尚不明确，需要量化真实硬件环境下的性能瓶颈。

Method: 在NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano设备上构建硬件原型进行分析。发现Jetson集成GPU架构缺乏NCCL所需的PCIe/NVLink通道，通信需通过GLOO并在CPU内存中暂存。提出Prism框架，结合Segment Means压缩技术与轻量级离线性能分析，在运行时自适应选择本地执行或分布式执行模式。

Result: CPU-GPU数据暂存开销随通信数据量增加而增大，导致中等规模模型（如ViT）在全张量交换时比单设备推理更慢。Prism框架相比静态分布式执行的全张量交换，延迟降低65%-77%，能耗降低34%-52%。

Conclusion: 性能分析驱动的自适应执行策略对嵌入式硬件上的实用化分布式Transformer推理至关重要，单纯依赖网络带宽优化不足以解决实际性能瓶颈。

Abstract: Distributing Transformer inference across embedded edge devices can alleviate individual memory and compute constraints, yet practical benefits on real hardware remain unclear: prior work relies largely on simulations that overlook hardware-specific communication overheads. We present a hardware prototype study on NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano devices connected over WiFi. Our key finding is that the dominant bottleneck is not just network bandwidth but also the CPU-GPU staging during communication. Because Jetson's integrated GPU architecture lacks the PCIe/NVLink pathway that NCCL requires, all inter-device data communication should be routed through GLOO and staged in CPU memory; an overhead that scales with communication data volume and makes full-tensor exchange slower than single-device inference across the batch sizes for medium sized models such as ViT. We therefore evaluate Prism by combining Segment Means compression with lightweight offline profiling to adaptively select between local and distributed execution at runtime. Experiments show that this strategy reduces latency by 65%-77% and energy consumption by 34%-52% relative to full-tensor exchange in static distributed execution setup, demonstrating that profiling-driven adaptation is essential for practical distributed Transformer inference on embedded hardware.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [201] [Algometrics: Forecasting Under Algorithmic Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23978)
*Marc Schmitt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"算法计量学"(algometrics)框架，证明在算法市场中，仅凭历史数据无法识别部署风险，模型排名可能因拥挤效应而反转，但随机化行动可估计部署风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在算法驱动的市场中，预测模型通过交易、配置等行动反过来影响其试图预测的时间序列数据，形成反馈循环。传统的时间序列分析方法忽视了这种模型部署对数据生成过程的影响，导致历史表现与实际部署表现存在差异，亟需建立能够刻画这种反馈机制的框架。

Method: 引入algometrics框架，将时间序列建模为其演化依赖于预测算法的系统。区分历史风险（被动预测下测量）与部署风险（预测驱动行动时测量）。采用单步线性反馈模型进行理论分析，设计随机化或工具变量行动的识别策略，推导部署风险估计的有限样本界。

Result: 得到三个核心结论：(1)部署风险不可识别性——即使在线性反馈模型中，无限多个算法中介环境可产生相同的历史分布但导致不同的部署风险；(2)排名反转效应——拥挤效应下，被动预测误差较低的模型在部署时可能产生更高误差；(3)可识别性条件——随机化或工具化行动能够识别短期线性反馈，并给出了部署风险估计的有限样本界。

Conclusion: 研究结果揭示算法市场中的时间序列基准测试应同时报告反馈敏感性与预测准确性，仅依赖历史被动数据的评估可能导致误导性的模型选择。为实践中的算法交易、风险管理等应用提供了评估部署风险的理论基础和估计方法。

Abstract: In algorithmic markets, predictive models become part of the data-generating process they aim to forecast. Once their outputs are converted into trades, allocations, execution schedules, or risk controls, they change the future data on which they are evaluated. I introduce algometrics, a framework for time series whose evolution depends on the predictive algorithms forecasting them. The framework distinguishes historical risk, measured under passive forecasting, from deployment risk, measured when forecasts drive actions. I prove three results. First, deployment risk is not identifiable from passive historical data alone: even in a one-step linear feedback model, infinitely many algorithm-mediated environments induce the same historical law while implying different deployment risks for the same forecaster. Second, historical model rankings can invert under crowding, so a predictor with lower passive error can have higher deployment error once similar algorithms are adopted. Third, randomized or instrumented actions identify short-horizon linear feedback, and I derive a finite-sample bound for deployment-risk estimation. These results suggest that time-series benchmarks in algorithmic markets should report feedback sensitivity alongside predictive accuracy.

</details>


### [202] [Parameter Efficient Multi-Class Intelligent Scheduling for Multimodal Online Distributed Industrial Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23984)
*Heqiang Wang,Weihong Yang,Zheyuan Yang,Jia Zhou,Xiaoxiong Zhong,Fangming Liu,Weizhe Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了MODIAD框架，首次解决多模态在线分布式工业异常检测问题，通过MIS调度算法和REC-LoRA策略实现了资源约束下的高效检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工业异常检测方法主要针对集中式离线场景设计，忽视了真实工业环境中数据分布式生成和持续产生的特性。随着边缘智能的发展，现代边缘设备已具备数据采集和分布式模型训练能力，为协作智能提供了可能，但如何在分布式在线场景下高效进行多模态异常检测仍是一个未解决的挑战。

Method: 提出了MODIAD框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 多类智能调度(MIS)问题建模，通过平衡数据充分性和类更新频率来协调跨类模型更新，并设计序列边际增益贪心(SMG)算法在资源约束下高效求解；(2) 资源高效类级低秩自适应(REC-LoRA)策略，显著降低训练过程中的计算和通信开销，同时保持检测性能。

Result: 在MVTec 3D-AD和Eyecandies两个代表性多模态工业异常检测数据集上进行了广泛实验，证明了该方法在MODIAD场景下取得了优越的性能和效率。

Conclusion: MODIAD框架成功地将工业异常检测从传统的集中式离线范式扩展到分布式在线场景，为边缘智能环境下的实时工业异常检测提供了有效的解决方案，在保持检测性能的同时显著降低了系统开销。

Abstract: Industrial anomaly detection has attracted significant attention as a fundamental challenge in industrial systems. The rapid advancement of heterogeneous industrial sensors has driven industrial anomaly detection from unimodal to multimodal paradigms. However, existing methods are primarily designed for centralized and offline settings, overlooking the distributed and continuously generated data characteristic of real-world industrial environments. With the advancement of edge intelligence, modern edge devices are increasingly capable of not only data acquisition but also distributed model training, enabling collaborative intelligence across the system. Industrial anomaly detection represents a critical application in this context. Motivated by these challenges, we propose a novel framework termed Multimodal Online Distributed Industrial Anomaly Detection (MODIAD). We first present a comprehensive workflow for MODIAD and then formulate a Multi-class Intelligent Scheduling (MIS) problem to coordinate cross class model updates by balancing data sufficiency and class update frequency. To efficiently solve this problem, we design a Sequential Marginal Gain Greedy (SMG) algorithm that enables effective multi-class training under resource constraints. Furthermore, to improve the computational and communication efficiency during training, we propose an Resource Efficient Class-Wise Low Rank Adaptation (REC-LoRA) strategy, which significantly reduces system overhead while preserving detection performance. Extensive experiments on two representative multimodal industrial anomaly detection datasets, MVTec 3D-AD and Eyecandies demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves superior performance and efficiency under the MODIAD scenario.

</details>


### [203] [CAFD: Concept-Aware DNN Fault Detection using VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24008)
*Amin Abbasishahkoo,Mahboubeh Dadkhah,Lionel Briand*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了CAFD方法，通过整合模型信号、距离特征和创新的CFR特征，在保持实用效率的同时实现了更优的DNN故障检测性能，平均FDR提升18.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的混合DNN故障检测方法虽然结合多源信息能获得更好性能，但往往带来大量计算开销，限制了其在真实场景中的可扩展性和实用性。因此需要在保持性能优势的同时提高效率。

Method: 提出Concept-Aware Fault Detection (CAFD)学习框架：1）精选信息特征集，包括基于模型的信号、基于距离的特征；2）创新提出Concept Failure Ratio (CFR)特征，利用视觉语言模型从图像中提取文本概念，量化其存在与DNN故障的关联；3）通过整合这些互补的语义信息进行训练。

Result: 在ImageNet等三个数据集和DNN模型上与五个SOTA基线对比，CAFD在各种约束选择预算下一致优于所有基线，平均FDR提升18.3%，证明了CFR作为DNN故障检测有效指标的价值。

Conclusion: CAFD成功实现了性能与效率的平衡，通过CFR特征引入的语义信息为DNN故障检测提供了互补价值，在实际应用中具有良好的可扩展性。

Abstract: Fault detection for Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) has received increasing attention in recent years. While more advanced hybrid approaches have been proposed to combine multiple sources of information and outperform earlier techniques, they often incur substantial computational overhead, limiting scalability and practicality in real-world settings. In this paper, we introduce Concept-Aware Fault Detection (CAFD), a learning-based approach that achieves superior fault detection performance by effectively integrating multiple information sources while maintaining practical efficiency. Specifically, CAFD is trained using a carefully selected set of informative features, including model-based signals derived from the DNN's outputs, distance-based features, and a novel concept-based feature, called Concept Failure Ratio (CFR). CFR leverages Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to extract textual concepts from images and quantify the likelihood that their presence is associated with DNN failures. By incorporating this feature, CAFD benefits from complementary semantic information, enabling more effective fault detection. Our results demonstrate that CFR serves as an effective indicator for DNN fault detection. We conduct an extensive empirical evaluation of CAFD, comparing it against five state-of-the-art baselines across three subject DNN models and datasets, including ImageNet. Across a wide range of constrained selection budgets, CAFD consistently outperforms all baselines in Fault Detection Rate (FDR), achieving average FDR improvements of 18.3% across all investigated subjects and budget sizes.

</details>


### [204] [Towards Verifiable Transformers: Solver-Checkable Circuit Explanations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24033)
*Neel Somani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了可验证Transformer框架，将机械可解释性发现的电路转化为可被SMT求解器验证的形式化命题，填补了发现电路与证明电路功能之间的空白。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机械可解释性研究通常通过示例、消融和手动推理验证电路解释，但这种方式在发现合理电路与证明电路实际功能之间存在差距，缺乏形式化的验证手段。

Method: 提出Verifiable Transformers框架：1）直接验证：将提取的任务电路编码到SMT求解器中验证；2）代理介导验证：对难以编码的算子拟合SMT可编码的代理模型，验证符号解释；采用Signed L1 BandNorm、sparsemax attention和LeakyReLU构建SMT可表示的Transformer架构。

Result: 在小规模符号序列任务上成功验证了引号闭合和括号类型跟踪电路的投射功能等价性、内容不变性、边必要性和最终残差鲁棒性；在GPT-2规模上训练稳定但直接SMT验证仍不可行；在难以编码注意力的电路上展示了代理介导验证的有效性，包括验证符号解释和生成反例。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了一条将机械可解释性的电路解释转化为可被证明或反驳的形式化命题的具体路径，虽然并非追求全模型验证，但为电路验证提供了实用工具。

Abstract: Mechanistic interpretability often identifies circuits inside Transformer models, but explanations of those circuits are usually validated through examples, ablations, and manual reasoning. This leaves a gap between finding a plausible circuit and proving what the circuit does. We introduce Verifiable Transformers, a framework for converting task-localized Transformer circuits into bounded, solver-checkable claims. Given a behavior, a finite task domain, and a candidate-token projection, we extract a task circuit and verify properties such as projected functional equivalence, edge necessity, task-relevant invariance, and final-residual robustness. Direct verification encodes the extracted circuit itself into an SMT solver. When a circuit contains operators that are not exactly or tractably encodable, surrogate-mediated verification fits an SMT-encodable surrogate, validates it against the extracted circuit over the bounded domain, and verifies symbolic explanations against the surrogate. We instantiate direct verification with a GPT-style architecture using Signed L1 BandNorm, sparsemax attention, and LeakyReLU. On small symbolic sequence tasks, we train an SMT-representable Transformer, extract sparse circuits for quote closing and bracket type tracking, and exhaustively verify projected functional equivalence, content invariance, edge necessity, and final-residual robustness. At GPT-2 scale, the same operator stack trains stably on OpenWebText, although naive direct SMT verification remains intractable. We also demonstrate surrogate-mediated verification on task-localized circuits with hard-to-encode attention, showing both verified symbolic explanations and solver-generated counterexamples. The goal is not full-model verification, but a concrete path for turning mechanistic circuit explanations into formal propositions that can be proven or refuted.

</details>


### [205] [Iterative Refinement Neural Operators are Learned Fixed-Point Solvers: A Principled Approach to Spectral Bias Mitigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24041)
*Xiaotian Liu,Shuyuan Shang,Xiaopeng Wang,Pu Ren,Yaoqing Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了迭代细化神经算子(IRNO)，通过引入学习到的细化模块进行迭代优化，有效解决了神经算子中的谱偏差问题，显著提升了高频细节的预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经算子采用单体单次推理过程，存在谱偏差问题，难以准确解析高频细节，限制了其在科学建模中的性能。

Method: IRNO将预测分解为粗粒度初始化和连续残差修正两阶段，模仿经典数值求解器；提出渐进谱损失函数，在训练过程中自适应地增加对高频分量的惩罚；在局部假设下证明了诱导算子的收缩性，确保收敛到唯一不动点。

Result: 在湍流问题上误差降低达56.05%；在活性物质问题上，相对于基础算子，归一化误差比在低频降至27.72-36.10%，中频降至5.07-6.68%，高频降至1.48-2.04%，且在超过训练迭代次数后保持稳定。

Conclusion: IRNO通过迭代细化机制成功克服了神经算子的谱偏差限制，在多种物理系统中实现了显著的精度提升，特别是在高频细节恢复方面表现突出，为科学建模提供了更可靠的快速数据驱动代理模型。

Abstract: Neural operators serve as fast, data-driven surrogates for scientific modeling but typically rely on a monolithic, single-pass inference procedure that struggles to resolve high-frequency details, a limitation known as spectral bias. We introduce the Iterative Refinement Neural Operator (IRNO), which augments pre-trained operators with a learned refinement module iteratively applied via fixed-point iteration. IRNO decomposes the prediction into a coarse initialization followed by successive residual corrections, paralleling classical numerical solvers. Under local assumptions, we establish contraction of the induced operator, ensuring convergence to a unique fixed point. To explicitly target high-frequency errors, we propose a progressive spectral loss that adaptively increases penalty on high-frequency components over refinement steps during training. Across physical systems, IRNO consistently lowers error, with up to 56.05% improvement on turbulent flow. On Active Matter, spectral analysis reveals that, relative to base operator, the normalized error ratios decrease to 27.72-36.10% in low-, 5.07-6.68% in mid-, and 1.48-2.04% in high-frequencies, remaining stable beyond the trained iteration count. Code is available at https://github.com/xiaotianliu-dartmouth/Iterative_Refinement_Neural_Operator

</details>


### [206] [Hidden-State Privacy Has an Empty Middle](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24042)
*Alexander Okezue Bell*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在1536种高斯发布协方差测试中，无一能同时实现中等效用和中等隐私；证明了Fisher-ball下界定理排除了均匀高斯安全性；提出对角逆Fisher发布机制是唯一极小极大最优方案；重新定义了隐藏状态发布问题需从机制设计转向架构或发布协同设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究隐藏状态隐私保护问题，探索在高斯发布类别中是否存在能够同时实现中等效用和中等隐私的机制，并试图找到最优的隐私-效用权衡方案。

Method: (1) 对1536种高斯发布协方差进行系统性测试；(2) 证明Fisher-ball下界定理；(3) 提出并分析对角逆Fisher发布机制和广义特征机制；(4) 使用自适应Mahalanobis攻击者进行评估；(5) 训练分割记忆Transformer架构进行验证。

Result: (1) 零机制能同时实现中等效用和隐私；(2) 对角逆Fisher机制是唯一极小极大最优对角机制；(3) 分割记忆Transformer在固定token语言建模损失惩罚下，相比同预算GPT基线保持6-24倍优势；(4) 广义特征机制在欧几里得检索下实现13倍帕累托改进，但在自适应攻击下完全失效。

Conclusion: 高斯类别内不存在均匀安全的发布机制，填补效用-隐私中间地带需要突破高斯机制框架，转向架构创新或发布协同设计的全新范式。

Abstract: Of $1{,}536$ Gaussian release covariances we tested for single-layer hidden-state privacy, zero achieve both moderate utility and moderate privacy against an adaptive retrieval attacker. We prove a complementary Fisher-ball lower bound: every full-rank Gaussian release at $O(1)$ Fisher utility admits a direction whose Mahalanobis signal grows linearly in hidden width, ruling out uniform Gaussian safety in the class and matching the empirical empty middle. The diagonal inverse-Fisher release $Σ^\star_{\mathrm{diag}}(\mathcal{K}) = (2\mathcal{K}/d)\,\mathrm{diag}(1/F_{ii})$ is the unique minimax-optimal diagonal mechanism at first-order KL budget $\mathcal{K}$ and the only release with worst-attacker top-1 $\le 0.001$ at every point of a 32 model-layer grid, but it sits on a privacy/utility edge rather than filling the middle. A generalized-eigen mechanism reaching $13\times$ Pareto reduction under Euclidean retrieval collapses to $100\%$ top-1 under the adaptive Mahalanobis attacker, and a full-trajectory sequence inverter recovers $94\%$ of clean GPT-2 prefixes but $0\%$ under $Σ_{\mathrm{diag}}$. A split-memory transformer trained from scratch reaches $G_{\mathrm{Mah}} \in [20, 33]$ at 90M and maintains a $6$--$24\times$ advantage over same-budget GPT baselines from 30M to 1B at a fixed-token language-modeling loss penalty; pretrained models top out at 9.3. These results reframe hidden-state release from mechanism-design within the Gaussian class to architecture or release co-design.

</details>


### [207] [LLM-AutoSciLab: Closed-Loop Scientific Discovery via Active Experimentation with LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24043)
*Sanchit Kabra,Nikhil Abhyankar,Saaketh Desai,Prasad Iyer,Chandan K Reddy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LLM-AutoSciLab框架，通过假设生成与条件实验选择的闭环迭代实现主动数据获取的科学发现，在多个基准上显著优于现有方法且样本效率提升2-5倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有科学发现方法多将其简化为固定数据集上的监督学习，有限观测可支持多个局部拟合但泛化性差的机制假设。核心挑战在于如何选择信息性观测来消解不确定性，从静态推断转向自适应数据获取。

Method: 提出LLM-AutoSciLab闭环框架：迭代地生成合理假设、选择能区分或细化假设的信息性实验、利用实验证据更新状态，将假设生成与假设条件下的实验选择及机制细化耦合。同时构建ActiveSciBench基准，包含57个酶动力学任务和45个基因调控网络任务，将发现建模为预算约束下的自适应实验设计过程。

Result: 在NewtonBench、ActiveSciBench-Chem和ActiveSciBench-GRN三个基准上，LLM-AutoSciLab分别取得67.6%、35.1%的符号准确率，以及31.1%的精确图恢复率；假设引导的实验比最强基线样本效率提升2-5倍。

Conclusion: LLM-AutoSciLab通过闭环主动数据获取有效解决了科学发现中假设模糊性问题，在多个领域任务上实现了性能与效率的双重提升，为动态科学发现研究提供了有效范式和新基准。

Abstract: Scientific discovery is a closed-loop process in which hypotheses guide data acquisition and observations refine the hypothesis space. Yet most approaches reduce discovery to supervised learning over fixed datasets, where limited observations can support multiple plausible mechanisms that fit locally but fail to generalize. Thus, the key challenge is selecting informative observations to resolve uncertainty, shifting the focus from static inference to adaptive data acquisition. To address this, we propose LLM-AutoSciLab, a closed-loop framework that couples hypothesis generation with hypothesis-conditioned experiment selection and mechanism refinement. Rather than fitting models to passively collected data, LLM-AutoSciLab iteratively proposes plausible hypotheses, selects informative experiments to distinguish or refine them, and updates its state using the resulting evidence. To evaluate dynamic, closed-loop scientific discovery with active data acquisition, we introduce ActiveSciBench, comprising two datasets: ActiveSciBench-Chem with 57 enzyme-kinetics tasks and ActiveSciBench-GRN with 45 gene-regulatory-network tasks. These datasets model discovery as a budget-constrained process requiring adaptive experiment design, variable selection, and recovery of true mechanisms. Across NewtonBench, ActiveSciBench-Chem, and ActiveSciBench-GRN, LLM-AutoSciLab outperforms prior methods, achieving 67.6% and 35.1% symbolic accuracy on NewtonBench and ActiveSciBench-Chem, respectively, and 31.1% exact graph recovery on ActiveSciBench-GRN. Moreover, hypothesis-guided experimentation is 2-5x more sample-efficient than the strongest competing baselines. Code and data are available at: https://github.com/scientific-discovery/LLM-AutoSciLab

</details>


### [208] [A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark: Do Protein-Ligand Models Learn Binding Sites or Just Binding Likelihood?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24045)
*Zhaohan Meng,Zhen Bai,Ke Yuan,Iadh Ounis,Zaiqiao Meng,Hao Xu,Joseph Loscalzo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了InteractBind数据集和基准，用于细粒度的蛋白质-配体结合位点定位评估，发现现有模型在二元结合预测上表现良好，但在结合位点定位方面能力有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的蛋白质-配体基准主要评估蛋白质与配体是否相互作用及结合强度（如二元结合预测和亲和力回归），但无法评估模型是否能定位结合位点或识别分子识别背后的非共价相互作用，存在评估粒度不足的问题。

Method: 构建了InteractBind大规模蛋白质-配体数据集，包含约10万个蛋白质-配体对，涵盖六种主要非共价相互作用类型的蛋白质残基和配体原子相互作用图谱；设计了结合位点定位的核心细粒度任务，通过模型生成的相互作用图谱评估结合位点定位能力；引入结合亲和力和蛋白质相似性控制的数据划分以支持现实的泛化评估。

Result: 在InteractBind上评估了8个现有的基于序列和感知相互作用的模型，结果表明：尽管二元结合预测表现良好，但结合位点定位能力有限，且不同非共价相互作用类型之间存在显著差异。

Conclusion: InteractBind建立了一个新的基准范式，通过细粒度评估促进开发更具可解释性和物理基础的蛋白质-配体模型。

Abstract: Protein-ligand modeling underpins computational drug discovery and molecular design. Existing protein-ligand benchmarks typically evaluate whether a protein and ligand interact and how strongly they bind, through tasks such as binary binding prediction and affinity regression. However, these evaluations provide limited evidence of whether models can localize binding sites or identify the non-covalent interactions underlying molecular recognition. To address this gap, we introduce InteractBind, a large-scale protein-ligand dataset comprising approximately 100k protein-ligand pairs, together with a benchmark for fine-grained evaluation. The core fine-grained task is that of binding-site localization, which uses protein-residue and ligand-atom interaction maps spanning six major types of non-covalent interactions to assess whether model-derived interaction maps localize binding sites. InteractBind further includes binding affinity and protein similarity-controlled splits to support realistic generalization assessment. Using InteractBind, we evaluate eight existing sequence-based and interaction-aware models, assessing binary binding prediction and binding-site localization. Results reveal limited binding-site localization despite strong binary binding prediction, with marked variation across non-covalent interaction types. Overall, InteractBind establishes a benchmark paradigm that encourages the development of more interpretable and physically grounded protein-ligand models.

</details>


### [209] [Mixture of Complementary Agents for Robust LLM Ensemble](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24048)
*Yichi Zhang,Kevin Lu,Yuang Zhang,Jie Gao,Lirong Xia,Fang-Yi Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将多AI协作中的提议者选择问题重构为组合选择问题，提出基于互补性的贪心选择算法，在性能与成本间取得最佳平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多AI协作（如LLM集成或辩论）中，如何选择提议者模型是一个关键问题。现有方法主要关注准确性（选择最强模型）或多样性（确保多样性），但往往忽略了提议者之间以及与摘要器之间的交互作用，且传统特征选择算法在LLM场景下时间复杂度过高。

Method: 将提议者选择重构为类似特征选择的组合选择问题，其中LLM的价值在于其与其他模型的互补性。提出了多种计算可行的贪心式选择算法，利用小规模标注集评估模型间的互补性。

Result: 实验验证了互补性作为提议者选择指导原则的有效性，并识别出在实际应用中能够实现最佳性能-成本权衡的方法。

Conclusion: 互补性是指导多AI协作中提议者选择的有效原则，基于此设计的贪心算法能够在保证性能的同时显著降低计算成本。

Abstract: Multi-AI collaboration, such as ensembling or debating large language models (LLMs), is a promising paradigm for aggregating information and boosting performance. A foundational step in these pipelines is to feed the responses of several proposer LLMs into a summarizer LLM, which synthesizes a better answer. However, choosing which proposers to include is non-trivial. Existing approaches primarily focus either on accuracy (picking the strongest models) or diversity (ensuring variety), and often overlook the interactions among proposers and with the summarizer. We reframe proposer selection as a combinatorial selection problem akin to feature selection, where the value of an LLM lies in its complementarity with others. However, directly applying standard feature-selection algorithms is impractical in the LLM setting due to prohibitive time complexity. Motivated by this limitation, we explore an extensive range of computationally feasible, greedy-style selection algorithms that assess complementarity using a small labeled set. Our experiments validate complementarity as a guiding principle for proposer selection and identify methods that achieve the best performance-cost trade-offs in practice.

</details>


### [210] [Truthful Online Preference Aggregation for LLM Fine-Tuning in Mobile Crowdsourcing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24052)
*Shugang Hao,Lingjie Duan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对移动众包平台中LLM微调的偏好聚合问题，提出了一种在线加权聚合机制，能有效激励策略性工作者诚实反馈，并实现了O(√T)的次线性遗憾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在移动众包应用中，平台需要将LLM生成的内容与来自众包工作者的反馈进行迭代对齐。然而，工作者可能为了最大化自身收益或影响力而策略性地虚报偏好反馈。现有的众包流水线（如基于EM的权重估计）无法在此在线场景中识别最准确的工作者，导致O(T)的线性遗憾。

Method: 提出了一种新的动态贝叶斯博弈来建模平台与策略性移动工作者之间的多智能体在线学习过程。设计了新颖的在线加权聚合机制，根据工作者的反馈准确性动态调整其在偏好聚合中的权重。

Result: 理论证明该机制能确保策略性工作者提供诚实反馈，在T个时间槽内实现O(√T)的次线性遗憾。进一步将机制扩展到每时间槽工作者反馈有限的挑战性场景，仍能保证O(√T)的次线性遗憾。实验结果表明该机制在真实数据集上的LLM微调中显著优于基准方案。

Conclusion: 本研究成功解决了移动众包中LLM微调的诚实在线偏好聚合问题，所提机制在激励相容性和学习效率方面都取得了理论保证和实证验证，为移动应用中的LLM持续优化提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: To better serve users' demands in mobile applications (e.g., navigation), mobile crowdsourcing platforms can iteratively align large language model (LLM)-generated content (e.g., AI-generated traffic condition predictions) with human feedback collected from crowdsourcing workers (e.g., mobile users). However, workers may strategically misreport their online preference feedback to maximize their influence or payment. Existing pipelines in mobile crowdsourcing (e.g., EM-based weight estimation) fail to identify the most accurate worker in this online setting, resulting in a linear regret $\mathcal{O}(T)$ over $T$ time slots. In this paper, we study truthful online preference aggregation for LLM fine-tuning in mobile crowdsourcing. We formulate a new dynamic Bayesian game to model the multi-agent online learning process between the platform and strategic mobile workers. We propose a novel online weighted aggregation mechanism that dynamically adjusts each worker's weight in the preference aggregation according to their feedback accuracy. We prove that our mechanism ensures truthful feedback from strategic workers and achieves a sublinear regret $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T})$ over $T$ time slots. We further extend our mechanism to a challenging scenario with limited worker feedback per time slot, still guaranteeing a sublinear regret $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T})$. Experiments on LLM fine-tuning with real-world datasets further demonstrate significant performance gains of our mechanisms over benchmark schemes.

</details>


### [211] [Cascade-KDE: Robust Time-Series Restoration under Out-of-Distribution Impulse Corruptions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24055)
*Yuefeng Liu,Ning Yang,Ziyu Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了Cascade-KDE，一种无需训练的时间序列恢复框架，通过密度截断和级联优化，在存在高斯噪声和脉冲异常值的情况下，有效保留了ECG形态分析等任务所需的局部形状特征和导数峰值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业传感、医疗保健和能源系统中的现实世界时间序列数据经常被高斯噪声和偶发的大幅值脉冲异常值混合污染。对于依赖局部形状的任务（如ECG形态分析和电池退化监测），主要需求不仅是低重建误差，还需要保留导数峰值和任务关键特征。现有方法难以同时满足去噪和特征保留的需求。

Method: 提出Cascade-KDE，一种免训练的恢复框架。该方法首先估计二维时间-幅度密度，然后应用密度截断鲁棒期望来限制远距离异常点的影响，最后通过带有自适应停止机制的指数级联来精细化序列。这种设计旨在提高分布外脉冲噪声下的鲁棒性，同时保持恢复轨迹接近原始局部结构。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上，该方法在曲线保真度、导数保留、下游分类任务和运行效率方面，相比经典滤波器和代表性的基于学习的基线方法，均展现出持续的性能提升。

Conclusion: 有界的基于密度的恢复方法为噪声时间序列处理管道中的特征保留预处理提供了一个实用的选择。该方法证明了在保持局部结构的同时有效处理混合噪声的可行性。

Abstract: Real-world time-series data in industrial sensing, healthcare, and energy systems is often corrupted by a mixture of Gaussian noise and occasional large-magnitude impulse outliers. For tasks that depend on local shape, such as ECG morphology analysis and battery degradation monitoring, the main requirement is not only low reconstruction error but also preservation of derivative peaks and task-critical features. We propose Cascade-KDE, a training-free restoration framework for corrupted time series. The method first estimates a two-dimensional temporal-amplitude density, then applies a Density-Truncated Robust Expectation to limit the influence of distant abnormal points, and finally refines the sequence through an exponential cascade with adaptive stopping. This design aims to improve robustness under out-of-distribution impulse corruptions while keeping the restored trajectory close to the original local structure. Across several benchmark datasets, the proposed method shows consistent gains over classical filters and representative learning-based baselines on curve fidelity, derivative preservation, downstream classification, and runtime efficiency. These results suggest that bounded density-based restoration is a practical option for feature-preserving preprocessing in noisy time-series pipelines.

</details>


### [212] [Feature Lottery? A Bifurcation Theory of Concept Emergence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24057)
*Fuming Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出分岔理论实时检测神经网络训练中的结构涌现，发现超临界叉式分岔点的动态比率β/β_c可作为通用、无标签的表征动力学相位坐标，能提前预测训练健康状态和特征可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络在训练特定时刻获得结构化表征，但现有方法依赖回顾性、依赖标签的指标来识别这些转变时刻，缺乏实时检测方法。

Method: 提出表征动力学的分岔理论，分析附加到演化编码器的被动GMM探针，证明结构涌现对应于由损失Hessian驱动的超临界叉式分岔。基于理论可预测的零交叉点β_c与网络当前状态β构建动态比率β(t)/β_c(t)，作为完全从隐藏状态计算的无标签相位坐标。

Result: 在SAE语言模型（Pythia）、SSL（CIFAR）和grokking（模运算）等多场景验证了四个不同的转变区域。发现宏观对称性破缺可能滞后初始零交叉点数个数量级，为grokking中的延迟逃逸现象提供了动力学解释。微观上分岔创造共享不稳定子空间迫使集体对称性破缺。训练仅5%时早期原子纯度即可稳健预测最终收敛纯度，顶层十位数的早期原子在收敛时纯度超基线12倍以上。

Conclusion: β/β_c不仅解释概念涌现，还提供训练健康的实用早期预警指标，能够在下游指标反应前数个epoch检测可用结构涌现、特征身份结晶和表征崩溃。同时揭示了SAE训练中的"特征彩票"现象，使特征的可解释性在训练极早期变得可预测。

Abstract: Neural networks acquire structured representations at specific moments during training, yet identifying these transitions typically relies on retrospective, label-dependent metrics. We introduce a bifurcation theory of representation dynamics to detect these moments in real time. Analyzing a passive GMM probe attached to the evolving encoder, we show the onset of structure corresponds to a supercritical pitchfork bifurcation driven by the loss Hessian. The system exhibits a theoretically predictable zero-crossing ($β_c$) that, compared to the network's current state ($β$), yields a dynamic ratio $β(t)/β_c(t)$: a universal, label-free phase coordinate for representation dynamics, computable entirely from hidden states. We empirically validate four distinct transition regimes predicted by this coordinate across diverse settings: SAEs on language models (Pythia), SSL (CIFAR), and grokking (modular arithmetic). Crucially, under finite dissipation, macroscopic symmetry-breaking can lag the initial zero-crossing by orders of magnitude, which providing a rigorous dynamical account of the delayed escape observed in grokking. Microscopically, the bifurcation creates a shared unstable subspace, forcing collective symmetry breaking. We term this the "feature lottery" in SAE training: a feature's terminal interpretability becomes predictable remarkably early. By only 5% of training, early atom purity robustly predicts final convergence purity, with top-decile early atoms achieving over 12x the baseline purity at convergence. Beyond explaining concept emergence, $β/β_c$ provides a practical early-warning indicator for training health, detecting the onset of usable structure, the crystallization of feature identity, and representational collapse epochs before downstream metrics react.

</details>


### [213] [Signs Beat Floats: Low-Rank Double-Binary Adaptation for On-Device Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24058)
*Yoshihiko Fujisawa,Yuma Ichikawa,Yudai Fujimoto,Akira Sakai,Katsuki Fujisawa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了LoRDBA，一种兼容LoRA的二值化适配器方法，通过将低秩因子替换为二值符号载体并用轻量级通道级尺度表示幅度，实现了超过10倍的适配器存储压缩，同时在匹配模型大小时优于低位基线，且最多仅增加8%的预填充延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在设备端大语言模型适配中，未合并的适配器模式下的LoRA适配器不仅是存储模块，还作为额外的密集浮点分支、可训练状态以及通信和热插拔单元。现有方法在保持压缩率的同时难以兼顾推理效率和适应质量，需要一种既能显著减少存储又能保持性能的方法。

Method: LoRDBA将LoRA的两个低秩因子替换为二值符号载体，通过轻量级的通道级尺度表示幅度，将密集适配器分支转换为两个符号累积矩阵乘法，并在其间插入通道级缩放操作。该方法提供了有限样本分析，证明重构质量由原始LoRA因子的残差-幅度比决定。

Result: 在适配器模式实验中，LoRDBA在匹配模型大小时优于低位基线，在特定情况下可匹配fp16 LoRA质量。在匹配秩r=16时，未合并适配器最多仅增加8%的预填充延迟，同时实现了超过10倍的适配器存储减少，训练内存开销约为fp16 LoRA的1.6倍。

Conclusion: LoRDBA成功地在保持LoRA兼容性的同时实现了显著的存储压缩和性能保持，为设备端大语言模型适配提供了一个有效的解决方案，在存储效率、推理延迟和适应质量之间取得了良好的平衡。

Abstract: On-device adaptation of large language models commonly keeps a quantized base model frozen while training and deploying a small, task-specific LoRA adapter. In the unmerged adapter-mode setting, however, the adapter is more than a compact storage module; it introduces an additional dense floating-point branch, maintains a trainable state for local updates, and acts as a unit of communication and hot-swapping.We introduce LoRDBA, a LoRA-compatible adapter that replaces both low-rank factors with binary sign carriers while representing magnitudes through lightweight, channel-wise scales, converting the dense adapter branch into two sign-accumulation matrix multiplications interleaved with channel-wise scaling. A finite-sample analysis shows that reconstruction quality is governed by the residual-to-magnitude ratio of the original LoRA factors. In adapter-mode experiments, LoRDBA outperforms low-bit baselines at matched model sizes while matching fp16 LoRA quality in selected regimes. The unmerged adapter incurs at most 8% prefill latency overhead at matched rank r=16 despite an over 10x reduction in adapter footprint, with moderate training memory overhead of approximately 1.6x that of fp16 LoRA.

</details>


### [214] [Spectral Probe-Circuits: A Three-Step Recipe for Identifying Attention-Head Circuits in Pretrained Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24059)
*Yongzhong Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出三步法识别预训练Transformer中的注意力头电路：光谱信号排序→任务模式筛选→组消融验证。在8倍参数范围内验证有效，发现诱导电路在各模型中因果必需。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 缺乏系统方法识别预训练Transformer中执行特定计算任务的注意力头电路，需要一种无需标签或归因梯度的自动化方法来发现模型内部的计算结构。

Method: 三步流程：1）使用时间积分参与率作为光谱信号对头进行排序，识别持续的内容依赖计算；2）任务模式筛选器将通用指标过滤为任务特定的候选电路；3）对匹配随机对照组进行组消融以完成因果验证。在51M到1B-active参数范围、两种架构（密集模型和混合专家模型）、四个预训练流程中验证。

Result: 在所有测试模型中，2-6个头的诱导电路因果必需，消融后合成诱导任务top-1准确率下降94-100%。光谱信号无监督预测能力强，在六个独立随机种子上均能识别特定电路。可识别的专门化计算头部比例在Pythia模型族中保持17-19%，诱导电路保持3-11个头（随总头数亚线性增长）。

Conclusion: 该方法具有跨模型、跨架构的可移植性，揭示了预训练模型中计算结构的普遍性和规模不变的特性，为研究预训练发展轨迹和组合任务电路奠定方法论基础。

Abstract: We present a three-step recipe for identifying attention-head circuits in pretrained transformers. A per-head spectral signal -- the time-integrated participation ratio of each head's attention output -- ranks heads doing sustained content-dependent computation without labels or attribution gradients. A task-pattern screen filters this general indicator into a task-specific candidate circuit, and group ablation against a matched-random control completes the causal claim. We validate across an 8x parameter range (51M to 1B-active / 7B-total), two architecture families (dense, mixture-of-experts), and four pretraining pipelines. The recipe ports: a 2-6 head induction circuit is causally necessary in every model tested, with a 94-100% drop in synthetic-induction top-1 after ablation. The spectral signal is predictive without supervision: on six independent seeds of a 51M-parameter probe model, the same computation identifies the seed-specific circuit on each seed. The fraction of heads doing identifiable specialized computation is conserved at 17-19% across the Pythia family (124M to 410M), while specific induction circuits stay 3-11 heads -- sublinear in total head count. This paper is the methodology anchor of a three-paper program; companion papers extend the recipe to developmental trajectories during pretraining and to composed-task circuits where pattern selectivity decouples from task-causal structure.

</details>


### [215] [Federated Learning over Human-Body Communication for On-Body Edge Intelligence: A Survey, Taxonomy, and BODYFED-HBC Scheduling Vignette](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24062)
*Koffka Khan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文综述了人体通信(HBC)与可穿戴联邦学习(FL)的交叉领域，提出了体感知联邦学习的概念，并给出了参考架构BODYFED-HBC及优化方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人体通信(HBC)与联邦学习(FL)是两个有前景但联系薄弱的研究领域：前者可实现围绕身体的局域化通信，后者可减少原始数据集中化，但现有文献中FL研究通常抽象通信层，而HBC研究则抽象学习和模型更新流量，缺乏对两者协同优化的探索。

Method: 提出区分体内、体中枢、跨用户和临床云FL部署的分类法；构建BODYFED-HBC参考架构；设计优化公式和调度算法；开发结合公开可穿戴数据集和实证人体耦合通信信号损耗模型的可复现仿真框架。

Result: 识别出体感知联邦学习这一开放问题：学习协议的客户端选择、更新压缩和聚合受姿态依赖的HBC链路、剩余能量、传感器内存和隐私风险控制；提供了优化建模和调度算法；建立了可复现的仿真评估框架。

Conclusion: 为硬件层以上的计算机科学研究者提供了开放数据集、评估指标、局限性分析和未来研究方向，推动HBC与FL的协同优化研究。

Abstract: Human-body communication (HBC) is a promising physical substrate for wearable body-area networks because it can localize communication around the body and reduce the burden of conventional radio links. Federated learning (FL) is a promising learning substrate because it can reduce raw-data centralization for physiological and behavioral sensing. Yet these two literatures remain weakly connected: FL for wearables usually abstracts the communication layer, whereas HBC research usually abstracts learning and model-update traffic. This article surveys the intersection of HBC, wireless body-area networks, wearable FL, Internet-of-Bodies privacy, and edge-intelligence optimization. We propose a taxonomy that distinguishes intra-body, body-hub, cross-user, and clinical-cloud FL deployments, and we identify the open problem of body-channel-aware FL: learning protocols whose client selection, update compression, and aggregation are controlled by posture-dependent HBC links, residual energy, sensor memory, and privacy risk. To make the research agenda concrete, we introduce BODYFED-HBC as a reference architecture and provide an optimization formulation and scheduling algorithm. We further specify a reproducible simulation vignette that combines public wearable datasets with empirical body-coupled-communication signal-loss models. The article concludes with open datasets, evaluation metrics, limitations, and research directions for computer scientists working above the hardware layer.

</details>


### [216] [Generative Representation Learning on Hyper-relational Knowledge Graphs via Masked Discrete Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24064)
*Jaejun Lee,Seheon Kim,Joyce Jiyoung Whang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了超关系知识图谱中的事实生成任务，并开发了首个生成式表示学习方法KREPE，通过掩码离散扩散模型统一实现了链接预测和事实生成，在两项任务上均达到了最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的超关系知识图谱推理方法局限于简单链接预测，假设事实中仅缺失单个组件，然而实际场景中可能同时缺失多个甚至全部组件。为填补这一空白，需要一种能够处理任意掩码查询并生成完整事实的方法。

Method: 提出KREPE方法，通过掩码离散扩散模型学习缺失组件的条件概率分布。模型通过上下文消息传递捕获事实内依赖关系，通过聚合随机采样的上下文捕获事实间相关性，从而在统一训练框架下同时支持链接预测和事实生成。

Result: KREPE在标准超关系知识图谱链接预测基准上达到最优性能，在生成新颖且正确的事实任务上优于基于大语言模型的基线方法，成功实现了链接预测和事实生成的统一。

Conclusion: 本研究首次将超关系知识图谱推理扩展到事实生成任务，证明了生成式表示学习方法在处理复杂缺失场景下的有效性，为知识图谱补全和应用提供了新的技术路径。

Abstract: Hyper-relational knowledge graphs (HKGs) effectively represent complex facts. While inferring new knowledge in HKGs is a critical problem, current methods cast it as a simple link prediction, assuming that nearly all entities and relations within a fact are known, leaving only a single blank to be filled. However, this restricted assumption may not hold in real-world scenarios in which multiple, or even all, constituent components of a fact may be missing simultaneously. To bridge this gap, we introduce a task called fact generation: generating a valid hyper-relational fact from an arbitrarily masked query, i.e., completing a partially observed fact or generating a fact from scratch. We propose KREPE, the first generative representation learning method for HKGs that learns to model the probability distributions of missing components conditioned on the local fact components and global structure of HKGs via a masked discrete diffusion. KREPE models both the intra-fact dependencies by contextual message passing and inter-fact correlations by aggregating stochastically sampled contexts. KREPE seamlessly unifies link prediction and fact generation within a single training framework, achieving state-of-the-art performance on standard HKG link prediction benchmarks and outperforming LLM-based baselines in generating novel and correct facts.

</details>


### [217] [Not All Transitions Matter: Evidence from PPO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24071)
*Ajhesh Basnet*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现随机丢弃rollout中固定比例(25%最佳)的转换数据，可以有效打破同策略强化学习中相邻状态的冗余梯度结构，在不修改核心算法的情况下显著稳定PPO训练过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在策略强化学习训练中，rollout中的连续状态通过智能体动作因果链式连接，导致相邻转换缺乏独立性，携带重叠信息。这种冗余性使得梯度信号过度重复，相同方向被反复强化，价值网络难以跟上策略变化，造成训练不稳定，而奖励曲线无法揭示这一问题。

Method: 提出在rollout的适当阶段随机丢弃固定比例的转换数据，保持奖励信号完整性的同时打破重复性梯度结构。该方法仅需一个采样步骤，不引入新组件，不修改核心算法，可适配任何PPO实现。通过在五个难度递增的环境中测试不同丢弃比例，发现25%为最佳平衡点。

Result: 在CartPole-v1、Acrobot-v1、LunarLander-v2、HalfCheetah-v5和Hopper-v5五个环境中，该方法在奖励指标上匹配vanilla PPO性能，同时在KL散度、策略熵和价值估计方面产生更一致的训练动态，展现出更好的训练稳定性。

Conclusion: 随机丢弃rollout中25%的转换数据是打破冗余梯度的有效方法，该方法以最小化修改实现了显著的训练稳定性提升，证明了同策略强化学习中相邻转换冗余性问题的存在及其解决方案的有效性。

Abstract: Training a reinforcement learning agent on-policy means collecting fresh experience at every update, and that experience comes with a hidden problem. Each state in a rollout is the direct output of the previous one, causally chained together by the agent's own actions. Because of this, consecutive transitions are never truly independent. They carry overlapping information, and the gradient signal the network receives ends up far more repetitive than the batch size suggests. The same directions get reinforced over and over, the value network struggles to keep up as the policy shifts, and training becomes quietly unstable in ways that reward curves alone rarely reveal.
  This paper asks whether that redundancy can simply be removed. We show that randomly dropping a fixed fraction of transitions from the rollout, at the right stage so the reward signal stays intact, is enough to break the repetitive gradient structure and stabilize training. The change is minimal: one sampling step, no new components, no modification to the core algorithm, and it works with any PPO implementation. Across five environments of increasing difficulty, CartPole-v1, Acrobot-v1, LunarLander-v2, HalfCheetah-v5, and Hopper-v5, the method matches vanilla PPO on reward while producing more consistent training dynamics across KL divergence, policy entropy, and value estimates. Dropping 25% of transitions turns out to be the sweet spot: enough to disrupt the redundancy, not enough to thin the batch.

</details>


### [218] [Verified SHAP: Provable Bounds for Exact Shapley Values of Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24084)
*David Boetius,Shahaf Bassan,Guy Katz,Stefan Leue,Tobias Sutter*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种利用神经网络验证技术计算SHAP精确上下界的算法，实现了比现有精确方法大数个数量级的搜索空间扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Shapley加性解释（SHAP）在神经网络中被广泛认为计算不可行，因为它们在输入特征上产生指数级搜索空间，现有精确方法难以处理大规模问题。

Method: 引入了一种算法，利用神经网络验证的最新进展来计算神经网络SHAP值的任意紧密精确下界和上界，最终恢复精确的SHAP值。

Result: 该方法能够扩展到比现有最先进精确方法大数个数量级的搜索空间，成功计算了更大规模神经网络的精确SHAP值。

Conclusion: 这为精确SHAP计算提供了重要的第一步，并为在更大搜索空间上评估统计近似方法建立了有原则的基石。

Abstract: Shapley additive explanations (SHAP) are widely recognised as computationally intractable for neural networks, since they induce an exponential search space over the input features. In this work, we take a first step towards scaling exact SHAP computation to larger search spaces by introducing an algorithm that leverages recent advances in neural network verification to compute arbitrarily tight exact lower and upper bounds on SHAP values for neural networks, ultimately recovering the exact SHAP values. We demonstrate that our approach scales to orders of magnitude larger search spaces than state-of-the-art exact methods. This provides an important first step towards exact SHAP computation and establishes a principled cornerstone for evaluating statistical approximation methods on larger search spaces.

</details>


### [219] [Joint Optimization of Training and Inference in Federated Edge Learning via Constrained Multi-Objective Deep Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25916)
*Zhen Li,Jun Cai,Chao Yang,Haoran Gao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对联邦边缘学习中的联合训练与推理问题，提出了一个在线优化框架。通过串联队列机制连接推理请求与训练数据，考虑数据和模型的新鲜度，采用多目标马尔可夫决策过程建模，开发了约束多目标近端策略优化算法（C-MOPPO），实现了在推理精度、延迟和能耗之间的良好平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦边缘学习是实现边缘智能的有前景范式，能在保护数据隐私的同时实现跨边缘设备的协作模型训练。然而，在资源受限的边缘设备上联合管理联邦训练和推理面临挑战：需要同时优化推理精度、延迟和能耗，且在线设置下问题复杂度更高。现有研究缺乏对这些目标的联合优化框架。

Method: 提出在线优化框架，引入串联队列转换机制连接推理请求和训练数据；将数据和模型新鲜度纳入精度建模以捕获真实环境的时序动态；将模式选择、通信和计算资源分配联合优化建模为多目标优化问题；将NP-hard问题转化为多目标马尔可夫决策过程（MOMDP）；开发约束多目标近端策略优化算法（C-MOPPO），学习不同偏好策略集合并利用约束策略优化丰富帕累托前沿。

Result: 大量实验表明，C-MOPPO算法在多个目标之间实现了良好平衡的权衡，在各种系统配置下显著优于基线方法；算法能够获得高质量、密集的帕累托解。

Conclusion: 本文成功构建了联邦边缘学习环境下训练与推理联合管理的在线优化框架，所提出的C-MOPPO算法有效解决了多目标优化问题，为边缘智能系统中的资源管理和性能优化提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: Federated edge learning (FEEL) has recently emerged as a promising paradigm for achieving edge intelligence (EI) via enabling collaborative model training across edge devices while protecting data privacy. In this paper, we put forth an online optimization framework that jointly manages federated training and inference on resource-constrained edge devices. We introduce a tandem-queue-inspired conversion mechanism that bridges inference requests and training data, and further incorporate both data and model freshness into the accuracy formulation to capture temporal dynamics in real-world environments. To maximize inference accuracy while minimizing latency and energy consumption, the mode selections, communication, and computation resource allocations of edge devices are jointly optimized. We formulate this optimization as a multi-objective optimization problem, which is NP-hard and further complicated by the online setting. To address these challenges, we transform the problem into a multi-objective Markov decision process (MOMDP) and develop a \underline{c}onstrained \underline{m}ulti-\underline{o}bjective \underline{p}roximal \underline{p}olicy \underline{o}ptimization (C-MOPPO) algorithm. Specifically, C-MOPPO first learns a set of policies with different preferences across three objectives, then leverages constrained policy optimization to enrich the Pareto front and obtain high-quality, dense solutions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that C-MOPPO achieves well-balanced trade-offs among objectives and significantly outperforms baselines under various system configurations.

</details>


### [220] [Overcoming "Physics Shock" in Earth Observation A Heteroscedastic Uncertainty Framework for PINN-based Flood Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24106)
*Tewodros Syum Gebre,Jagrati Talreja,Matilda Anokye,Leila Hashemi-Beni*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种针对遥感洪水范围制图的Uncertainty-Aware PINN框架，通过动态Warm-Start协议和对异方差偶然不确定性建模，有效解决了传统PINN应用于真实SAR数据时出现的Physics Shock问题，在Sen1Floods11数据集上IoU相比确定性基线相对提升25%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统深度学习模型在SAR洪水制图中缺乏水文物理约束，常产生物理上不可能的预测结果；而现有物理信息神经网络(PINNs)在应用于真实遥感数据时，由于强制在未调节的潜在空间上拟合带有噪声的SAR斑点，导致严重的梯度发散问题(即Physics Shock)，使其在实际应用中经常失败。

Method: 提出Uncertainty-Aware PINN框架，集成动态Warm-Start协议，通过负对数似然目标函数对异方差偶然不确定性(aleatoric uncertainty)进行建模，使网络能够动态地在高传感器噪声区域放松物理约束，同时在髙置信度区域严格执行物理约束。采用概率性Attention-Gated FNO-UNet架构，并通过Deep Ensembles方法区分内在传感器噪声和分布外地形不确定性。

Result: 在Sen1Floods11数据集上的评估表明，该方法成功稳定了多目标优化过程，相比确定性基线实现了25%的IoU相对提升；通过Deep Ensembles成功区分了内在传感器噪声和分布外地形不确定性，为业务机构提供了高度校准、物理一致的置信区间。

Conclusion: 所提出的框架有效解决了PINNs在遥感应用中的不稳定性问题，能够生成物理一致的洪水范围预测结果，为灾害响应机构提供了可靠的置信边界，支持稳健的灾害缓解和实时决策制定。

Abstract: Rapid and accurate flood extent mapping from Remote Sensing data, such as Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR), is critical for operational disaster response, but standard Deep Learning models often produce physically impossible predictions due to a lack of hydrological constraints. While PhysicsInformed Neural Networks (PINNs) attempt to address this by embedding governing laws directly into the loss function, their application to real-world remote sensing data frequently fails. Enforcing rigid spatial derivatives (e.g., the 2D Shallow Water Equations) onto unconditioned latent spaces attempting to fit noisy SAR speckle causes catastrophic gradient divergence, a phenomenon we term Physics Shock. In this paper, we propose a novel Uncertainty-Aware PINN framework tailored specifically for applied Earth Observation that addresses this instability. By integrating a dynamic Warm-Start protocol and modeling heteroscedastic aleatoric uncertainty via a negative log-likelihood objective, the network learns to dynamically relax physical constraints in regions of high sensor noise while strictly enforcing them in high-confidence areas. Evaluated on the Sen1Floods11 dataset, our probabilistic Attention-Gated FNO-UNet successfully stabilizes multi-objective optimization, achieving a +25% relative improvement in Intersection over Union (IoU) compared to deterministic baselines. Furthermore, through Deep Ensembles, we successfully disentangle intrinsic sensor noise from out-of-distribution terrain ignorance, providing operational agencies with highly calibrated, physically consistent confidence bounds for robust disaster mitigation and real-time decision-making.

</details>


### [221] [Riemannian Archetypal Analysis: Interpretable non-linear data analysis on deformed star distributions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24113)
*Willem Diepeveen,Deanna Needell*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于数据驱动拉回几何的黎曼原型分析方法（RAM），结合了经典原型分析的可解释性与非线性模型的表达能力，在合成数据和MNIST上展示了优越的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典原型分析虽然具有可解释性，但其线性几何限制了在强非线性结构数据上的性能；现有的神经网络扩展虽然提高了灵活性，但往往削弱了原型和插值的几何意义。因此需要一种方法既能保持可解释性，又能处理非线性数据结构。

Method: 引入变形星形分布类及其相关的拉回黎曼几何，为流形映射提供统计解释；将黎曼原型映射（RAM）定义为投影到原型的测地凸组合流形上；提出基于凸松弛和非凸细化的优化方案；设计从数据中学习变形星形分布的方案。

Result: 在合成示例和MNIST数据集上的实验表明，该框架能够产生有意义的测地线、有效的去噪投影和几何感知的分类，同时也揭示了当前优化方法的局限性。

Conclusion: 本文成功开发了黎曼版本的原型分析方法，实现了经典原型分析可解释性与现代非线性模型表达能力的结合，为处理具有非线性结构的数据提供了新的几何工具，但优化方法仍需进一步改进。

Abstract: Classical archetypal analysis is appealing for its interpretability, but its linear geometry can limit performance on data with strongly non-linear structure; at the same time, existing neural extensions improve flexibility while often weakening the geometric meaning of archetypes and interpolations.
