Within Muon, a full training recipe is important for preventing late spectral concentration and mode collapse in deep feedforward blocks. We further demonstrate efficacy in training ViTs on image segmentation and masked autoencoder models, where Muon outperforms AdamW in all settings considered.

</details>


### [291] [Hermite-NGP: Gradient-Augmented Hash Encoding for Learning PDEs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24774)
*Jinjin He,Zhiqi Li,Sinan Wang,Bo Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Hermite-NGP，一种梯度增强的多分辨率哈希编码方法，通过在哈希网格顶点显式存储函数值和混合偏导数，实现解析求导，在PDE基准上误差降低约20倍，收敛时间缩短2-10倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于NGP的神经PDE求解器依赖自动微分或有限差分计算空间导数，存在不稳定或计算成本高的问题，无法同时兼顾效率与精度。

Method: 在哈希网格顶点显式存储函数值与混合偏导数，通过Hermite插值实现对梯度、雅可比矩阵和Hessian矩阵的完全解析计算；引入类似多重网格V循环的多分辨率课程训练策略，实现从粗到精的优化。

Result: 在2D和3D PDE基准测试中，相比先前神经PDE方法误差降低约20倍；相比其他求解器墙钟收敛时间减少2至10倍；含1700万参数的模型每轮训练时间低至3.5ms。

Conclusion: Hermite-NGP成功将NGP的效率与空间自适应性同解析微分算子支持相结合，为神经PDE求解器提供了一种快速、准确且稳定的解决方案。

Abstract: We propose Hermite-NGP, a gradient-augmented multi-resolution hash encoding designed to enable fast and accurate computation of spatial derivatives for neural PDE solvers. Unlike existing NGP-based approaches that rely on automatic differentiation or finite differences and suffer from instability or high cost, Hermite-NGP explicitly stores function values and mixed partial derivatives at hash grid vertices, allowing fully analytic evaluation of gradients, Jacobians, and Hessians via Hermite interpolation. This design preserves the efficiency and spatial adaptivity of NGP while supporting analytic differential operators up to second order. We further introduce a multi-resolution curriculum training strategy analogous to multigrid V-cycles to enable coarse-to-fine optimization. Across a range of 2D and 3D PDE benchmarks, Hermite-NGP achieves up to approximately 20 times lower error than prior neural PDE methods, and reduces wall-clock convergence time by 2 to 10 times compared to other solvers, with per-epoch training times as low as 3.5 ms for models with up to 17M parameters.

</details>


### [292] [Complement Submodular Information Measures for Balanced and Robust Data Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24779)
*Rishabh Iyer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的补充感知子模目标函数（CSI），显式建模子集与补集之间的结构信息，在理论保证和实验性能上均优于经典子模方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典子模优化仅关注选定的子集，未能显式保留选定子集与剩余数据之间的结构信息。然而在训练/验证/测试集划分、基准构建和鲁棒子集选择等现代机器学习应用中，选择质量严重依赖于在选定子集和其补集之间保持平衡的结构。

Method: 提出补充子模信息（CSI），一类新的补充感知子模目标函数，用于量化子集与其补集之间的共享结构信息。该框架诱导出多种经典子模函数的补充感知变体，包括设施定位、图割、对数行列式、饱和覆盖、集合覆盖、概率集合覆盖和基于特征的函数。理论分析表明CSI目标在有界曲率条件下表现出近似单调性，具有近似(1-1/e)的贪婪近似保证。

Result: 在鲁棒隐藏切片感知子集选择任务上，CSI目标一致优于标准子模目标。CSI显著改善了连贯稀有/尾部语义结构的保留，同时抑制噪声和孤立异常值，大幅提升下游预测性能。合成实验进一步展示了不同CSI实例如何捕获互补的代表性、多样性、连通性和平衡邻域保持概念。

Conclusion: CSI框架成功扩展了子模优化范式，通过显式建模子集与补集的结构关系，为需要平衡结构保持的子集选择问题提供了理论保证和实际有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Submodular optimization has become a fundamental paradigm for data selection, retrieval, summarization, and representation learning due to its ability to model coverage, diversity, and representativeness. However, classical submodular objectives optimize only the selected subset and do not explicitly preserve structural information between the selected subset and the remaining data. In many modern machine learning applications, including train/validation/test splitting, benchmark construction, and robust subset selection, the quality of a selection depends critically on preserving balanced structure across both the selected subset and its complement.
  In this work, we introduce Complement Submodular Information (CSI), a new class of complement-aware submodular objectives that quantify shared structural information between a subset and its complement. Our framework induces complement-aware variants of several classical submodular functions including Facility Location, Graph Cut, LogDet, Saturated Coverage, Set Cover, Probabilistic Set Cover, and Feature Based Functions. We analyze the theoretical properties of CSI objectives and show that they exhibit approximate monotonicity under bounded curvature conditions, leading to near-$(1-1/e)$ greedy approximation guarantees.
  Empirically, CSI objectives consistently outperform standard submodular objectives on robust hidden-slice-aware subset selection. In particular, CSI objectives significantly improve preservation of coherent rare/tail semantic structure while simultaneously suppressing noisy and isolated outliers, leading to substantially improved downstream predictive performance. Synthetic experiments further illustrate how different CSI instantiations capture complementary notions of representativeness, diversity, connectivity, and balanced neighborhood preservation.

</details>


### [293] [The Perception-Physics Paradox: Probing Scientific Alignment with TC-Bench](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24782)
*Dingling Yao,Andrea Polesello,Adeel Pervez,Caroline Muller,Francesco Locatello*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出“感知-物理悖论”，指出当前卫星图像视觉基础模型依赖视觉相关性而非科学不变量；引入科学对齐概念及结构同构框架，发布TC-Bench基准，证明现有模型在极端情景下失效，科学对齐不能仅通过规模扩展自然获得。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉基础模型在卫星图像预测任务上表现优异，但其性能可能源于视觉相关性而非底层结构不变量，导致模型看似正确但推理错误，传统分布外准确率不足以衡量科学实用性，因此需要明确科学对齐目标。

Method: 通过结构同构形式化科学对齐，要求潜表示在线性重参数化下唯一识别物理系统，导出必要条件层次与物理因果可解释性探测协议；构建TC-Bench全球热带气旋研究基准数据集及自动化构建流程以验证框架。

Result: 实验表明，现有视觉基础模型依赖视觉捷径，在强强度情景下性能崩溃，科学对齐并未随着模型规模扩展而自然产生。

Conclusion: 科学对齐应成为科学领域表征学习的显式目标，而非指望通过扩展规模自动涌现；所提框架与基准为构建具备物理因果可解释性的模型提供了系统方法论。

Abstract: While Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) excel at predictive tasks on satellite imagery, their performance can arise from visual correlations rather than underlying structural invariants, making even perception-based out-of-distribution accuracy a poor proxy for scientific utility. As a result, models may look correct without reasoning correctly, a discrepancy we term the Perception-Physics Paradox. To address this gap, we introduce scientific alignment as an implicit objective for representation learning in scientific domains. We study a principled, testable aspect of scientific alignment through structural isomorphism, which requires latent representations to uniquely identify physical systems up to a linear reparameterization. This perspective induces a hierarchy of necessary conditions and yields a systematic probing protocol for physical and causal interpretability. To operationalize this framework, we release TC-Bench, a global, reproducible benchmark dataset with an automated construction pipeline for tropical cyclone research, and show that current VFMs rely on visual shortcuts that collapse in intense regimes, indicating that scientific alignment does not arise as a natural byproduct of scaling alone.

</details>


### [294] [CONF-KV: Confidence-Aware KV Cache Eviction with Mixed-Precision Storage for Long-Horizon LLM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24786)
*Yubo Li,Yidi Miao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CONF-KV，一种基于模型不确定性的KV缓存管理策略，在保持近512-token滑动窗口内存占用的同时，显著提升长文本推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长序列LLM推理中KV缓存成为GPU内存的主要消耗者，现有驱逐策略（如静态最近窗口或历史注意力）未能利用每个解码步骤中已有的信号：模型当前的不确定性。

Method: CONF-KV将下一个token分布转换为置信度分数，据此动态分配每步缓存预算：模型不确定时保留更多上下文，自信时激进剪枝。在每个预算内，通过累积注意力质量与近期性组合对token排序，并保护最近窗口以维持局部连贯性。结合分块在线softmax注意力、FP16/INT8混合存储及金字塔式分层预算变体。

Result: 在4个模型族和最长4K生成长度上，CONF-KV内存占用接近固定512-token滑动窗口，困惑度仅比完整KV高1.5-2.1点；在32K Needle-in-a-Haystack任务中达到91.4%检索准确率（滑动窗口53.8%，H2O为80.6%）；在75个VisualWebArena任务中，峰值内存降低2.8倍的同时保留95.3%的完整KV成功率。

Conclusion: 基于置信度的自适应KV缓存管理能有效平衡内存效率与性能，在多项长序列任务中显著优于现有固定窗口和静态驱逐策略。

Abstract: Long-horizon LLM inference turns the key--value (KV) cache into the dominant GPU memory consumer and makes per-token attention increasingly expensive. Many common eviction policies use static recency windows or historical attention, leaving unused a signal computed on every decoding step: the model's current uncertainty. We introduce CONF-KV, a KV-cache manager that converts the next-token distribution into a scalar confidence score and uses it to choose the per-step cache budget, retaining more context when the model is uncertain and pruning aggressively when it is confident. Within each budget, tokens are ranked by a composite of accumulated attention mass and recency, while a protected recent window preserves local coherence. We combine the policy with blockwise online-softmax attention, mixed FP16/INT8 storage, and a pyramidal per-layer budget variant. Across four model families and generated lengths up to 4K, CONF-KV stays near the footprint of a fixed 512-token sliding window while remaining within 1.5--2.1 perplexity points of full KV. On Needle-in-a-Haystack up to 32K tokens, CONF-KV reaches 91.4% retrieval accuracy versus 53.8% for sliding windows and 80.6% for H2O; on 75 VisualWebArena tasks it retains 95.3% of full-KV success at 2.8 times lower peak memory.

</details>


### [295] [Active Learning for Stochastic Contextual Linear Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24803)
*Emma Brunskill,Ishani Karmarkar,Zhaoqi Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种主动上下文采样算法，用于随机上下文线性老虎机问题，通过策略性地采样上下文而非被动采样，可以将样本复杂度降低最多√d倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的随机上下文线性老虎机算法仅策略性地采样动作，而被动地从底层分布中采样上下文。然而在在线内容推荐、调查研究和临床试验等实际场景中，从业者可以基于对上下文分布的先验知识主动采样或招募上下文。上下文采样在随机上下文线性老虎机中的作用尚未得到充分探索。

Method: 提出一种新算法，通过策略性地采样上下文-动作对的奖励来学习近似最优策略，实现主动上下文采样而非被动采样。

Result: 证明了实例依赖的理论保证，表明主动上下文采样策略可以将样本复杂度相对极小化极大速率提升最多√d倍（d为线性维度）。在华法林剂量预测和笑话推荐等任务中，实验表明该算法减少了学习近似最优策略所需的样本数量。

Conclusion: 主动上下文采样在随机上下文线性老虎机问题中具有显著优势，能够有效提升学习效率，为实际应用场景提供了更优的解决方案。

Abstract: A key goal in stochastic contextual linear bandits is to efficiently learn a near-optimal policy. Prior algorithms for this problem learn a policy by strategically sampling actions but naively (passively) sampling contexts from the underlying context distribution. However, in many practical scenarios -- including online content recommendation, survey research, and clinical trials -- practitioners can actively sample or recruit contexts based on prior knowledge of the context distribution. Despite this potential for active learning, the role of strategic context sampling in stochastic contextual linear bandits is underexplored. We propose an algorithm that learns a near-optimal policy by strategically sampling rewards of context-action pairs. We prove instance-dependent theoretical guarantees demonstrating that our active context sampling strategy can improve over the minimax rate by up to a factor of $\sqrt{d}$, where $d$ is the linear dimension. We show empirically that our algorithm reduces the number of samples needed to learn a near-optimal policy, in tasks such as warfarin dose prediction and joke recommendation.

</details>


### [296] [Disentangled Double Machine Learning for Accurate Causal Effect Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24808)
*Guodu Xiang,Kui Yu,Yujie Wang,Richang Hong,Fuyuan Cao,Jiye Liang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出解耦双机器学习(DDML)算法，通过因果角色解耦和残差依赖正交化策略，解决了DML在高维或有限样本场景下估计偏差和不稳定的问题，在多项实验中显著优于13个基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双机器学习(DML)在处理观测数据因果效应估计时存在关键局限：在高维或有限样本场景下常产生偏差和不稳定的估计。根本原因在于：(1)DML使用所有协变量估计干扰函数而未解耦不同的潜在因子，导致干扰函数估计不可靠；(2)不精确的干扰估计进一步引入了处理残差与剩余结果误差之间的残差依赖，削弱了因果效应估计的准确性。

Method: 提出解耦双机器学习(DDML)算法，集成两大核心策略：(1)因果角色解耦策略，将协变量分解为混淆因子、处理特定因子和结果特定因子，实现可靠的干扰函数估计；(2)残差依赖正交化策略，缓解由干扰估计误差引起的残差依赖，提升因果效应估计的精度。

Result: 在合成数据集、半合成数据集和真实世界数据集上的实验结果表明，DDML在MAE和RMSE指标上均显著优于13个最先进的基线算法。

Conclusion: DDML通过因果角色解耦和残差依赖正交化的创新设计，有效解决了传统DML在高维或有限样本场景下的估计偏差和不稳定性问题，为观测数据的因果效应估计提供了更可靠的方法论框架。

Abstract: Confounding bias is a key challenge in causal effect estimation from observational data. Double Machine Learning (DML) addresses this issue by estimating treatment and outcome nuisance functions, constructing treatment and outcome residuals, and estimating causal effects from the residuals. However, DML often produces biased and unstable estimates in highdimensional or finite-sample scenarios. One reason is that DML estimates nuisance functions using all covariates without disentangling distinct latent factors, resulting in unreliable nuisance function estimation. Another is that imprecise nuisance estimation further introduces residual dependence between the treatment residual and the remaining outcome error, undermining the accuracy of causal effect estimates. To address these issues, in this paper, we propose Disentangled Double Machine Learning (DDML), a novel algorithm that integrates two key strategies. First, a causal role disentanglement strategy decomposes covariates into confounders, treatment-specific factors, and outcomespecific factors for enabling reliable nuisance function estimation. And second, a residual dependence orthogonalization strategy mitigates residual dependence caused by nuisance estimation errors for enhancing the precision of causal effect estimates. Experimental results on synthetic, semi-synthetic, and real-world datasets demonstrate that DDML significantly outperforms 13 state-of-the-art baseline algorithms in both MAE and RMSE.

</details>


### [297] [Cross-Domain Energy-Guided Diffusion Generation for Off-Dynamics Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24810)
*Yu Yang,Yihong Guo,Anqi Liu,Pan Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CEDGE框架，通过能量引导的轨迹扩散生成来解决离线强化学习中的动态不匹配问题，在轨迹层面生成高质量样本用于规划和策略学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有离线动态偏移离线强化学习方法存在局限：奖励增强和数据过滤方法受限于源数据集，无法合成新的目标行为；基于模型的方法仅在转移层面生成经验，长视界下误差累积。因此需要转向轨迹级生成方法。

Method: 提出CEDGE（跨域能量引导扩散生成）框架：1) 在源域轨迹上训练轨迹扩散模型；2) 通过能量引导将生成样本适配到目标域，能量由最小化源域和目标域轨迹分布差异推导，分解为回报、域和行为能量组件；3) 生成的轨迹可直接用于规划或作为合成数据训练策略。目标适配通过能量引导而非重新训练扩散模型实现。

Result: 在ODRL基准测试上的实验表明：轨迹级能量引导生成在动态偏移下改善了扩散规划效果，产生的合成数据提升了下游目标策略学习的性能。相比先前方法，CEDGE能高效适配到新的目标动态。

Conclusion: 轨迹级生成优于转移级生成，能量引导方法相比模型重训练更高效。CEDGE成功解决了离线强化学习中动态不匹配问题，为目标域策略学习提供了有效的轨迹生成和规划方法。

Abstract: Off-dynamics offline reinforcement learning seeks to learn a target-domain policy from a large source dataset and a limited target dataset under mismatched transition dynamics. Existing approaches such as reward augmentation and data filtering are constrained to the source dataset and cannot synthesize new target behavior to improve coverage beyond the collected source trajectories. While recent model-based methods attempt to address this by learning target-aware dynamics, the generated experience is constructed only at the transition level, which leads to accumulated errors over long horizons. These limitations necessitate a shift toward trajectory-level generation for off-dynamics offline RL. We propose CEDGE, a Cross-domain Energy-guided Diffusion GEneration framework. CEDGE trains a trajectory diffusion model on source-domain trajectories and adapts the generated samples to the target domain through energy guidance. This guidance is derived by minimizing the distribution mismatch between the source and desired target-domain trajectories and is decomposed into return, domain, and behavior energy components. The resulting energy-guided trajectories are useful both for direct planning and as synthetic data for policy learning. Since target adaptation is achieved via energy guidance rather than retraining the diffusion model, CEDGE can be efficiently adapted to new target dynamics compared to previous methods. Experiments on the ODRL benchmark demonstrate that trajectory-level energy-guided generation improves diffusion planning under dynamics shifts and produces synthetic data that improves downstream target policy learning.

</details>


### [298] [DriftingMol: Decoder-Coupled Drift for One-Pass Property-Conditional Molecular Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24841)
*Jiangjie Qiu,Yijun Li,Wentao Li,Xiaonan Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了DriftingMol框架，通过解码器耦合的漂移机制在SELFIES潜在空间中实现高效、高质量的属性条件分子生成，仅需一次生成器评估和一次冻结解码器前向传播。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 属性条件分子生成需要在保证分子有效性和多样性的同时，以低采样成本响应连续的目标属性值。现有方法难以同时满足这些要求，因此需要一种能够有效利用潜在空间结构、低成本且高精度的分子生成方法。

Method: 提出DriftingMol两阶段框架：1) 使用冻结的SELFIES beta-VAE提供潜在空间，将其解码器的隐藏表示作为漂移特征图；2) 采用解码器耦合漂移机制，保持解码器权重固定，但将漂移梯度通过解码器特征图反向传播到DiT生成器，引入与分子解码对齐的拉回度量。在实验中对比了15种控制变体，包括潜在空间、随机特征和外部特征漂移变体。

Result: 在ZINC250K数据集上：默认设置下QED Spearman相关系数达0.493，唯一性94.7%；最强解码器耦合条件下相关系数达0.510。在协议匹配的四属性条件设置下，相关系数高达0.598。保持通过解码器特征的梯度路径的模型比潜在空间、随机特征和外部特征漂移变体具有更高的相关性。分离或停止梯度的解码器控制导致QED相关性接近零且唯一性极低。

Conclusion: 解码器耦合漂移是一种有效的低成本属性偏置分子生成机制，仅需一次生成器评估和一次冻结解码器前向传播即可实现高质量分子生成，证明了保持梯度通过解码器特征路径对于性能的重要性。

Abstract: Property-conditional molecular generation should produce valid, diverse molecules while responding to continuous target values at low sampling cost. We introduce DriftingMol, a two-stage framework that adapts drifting models to a SELFIES latent molecular space. A frozen SELFIES beta-VAE provides the latent space, and the hidden representation of its decoder serves as the drift feature map. In decoder-coupled drift, decoder weights remain fixed, but drift gradients are backpropagated through the decoder feature map to a DiT generator, inducing a pullback metric aligned with molecular decoding. On ZINC250K, the default setting achieves QED Spearman correlation 0.493 with 94.7% uniqueness, while the strongest decoder-coupled condition reaches 0.510. Under protocol-matched four-property conditioning, decoder-coupled drift reaches mean Spearman correlation up to 0.598. Across 15 controlled variants, models that preserve the gradient path through decoder features achieve higher correlations than the tested latent-space, random-feature, and external-feature drift variants, while detached or stop-gradient decoder controls yield near-zero QED correlation and very low uniqueness. These results indicate that decoder-coupled drift is a useful low-cost mechanism for property-biased molecular generation, requiring one generator evaluation and one frozen decoder pass.

</details>


### [299] [Tiny Brains, Giant Impact: Uncovering the Keystone Neurons of LLM with Just a Few Prompts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24846)
*Xiangtian Ji,Yuxin Chen,Zhengzhou Cai,Xiang Wang,An Zhang,Tat-Seng Chua*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现大语言模型中存在一小部分“关键神经元”，它们在多任务推理中保持高激活状态。移除这些神经元会导致模型行为崩溃。基于此发现，作者提出了一种仅更新关键神经元的监督微调方法，在修改极少参数的情况下达到了与全参数微调相当甚至更好的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管大语言模型展现出强大的综合能力，但支撑这些行为的内部机制仍未被充分理解。本文旨在探究模型内部是否存在某些关键的神经元子集，它们对模型的各项能力起着至关重要的作用。

Method: 作者在多种开源Transformer模型上进行实验，通过探测跨任务激活强度，识别出一组极度稀疏且在推理过程中始终高度激活的神经元子集（即关键神经元）。随后，通过移除这些神经元观察模型表现，并分析其在预训练过程中的形成机制。最后，基于关键神经元的重要性，提出了一种仅针对这些神经元进行参数更新的监督微调策略。

Result: 研究发现，关键神经元是模型内部稳定且内在的子集，主要在预训练阶段建立；这些神经元的参数值经过精确校准，对模型能力至关重要。移除这些神经元会导致模型行为崩溃。仅更新关键神经元的微调方法，在修改远少于全参数微调的参数量下，实现了相当甚至更优的任务性能，并更好地保留了模型在其他能力维度的表现。

Conclusion: 关键神经元是大语言模型能力的核心支撑，对其参数的精确校准至关重要。基于关键神经元的稀疏微调方法，不仅高效而且能有效保持模型的多维能力，为大语言模型的理解与优化提供了新的视角和工具。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) display strong comprehensive abilities, yet the internal mechanisms that support these behaviors remain insufficiently understood. In this work, we show that across a wide range of open-weight Transformers, a subset of neurons remains consistently highly activated during inference across tasks of multiple capability dimensions. By probing along the cross-task activation strength, an extremely sparse subset is isolated, whose removal causes a collapse in model behavior, which we term keystone neurons. Our analysis reveals that keystone neurons are a stable and intrinsic neuron subset of the model that is largely established during pretraining. The parameters associated with these neurons are tightly calibrated during the training process, and their precise values are critical for the capabilities of the model. Building on these insights, we propose a supervised fine-tuning approach that updates only keystone neurons, achieving task gains comparable to or even better than full-parameter fine-tuning while better preserving performance in other capability dimensions, despite modifying a much smaller number of parameters.

</details>


### [300] [T2S-MPC: Time-Embedded Online Adaptive Model Predictive Control for Time-Varying Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24852)
*Zeyu Shen,Zhuoyuan Wang,Laixi Shi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了T2S-MPC框架，通过在线学习残差动力学模型并结合结构化时间嵌入与双时间尺度更新机制，有效处理未知且不可预测的时变动态，在四旋翼控制任务中显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于学习的模型预测控制（MPC）方法主要针对特定或结构化的动态变化形式，对于更一般、未知且不可预测的时变动态处理能力不足，需要一种能够适应快速演化、非平稳动态的控制框架。

Method: 提出T2S-MPC框架，核心包括：(1) 在线自适应学习残差动力学模型并与标称模型集成于MPC框架；(2) 通过结构化时间嵌入显式编码时间信息，使模型具备时间感知能力；(3) 采用双时间尺度更新机制，在快速适应与稳定学习之间取得平衡。

Result: 在2D四旋翼的姿态稳定与轨迹跟踪任务上进行评估，扰动条件包括线性漂移和周期性扰动。实验结果表明，T2S-MPC在控制性能上持续优于经典MPC、神经MPC及消融变体，并在广泛的扰动条件下展现出强鲁棒性，无需额外参数调优。

Conclusion: T2S-MPC通过时间感知的在线模型学习与双时间尺度更新策略，有效解决了非平稳时变动态的控制难题，为复杂时变系统提供了一种通用且鲁棒的解决方案。

Abstract: Recent advances in learning-based model predictive control (MPC) have leveraged neural networks for online model learning, achieving strong performance when nonstationary system dynamics deviate from nominal models. However, existing approaches primarily address specific or relatively structured forms of dynamical variation, leaving more general, unknown, and unpredictable time-varying dynamics insufficiently handled. To tackle this challenge, we propose T2S-MPC, a framework that adaptively learns a residual dynamics model online and integrates it with the nominal model within the MPC framework to enable fast-evolving online planning. To make the model time-aware, we explicitly encode temporal information through a structured time embedding and employ a two-timescale update scheme, allowing the controller to capture nonstationary dynamics while balancing rapid adaptation with stable learning. We evaluate the proposed method on a 2D quadrotor across stabilization and trajectory tracking tasks under diverse time-varying disturbances, including linear drifting and periodic perturbations. Experimental results show that T2S-MPC consistently outperforms classical MPC, neural MPC, and ablated variants in control performance, while also demonstrating strong robustness across a wide range of disturbance conditions without additional tuning. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/Zeyuu0920/T2S_MPC

</details>


### [301] [The Concept Allocation Zone: Tracking How Concepts Form Across Transformer Depth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24856)
*James Henry*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出概念分配区（CAZ）框架，揭示Transformer模型中概念形成是跨越多层的渐进过程而非单层事件，通过三种层级指标实现自动化边界检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机械可解释性方法仅识别类别分离峰值所在的“最佳层”，这种快照式方法忽略了概念在残差流中渐进涌现的动态过程，无法捕捉概念形成的完整机制。

Method: 引入概念分配区（CAZ）形式化框架，定义概念可分离的深度区间；设计三种层级指标（分离度、概念一致性、概念速度）实现边界自动检测；提出评分检测器识别隐蔽的CAZ；在34个模型、8种架构族、7个概念上进行实证验证。

Result: 发现分离曲线S(l)常呈多峰分布；隐蔽CAZ在消融实验中93-100%具因果活性；跨架构对齐表现为深度匹配而非单一整体模式；七个可检验预测中两个不支持、一个部分支持、一个支持、一个前提失效、两个统计效力不足。

Conclusion: 概念在Transformer中的形成是深度扩展的几何组织过程，CAZ框架提供了比传统“最佳层”方法更完整的概念形成描述，并为可解释性研究提供了可检验的理论预测体系。

Abstract: Concept formation in transformer language models is depth-extended, not a single-layer event: concepts emerge gradually across a contiguous region of the residual stream. Mechanistic interpretability methods identify the single layer of peak class separation -- the "best layer" -- capturing a snapshot rather than the process itself. We introduce the Concept Allocation Zone (CAZ): the depth interval within which a concept becomes measurably separable, the region allocated to its geometric expression. We formalize the CAZ through three layer-wise metrics (Separation, Concept Coherence, Concept Velocity) and derive principled boundary detection without manual layer sweeps. A CAZ is not a concept: it is the depth region within which the model organizes its geometry to make a concept separable. A single concept typically participates in multiple CAZes; multiple concepts may share one. Empirical validation across 34 models from 8 architectural families and 7 concepts reveals that the separation curve S(l) is frequently multimodal. A scored detector uncovers "gentle CAZes" -- subtle allocation regions invisible to standard peak detection but causally active in 93-100% of cases under ablation (16 of 34 models; 26 in the companion validation paper). The framework generates seven testable predictions; four yield clear verdicts (two not supported, one partially supported, one supported), one had its precondition invalidated by the data, and two are underpowered -- with cross-architecture alignment confirmed as depth-matched rather than monolithic under leave-one-concept-out cross-validation. Reference implementation: rosetta_tools v1.3.1 (doi:10.5281/zenodo.20361433).

</details>


### [302] [Unifying Value Alignment and Assignment in Cross-Domain Offline Reinforcement Learning with Heterogeneous Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24862)
*Zhongjian Qiao,Jiafei Lyu,Chenjia Bai,Peisong Wang,Siyang Gao,Shuang Qiu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对异构跨域离线强化学习场景，揭示了现有方法中存在的价值错配问题，并提出了V2A框架，通过整合动态对齐、价值对齐和价值分配，显著提升了智能体在目标域的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的跨域离线强化学习方法通常仅在单一域或单一行为策略的源数据集上进行验证，而在更一般的异构跨域场景（多源域、多行为策略）中，存在一个被忽视的关键问题——价值错配。该问题会破坏价值对齐，误导数据过滤选择次优样本，增大次优性差距，从而导致智能体性能下降。

Method: 提出V2A框架，包含三个核心组件：(1) 时序一致模态表示学习，从源数据集中提取动态模态；(2) 模态感知优势学习，修正价值对齐；(3) 数据过滤范式，选择性共享源数据用于策略学习。该方法整合了动态对齐、价值对齐和价值分配。

Result: 通过经验性和理论性分析，证明了价值错配问题的存在及其对性能的负面影响。实验结果表明，V2A在一般异构跨域离线强化学习设置下显著优于强基线方法。

Conclusion: 本文首次识别并解决了异构跨域离线强化学习中的价值错配问题，提出的V2A方法通过多角度对齐和选择性数据共享，实现了高效的跨域策略迁移，为该领域提供了新的研究方向和解决方案。

Abstract: Cross-domain offline reinforcement learning (RL) aims to learn a policy in the target domain with a limited target domain dataset and a source domain dataset that exhibits a dynamics shift. Training directly on the original source dataset typically leads to performance collapse. Recent studies perform data filtering from the perspective of dynamics alignment or value alignment to enable efficient policy transfer. However, these studies are typically validated on single-domain or single-behavior-policy source datasets. In this work, we explore a more general heterogeneous cross-domain offline RL setting, where the source datasets may be collected from multiple source domains by diverse behavior policies. We first uncover a critical yet overlooked issue in this setting: value misassignment. Empirically and theoretically, we demonstrate that value misassignment can undermine value alignment, mislead data filtering toward selecting suboptimal samples, and loosen the suboptimality gap, thereby degrading the agent's performance. To address this issue, we propose V2A, which integrates dynamics alignment, value alignment, and value assignment. V2A first employs temporally-consistent modality representation learning to extract dynamics modalities from the source dataset, followed by modality-aware advantage learning to rectify value alignment. Finally, it adopts a data filtering paradigm to selectively share source data for policy learning. Empirical results show that V2A significantly outperforms strong baseline methods under general heterogeneous cross-domain offline RL settings.

</details>


### [303] [A comparative study of accuracy and rollout stability of temporal surrogate models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24868)
*Rajarshi Biswas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过控制模型容量并在双摆、Kuramoto-Sivashinsky方程和Kolmogorov流三个混沌系统上进行实验，比较了几种常用深度学习架构在长时预测稳定性方面的表现，发现具有积分器式更新机制的模型偏差更低、扰动放大更小，从而实现了更稳定的长期预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混沌动力系统的数值模拟计算成本高昂，尽管时间代理模型（尤其是深度神经网络）已被用于此类预测，但缺乏公平且系统的架构对比研究。本研究旨在在统一的训练协议和匹配的模型容量下，评估不同模型架构对长时预测稳定性的影响。

Method: 选取双摆、Kuramoto-Sivashinsky方程和Kolmogorov流三个经典混沌系统作为测试基准。在两种场景下进行对比：一是匹配模型容量，二是对每个模型单独优化。通过注入步进误差并分析局部雅可比矩阵、相对单步偏差和有限时间李雅普诺夫指数增长等指标来量化误差传播行为。同时进行吸引子分析以评估模型对底层系统几何结构的复现能力，并对连续更新架构的各组件进行消融研究。

Result: 实验表明，不同架构的模型在长时预测中表现出显著的类别性差异。具有积分器式更新机制的模型展现出更低的相对单步偏差和更小的扰动放大效应，能更准确地复现底层系统的吸引子几何结构，从而实现稳定的长期预测。

Conclusion: 模型架构的选择对混沌系统长时预测的稳定性至关重要。具有积分器式更新的架构因其低偏差和低扰动放大特性，在长时预测任务中优于其他架构，推荐作为此类问题的首选模型设计。

Abstract: Temporal surrogate models are effective for predicting chaotic dynamical systems where computational cost can be prohibitive. Several deep neural network architectures can be used for such purposes. In this work, a few commonly used architectures are compared using a common training protocol. The objective is to fairly assess the impact of model architectures for long-horizon prediction stability. Experiments are carried out for three problems, the double pendulum, the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equations, and the Kolmogorov flow. The experiments are carried out with matching model capacity. Analysis is also carried out for a scenario where each model is individually optimized. It is observed that in both scenarios, the models exhibit categorical differences in long-horizon rollouts. For a concrete quantification, stepwise error injections and perturbation amplifications are analyzed using metrics such as local jacobian, relative one-step bias, and finite-time Lyapunov growth. Additionally, an attractor analysis is also conducted to assess how well the learned models replicate the underlying system geometry. An ablation study to isolate the impact of each component of a continuous-update architecture is also carried out. It is concluded that models that having integrator-like updates show lower bias and perturbation amplification yielding stable long-horizon rollout and more accurate predictions.

</details>


### [304] [Cluster Frequency Conformal Prediction for Local Coverage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24872)
*Tomer Lavi,Bracha Shapira,Nadav Rappoport*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CFCP框架，通过在学习的表示空间中利用聚类频率信息来改进多类别共形预测，解决了传统方法在特定类别或子群体上覆盖不足的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 共形预测虽然提供分布无关的覆盖保证，但在多类别分类中往往对特定类别或子群体覆盖不足，这阻碍了其在高风险应用中的安全部署。

Method: CFCP是一个即插即用框架：1)对学习到的嵌入进行聚类；2)从校准数据估计聚类级别的标签频率分布；3)为每个测试点通过软混合附近聚类分布（结合全局先验和可靠性感知收缩的正则化）构建样本特定的概率向量；4)使用标准集合构造器进行共形化。

Result: 在图像和文本基准测试中，CFCP在16个数据集/评分家族比较中的15个实现了最佳类别覆盖率，预测集大小效率具有竞争力，某些设置下效率显著提升。

Conclusion: 聚类频率信息为改善多类别共形预测中的类别可靠性提供了有效的局部信号，在保持有限样本边际有效性的同时提升了局部有效性。

Abstract: Conformal prediction provides distribution-free coverage guarantees, but in many-class classification it may still under-cover specific classes or subpopulations, preventing safe deployment in high-stakes applications. We propose Cluster Frequency Conformal Prediction (CFCP), a plug-in framework that adapts conformal prediction to local structure in a learned representation space. CFCP clusters learned embeddings, estimates cluster-level label-frequency distributions from calibration data, and for each test point constructs a sample-specific probability vector by softly mixing nearby cluster distributions regularized with global-prior and reliability-aware shrinkage. This vector is then conformalized using standard set constructors. In the disjoint-split regime, CFCP inherits standard finite-sample marginal validity. Under additional assumptions, CFCP further admits a local-validity interpretation. Since representation clusters aggregate locally similar samples, their empirical class frequencies provide a stable estimate of local label ambiguity. Across image and text benchmarks, CFCP achieves the best class coverage in 15/16 dataset/score-family comparisons and a competitive prediction set size efficiency, with several settings substantially more efficient. Overall, our results show that cluster-frequency information provides an effective localized signal for improving classwise reliability in many-class conformal prediction.

</details>


### [305] [Efficient DP-SGD for LLMs with Randomized Clipping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24879)
*Enayat Ullah,Sai Aparna Aketi,Devansh Gupta,Huanyu Zhang,Meisam Razaviyayn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了DP-SGD-RC，一种基于随机裁剪的差分隐私训练方法，利用随机迹估计显著降低了内存和计算开销，在保持模型效用的同时解决了大语言模型长序列训练中的内存瓶颈问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有差分隐私训练方法在大语言模型上面临严重的内存瓶颈，其快速梯度裁剪技术的内存开销为O(B·min{T², d²})，当模型规模和上下文长度增长时变得不可接受。

Method: 提出DP-SGD-RC算法，采用随机裁剪策略替代确定性裁剪，利用Hutchinson估计器和改进版Hutch++等随机迹估计方法来降低单样本梯度范数估计的内存占用。

Result: 在Llama 3.2-1B模型上的长上下文微调实验（涵盖分类、问答和摘要任务）表明，DP-SGD-RC在显著降低内存和计算需求的同时，能够达到与基线方法相当的模型效用，且隐私分析证明其噪声乘数具有竞争力。

Conclusion: DP-SGD-RC成功解决了大语言模型差分隐私训练中的可扩展性挑战，为大规模模型的隐私保护训练提供了可行的解决方案，实现了隐私保护、模型效用和计算效率的良好平衡。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are trained on vast datasets that may contain sensitive information. Differential privacy (DP), the de facto standard for formal privacy guarantees, provides a principled framework for training LLMs with provable privacy protection. However, state-of-the-art DP training implementations rely on fast gradient clipping techniques with memory overhead $O(B \min\{T^2, d^2\})$, where $B$ is the batch size, $T$ is the sequence length, and $d$ is the model width. This becomes prohibitive as both model size and context length grow. We propose DP-SGD-RC, a novel variant of DP-SGD with randomized clipping that reduces memory and compute complexity. DP-SGD-RC leverages stochastic trace estimation methods, specifically Hutchinson's estimator[Hutchinson, 1989] and its improved variant, Hutch++[Meyer et al., 2021], to reduce the memory footprint of per-sample gradient norm estimation. We provide a tight privacy analysis showing that DP-SGD-RC achieves noise multipliers competitive with deterministic clipping. Experiments fine-tuning Llama~3.2-1B on long-context benchmarks spanning classification, question answering, and summarization tasks demonstrate that DP-SGD-RC matches baseline utility while significantly reducing memory and compute requirements.

</details>


### [306] [On the Impact of Class Imbalance on the Learning Dynamics of Deep Neural Networks:An Intuitive Insight](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24908)
*Ismail B. Mustapha,Shafaatunnur Hasan,Sunday O. Olatunji,Hatem S. Y. Nabus*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 类别不平衡导致DNN在训练早期严重欠拟合少数类样本，后期学习到的少数类表示因过拟合而缺乏泛化能力，从而损害模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文献对DNN在类别不平衡数据上性能下降的原因解释不一，缺乏系统性理解。深入研究类别不平衡对DNN学习动态的影响机制，对于开发有效的处理方法至关重要。

Method: 通过监控DNN模型在不同不平衡比例数据集上的学习模式，系统研究类别不平衡对DNN学习动态的影响，对比分析多数类和少数类的学习过程。

Result: 实验发现：1）与平衡数据集不同，类别不平衡严重影响DNN性能；2）模型在训练早期严重欠拟合少数类样本，同时仅学习多数类；3）虽然最终学习少数样本，但这种学习方式导致少数类表示过拟合以最小化训练损失，在测试阶段缺乏泛化能力。

Conclusion: 类别不平衡通过破坏DNN的正常学习动态导致性能下降，具体表现为早期对少数类的欠拟合和后期的过拟合，这为开发基于DNN的不平衡数据处理方法提供了重要理论基础。

Abstract: Class imbalance in deep neural networks (DNNs) has witnessed a rapid increase in research attention in recent years. However, the varying accounts of the reasons behind the poor performance of DNN on imbalance data in pertinent literature shows that little is known about how this agelong phenomenon impacts the performance of DNNs. A better understanding of this problem is crucial to developing effective DNN-based imbalance methods. Thus, this study systematically investigates the impact of class imbalance on the learning dynamics of DNN by monitoring the learning pattern of DNN models on both the majority and minority classes of datasets of varying imbalance ratios. Experimental findings shows that as against learning from balanced datasets where DNN learns the classes similarly, class imbalance has severe deteriorating impact on the performance of DNN, driving the model to underfit the minority class samples in the early training epochs while simultaneously learning only the majority class. Although DNN ultimately learns the minority samples, learning in this manner only results in learnt minority representations that are non-generalizable at test phase because they are merely overfitted to keep the overall training loss as low as possible.

</details>


### [307] [Factorize to Generalize: Retrieval-Guided Invariant-Dynamic Decomposition for Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24911)
*Jinjin Chi,Lei Feng,Lulu Zhang,Yongcheng Jing,Yiming Wang,Ximing Li,Jialie Shen,Leszek Rutkowski,Dacheng Tao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个检索引导的不变-动态分解框架（RIDDE），用于时间序列预测。通过将检索到的序列作为相关环境的隐式样本，引导模型将表示分解为捕获稳定共享结构的不变分量和建模上下文相关变化的动态分量，从而解决了传统检索方法在平滑趋势序列上性能退化的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）通过检索增强预测取得了显著的零样本预测性能，但实证分析揭示了其关键局限性：检索策略倾向于产生更具振荡性的预测，虽然在高波动序列上表现良好，但在平滑、趋势主导的序列上会降低准确性。这表明检索信息在融合到预测中时，没有显式区分稳定的时序结构和实例特定的变化，从而在分布偏移下降低了鲁棒性。

Method: 提出检索引导的不变-动态分解框架。首先通过基于注意力的聚合构建检索感知表示，然后引入检索引导路由机制，将其分解为捕获稳定共享结构的不变分量和建模上下文相关变化的动态分量。这两个分量分别进行预测并融合，使模型既能保留可迁移模式，又能适应动态变化。此外，设计了鼓励不变学习和解耦的训练目标，并提供了理论分析，证明检索聚合能够降低方差并在没有显式环境监督的情况下逼近不变表示学习。

Result: 大量实验表明，该方法在分布偏移下持续提高了鲁棒性，在零样本预测设置下优于现有的TSFMs和基于检索的基线方法。理论分析进一步验证了检索聚合减少方差并近似不变表示学习的有效性。

Conclusion: 本文提出的RIDDE框架通过将检索信息用于指导表示分解而非作为辅助预测上下文，成功解决了检索增强预测在平滑序列上的性能退化问题，为时间序列基础模型在分布偏移下的鲁棒预测提供了新思路。

Abstract: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) have recently achieved strong zero-shot forecasting performance through large-scale pretraining and retrieval-augmented prediction. However, our empirical analysis reveals a non-trivial limitation of retrieval-based forecasting: retrieval tends to induce more oscillatory predictions, improving performance on highly fluctuating series while degrading accuracy on smoother, trend-dominated ones. This suggests that retrieved information may be fused into prediction without explicitly distinguishing stable temporal structure from instance-specific variations, which can reduce robustness under distribution shifts. We propose a Retrieval-guided Invariant-Dynamic DEcomposition framework for time series forecasting. Rather than using retrieval as auxiliary predictive context, we leverage retrieved sequences as implicit samples from related environments to guide representation decomposition. Specifically, we first construct a retrieval-aware representation via attention-based aggregation, and then introduce a retrieval-guided routing mechanism to decompose it into an invariant component capturing stable shared structure and a dynamic component modeling context-dependent variations. These two components are forecast separately and fused for final prediction, enabling the model to preserve transferable patterns while remaining adaptive to evolving dynamics. We further design training objectives that encourage invariant learning and disentanglement, and provide theoretical insight showing that retrieval aggregation reduces variance and approximates invariant representation learning without explicit environment supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method consistently improves robustness under distribution shifts and outperforms existing TSFMs and retrieval-based baselines in zero-shot forecasting settings.

</details>


### [308] [Explainable Retinal Imaging for Prediction of Multi-Organ Dysfunction in Type 2 Diabetes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24912)
*Mini Han Wang,Liting Huang,Wei Hong,Boonthawan Wingwon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究基于常规实验室生物标志物，构建了可解释的机器学习框架（梯度提升模型，AUC=1.000）用于预测2型糖尿病患者的多系统功能失调，识别出高血糖、肾损伤、血脂异常和炎症是主要驱动因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 2型糖尿病日益被视为一种系统性疾病，涉及代谢、肾脏、脂质和炎症途径的协调功能障碍，但现有的临床评估方法往往无法捕捉这种多维度负担。

Method: 对1,195名患者进行回顾性研究，构建系统级异常指数以量化器官特异性功能障碍，将多系统受累定义为两个或以上系统的异常。训练包括逻辑回归、随机森林和梯度提升在内的监督机器学习模型来预测多系统失调，并使用SHAP方法实现模型可解释性。

Result: 梯度提升模型表现出近乎完美的判别能力（AUC=1.000），显著优于逻辑回归（AUC=0.925）。特征归因分析显示高血糖、肾损伤、血脂异常和炎症是多系统风险的主要驱动因素。部分依赖分析中观察到的剂量-反应关系进一步支持了模型预测的生物学合理性。

Conclusion: 本研究提出了一个可解释的、数据驱动的框架用于量化2型糖尿病的系统性疾病负担。通过将常规生物标志物与多器官功能障碍联系起来，该方法既提供了预测准确性又提供了机制洞察，为糖尿病护理中改进的风险分层和精准医疗提供了潜力。

Abstract: Background: Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) is increasingly recognised as a systemic disease characterised by coordinated dysfunction across metabolic, renal, lipid, and inflammatory pathways. Existing clinical assessments often fail to capture this multi-dimensional burden.
  Methods: We conducted a retrospective study of 1,195 patients using routinely collected laboratory biomarkers. System-level abnormality indices were constructed to quantify organ-specific dysfunction, and multi-system involvement was defined as abnormalities in two or more systems. Supervised machine learning models, including logistic regression, random forest, and gradient boosting, were trained to predict multi-system dysregulation. Model interpretability was achieved using SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP).
  Results: The gradient boosting model demonstrated near-perfect discrimination (AUC = 1.000), significantly outperforming logistic regression (AUC = 0.925). Feature attribution analysis revealed that hyperglycaemia, renal impairment, dyslipidaemia, and inflammation were the dominant drivers of multi-system risk. Dose-response relationships observed in partial dependence analyses further supported the biological plausibility of model predictions.
  Conclusion: This study presents an interpretable, data-driven framework for quantifying systemic disease burden in T2DM. By linking routine biomarkers to multi-organ dysfunction, our approach provides both predictive accuracy and mechanistic insight, offering potential for improved risk stratification and precision medicine in diabetes care.
  The data and code used in this study are openly available on GitHub at: https://github.com/MiniHanWang/Type-2-Diabetes-1.git

</details>


### [309] [Quaternion Self-Attention with Shared Scores](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24920)
*Shogo Yamauchi,Tohru Nitta,Hideaki Tamori*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出共享分数的四元数自注意力机制，通过四元数内积计算单一实值分数并共享注意力分布，将乘法运算减少75%，softmax操作从4个降至1个，在语音增强任务中GPU推理速度提升44.3%、CPU提升58.1%且保持质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有四元数自注意力机制逐分量计算分数并独立应用softmax操作，存在两个问题：计算成本高；各分量的注意力分布可能发散，导致不一致。

Method: 提出共享分数的四元数自注意力机制：使用四元数内积计算单一实值分数，在所有分量间共享注意力分布。证明当查询和键由引入分量预混合的四元数线性投影产生时，逐分量分数与共享分数位于同一交互子空间。

Result: 在语音增强任务中，GPU推理时间减少高达44.3%，CPU推理时间减少58.1%，同时保持输出质量；在视觉和自然语言处理任务中呈现一致的趋势。计算方面：分数计算的乘法运算减少75%，softmax操作数量从4个降至1个。

Conclusion: 共享分数的四元数自注意力机制在保持性能的同时显著提升了计算效率，证明了独立逐分量注意力主要是在重新参数化相同交互而非扩展特征交互空间，为四元数神经网络的高效实现提供了理论依据和实践方案。

Abstract: Quaternion neural networks are parameter-efficient and model multidimensional dependencies by representing four related features as a single entity. However, existing quaternion self-attention computes component-wise scores and applies independent softmax operations to each component, which increases the computational cost and allows attention distributions to diverge across components. We propose a shared-score quaternion self-attention mechanism that computes a single real-valued score using the quaternion inner product and applies a shared attention distribution across all components. This reduces score-computation multiplications by 75% and the number of softmax operations from four to one. We prove that, when queries and keys are produced by quaternion linear projections that induce component pre-mixing, the component-wise and shared scores lie in the same interaction subspace, indicating that independent component-wise attention primarily re-parameterizes the same interactions rather than expanding the feature interaction space. In speech enhancement, our method reduces inference time by up to 44.3% on a GPU and 58.1% on a CPU while maintaining quality, with consistent trends across vision and natural language processing.

</details>


### [310] [BandVQ: Band-Wise Vector-Quantized EEG Foundation Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24921)
*Jamiyan Sukhbaatar,Satoshi Imamura,Toshihisa Tanaka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了BandVQ，一个基于频带分解和向量量化的EEG基础模型，通过为delta、theta、alpha、beta、gamma五个频带分别训练VQ-VAE tokenizer，并在大规模EEG数据上预训练共享Transformer编码器，在多个认知和运动想象任务上取得了优异的迁移性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG基础建模面临跨不同任务、导联方式、参考方式和频谱特性的记录学习可迁移表示的核心挑战。现有掩码建模方法通常依赖宽带连续patch或单一离散表示，可能无法充分表示特定频率的活动。

Method: 提出BandVQ模型：(1)将EEG分解为delta、theta、alpha、beta、gamma五个频带；(2)为每个频带训练独立的VQ-VAE tokenizer；(3)在离散VQ码索引上预训练共享Transformer编码器。编码器使用掩码码元、量化的绝对对数功率码元、通道和时间嵌入以及元数据前缀码元（表示参考、频带、任务族和阶段）。引入基于区域的掩码以减少空间相邻电极的平凡重建。在71个公开EEG语料库上预训练，包含超过9,200名受试者和357,000个单通道小时。

Result: 在当前评估设置下，在六个独立受试者分类数据集上评估，所提模型实现了强迁移性能：在三个认知任务上报告了最高结果，在三个运动想象任务上取得了竞争性表现。

Conclusion: BandVQ通过频带分解和独立量化有效捕获了频率特异性活动，结合区域掩码和大尺度预训练，实现了EEG基础模型的强迁移能力，为EEG跨任务、跨导联、跨参考的表示学习提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: A central challenge in electroencephalography (EEG) foundation modeling is learning transferable representations across recordings with diverse tasks, montages, references, and spectral characteristics. Existing masked modeling approaches often rely on broadband continuous patches or a single discrete representation, which may underrepresent frequency-specific activity. This paper proposes BandVQ, a band-wise vector-quantized EEG foundation model that decomposes EEG into delta, theta, alpha, beta, and gamma bands, trains an independent VQ-VAE tokenizer for each band, and pretrains a shared Transformer encoder on the resulting discrete VQ code indices. The encoder uses masked code tokens, quantized absolute log-power tokens, channel and temporal embeddings, and metadata prefix tokens representing reference, band, task family, and phase. Region-based masking is also introduced to reduce the trivial reconstruction of spatially adjacent electrodes. The model is pretrained on 71 public EEG corpora comprising over 9,200 subjects and 357,000 single-channel hours and evaluated on six subject-independent classification datasets. Under the current evaluation setting, the proposed model achieves strong transfer performance, with the highest reported results on three cognitive tasks and competitive performance on three motor imagery tasks.

</details>


### [311] [Global linear convergence of entropy-regularized softmax policy gradient beyond tabular MDPs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24939)
*Ziyue Chen,David Šiška,Lukasz Szpruch*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了连续状态-动作空间下无限视界熵正则化MDP的策略梯度全局收敛性。在Q^π_τ-可实现性假设下，建立了非均匀PL不等式，并针对两种特征情形证明了几何常数的下界，从而获得梯度流的全局线性收敛率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有关于熵正则化softmax策略梯度的全局收敛理论主要局限于表格型设置（tabular setting）。然而实际应用中状态和动作空间通常是连续的，需要使用函数近似。本文旨在将全局收敛理论扩展到连续状态-动作空间，研究带线性函数近似的对数线性softmax策略的收敛性质。

Method: （1）考虑对数线性softmax策略参数化，在Q^π_τ-可实现性假设下建立非均匀Polyak-Łojasiewicz（PL）不等式；（2）非均匀性源于策略几何相关常数（Fisher信息矩阵或无中心特征协方差矩阵）的退化；（3）识别两种特征情形：全仿射张成特征和单纯值特征；（4）对全仿射张成特征，证明KL正则项的径向无界性及Fisher信息矩阵最小特征值的下界；（5）对单纯值特征，在全1向量正交子空间中证明径向无界性及无中心协方差矩阵最小特征值的一致下界。

Result: 在两种特征情形下，非均匀PL常数可沿梯度流保持有界，从而证明正则化目标函数沿梯度流具有全局线性收敛性，即次优性以O(e^{-Ct})（C>0）的速率衰减。该结果将熵正则化softmax策略梯度的全局收敛理论从表格型设置成功扩展至连续状态-动作空间设置。

Conclusion: 本文成功将熵正则化softmax策略梯度的全局收敛理论扩展到连续状态-动作空间，在Q^π_τ-可实现性假设下证明了对数线性策略参数化的全局线性收敛性。研究揭示了策略几何相关的常数如何影响收敛率，并为两种特征情形提供了明确的理论保证。这一工作填补了从表格型到连续设置的理论空白。

Abstract: We study the global convergence of policy gradient for infinite-horizon entropy-regularized Markov decision processes (MDPs) with continuous state and action spaces. We consider log-linear softmax policies with linear function approximation, which extend the tabular softmax parameterization while retaining a tractable policy class. Under $Q^π_τ$-realizability for the regularized state-action value function, we first establish a non-uniform Polyak--Łojasiewicz (PŁ) inequality. The non-uniformity arises through degeneracy of constants associated with the policy geometry, namely the Fisher information matrix or an uncentered feature covariance matrix. We then identify two feature regimes under which this non-uniform constant can be bounded along the gradient flow. For full-affine-span features, we prove radial unboundedness of the KL regularizer and show that the smallest eigenvalue of the Fisher information matrix remains bounded below by an initialization-dependent positive constant. For simplex-valued features, we prove an analogous radial unboundedness result in the subspace orthogonal to the all-ones vector and obtain a uniform lower bound for the smallest eigenvalue of the uncentered covariance matrix. These results imply global linear convergence of the regularized objective along the gradient flow, i.e. suboptimality decaying as $\mathcal{O}(e^{-Ct})$ for some $C>0$. Our analysis extends the global convergence theory of entropy-regularized softmax policy gradient beyond the tabular setting of Agarwal et al. (2020); Bhandari and Russo (2024); Mei et al. (2020).

</details>


### [312] [Riemannian-Manifold Steering: Geometry-Aware Generative Autoencoders for Label-Free Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24942)
*Narmeen Oozeer,Shivam Raval,Philip Quirke,Manikandan Ravikiran,Jeff Phillips,Shriyash Upadhyay,Amirali Abdullah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将语言模型的流形引导重新定义为激活空间上的黎曼测地线计算，提出了一种无需标签质心、无需预设拓扑结构的方案，通过输出空间Hellinger距离的拉回度量，实现了更自然有效的模型行为引导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的非线性引导方法（如角度和核化引导）未学习显式的激活空间几何结构；而新提出的几何感知流形方法虽然学习了几何结构，但需要标签类质心和预设的循环或序列结构，这些假设限制了流形引导的应用范围。

Method: 将流形引导重新构建为激活空间上的黎曼测地线计算，线性引导和标签样条引导可恢复为特定度量选择下的测地线。提出使用输出空间Hellinger距离拉回到激活空间的度量，通过在概念token模式上的小规模输出距离训练学习编码器来近似该度量。该方法无需每次提示的标签、无需拓扑先验、无需每任务曲线拟合。

Result: 在标准的四任务语言模型算术基准测试中，该方法在所有任务上都能可靠地将模型驱动到目标类别；在较小的输出空间上，相比基线方法，其轨迹在行为上更加自然。

Conclusion: 提供了一个统一的黎曼流形引导框架，以及一个基于模式监督、无标签的具体实现方案，该方案无需标签质心或预设边界条件即可运行，扩展了流形引导的适用范围。

Abstract: Steering a language model - intervening on its internal activations to change downstream behaviour - has recently expanded beyond linear interpolation to nonlinear methods such as angular and kernelized steering, which define intervention transformations without learning an explicit geometry over paths in activation space. Freshly introduced geometry-aware manifold methods do learn such a geometry, but require labelled class centroids together with prescribed cyclic or sequential structure. These assumptions restrict where manifold steering can be applied, since existing constructions require labelled centroids and compatible boundary conditions. We recast manifold steering more broadly as \textbf{Riemannian geodesic computation} on activation space, recovering linear and labelled-spline steering as geodesics under particular choices of metric. A principled metric within this framework is the output-space Hellinger distance pulled back to activations; we approximate this with a learned encoder trained on output distances over a small concept-token schema - no per-prompt labels, no topology prior, and no per-task curve fitting. Empirically, the method reliably drives the model onto the target class across all tasks in a standard four-task language-model arithmetic benchmark, while following more behaviourally natural trajectories than baselines on smaller output spaces. We thereby provide a unified Riemannian framework for manifold steering together with a schema-supervised, label-free instantiation that operates without labelled centroids or prescribed boundary conditions.

</details>


### [313] [RealBench: Benchmarking Data-Driven Numerical Weather Forecasting Under Operational Conditions and Extreme Event Challenges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24945)
*Ruize Li,Zhibin Wen,Tao Han,Hao Chen,Fenghua Ling,Wei Zhang,Song Guo,Lei Bai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了RealBench，一个面向AI天气预报的新型基准测试，通过使用2025年的分布外测试集、融合低延迟业务分析数据和全球超过10,000个站点观测数据，以及针对极端天气事件的特定评估指标，解决了现有基准测试依赖再分析产品（如ERA5）导致的系统性偏差问题，揭示了再分析指标与真实世界性能之间的显著差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的天气预报模型评估基准主要依赖再分析产品（如ERA5），这些产品通过延迟数据同化生成，无法反映实时业务预报的约束条件，导致基准性能与真实世界预报之间存在系统性不匹配，尤其是在极端天气事件评估方面存在不足。

Method: 构建了RealBench基准测试系统：(1) 使用严格分布外的2025年测试集以消除数据泄漏并捕捉最新大气状态；(2) 整合多源数据，包括低延迟业务分析数据和包含超过10,000个站点的大规模全球原位观测数据集；(3) 除标准全球指标外，提供针对高温热浪、寒潮和热带气旋等高影响极端事件的综合评估框架和特定事件指标。

Result: 评估结果显示，基于再分析产品的指标与真实世界性能之间存在显著差异，尤其在极端事件方面更为突出。这证实了现有基准测试方法的局限性，验证了RealBench在提供更忠实于业务实际评估方面的有效性。

Conclusion: 本研究通过揭示现有基准测试的局限性，建立了一个更忠实且与业务相关的评估范式，为推进下一代AI天气预报系统提供了严谨的基础，有助于推动更可靠的天气预报模型在实际应用中的部署。

Abstract: Accurate evaluation of weather forecasting models is critical for their reliable deployment in real-world applications. However, existing benchmarks predominantly rely on reanalysis products such as ERA5, which are generated through delayed data assimilation and do not reflect the constraints of real-time operational forecasting, thereby resulting in a systematic mismatch between benchmark performance and real-world forecasting. In this work, we introduce RealBench, a next-generation benchmark for AI weather forecasting that emphasizes realistic evaluation under operational conditions. RealBench features a strictly out-of-distribution test set spanning 2025 to eliminate data leakage and capture recent atmospheric regimes. It integrates multiple data sources, including low-latency operational analysis and a large-scale global in-situ observation dataset comprising over 10,000 stations, enabling direct evaluation against real atmospheric measurements. Beyond standard global metrics, RealBench provides a comprehensive evaluation framework for high-impact extreme events, including heatwaves, cold surges, and tropical cyclones, using event-specific metrics that better reflect real-world forecasting priorities. The evaluation results reveal substantial discrepancies between reanalysis-based metrics and real-world performance, particularly concerning extreme events. By highlighting the limitations of existing benchmarks, this work establishes a more faithful and operationally relevant evaluation paradigm, providing a rigorous foundation for advancing next-generation AI weather forecasting systems. The benchmark implementation is available at: https://github.com/lixruize-del/NWP-Benchmark.

</details>


### [314] [MedMamba: Multi-View State Space Models with Adaptive Graph Learning for Medical Time Series Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24961)
*Da Zhang,Bingyu Li,Zhiyuan Zhao,Hongyuan Zhang,Junyu Gao,Xuelong Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MedMamba模型，通过融合状态空间模型与领域归纳偏置，有效解决医疗时间序列中局部-全局动态建模、非平稳性处理及潜在通道交互捕获等挑战，在五个数据集上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医疗时间序列对临床决策至关重要，但现有方法在联合建模局部-全局动态、处理基线漂移等非平稳性、以及捕获潜在通道交互方面存在显著不足，亟需开发更有效的建模方法。

Method: 提出MedMamba端到端架构，包含三个核心组件：(1)多尺度卷积嵌入捕获局部形态特征；(2)三分支差分状态空间编码器，处理原始信号、时域差分和频域视图以抑制基线漂移；(3)空间图Mamba模块，学习稀疏无环的有向依赖结构以发现潜在通道相关性，无需预定义图结构。

Result: 在五个真实医疗数据集上进行了广泛实验，MedMamba达到了最先进的性能，同时保持线性计算复杂度。消融研究验证了每个组件的有效贡献。

Conclusion: MedMamba成功地将状态空间模型与医疗领域特定的归纳偏置相结合，有效解决了医疗时间序列分析的关键挑战，为临床决策支持提供了高性能、高效率的解决方案。

Abstract: Medical time series are central to healthcare, enabling continuous monitoring and supporting timely clinical decisions. Despite recent progress, existing methods struggle to jointly model local-global dynamics and handle nonstationarities like baseline drift, while often failing to capture latent channel interactions. To address these challenges, we propose MedMamba, an end-to-end architecture that integrates state space models with domain-specific inductive biases. Specifically, MedMamba first employs multi-scale convolutional embeddings to capture discriminative local morphology. Second, to mitigate nonstationarity, we introduce a tri-branch differential state space encoder that processes raw, temporal-difference, and frequency-domain views, fusing them to emphasize informative patterns while suppressing drift. Furthermore, to uncover latent channel correlations, we design a spatial graph Mamba module that learns a directed dependency structure regularized toward sparsity and acyclicity, which obviates the need for predefined graphs. Extensive experiments on five real-world datasets demonstrate that MedMamba achieves state-of-the-art performance while maintaining linear computational complexity, and ablation studies validate each component's contribution.Code is available at https://github.com/zhangda1018/MedMamba.

</details>


### [315] [OSDTW: Optimal Shared Depth and Task Weighting for Long-Tailed Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24969)
*Chang Chu,Qingyue Zhang,Shao-Lun Huang,Junxiong Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了OSDTW，一个基于任务分解的原则性框架，通过将长尾识别问题分解为头部任务和尾部任务，利用KL散度推导出的可计算的偏差-方差分解来指导共享深度和任务权重的选择，从而有效缓解头部-尾部性能权衡问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长尾识别中存在持久的头部-尾部权衡问题：提升尾部性能往往会降低头部准确率并增加训练不稳定性。现有方法（如重加权、解耦训练、多专家方法）虽然在实证上表现良好，但关于头部和尾部类别之间的表示共享以及跨类别组的监督权重等关键设计选择主要依赖启发式方法，缺乏理论指导。

Method: 提出了OSDTW框架：(1) 将单标签识别问题分解为头部任务和尾部任务，使用共享编码器和任务特定解码器实现；(2) 引入分解模型处理两组标签之间的互斥性和统计依赖性，推导出基于KL散度的任务级目标函数；(3) 设计三阶段训练流程：独立任务训练（估计任务级最优值和Fisher信息矩阵）、加权联合训练（学习共享编码器）、分支组装（构建最终解耦模型）；(4) 在块对角Fisher近似下推导期望泛化误差的二阶展开，分解为编码器方差、编码器偏差和解码器方差，用于指导共享深度和任务权重的选择。

Result: 在标准长尾基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法优于强基线方法。通过偏差-方差分解提供的可计算代理，能够高效地进行超参数搜索，有效平衡头部和尾部的性能。

Conclusion: OSDTW框架为长尾识别中的头部-尾部权衡问题提供了原则性的解决方案，通过理论推导的偏差-方差分解指导模型设计，减少了对启发式方法的依赖，实现了更优的性能平衡。

Abstract: Long-tailed recognition suffers from a persistent head--tail trade-off: improving tail performance often degrades head accuracy and can increase training instability. Despite strong empirical results from re-weighting, decoupled training, and multi-expert methods, key design choices about representation sharing between head and tail classes and supervision weighting across class groups remain largely heuristic. In this work, we propose OSDTW, a principled task-decomposition framework that partitions the original single-label recognition problem into a head task and a tail task, implemented with a shared encoder and task-specific decoders. To handle the mutual exclusivity and statistical dependence between the two label groups, we introduce a factorized model and show that the resulting Kullback--Leibler divergence-based generalization error can be written as the sum of task-wise terms up to an additive constant, yielding a well-defined task-wise objective. We further develop a three-stage training pipeline: independent task training to estimate task-wise optima and the Fisher information matrix, weighted joint training to learn a shared encoder, and branch assembly to construct the final decoupled model. Under a block-diagonal Fisher approximation, we derive a computable second-order expansion of the expected generalization error, decomposing it into encoder variance, encoder bias, and decoder variance. This bias--variance decomposition provides a computable proxy to select the shared depth and task weights, enabling efficient hyper-parameter search. Experiments on standard long-tailed benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach over strong baselines.

</details>


### [316] [TGFormer: Towards Temporal Graph Transformer with Auto-Correlation Mechanism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24971)
*Hongjiang Chen,Pengfei Jiao,Ming Du,Xuan Guo,Zhidong Zhao,Di Jin,Xiao Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了TGFormer，一种专门为时序图设计的Transformer架构，通过轨迹框架和自相关机制解决了TGNN在捕获长期依赖和识别周期性模式方面的挑战，在六个公开基准测试中相比最先进方法实现了最高9.35%的精度提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时序图神经网络(TGNNs)在建模复杂动态方面表现出色，但在捕获长期依赖关系和识别周期性模式方面存在根本性挑战，限制了其性能表现。

Method: 提出TGFormer模型，采用与时序分析原则对齐的轨迹框架重新定义时序图学习，通过系统分析历史交互推导节点表示；基于随机过程理论开发自相关机制，系统性地揭示节点交互中的周期性依赖，在子交互级别进行依赖发现和表示聚合。

Result: 在六个公开基准数据集上的实验验证表明，TGFormer相比最先进方法实现了显著的性能提升，精度提升最高达到9.35%，证明了该方法在效率和准确性方面优于传统注意力机制。

Conclusion: TGFormer成功解决了TGNN在长期依赖捕获和周期模式识别方面的关键问题，为时序图学习提供了一个高效且准确的解决方案，在多个基准测试中展现了优越性能。

Abstract: The growing interest in Temporal Graph Neural Networks (TGNNs) stems from their ability to model complex dynamics and deliver superior performance. However, TGNNs encounter fundamental challenges in capturing long-term dependencies and identifying periodic patterns. To address these limitations, we propose TGFormer, a novel Transformer architecture specifically designed for temporal graphs. Our model redefines temporal graph learning by establishing a trajectory framework that aligns with time series analysis principles. This approach allows TGFormer to derive node representations through systematic analysis of historical interactions, enabling granular examination of node relationships across sequential timestamps. Building upon stochastic process theory, we develop an auto-correlation mechanism that systematically uncovers periodic dependencies in node interactions. This innovation empowers TGFormer to perform dependency discovery and representation aggregation at sub-interaction levels, demonstrating superior efficiency and accuracy compared to conventional attention mechanisms. Experimental validation across six public benchmarks confirms the effectiveness of our approach, with TGFormer at most achieving 9.35\% precision improvement compared to state-of-the-art approaches.

</details>


### [317] [Benchmarking non-conformity score functions in conformal prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24983)
*Sol Erika Boman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了共形预测中非一致性分数函数的性质与效果，提出了新的评估方法和改进函数，并在类别不平衡场景下进行了比较分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 共形预测是机器学习分类中一种有用的方法，能够提供预测集而非单一类别预测，保证覆盖率。然而，预测集的大小和实用性严重依赖于非一致性分数函数的选择，现有文献缺乏对这些函数性质和有效性的系统性研究。

Method: 1) 概述非一致性分数函数的性质；2) 总结现有文献中的函数并引入原创改进；3) 提出一种原创方法评估共形预测器的预测集大小；4) 在类别不平衡场景下比较不同非一致性分数函数在类条件共形预测中的效果。

Result: 提供了非一致性分数函数性质的系统性概述；提出了原创的预测集大小评估方法；通过比较分析展示了不同非一致性分数函数的表现差异；揭示了在类别不平衡条件下各函数的有效性。

Conclusion: 本文填补了对非一致性分数函数系统性研究的空白，为共形预测中分数函数的选择提供了理论指导和实证依据，有助于提升预测集的质量和实用性。

Abstract: Conformal prediction is a useful and versatile alternative to model calibration in machine learning classification. It replaces single-class prediction with prediction sets, guaranteeing that the \textit{a priori} probability of the prediction sets containing the true class is larger than or equal to a pre-specified rate. The size and usefulness of the prediction sets relies heavily on the choice of the non-conformity score function. The scientific literature contains many examples of non-conformity score functions but there is an absence of studies examining their properties and effectiveness. In this paper, we give an overview of properties of non-conformity score functions. We give examples of non-conformity score functions in the existing literature and introduce original modifications. We introduce an original method of evaluating the prediction set sizes of conformal predictors and use it to provide a comparison between non-conformity score functions. We also examine efficacy of different non-conformity score functions for class-conditional conformal prediction in a setting with imbalanced classes.

</details>


### [318] [Selective Test-Time Compute Scaling for Click-Through Rate Prediction via Uncertainty-Triggered Feature Path Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24989)
*Moyu Zhang,Yun Chen,Yujun Jin,Jinxin Hu,Yu Zhang,Xiaoyi Zeng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了UTTSI框架，这是一种无需训练、模型无关的方法，通过根据每个样本的不确定性动态调整推理深度来扩展点击率（CTR）预测的测试时计算，实现了显著的性能提升和实际业务收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业CTR预测模型存在基本的不对称性：训练中充分表示的特征组合产生高置信度预测，而稀疏观察的组合产生不可靠输出。现有的训练阶段方案（如自适应门控）学习固定的选择函数，同样受稀疏性限制，在部署时无法针对单个实例进行补救。测试时计算扩展在语言模型中已被证明有效，但在工业CTR预测中仍未被探索。

Method: 提出UTTSI（不确定性触发的测试时选择性推理）框架：1) 使用双信号估计器（结合模型logit置信度和数据级频率先验）区分认知不确定性和随机模糊性；2) 每个样本都经过自适应特征过滤以移除不可靠的嵌入；3) 不确定样本额外进行随机特征路径探索，通过一致性加权集成聚合预测；4) 高置信度样本完全跳过探索，保持平均开销约为基础模型成本的2.8倍，最坏情况延迟不变。

Result: 在四个数据集和三种骨干架构上的实验显示，相比所有训练阶段基线有一致且统计显著的提升。七天在线A/B测试确认了5.3%的相对CTR提升（p < 0.01）。

Conclusion: 选择性测试时计算分配是训练阶段进步的实际补充，为CTR预测提供了一种有效的实践方案。无需训练且模型无关的特性使其易于部署，平均开销可控且最坏情况延迟不变。

Abstract: Scaling test-time compute has proven highly effective for language models, yet this opportunity remains largely unexplored for industrial Click-Through Rate (CTR) prediction. CTR models suffer from a fundamental asymmetry: feature combinations well-represented in training yield confident predictions, while sparsely observed ones produce unreliable outputs. Existing training-phase solutions such as adaptive gating learn a fixed selection function subject to the same sparsity, offering no per-instance recourse at deployment.We propose UTTSI (Uncertainty-Triggered Test-Time Selective Inference), a training-free model-agnostic framework that scales inference depth proportionally to per-instance uncertainty. A dual-signal estimator combining model logit confidence with a data-level frequency prior distinguishes epistemic uncertainty from aleatoric ambiguity. Every instance undergoes adaptive feature filtering to remove unreliable embeddings; uncertain instances additionally receive stochastic feature-path explorations whose predictions are aggregated via consistency-weighted ensembling. Confident instances bypass exploration entirely, keeping average overhead at approximately $2.8\times$ base model cost with worst-case latency unchanged.Experiments on four datasets with three backbone architectures demonstrate consistent, statistically significant gains over all training-phase baselines. A seven-day online A/B test further confirms a 5.3% relative CTR gain ($p < 0.01$), establishing selective test-time compute allocation as a practical complement to training-phase advances for CTR prediction.

</details>


### [319] [Mitigating Gradient Pathology in PINNs through Aligned Constraint](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25001)
*Yichen Luo,Peiyu Zhu,Dongxiao Hu,Jia Wang,Tailin Wu,Dapeng Lan,Yu Liu,Zhibo Pang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CAML方法，通过约束对齐和流形提升技术解决PINNs训练中的梯度病理问题，显著提升复杂PDE问题的数值稳定性和效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理信息神经网络(PINNs)在求解偏微分方程时存在梯度病理问题：PDE残差梯度与边界约束梯度相互对立，导致模型陷入局部最小值。现有方法如自适应权重或硬约束要么无法根本解决这种病态条件，要么局限于简单几何形状。

Method: 提出约束对齐损失与流形提升(CAML)方法：1) 将所有零阶项重新表述为对齐约束，有效缓解梯度冲突；2) 引入延迟因子帮助优化器跳过高曲率区域。从损失景观和优化动力学角度系统分析梯度病理的成因。

Result: 实验表明CAML方法显著提升了高度复杂PINN问题的数值稳定性和计算效率，有效解决了梯度病理问题。

Conclusion: CAML通过约束对齐和延迟机制成功解决了PINNs训练中的梯度病理问题，为复杂PDE求解提供了更稳定高效的方案，代码已开源。

Abstract: While Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) are powerful for solving Partial Differential Equations (PDEs), their training is often paralyzed by gradient pathology. The gradients from the PDE residuals and boundary constraints oppose each other, trapping the model in local minima. Current solutions, such as adaptive weighting or hard constraints, either fail to fundamentally resolve this ill-conditioning or are limited to simple geometries. In this study, we systematically analyze the possible causes of this gradient pathology from the perspectives of loss landscapes and optimization dynamics. Based on the obtained conclusion, we propose Constraint-Aligned loss with Manifold Lifting (CAML). By reformulating all zeroth-order terms into aligned constraints, our method effectively mitigates gradient conflicts. In addition, we introduce a delay factor to help the optimizer skip the high-curvature area. Experiments demonstrate that our CAML significantly enhances numerical stability and efficiency in highly complex PINN problems. Our code is open-sourced on https://github.com/YichenLuo-0/CAML.

</details>


### [320] [Metropolis-Scale Resilient and Trustworthy Traffic Flow Inference Using Multi-Source Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25004)
*Qishen Zhou,Yifan Zhang,Michail A. Makridis,Anastasios Kouvelas,Yibing Wang,Simon Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了TA-ANP（任务感知注意力神经过程）框架，用于从稀疏观测数据中推断全网络交通状态，通过融合浮动车数据和固定检测器数据，实现了高精度推断和可靠的不确定性量化，并在2371条路段的大规模数据集上验证了其优越性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全网络交通状态推断（GTSI）面临三大挑战：问题的欠定性质、传感网络中的多方面干扰、以及联合建模多个推断子任务时的内在冲突。现有方法难以在保证高精度的同时提供可信的不确定性量化，且缺乏对传感配置变化的适应能力。

Method: 提出任务感知注意力神经过程（TA-ANP）统一概率框架：1）将GTSI建模为随机过程，利用神经过程的元学习特性快速适应传感配置变化；2）设计任务感知多头注意力模块，引入时空归纳偏置以联合处理三个GTSI子任务并缓解跨任务干扰；3）结合神经过程与蒙特卡洛Dropout捕获偶然不确定性和认知不确定性；4）构建都市多源交通数据集（MMTD）用于大规模验证。

Result: 在包含2371条路段的MMTD数据集上，TA-ANP在确定性和概率性指标下均达到最先进性能。模型产生的良好校准的不确定性使固定传感器部署更高效（需更少传感器）。在"损坏-修复-新增"传感生命周期下，TA-ANP在干扰吸收、性能恢复和对未见传感配置的适应性方面展现出卓越的韧性。

Conclusion: TA-ANP为智能交通系统提供了一种具有韧性、可信且高效的交通状态推断解决方案，通过融合多源数据实现了高精度推断和可靠的不确定性量化，具有良好的实际应用价值。

Abstract: Inferring network-wide traffic states from sparse observations with high accuracy and trustworthy uncertainty quantification is essential for intelligent transportation systems, yet it remains challenging due to the underdetermined nature of the problem, multifaceted disturbances in sensing networks, and the inherent conflicts among multiple inference sub-tasks when modeled jointly. We propose the Task-Aware Attentive Neural Process (TA-ANP), a unified probabilistic framework for resilient and trustworthy global traffic state inference (GTSI) by fusing floating car data (FCD) with sparse fixed-detector measurements. By casting GTSI as a stochastic process, TA-ANP leverages the meta-learning properties of neural processes to adapt rapidly to changes in sensing configurations without retraining. A task-aware multi-query attention module with distinct spatiotemporal inductive biases is introduced to jointly handle three GTSI sub-tasks, while mitigating cross-task interference. For uncertainty quantification, we combine neural processes with Monte Carlo Dropout to capture both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty. To support metropolis-scale evaluation, we construct the Metropolitan Multi-Source Traffic Dataset (MMTD), integrating fixed-loop sensor measurements, FCD statistics, and OpenStreetMap road-network data over an urban network of 2,371 road segments. Experiments on MMTD show that TA-ANP achieves state-of-the-art performance across all sub-tasks under deterministic and probabilistic metrics. The resulting well-calibrated uncertainties enable more efficient fixed-sensor placement with fewer sensor deployments. Under a Damage-Repair-Addition sensing lifecycle, TA-ANP demonstrates superior resilience in terms of disturbance absorption, performance recovery, and adaptability to unseen sensing configurations.

</details>


### [321] [A perspective on fluid mechanical environments for challenges in reinforcement learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25011)
*Shruti Mishra,Michael Chang,Vamsi Spandan,Shmuel M. Rubinstein*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将经典流体力学问题作为强化学习智能体的测试平台，用于开发和测试能够在高维演化环境中高效交互的智能体，并以Dedalus模拟器为例演示了在平稳环境中训练导航智能体的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开发能够在高维、演化环境中高效交互的实用强化学习智能体面临重大挑战。流体力学中的非线性不稳定性问题（如液体射流破碎、流体界面混合、海洋异常巨浪）提供了理想的测试场景，这些场景具有小扰动可改变系统动力学的特性，且存在可供智能体利用的跨动力学保持不变性。

Method: （1）提出了两个流体力学环境下智能体交互的问题描述框架，包括状态空间、动作空间和奖励函数的完整定义；（2）明确指定环境的非平稳方面和保持的不变性；（3）识别Dedalus和JAX-CFD作为可用于强化学习方法开发的开源模拟器；（4）使用Dedalus创建平稳模拟环境，训练强化学习智能体学习导航任务。

Result: 成功演示了使用Dedalus模拟器进行环境生成的完整流程，训练出能够在流体力学平稳模拟环境中学习导航任务的强化学习智能体。

Conclusion: 流体力学问题为开发实用强化学习方法提供了具有科学和工业价值的测试平台。本研究为未来开发能够与自然和工业流动中的科学挑战进行有意义交互的强化学习智能体奠定了基础。

Abstract: We consider the challenge of developing agents that efficiently interact with high-dimensional, evolving environments, towards a view of practical reinforcement learning (RL) agents interacting with open worlds, of which they witness and affect only a small part. We argue that canonical fluid mechanics problems, and their simulations, present a compelling testbed for the development of such methods. These problems arise in nonlinear instabilities, where small disturbances can grow to transform the dynamics of a system. Nonlinear instabilities represent several open scientific challenges with industrial applications -- the droplet breakup of a liquid jet, mixing at an interface between two fluids, and the appearance of unusually tall rogue waves in the ocean. In these settings, agents may leverage preserved representations across the changing dynamics to learn efficiently.
  We present two problem descriptions of agents interacting with a fluid mechanical environment, and describe the state and action spaces, and reward functions, for these agents. For these examples, we specify the aspects of the environment which are nonstationary and the preserved invariances. We note Dedalus and JAX-CFD as open-source simulators that can be used for the development of reinforcement learning methods (Burns et al., 2016; Kochkov et al., 2021)) We demonstrate the use of Dedalus for environment generation by creating RL agents that learn to navigate in a stationary environment that is simulated using Dedalus. This sets the stage for future development of RL agents that learn to meaningfully interact with simulated environments that represent scientific challenges in natural and industrial flows.

</details>


### [322] [MimirRAG: A Multi-Agent RAG Framework for Financial Data Retrieval with Metadata Integration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25030)
*Magnus Samuelsen,Wilmer Nyström,Somnath Mazumdar,Mansoor Hussain,Mikkel Strange*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了MimirRAG，一个面向金融分析的多智能体检索增强生成系统，通过元数据集成、表格感知分块和智能体工作流等关键技术，在FinanceBench上达到89.3%的准确率，超越了原有基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融分析要求答案基于可验证证据而非模型先验生成，但现有RAG系统难以从混合金融文档中提取有意义见解并融入分析师工作流程，因此需要设计专门的系统来提升金融分析场景下LLM的可靠性与实用性。

Method: 提出MimirRAG系统，采用模块化流水线，包括：结构保留的PDF解析、表格感知分块、元数据提取、基于智能体的检索（含查询规划和混合搜索）、验证机制，以及支持数值推理的上下文感知生成；系统通过消融实验识别关键使能技术。

Result: 在FinanceBench定量评估中达到89.3%准确率，超越原始基准线；四位金融分析师的定性验证表明系统有效；消融实验确定了三个关键技术使能因素：元数据集成、表格感知分块和智能体工作流。

Conclusion: 结合多智能体RAG架构与以人为中心的设计原则可以有效改善金融分析中有意义见解的提取，成功部署还需要校准信任、全面数据集成和用户个性化。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems offer a promising approach to reduce hallucinations and improve answer accuracy in large language models (LLMs), a requirement for reliable, financial analysis where answers must be grounded in verifiable evidence from filings rather than generated from model priors. However, designing RAG systems that extract meaningful insights from mixed financial documents and integrate into analyst workflows remains challenging. This paper introduces MimirRAG (Metadata-Integrated Multi-Agent Information Retrieval), a multi-agent RAG system developed iteratively to address these challenges. MimirRAG features a modular pipeline encompassing structure-preserving parsing of PDF filings, table-aware chunking, metadata extraction, agent-based retrieval with query planning and hybrid search, validation, and context-aware generation with numerical reasoning support. Our ablation study identifies three key technical enablers for effective financial RAG: metadata integration, table-aware chunking, and an agentic workflow. MimirRAG was evaluated quantitatively using FinanceBench and qualitatively through expert validation with four financial analysts. The system achieved 89.3% accuracy on FinanceBench, outperforming the original benchmark baselines. Expert feedback highlighted that successful deployment also requires calibrated trust, comprehensive data integration, and user personalization. We conclude that combining multi-agent RAG architecture with human-centric design principles can improve the extraction of meaningful insights in financial analysis.

</details>


### [323] [Scale When Needed: Adaptive Neuron-level Mixed Precision Quantization Aware Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25054)
*Ayush K. Varshney,Konstantinos Vandikas,Šarūnas Girdzijauskas,Adam Orucu,Aneta Vulgarakis Feljan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出神经元级混合精度量化感知训练方法（NMP-QAT），通过让每个神经元独立学习其离散精度，实现比现有方法更优的压缩-精度权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有混合精度量化方法通常在粗粒度（层或通道级别）上操作，依赖启发式或搜索式位分配策略，忽略了神经元级别的细粒度变异性，可能导致次优的压缩效果。

Method: 提出神经元级混合精度量化感知训练（NMP-QAT），使每个神经元在训练过程中独立学习其离散精度。方法从低位宽开始，当训练信号需求时通过可微分代理和直通估计器扩展位宽，同时保持完全离散的推理图，该自适应性同时应用于权重和激活。

Result: 在电信和非电信数据集上的MLP和表格基础模型架构评估中，NMP-QAT相比混合精度QAT基线实现了更优的压缩-精度权衡，有效减少了内存移动。

Conclusion: NMP-QAT方法适合在网络边缘的绿色AI部署，能够在资源受限的6G边缘设备上实现激进的压缩同时保持最小精度损失。

Abstract: Deploying deep neural networks on resource-constrained 6G edge devices demands aggressive compression with minimal accuracy loss. Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) has emerged as a leading compression approach; however, existing mixed-precision methods typically operate at coarse layer- or channel-level granularity. These methods often rely on heuristic or search-based bit-allocation strategies, which may overlook fine-grained variability at the neuron level. We propose Neuron-Level Mixed-Precision QAT (NMP-QAT), where each neuron independently learns its own discrete precision during training. Starting from low-bit precision, NMP-QAT expands bit-width only when training signals demand it, via differentiable surrogates and straight-through estimators, while preserving a fully discrete inference graph. This adaptability extends to both weights and activations, reducing memory movement. Evaluated on telecom and non-telecom datasets across MLP and tabular foundation model architectures, NMP-QAT achieves superior compression-accuracy trade-offs over mixed-precision QAT baselines, making it well-suited for Green AI deployments at the network edge.

</details>


### [324] [GL-LFGNN:A Global-Local Dual-branch Causal Graph Neural Network Based on Liang-Kleeman Information Flow for EEG Emotion Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25061)
*Ziyi Wang,Dongyang Kuang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GL-LFGNN，基于Liang-Kleeman信息流理论构建有向因果图，在EEG情绪识别中实现86%准确率且参数量仅为SOTA的10%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于GNN的EEG情绪识别方法使用对称邻接矩阵（空间邻近性或功能相关性），仅捕捉统计关联而非有向因果影响，这与神经信息流的本质非对称性和因果驱动特性相冲突。

Method: 提出GL-LFGNN模型：(1)基于Liang-Kleeman信息流理论量化因果强度，从动力系统视角构建神经生理学可解释的有向图，区别于仅评估时序优先级的Granger因果；(2)设计双分支架构，整合全脑连接与符合功能神经解剖学的区域特异性处理。

Result: 在MEEG数据集上，Arousal准确率86.17%，Valence准确率86.71%；模型仅37K参数，约为当前SOTA的10%。

Conclusion: 原理性因果建模可同时提升模型的可解释性、泛化能力和计算效率，证明了有向因果图在EEG情绪识别中的有效性。

Abstract: EEG-based emotion recognition holds significant promise for objective diagnosis of mood disorders. Graph neural networks (GNNs) have emerged as the dominant paradigm for modeling inter-channel dependencies in EEG, yet existing approaches rely on symmetric adjacency matrices derived from spatial proximity or functional correlations that fundamentally capture statistical associations rather than directed causal influences, which conflicts with the inherently asymmetric, causally-driven nature of neural information flow. To bridge this gap, we propose GL-LFGNN, a Global-Local Dual-branch Causal Graph Neural Network grounded in Liang-Kleeman information flow theory. Unlike Granger causality that merely assesses temporal precedence, our approach rigorously quantifies causal strength from a dynamical systems perspective, yielding neurophysiologically interpretable directed graphs. A dual-branch architecture further integrates whole-brain connectivity with region-specific processing aligned to established functional neuroanatomy. On the MEEG dataset, GL-LFGNN achieves 86.17% (Arousal) and 86.71% (Valence) accuracy with only 37K parameters -- approximately 10% of the current state-of-the-art -- demonstrating that principled causal modeling can simultaneously enhance interpretability, generalization, and computational efficiency. Code will be released.

</details>


### [325] [Reinforcement Learning for Laser Additive Manufacturing Scan-Order Optimisation: A Bilevel Proxy--FEA Diagnostic Framework for Reward and World-Model Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25063)
*Xian Wu,Haoran Li,Dongbin Zhao,Ruiyao Zhang,Yuanqi Chu,Bin Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种双层诊断框架，用于评估和改进激光增材制造扫描顺序优化中的强化学习奖励函数和世界模型，发现现有代理指标主要捕获变形行为但与真实热机械目标存在弱相关性，强调了稀疏FEA参考信号的重要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在激光增材制造中，扫描顺序对热积累、残余应力、变形和零件质量有重要影响。强化学习为扫描顺序优化提供了有前景的方法，但存在关键挑战：完整的有限元分析计算成本过高，而廉价的热启发式代理指标仅能捕获真实热机械目标的部分特性，可能导致奖励函数和世界模型的失配。

Method: 提出双层代理-FEA诊断框架：底层使用轻量级扫描路径和热启发式代理进行快速候选生成和策略筛选；上层使用稀疏Abaqus FEA仿真提供基于仿真的参考标签。在简化的全轨道加热LDED32条带基准上进行验证，包含10种代表性扫描策略。

Result: 残余Mises应力、U3垂直变形和PEEQ塑性指标揭示了应力-变形权衡关系，而非单一单调质量目标。中心向外策略成为鲁棒的折中候选，而从左到右光栅和边缘向内策略形成权衡的两个极端端点。代理-FEA对齐分析显示现有廉价路径指标主要捕获变形相关(U3)行为，与稀疏FEA参考标签仅呈现弱相关性。

Conclusion: 仅使用代理指标的奖励设计存在未来强化学习训练中的失配风险，强调了稀疏FEA参考信号在诊断引导的奖励和世界模型优化中的价值，建议在大规模策略优化前进行诊断框架的奖励和世界模型优化。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning offers a promising approach for scan-order optimisation in laser additive manufacturing, where sequential scan decisions critically influence thermal accumulation, residual stress, distortion, and final part quality. A central challenge in applying RL to this domain lies in reward and world-model fidelity: full finite-element analysis is computationally prohibitive for dense in-the-loop evaluation, while cheap thermo-inspired proxy metrics, though efficient, may capture only partial aspects of the true thermo-mechanical objectives. This paper investigates a bilevel Proxy--FEA diagnostic framework for reward and world-model diagnosis in reinforcement-learning-guided scan-order optimisation. The lower level employs lightweight scan-path and thermo-inspired proxies for rapid candidate generation and preliminary policy-side screening, while the upper level utilises sparse Abaqus FEA simulations to provide simulation-based reference labels. The framework is examined on a simplified whole-track heating LDED32 stripe benchmark comprising ten representative scan strategies.
