The goal is to design an adaptive policy that strategically explores the bandit instance in the initial free exploration phase and minimizes the cumulative regret in the subsequent phase. We formalize this regret minimization with free exploration problem and identify an interesting regime where the free exploration budget scales logarithmically with the time horizon. To quantify the amount of regret saved with high probability as a result of the availability of the free exploration phase, we introduce a novel set of policies known as $(α,β)$-probably saving policies. We propose a two-phase, probably saving algorithm, UFE-KLUCB-H, which consists of a principled free exploration policy, UFE, and a history-aware regret minimization policy KLUCB-H. Instance-dependent upper bounds on UFE-KLUCB-H are derived, showing that UFE-KLUCB-H accumulates strictly less regret than policies that do not have access to a free exploration phase. Complementarily, we derive instance-dependent lower bounds based on novel multi-instance perturbation arguments tailored to the free-exploration setting, demonstrating the near-optimality of UFE-KLUCB-H for two-valued bandits. Our upper and lower bounds reveal sharp phase transitions in the accumulated regret depending on the amount of available free exploration. Simulations are conducted to demonstrate that forced exploration and adaptivity in the algorithm lead to greater regret savings.

</details>


### [399] [On Reliability of Efficient Membership Inference Vulnerability Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25819)
*Joonas Jälkö,Gauri Pradhan,Ossi Räisä,Antti Honkela*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出了高效成员推断攻击（MIA）评估流程中的两个关键弱点：（1）在极低假阳性率（FPR）下，跨多个样本连接MIA分数的评估方法未能在各样本FPR间校准，导致其作为差分隐私审计工具不可靠；（2）常用的高效似然比攻击（LiRA）实现存在有限总体偏差，导致样本级脆弱性估计出现正偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 成员推断攻击是评估模型训练数据敏感信息泄露的流行方法。为降低计算成本，现有评估方法通常在多个个体和目标模型上对MIA分数进行平均。然而，这种高效评估流程的可靠性和准确性尚未得到充分检验，特别是在差分隐私审计等应用场景中。本文旨在揭示该评估流程中存在的关键弱点。

Method: 作者通过理论分析和实验验证，识别出两个问题：（1）分析跨样本连接MIA分数这一常用技术，证明其在极低FPR区域无法正确校准各样本的FPR，并提出了后处理校准方法解决该问题；（2）分析Carlini等人2022年提出的高效LiRA实现，识别出其中的有限总体偏差问题。

Result: 研究结果表明：（1）在极低FPR下，跨样本连接MIA分数的评估方法不可靠，无法作为差分隐私审计的有效工具；提出的后处理校准方法能有效校正各样本的FPR；（2）高效LiRA实现存在有限总体偏差，导致样本级脆弱性估计产生正偏差，即高估了实际脆弱性。

Conclusion: 当前高效MIA评估流程存在显著缺陷，可能导致对隐私泄露风险的错误评估。研究者在使用MIA进行隐私审计（特别是差分隐私验证）时应谨慎使用这些方法，并采用本文提出的校准技术进行修正。这对机器学习隐私评估的实践具有重要指导意义。

Abstract: Membership inference attacks (MIAs) are popular methods for empirically assessing the leakage of sensitive information in the training data through models or statistics learned from the data. The MIA vulnerability is often evaluated through false positive rate (FPR) and true positive rate (TPR) of a binary classifier that tries to predict whether a particular sample was in the training data. However, in order to reliably estimate the TPR especially for low FPR values, a lot of observations are needed, which in case of MIA translates to many target models, leading to large computational cost. To avoid excessive compute requirements, the MIA scores are often averaged over multiple individuals and multiple targeted models. We demonstrate two key weaknesses in this efficient MIA evaluation pipeline. First, we show that evaluating the TPR based on MIA scores concatenated across multiple individuals, commonly used to study vulnerabilities in the very low FPR regime, is not calibrated across the per-sample FPRs. This makes it unreliable as a tool for auditing differential privacy. To solve this, we propose a post-processing method to effectively calibrate the FPR across different samples. Second, we identify a finite population bias in the commonly used efficient likelihood-ratio attack (LiRA) implementation proposed by Carlini et al. 2022, leading to a positive bias in the per-sample vulnerability.

</details>


### [400] [Visual-Redundancy-Controlled Parallel Decoding for Diffusion-Based Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25820)
*Yulin Yuan,Hongshuo Zhao,Xiangming Meng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对扩散式多模态大语言模型解码中存在的视觉冗余问题，提出了无需训练的VRCD解码方法，通过关注视觉互补性显著提升生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于置信度的解码方法独立排序各掩码位置并提交Top-K，忽略了这些位置是否具有互补的视觉依据。研究发现同一解码步骤中选出的高置信度Token往往依赖重叠的视觉区域，造成视觉冗余，削弱了后续解码可用的互补视觉信息。

Method: 1) 提出视觉冗余指数(VRI)量化并行提交Token间的视觉依据重叠程度；2) 提出视觉冗余控制解码(VRCD)，一种无需训练的推理时解码方法，利用Token-图像注意力优先选择视觉上互补的位置。

Result: 在多种多模态基准测试中，VRCD有效降低了视觉冗余和剩余位置熵。在更长解码实验中，相比基于置信度的解码，VRCD在M^3CoT上获得最高18.8%的相对准确率提升，在MMBench上获得6.9%的提升，运行时开销较小。

Conclusion: 通过显式控制视觉冗余，VRCD显著改善了扩散式多模态大语言模型的解码效果，证明了视觉互补性在多模态并行解码中的重要性。

Abstract: Diffusion-based multimodal large language models (dMLLMs) decode by iteratively predicting tokens at multiple masked positions in parallel. This turns each decoding step into a position-selection problem: the model must choose not only which predictions are reliable in isolation, but also which positions should be committed together as context for later decoding steps. Existing confidence-based decoding ranks masked positions independently and commits the top-K positions, largely ignoring whether the committed tokens provide complementary visual grounding. We identify a step-level limitation of this strategy in multimodal settings: high-confidence tokens selected in the same step can rely on overlapping visual grounding, introducing visual redundancy among the committed tokens and leaving less complementary visual grounding available for later decoding. To quantify this effect, we introduce the Visual Redundancy Index (VRI), which measures visual grounding overlap among tokens committed in parallel. To control this redundancy during decoding, we propose Visual-Redundancy-Controlled Decoding (VRCD), a training-free inference-time decoding method that uses token-to-image attention to prioritize visually complementary positions. Across diverse multimodal benchmarks, VRCD reduces visual redundancy and remaining-position entropy with modest runtime overhead. In longer decoding experiments, it also achieves relative accuracy gains of up to 18.8% on M^3CoT and 6.9% on MMBench over confidence-based decoding. Code will be released at https://github.com/infiniteYuanyl/VRCD.

</details>


### [401] [Context-Instrumental Data Distillation for Kubernetes Manifest Generation: Method and Experimental Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25835)
*Andrey Kozachok,Anatoliy Bakaev,Aleksandr Kozachok,Shamil Magomedov,Artem Noev*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究通过上下文工具性数据蒸馏方法，将小型语言模型专业化用于生成Kubernetes配置文件，在资源受限条件下（CPU上微调）实现了91.5%的准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究旨在探索小型语言模型（参数量≤4B）在领域特定语言（DSL）生成任务中的专业化能力，选择Kubernetes配置文件作为目标领域，以解决在资源受限场景下部署高质量DSL生成模型的需求。

Method: 提出上下文工具性数据蒸馏方法：通过合成生成和反向指令生成构建源语料库，仅将通过外部验证器验证且匹配领域上下文模型的样本对纳入训练；采用DeepSeek-V4 Flash API作为教师模型进行合成生成，使用LoRA技术在CPU上微调Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct模型。

Result: 在K8s-Distill-Pilot数据集（训练集1200、验证集100、测试集200）上，采用严格提示格式和max_new_tokens=768设置，实现了full-pass@1 = 91.5%（183/200）的准确率。关键发现：对于Kubernetes YAML生成，结果质量更依赖于严格的输出格式要求，而非单纯增加训练样本数量。

Conclusion: 小型语言模型可通过工具性验证的数据蒸馏方法有效专业化于DSL生成任务；在资源受限条件下，严格的输出格式约束比增加训练数据量更能提升生成质量，为低资源场景下的模型专业化提供了可行路径。

Abstract: This paper examines the specialization of Small Language Models (SLMs) with up to 4 billion parameters for generating artifacts in domain-specific languages (DSL). Kubernetes manifests are chosen as the target domain. We propose the context-instrumental data distillation method: the source corpus is formed through synthetic generation and, in an extended scheme, through reverse instruction generation from real Kubernetes YAML files, with pairs included in training only upon passing external validators and matching the domain context model. Unlike classical KL-divergence knowledge distillation, the baseline implementation reduces to supervised fine-tuning on instrumentally verified examples. The experimental section presents a pilot implementation under resource-constrained conditions: the DeepSeek-V4 Flash API serves as the teacher for synthetic generation, while Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct is fine-tuned via LoRA on CPU. On the K8s-Distill-Pilot corpus (train_1200, validation_100, test_200), we achieved full-pass@1 = 91.5% (183/200) with a stricter prompt formulation and max_new_tokens=768. The key empirical finding is that for Kubernetes YAML, result quality in the pilot depended more on strict output format requirements than on simply increasing the number of training examples.

</details>


### [402] [Geometric Evolution Maps: Extracting Stable Concept Probes from Transformer Residual Streams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25848)
*James Henry*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GEMs方法，通过追踪概念方向轨迹并识别handoff层来提取探针，在66.2%的实验中优于传统peak-layer方法，尤其适用于MHA架构模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在固定层或分离分数峰值层提取探针，忽略了概念表示在组装阶段会经历显著方向旋转，直到handoff层才趋于稳定这一结构特征。

Method: 引入几何演化图，追踪概念在残差流激活中的完整方向轨迹，识别旋转停止的handoff层，并从该层提取稳定的探针方向；配合自适应消融宽度规则优化近终层情况。

Result: 在23个架构、17种概念类型上，CAZ内入口到出口的余弦相似度均值仅0.233；GEM探针在259/391组实验(66.2%)中严格优于峰值层探针；MHA模型优势更显著(78.3%)，GQA模型优势较弱(47.1%)；方向特异性控制显示中位数377倍抑制率。

Conclusion: GEMs揭示了概念表示的动态组装过程，证明了handoff层探针提取的有效性，为模型可解释性研究提供了更可靠的方法论基础，但效果因注意力机制类型而异。

Abstract: Concept probes extracted from transformer residual streams are only as reliable as the layer from which they are extracted. The common practice of probing at a fixed late layer or at the peak of a separation score function ignores a fundamental structural feature: concept representations undergo substantial directional rotation during their assembly phase, and do not settle into a stable direction until a characteristic handoff layer after the primary Concept Allocation Zone (CAZ). We introduce Geometric Evolution Maps (GEMs), which track the full directional trajectory of a concept through residual stream activations, identify the handoff layer where rotation ceases, and extract the settled probe direction from that layer. Across 23 architectures spanning 70M to 14B parameters and 17 concept types, the entry-to-exit cosine similarity within CAZs has a mean of 0.233, showing that probe direction at CAZ entry does not reliably predict probe direction at exit. Ablation experiments across 391 concept x model pairs (23 models x 17 concepts) show that GEM-extracted probes are at least as precise as peak-layer probes in 268/391 trials (68.5%), and strictly outperform in 259/391 (66.2%). The architecture split is pronounced: MHA models favour the handoff in 173/221 trials (78.3%); GQA models favour the handoff in only 56/119 trials (47.1%). Model-level Wilcoxon: W=214, N=23, p=0.010 (one-sided). An adaptive ablation width rule targets the 79/391 near-final-layer cases: it improves probe quality in 60/79 triggered cases (75.9%), mean gain +7.44pp. A direction-specificity control confirms the ablation effect is concept-direction specific: median 377x suppression rate versus random-direction ablation (99.1% of concept directions beat all 10 random seeds). Reference implementation: rosetta_tools v1.3.1 (doi:10.5281/zenodo.20361433).

</details>


### [403] [When Self-Belief Misleads: Active Label Acquisition for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25864)
*Li Wang,Xiaodong Lu,Xiaohan Wang,Yikun Ban,Jiajun Chai,Wei Lin,Tianhao Peng,Guojun Yin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RLAVR方法，通过主动学习选择少量高价值样本进行标注，结合伪标签在有限标注预算下稳定训练；引入CAG指标和CARE策略实现高效样本选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RLVR方法依赖昂贵的真实标签，无监督方法使用伪标签易导致训练崩溃，且不同样本的标注价值不同。

Method: 提出Reinforcement Learning with Active Verifiable Rewards (RLAVR)框架，主动获取少量精选样本的真实标签并与伪标签结合；提出Corrective Advantage Gap (CAG)指标分析样本级监督价值；设计Correction-Aware Reliability Estimation (CARE)预查询获取策略。

Result: 在多个领域、模型家族和模型规模上的广泛实验证明了方法的有效性和通用性。

Conclusion: RLAVR通过主动学习策略，在有限标注预算下有效解决了RLVR训练不稳定问题，实现了性能提升与标注成本降低的平衡。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable advancements in reasoning capabilities empowered by Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR). Nonetheless, RLVR intrinsically relies on ground-truth labels for reward computation, the acquisition of which is often prohibitively expensive in real-world scenarios. While unsupervised RLVR paradigms attempt to circumvent this by training on pseudo-labels, they are notoriously susceptible to training collapse. Moreover, different samples often exhibit varying annotation values. In this paper, we propose Reinforcement Learning with Active Verifiable Rewards (RLAVR), which actively acquires ground-truth labels for a small set of selected samples and integrates them with pseudo-labels, thereby stabilizing training dynamics and improving performance under limited annotation budgets. To identify valuable samples, we propose the Corrective Advantage Gap (CAG) metric and analyze the sample-level supervision value. Building on this, we introduce Correction-Aware Reliability Estimation for RLAVR (CARE), which translates the oracle CAG criterion into a practical pre-query acquisition policy to substantially improve training stability. Extensive experiments across diverse domains, model families, and model scales demonstrate the effectiveness and generality of our approach. Our code is available at https://github.com/Lumina04/CARE.

</details>


### [404] [UNATE: UNsupervised ATomic Embedding for crystal structures property prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25866)
*Laura Solà-Garcia,Àlex Solé,Javier Ruiz-Hidalgo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出UNATE框架，利用无监督去噪自编码器和自监督对比学习从无标签晶体结构中学习原子表示，显著提升材料性质预测性能，尤其在标注数据稀缺时效果更佳（最高提升10%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 准确预测晶体性质对于加速材料发现至关重要，但受到标注数据稀缺和理论计算成本高昂的限制。

Method: 提出UNATE（无监督原子嵌入）框架，将无监督去噪自编码器与自监督对比学习相结合，从无标签晶体结构中提取结构信息，学习鲁棒的原子表示，并将其作为下游性质预测任务的输入特征。

Result: 实验结果表明，使用UNATE预训练的节点嵌入替代原始原子序数，在全数据基线上提升了2.7%。在标注数据有限的场景下优势更加明显，当仅使用25%的标注数据时，性能提升最高可达10%。

Conclusion: UNATE框架能够有效利用无标签晶体结构信息，学习高质量的原子表示，显著缓解标注数据稀缺问题，为加速材料发现提供了有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Accurately predicting crystal properties is critical for accelerating materials discovery, but it is often limited by scarce labeled data and costly theoretical calculations. To alleviate this, we propose UNATE (Unsupervised Atomic Embedding), a framework that leverages structural information extracted from unlabeled crystal structures. UNATE integrates an unsupervised denoising autoencoder with self-supervised contrastive learning to learn robust atomic representations, which are then used as input features for downstream property prediction. Experimental results show that replacing raw atomic numbers with UNATE-pretrained node embeddings yields a 2.7\% improvement over the full-data baseline. Notably, the benefits become more pronounced in scenarios with limited labeled data, reaching improvements of up to 10\% when only 25\% of the labeled data is used.

</details>


### [405] [The Quantization Benefits of Residual-Free Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25880)
*Yiping Ji,Mahalakshmi Sabanayagam,Peyman Moghadam,Hemanth Saratchandran,Simon Lucey*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文发现残差连接会导致Transformer激活值偏离高斯分布，显著降低低比特量化的精度；通过提出无残差Transformer并结合正交初始化、谱优化等技术，在语言任务中实现了对低比特量化显著更好的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模Transformer训练和部署受限于激活值、梯度和优化器状态在加速器间的传输开销；低比特量化虽是自然解决方案，但Transformer激活值往往呈现重尾和离群点主导特性，导致简单量化损失严重。作者旨在探究该问题的根源不仅在于量化器本身，更在于模型架构设计。

Method: 1. 通过残差与无残差Transformer的对照实验，分析残差连接对激活值分布的影响；2. 使用超额峰度分析解释残差混合放大非高斯性、稠密混合收缩非高斯性的机理；3. 构建可训练的无残差Transformer，采用正交初始化、谱或二阶优化、深度感知的注意力温度缩放等技术；4. 在语言任务上对比全精度性能与低比特量化鲁棒性。

Result: 1. 残差连接在训练过程中驱动激活值偏离高斯分布，导致低精度下量化误差和精度退化显著增加；2. 无残差Transformer在全精度下性能略有下降，但激活值保持近似高斯分布；3. 无残差模型在低比特量化下表现出显著更好的鲁棒性，量化误差和精度损失明显更低。

Conclusion: 该研究揭示了Transformer设计中存在的精度-可压缩性权衡关系，残差连接虽有利于训练但损害量化友好性；研究结果启发了在架构层面设计量化友好的基础模型，为未来大规模模型的部署提供了新的设计思路。

Abstract: Large-scale transformer training and deployment are increasingly constrained by the transfer of activations, gradients, and optimizer states across accelerators. Low-bit quantization offers a natural remedy, but transformer activations are often heavy-tailed and outlier-dominated, making simple quantization highly lossy. We show that this difficulty is not only a property of the quantizer, but also of the architecture. Specifically, residual connections can drive transformer activations away from Gaussianity during training. Using controlled comparisons between residual and residual-free transformers, we demonstrate that this effect leads to substantially higher quantization error and accuracy degradation at low precision in residual models. We explain the phenomenon through an excess kurtosis analysis, showing that residual mixing can amplify non-Gaussianity, whereas dense mixing in residual-free contracts non-Gaussianity. We then show that residual-free transformers can be made trainable using orthogonal initialization, spectral or second-order optimization, and depth-aware scaling of attention temperature. In language tasks, while there is a small drop in full precision performance, these models retain near-Gaussian activations and exhibit significantly improved robustness to low-bit quantization. Our results identify an accuracy--compressibility trade-off in transformer design and motivate architecture-level approaches to quantization-friendly foundation models.

</details>


### [406] [Conformalised imprecise inference for robust extrapolation under limited data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25882)
*Yu Chen,Scott Ferson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个保形不精确推理框架，用于在分布偏移下实现鲁棒的外推预测，能够自适应地扩大不确定性范围，在保持覆盖性的同时提供可靠的不确定性量化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习中的不确定性量化越来越强调偶然不确定性和认知不确定性的区分，需要更统一的框架。然而，现有方法在训练域之外进行泛化时往往缺乏严格的保证，无法提供可靠的不确定性量化。

Method: 提出了一种保形不精确推理框架，该框架具有模型无关性，通过引入不精确性和距离感知来增强预测模型。该方法生成不精确预测（概率盒），在分布偏移下保持有效性，能够自适应地在预测范围外推时扩大不确定性。

Result: 在合成数据集和基准数据集上的实验表明，与标准概率方法相比，该方法在数据有限的情况下表现出更好的鲁棒性和可靠的覆盖性，特别是在分布外推场景中优势明显。

Conclusion: 所提出的框架成功地为机器学习模型在分布偏移下的外推预测提供了严格的理论保证，实现了鲁棒性和可靠覆盖性的平衡，为不确定性量化领域提供了一个统一且实用的解决方案。

Abstract: Recent advances in uncertainty quantification increasingly emphasise the distinction between aleatory and epistemic uncertainty in machine learning, motivating the need for more unified frameworks. However, despite much progress in producing reliable predictions, existing methods often lack rigorous guarantees when generalising beyond the training domain. We propose a conformalised imprecise inference framework for robust extrapolation, which is model-agnostic and augments predictive models with imprecision and distance awareness. The proposed approach yields imprecise predictions (probability boxes) that remain valid under distributional shift, maintaining coverage while adaptively expanding uncertainty in extrapolation regimes. Experiments on synthetic and benchmark datasets demonstrate improved robustness and reliable coverage compared to standard probabilistic approaches, particularly under limited data.

</details>


### [407] [Optimal and Order-optimal Gated Priority-based Greedy Policies for Two-layer Multi-item Order Fulfillment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25888)
*Xi Chen,Yuze Chen,Ziyi Chen,Yuan Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了电商在两层配送网络中的实时履约决策问题，提出了一类有竞争比保证的优先级贪心策略，在未知需求的在线场景下表现接近最优离线算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电商履约面临核心管理权衡：是否使用稀缺的前置配送中心(FDC)库存来降低当前履约成本，还是保留库存以服务未来可能更有价值的本地订单，这种实时决策在未知未来需求的情况下具有挑战性。

Method: 构建了一个对抗性在线模型，包含多个FDC、一个区域配送中心(RDC)、多单位多商品订单以及随时间变化的商品特定变动成本；开发了一类门控优先级贪心(Gated Priority-based Greedy)策略，并在时变和时不变成本结构下推导竞争比保证。

Result: 为所提出的在线算法建立了匹配或近乎匹配的下界，证明了竞争比的理论保证；数值实验表明所提策略相对于广义短视策略和基于预测的基准方法表现优异。

Conclusion: 研究为何时应保护本地库存、何时值得承担固定成本拆分订单，以及固定成本与变动成本的相对大小如何决定复杂优化方法的价值提供了管理指导。

Abstract: We study how an e-commerce firm should make real-time fulfillment decisions in a two-layer distribution network when multi-item customer orders arrive sequentially and future demand is unknown. The central managerial tension is whether to use scarce front distribution center (FDC) inventory to save current fulfillment cost or preserve that inventory for future orders that may be more valuable to serve locally. We formulate an adversarial online model with multiple FDCs, one regional distribution center (RDC), multi-unit multi-item orders, and item-specific and time-varying variable costs. Our theoretical objective is to characterize when simple, interpretable, and implementable fulfillment rules can perform nearly as well as an optimal clairvoyant planner. We develop a family of Gated Priority-based Greedy policies, derive competitive-ratio guarantees under both time-varying and time-invariant cost structures, and establish matching or near-matching lower bounds for any online algorithm. Numerical experiments show that the proposed policies perform strongly relative to generalized myopic and forecast-based benchmarks. The analysis yields managerial guidance on when local inventory should be protected, when splitting orders is worth the fixed-cost burden, and how the relative magnitudes of fixed and variable costs determine the value of more sophisticated optimization.

</details>


### [408] [Merge-Bench: Resolve Merge Conflicts with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25890)
*Benedikt Schesch,Michael D. Ernst*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文构建了包含7938个真实合并冲突的数据集Merge-Bench，并使用强化学习方法训练了Java合并冲突解决模型LLMergeJ，其14B参数版本性能仅次于Gemini 2.5 Pro，优于其他商业LLM，但最佳模型正确率仍低于60%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 版本控制合并是一个困难且重要的任务，现有方法效果有限。本文旨在利用机器学习技术，特别是大语言模型，来自动解决合并冲突问题，提高软件开发效率。

Method: 构建包含7938个真实合并冲突的数据集Merge-Bench，采用无需人工标注的可扩展数据集构建方法；使用Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)在线强化学习方法训练大语言模型LLMergeJ用于解决Java程序中的合并冲突。

Result: 在Java程序上，LLMergeJ（14B参数）性能优于3个商业LLM，仅次于Gemini 2.5 Pro；在11种编程语言测试中，商业LLM性能表现稳定；最佳模型的合并冲突正确解决率低于60%。

Conclusion: 机器学习在合并冲突解决方面展现出潜力，但仍存在改进空间；构建的基准数据集和方法论为后续研究提供了基础；该领域需要进一步研究以提升自动解决合并冲突的准确率。

Abstract: This paper applies machine learning to the difficult and important task of version control merging. (1) We constructed a dataset, Merge-Bench, of 7938 real-world merge conflict hunks from 1439 GitHub repositories. The ground truth is the merge resolution that developers committed to the repository. Our dataset construction methodology is scalable to arbitrary amounts of data since no manual labeling is required. (2) We trained a model, LLMergeJ, to resolve merge conflicts in Java programs. Our approach uses Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), an online reinforcement learning method, to train a Large Language Model (LLM). (3) We performed two evaluations of the performance of LLMs on resolving merge conflicts. On Java programs, LLMergeJ with 14B parameters outperforms 3 commercial LLMs, trailing only Gemini 2.5 Pro. Across 11 programming languages, commercial LLM performance is largely stable from language to language. The best models correctly resolve less than 60% of merge conflicts.

</details>


### [409] [Predicting Stock Price Direction on Earnings Announcement Days using Multi-modal Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25894)
*Manuel Noseda,Nathan Soldati,Marco Paina*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究构建了融合基本面、技术指标和新闻情感的多模态特征空间，对比评估了LSTM和Transformer模型在财报公告日预测股价走势的能力。结果显示Transformer在识别波动性变动方面表现更优，加入新闻情感特征能一致性地提升模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 财报公告期间的股价预测面临市场噪声和高影响价格不连续性的重大挑战，研究旨在评估公告前新闻情感、公司基本面和近期市场动态是否能联合预测财报日的股价方向性变动。

Method: 构建多模态特征空间，融合15个基本面指标、3个基于价格的技术指标以及经FinBERT处理的财经新闻情感分数；对比LSTM网络、Transformer架构与逻辑回归基线模型，并通过消融实验评估加入情感特征的增量价值。

Result: LSTM通过保守的稳健策略展现出更高的精确度，而Transformer模型在识别波动性变动方面表现更优，取得了更高的宏平均F1分数；消融实验表明，纳入新闻情感特征能带来一致性的性能提升。

Conclusion: 多模态特征融合方法对财报公告期的股价预测具有有效性，Transformer架构在捕捉复杂波动模式方面优于LSTM，新闻情感信息为预测模型提供了显著的增量价值。

Abstract: Predicting stock price movements during Earnings Announcements (EAs) is a significant challenge due to market noise and high-impact price discontinuities. In this study, we evaluate whether pre-announcement news sentiment, firm fundamentals, and recent market dynamics jointly predict the directional price movement of equities on EA days. We construct a multi-modal feature space combining 15 fundamental metrics, 3 price-based technical indicators and sentiment scores derived from financial news articles processed using FinBERT. We compare a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network and a Transformer-based architecture against a logistic regression baseline, and further assess all models with and without sentiment features to quantify their incremental value. Our results indicate that while the LSTM demonstrates higher precision through a conservative safe-bet strategy, the Transformer model exhibits superior sensitivity in identifying volatile movements, achieving a higher macro F1-score, with ablation experiments showing a consistent benefit from incorporating news sentiment.

</details>


### [410] [Reading the Finetuning Prior: Verbatim Content Recovery via Contrastive Decoding Diffing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25902)
*Michał Brzozowski,Zuzanna Dubanowska,Enrico Cassano,Neo Christopher Chung*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CDD方法，仅通过输出级logit分布（无需权重访问）即可从微调模型中精确提取植入的事实，性能优于现有白盒方法ADL且速度快170倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 审计已部署模型所学内容（无需访问权重或训练数据）仍是开放挑战。现有白盒方法ADL需要完全访问模型内部，且只能恢复模糊的领域描述，无法提取具体事实。

Method: 提出Contrastive Decoding Diffing (CDD)：1)绕过chat模板暴露原始微调先验；2)用最大模糊预填充初始化生成；3)在每个解码步骤放大微调模型与基座模型之间的logit空间差异。无需权重访问、层选择或单模型调优。

Result: 在四种架构（1B-32B参数）上精确恢复植入事实（药物名称、投票计数、物理测量、程序细节），性能均优于ADL；发现数据流水线伪影（虚构角色从数据生成器泄露到模型权重）；在真实领域微调设置中实现近乎完美的恢复率。

Conclusion: CDD作为灰盒方法超越白盒基线，证明了其在AI系统透明度和问责制方面的实用价值，首次展示了从数据生成器伪影到模型权重再到恢复输出的端到端指纹链。

Abstract: Narrowly finetuned language models memorize implanted content verbatim, but auditing what a deployed model has been taught, without access to its weights or training data, remains an open challenge. Recent work shows that activation differences between base and finetuned models carry readable traces of the finetuning domain; the state-of-the-art Activation Difference Lens (ADL) recovers a vague domain-level description but requires full "white-box" access to model internals. We introduce Contrastive Decoding Diffing (CDD), a model diffing method that operates on output-level logit distributions only, with no weight access, no layer selection, and no per-model tuning, yet recovers implanted facts. CDD consists of three ideas: bypassing the chat template to expose the raw finetuning prior, seeding generation with maximally vague pre-fills, and amplifying the logit-space difference between finetuned and base models at each decoding step. A single default configuration recovers implanted facts verbatim -- exact drug names, vote counts, physical measurements, and procedural details -- across four architectures (1B--32B parameters), uniformly outperforming ADL despite less access and running ~170x faster. Furthermore, CDD surfaces unintended data pipeline artifacts: a fictional persona introduced by the LLM data generator via mode collapse leaked into model weights and was extracted by CDD, constituting to our knowledge the first demonstrated end-to-end fingerprinting chain from data generator artifact to model weights to recovered output. We validate on real-domain finetuning settings, achieving near-perfect recovery across all single-dataset non-CoT variants and correctly identifying all four datasets in the mixed-dataset setting. CDD's success as a grey-box method outperforming white-box baselines underscores its practical utility for transparency and accountability in AI systems.

</details>


### [411] [Quantitative Evaluation of the Severity of Posttraumatic Stress Disorder through Transfer Learning from Specific Phobia Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25933)
*Nicolas Ricka,Gauthier Pellegrin,Denis A. Fompeyrine,Thomas Rohaly,Leah Enders,Heather Roy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究提出了一种基于多元核密度估计（MKDE）的机器学习方法，利用心率（HR）和皮肤电反应（GSR）信号客观评估PTSD严重程度，分类准确率达86%，严重程度量表估计的平均绝对百分比误差为17%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前PTSD的临床评估主要依赖主观评价，存在耗时、昂贵且易受人为偏差影响的问题，迫切需要一种客观、高效且低成本的评估方法。

Method: 从21名参与者的沉浸式模拟中收集心率（HR）和皮肤电反应（GSR）信号及PCL-M标签；在公开的蜘蛛恐惧数据集上训练恐惧反应模型，并从军事数据集估计的恐惧反应曲线中提取PTSD预测特征，应用多元核密度估计（MKDE）技术构建评估模型。

Result: 模型在PTSD状态分类（PCL-M阈值36）上达到86%的准确率，平均绝对误差（MAE）为5.6，临床PTSD严重程度量表估计的平均绝对百分比误差为17%。

Conclusion: 该方法展示了利用生理信号进行PTSD严重程度客观、低负担评估的潜力，在筛查和随访场景中具有重要的临床应用价值。

Abstract: Posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) is a prevalent and debilitating mental health condition with significant personal and societal impacts. Current clinical assessments of PTSD often rely on subjective evaluations, which can be time-consuming, costly, and prone to human bias. This study proposes a machine learning (ML) approach based on multivariate kernel density estimation (MKDE) technique for the objective evaluation of PTSD severity. We collected heart rate (HR) and galvanic skin response (GSR) signals as well as PTSD Checklist - Military Version (PCL-M) labels from 21 participants during an immersive simulation. A fear-response model was trained on a public arachnophobia dataset, and predictive features of PTSD were extracted from the fear-response curves estimated on the military dataset. The model achieved an accuracy of 86\% in classifying PTSD status, effectively distinguishing participants with and without PTSD (PCL-M threshold of 36). The average mean absolute error (MAE) of the models is 5.6, and it estimated a clinical PTSD severity scale with a mean absolute percentage error of 17\%. Our algorithm demonstrates promising potential for enhancing estimation of PTSD severity and followup by offering an objective and low-effort evaluation approach using physiology. These findings suggest clinical utility in both screening and follow-up settings.

</details>


### [412] [From Latent Space to Training Data: Explainable Specialization in Minimal MLPs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25939)
*Enrique Alba,Ezequiel Lopez-Rubio*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究发现，在最小单隐藏层MLP中，覆盖正则化能有效提升原型重建性能和神经元专业化，而重叠惩罚会系统性地损害模型，将原型中心推向训练数据凸包之外。提出了一个设计原则：每个排斥性结构损失必须由兼容的吸引子补偿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究训练偏差是否能使隐藏神经元在最小单隐藏层MLP中专业化，以及这种专业化是否能改善从学习权重中对训练数据集进行基于原型的重建。

Method: 使用宽度等于数据集大小的高斯激活MLP，比较三种结构损失（分别鼓励训练样本覆盖、神经元诱导原型分离、隐藏响应低重叠）与标准拟合基线。在一维均匀采样数据集上从N=3到N=100进行了480次受控实验。

Result: 覆盖正则化在所有测试规模下均给出最低平均重建误差，并提高了原型使用专业化比率；分离效果混合；重叠惩罚系统性有害。重叠惩罚的危害并非优化失败，而是将原型中心推向训练输入凸包之外的退化平衡点。覆盖正则化起到吸引子作用，分离仅在高温下允许此现象，重叠在标称超参数选择下允许此现象。

Conclusion: 得出了一个简单的原型可恢复性感知训练设计原则：每个排斥性结构损失必须由兼容的吸引子补偿，否则将崩溃其本意改进的潜在几何结构。

Abstract: We here study whether training biases can make hidden neurons specialize in minimal one-hidden-layer MLPs, and whether such specialization improves prototype-based reconstruction of the training dataset from the learned weights. We consider Gaussianactivation MLPs of width equal to dataset size and compare three structural losses that respectively encourage coverage of the training samples, separation between neuron-induced prototypes, and low overlap of hidden responses, against the standard fitting baseline. Experiments on uniformly sampled one-dimensional datasets show a stable pattern from N = 3 to N = 100 across 480 controlled runs. Coverage regularization gives the lowest mean reconstruction error at every tested size and raises the prototype-usage specialization ratio relative to the standard baseline, while separation has mixed effects and overlap penalties are systematically harmful. We show that the harm is not an optimization failure: overlap-active approaches fit the data as well as overlap-free ones but route the optimizer to a degenerate equilibrium in which prototype centers are pushed outside the convex hull of the training inputs. Coverage cannot reward this expulsion and acts as an attractor: separation admits it only at large temperature and overlap admits it at the nominal hyperparameter choice. A direct τ-sweep on the separation-only mask and a prototype-position visualization at N = 100 confirm the mechanism. The findings yield a simple design principle for prototype-recoverability-aware training: every repulsive structural loss must be compensated by a compatible attractor, or it will collapse the latent geometry it was meant to refine.

</details>


### [413] [STaT: Resolving Shape Distortion in Non-Stationary Time Series via Tri-Modal Synergy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25943)
*Hui Cheng,Jinsheng Guo,Zhenhao Weng,Yan Qiao,Meng Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出STaT多模态架构，通过融合符号、时序和文本三种模态，在提升预测精度8.9%的同时降低形状失真8.5%，有效解决了现有多模态方法过度平滑的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态时间序列预测方法存在关键困境：为最小化平均误差而导致预测结果过度平滑，忽略了重要的波动特征和转折点，无法有效捕捉非平稳环境下的结构变化。

Method: 提出STaT架构，融合三种协同模态：(1)符号模态将连续时间序列转换为离散token，准确识别结构模式和转折点；(2)时序模态提取固有序列依赖关系；(3)文本模态利用领域语义引导宏观预测趋势。

Result: 在8个真实世界基准数据集上验证，STaT将传统幅度指标提升高达8.9%，同时将形状失真降低高达8.5%，有效平衡了预测精度与波动保真度。

Conclusion: STaT通过符号-时序-文本三模态对齐成功解决了多模态预测中的平滑化困境，实现了预测精度与形状保真度的双重提升，为非平稳环境下的时间序列预测提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: Recent research in time series forecasting frequently investigates the integration of textual and visual modalities with numerical models to better navigate non-stationary environments. Despite delivering solid numerical results, existing multi-modal approaches usually encounter a dilemma: prioritizing the minimization of average errors can result in excessively smooth forecasts that overlook essential fluctuations. To resolve this limitation, we introduce STaT, an innovative multimodal architecture for Symbolic-Temporal-Textual Alignment, which seamlessly unites three synergistic modalities. Specifically, the symbolic modality converts continuous time series into discrete tokens, facilitating the accurate identification of structural patterns and turning points; the temporal modality extracts inherent sequential dependencies; and the textual modality leverages domain semantics to steer the macroscopic forecasting trends. Comprehensive evaluations on eight real-world benchmarks indicate that STaT delivers exceptional performance, enhancing conventional magnitude indicators by up to 8.9% while simultaneously decreasing shape distortion by up to 8.5%.

</details>


### [414] [Small Models, Strong Priors: Architectural Inductive Bias for Parameter-Efficient Neural PDE Solvers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25949)
*Shyam Sankaran,Hanwen Wang,Paris Perdikaris*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: WaveLiT通过引入小波多尺度先验架构，使1-10M参数的小模型在8个基准测试中匹敌大100-1000倍的基座模型，证明架构归纳偏置比规模更重要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经PDE求解器近年来追随视觉和语言模型的规模化路径，基座模型已达数十亿参数。作者质疑这种趋势，认为在该领域中，规模是架构归纳偏置的糟糕替代品——结构化先验能带来显著的参数效率提升，且其成功与失败的模式本身能揭示其捕获的内容。

Method: 提出WaveLiT架构，包含四个核心组件：1）离散小波变换实现无损多分辨率token化；2）增强线性注意力块；3）共享权重的多尺度特征金字塔；4）小波域辅助损失。整个训练流程可在单GPU上完成。

Result: 定制的1-10M参数WaveLiT模型在8个TheWell基准测试中与规模大100-1000倍的基座模型竞争，在波和声学主导的基准上增益最大（小波多尺度先验匹配主导动力学结构且每步误差不会在rollout中几何级累积）。联合训练所有8个基准的10M参数基座变体展现出结构化、物理可解释的迁移模式：先验匹配动力学处最强，混沌对流主导流场处最弱。

Conclusion: 结果表明小模型PDE性能由架构归纳偏置而非规模决定，先验失败的结构是关于其内容的有用实证信号。这为PDE求解器设计提供了新方向：应重视架构归纳偏置而非单纯追求规模。

Abstract: Neural PDE solvers have followed the scaling trajectory of vision and language, with recent foundation models reaching billions of parameters. We argue that scale is a poor substitute for architectural inductive bias in this domain: structured priors deliver outsized parameter efficiency, and the pattern of where they succeed and fail is itself informative about what they capture. We instantiate this argument in WaveLiT, an architecture combining a discrete wavelet transform for lossless multi-resolution tokenization, an augmented linear attention block, a shared-weight multiscale feature pyramid, and a wavelet-domain auxiliary loss. Bespoke 1-10M-parameter WaveLiT models compete with foundation models of 100-1000$\times$ their size across eight TheWell benchmarks, with the largest gains on wave and acoustic-dominated benchmarks where the wavelet-multiscale prior fits the dominant dynamical structure and small per-step errors do not compound geometrically under rollout. Trained jointly across all eight benchmarks, a 10M-parameter foundation variant exhibits a structured, physically interpretable transfer pattern -- strongest where the wavelet-multiscale prior matches the dynamics, weakest on chaotic advection-dominated flows. The entire pipeline trains on a single GPU. The results suggest that small-model PDE performance is shaped by architectural inductive bias rather than scale, and that the structure of a prior's failures is a useful empirical signal about its content.

</details>


### [415] [Step-TP: A Grounded, Step-Level Dataset with Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for LLM-Guided Tensor Program Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25954)
*Mengfan Liu,Da Zheng,Junwei Su,Chuan Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了Step-TP，一个用于张量程序优化的后训练数据集，通过提供有依据的原子级步骤监督和结构化链式思维推理，解决了现有LLM引导优化方法缺乏可验证步骤级监督的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管大语言模型具有强大的推理能力，但现有的张量程序优化方法存在局限性：现有数据集仅提供端到端优化程序对，使用低效的token表示，缺乏可验证的步骤级监督和可解释性，导致LLM在大型组合优化空间中难以做出可靠的单步决策。

Method: Step-TP数据集采用四项设计原则：(i) 使用高效token的可验证中间表示(IR)，可确定性地转换为TVM TIR；(ii) 原子化和可组合的优化策略，将复杂轨迹分解为可解释的单步决策；(iii) 结构化CoT监督结合明确的IR到IR状态转换；(iv) 策略过滤以平衡覆盖范围并防止捷径利用。该方法在中间程序状态上形成封闭推理循环，实现可靠的多步优化而非结果模仿。

Result: 构建了一个提供有依据、原子级、步骤级监督和结构化链式思维推理的张量程序优化后训练数据集，数据集和实现已在GitHub上开源。

Conclusion: Step-TP通过提供步骤级监督和结构化推理路径，使LLM能够在大型组合优化空间中做出可靠的单步决策，从而实现可靠的多步优化，而不是简单地模仿最终结果。这种方法为张量程序优化提供了一个更有效、更具可解释性的解决方案。

Abstract: Despite the strong reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), optimizing the execution efficiency of tensor programs remains challenging due to the need for precise, composable transformation decisions. Recent LLM-guided approaches frame tensor program optimization as an iterative decision process, but existing datasets provide only end-to-end optimized program pairs using token-inefficient representations, lacking verifiable step-level supervision and interpretability. As a result, LLMs struggle to make reliable single-step decisions in large combinatorial optimization spaces. We introduce Step-TP, a post-training dataset for tensor program optimization that provides grounded, atomic, step-level supervision with structured chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning. Step-TP forms a closed reasoning loop over intermediate program states, enabling reliable multi-step optimization rather than outcome imitation. Its design is guided by four principles: (i) a token-efficient, verifiable intermediate representation (IR) that deterministically lowers to TVM TIR; (ii) atomic and composable optimization strategies that decompose complex trajectories into interpretable single-step decisions; (iii) structured CoT supervision coupled with explicit IR-to-IR state transitions; and (iv) strategy filtering to balance coverage while preventing shortcut exploitation. The dataset and implementation are available at a GitHub link, https://github.com/LIUMENGFAN-gif/StepTP.

</details>


### [416] [Mapping the Schedule x Bit-Width Boundary in Sub-100M Quantisation-Aware Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25966)
*Christian Brandt Thomassen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在子100M解码器语言模型的量化感知训练(QAT)中，FP16/INT8/INT6的最优学习率调度相同(最佳warmdown为33%)，INT4在50M以上也最优wd33，50M以下处于噪声主导区域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究量化感知训练中不同比特宽度是否需要不同的最优学习率调度，特别是验证INT6 QAT是否需要与更高精度训练不同的调度方案这一主要假设。

Method: 采用两阶段大规模消融实验：Phase 2使用720次运行的全因子网格搜索(比特宽度×warmdown比例×学习率幅度×模型规模×种子)；Phase 5使用625次运行沿五个轴探测零假设的鲁棒性。使用权重到网格距离探针检验快速网格吸附机制。

Result: 主要假设被证伪：FP16/INT8/INT6在所有模型规模下最优warmdown均为33%，零假设在优化器、调度形状、训练长度、规模扩展和INT4扫描等五个轴上均保持鲁棒。INT6惩罚遵循对数线性缩放定律。INT4呈现明显的分界：50M以上wd33显著最优(paired z ~ 12-15)，50M以下无统计显著的调度偏好。权重到网格距离探针排除了快速网格吸附机制。

Conclusion: 实际建议：在子100M规模下，FP16调优一次学习率调度后可直接应用于INT8/INT6 QAT；INT4在50M+使用wd33；INT4在50M以下调度选择处于噪声范围内。量化比特宽度不影响最优学习率调度选择。

Abstract: We test whether the optimal learning-rate schedule depends on bit-width during from-initialisation quantisation-aware training (QAT) for sub-100M decoder language models. A 720-run factorial grid (Phase 2) over bit-width x warmdown fraction x LR magnitude x model size x seed (FP16/INT8/INT6, 15M-100M, 5 seeds) finds the optimal warmdown is 33% at every (bit-width, size) cell. The primary hypothesis -- that INT6 QAT requires a different schedule than higher-precision training -- is falsified at FP16/INT8/INT6. A 625-run follow-up (Phase 5) probes the null along five axes: optimiser (AdamW), schedule shape (cosine), training length (up to 9x more iterations), an extended size sweep (5M-350M), and an INT4 sweep from 3M to 100M. The null is robust under all three setup changes. The INT6 penalty follows a log-linear scaling law whose fit on Phase 2 predicts the five held-out Phase 5 sizes (5M, 8M, 175M, 250M, 350M) within their 95% prediction intervals (5/5). For INT4 the picture is sharper than the higher precisions: at 50M and 100M, wd33 is decisively optimal (paired z ~ 12-15, 10/10 seeds); below 50M, across the six tested sizes from 3M to 30M, no individual size shows a statistically significant schedule preference and the per-size mean penalty oscillates within seed-level noise. The boundary is therefore a transition between a noise-dominated regime below 50M and a decisive wd33 regime at and above 50M, not a clean wd10 region. A weight-to-grid-distance probe falsifies the simplest mechanism for the FP16/INT8/INT6 null result (rapid grid-snapping): pre-warmdown, INT6-QAT weights sit at essentially the same distance from the INT6 grid as FP16 weights (ratio ~ 1.04). Practical recommendation: at sub-100M scale, tune the LR schedule once at FP16 and apply unchanged to INT8/INT6 QAT; for INT4 at 50M+ use wd33; for INT4 below 50M the schedule choice is in the noise.

</details>


### [417] [Hidden in Plain Tokens: Simply Robust, Gradient-Free Watermark for Synthetic Audio](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25967)
*Georgios Milis,Yubin Qin,Yihan Wu,Heng Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于词汇冗余的无梯度音频水印方法，通过社区检测减少词汇表，显著提升水印检测能力和鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自回归模型推理时水印方法不适用于连续模态，而通过微调分词器的解决方案消除了无训练水印的优势。作者受到离散化词汇冗余的启发，旨在提出一种既保持无训练优势又具备高鲁棒性的音频水印方案。

Method: 该方法利用离散化词汇的冗余特性，通过社区检测算法获得缩减词汇表，有效缓解了标记错误对水印检测的影响。整个过程无需梯度计算或模型微调。

Result: 实验表明，该方法将水印可检测性提升数个数量级，同时对音频修改具有内置的鲁棒性，达到了多媒体标记级水印的新最优性能。

Conclusion: 研究表明，离散表征学习的内在特性为多媒体水印提供了新的最优方案，揭示了词汇冗余在标记级水印设计中的潜力。

Abstract: As policy catches up with the capabilities of generative AI, watermarking is central to content provenance efforts. Inference-time watermarks for autoregressive models are unfit for continuous modalities due to discretization inconsistencies. Existing methods overcome this by finetuning the modality tokenizers, nullifying the watermark's training-free advantage. In this work, motivated by the vocabulary redundancy of discretization, we propose an elegant solution for powerful and robust watermarking of synthetic audio. We theoretically analyze the impact of token errors on watermark detection, and effectively mitigate them using a reduced vocabulary obtained via community detection. Thorough experiments showcase that our gradient-free method can boost detectability by several orders of magnitude, while also achieving built-in robustness to audio modifications. Broadly, we discover a new state-of-the-art for token-level watermarks in multimedia, which simply arises from the nature of discrete representation learning.

</details>


### [418] [Fuzzy PyTorch: Rapid Numerical Variability Evaluation for Deep Learning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25991)
*Inés Gonzalez-Pepe,Hiba Akhaddar,Tristan Glatard,Yohan Chatelain*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了Fuzzy PyTorch框架，用于快速评估深度学习模型中的数值变异性，相比现有工具实现了5-60倍的运行时加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着深度学习应用于多样化任务，理解浮点运算引起的数值变异性对于确保模型的鲁棒性和可靠性至关重要。现有工具需要具备可扩展性、高效性，并能与现有框架无缝集成且最小化代码修改。

Method: 通过Probabilistic Rounding with Instruction Set Management库将随机算术集成到PyTorch中，该库与数值分析编译器Verificarlo接口。提供了随机舍入模式和一种新颖的上下舍入模式。

Result: Fuzzy PyTorch在保持模型性能的同时，相比最先进工具Verrou实现了5倍到60倍的运行时加速。通过测试参数规模从1百万到3.41亿的模型，验证了框架在不同规模深度学习架构中的适用性。

Conclusion: Fuzzy PyTorch为评估深度学习中的数值变异性提供了高效、可扩展且实用的解决方案，使研究人员和从业者能够在不牺牲性能或计算效率的情况下量化和管理浮点不确定性。

Abstract: We introduce Fuzzy PyTorch, a framework for rapid evaluation of numerical variability in deep learning (DL) models. As DL is increasingly applied to diverse tasks, understanding variability from floating-point arithmetic is essential to ensure robust and reliable performance. Tools assessing such variability must be scalable, efficient, and integrate seamlessly with existing frameworks while minimizing code modifications. Fuzzy PyTorch enables this by integrating stochastic arithmetic into PyTorch through Probabilistic Rounding with Instruction Set Management, a novel library interfacing with Verificarlo, a numerical analysis compiler. The library offers stochastic rounding mode and a novel mode; up-down rounding. Comparative evaluations show Fuzzy PyTorch maintains model performance and achieves runtime reductions of 5x to 60x versus Verrou, a state-of-the-art tool. We further demonstrate scalability by running models from 1 to 341 million parameters, confirming applicability across small and large DL architectures. Overall, Fuzzy PyTorch provides an efficient, scalable, and practical solution for assessing numerical variability in deep learning, enabling researchers and practitioners to quantify and manage floating-point uncertainty without compromising performance or computational efficiency.

</details>


### [419] [Deployment-complete benchmarking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25997)
*El Mustapha Mansouri,Keigo Arai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出“部署完备基准测试”框架，指出传统基准分数不足以支撑部署决策。通过证据纤维、完成曲线和认证-获取流程，量化并缓解证据不足带来的决策风险，在Tox21和JARVIS等公开审计中显著降低误判率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准测试仅记录响应分数，不能保证这些证据足以决定部署行动。部署决策往往基于不充分或不相关的证据，可能导致错误决策、资源浪费或安全风险。因此需要一种框架来评估和补全基准证据与部署行动之间的缺口。

Method: 引入“部署完备基准测试”：定义基准对某一声明完备当且仅当在每个证据纤维上行动一致；混合纤维暴露缺失信息；完成曲线量化消除歧义所需证据。构造认证-获取流程，在保留集上先认证候选，再针对混合纤维进行证据补全，并比较基准通道共形覆盖与响应-秩区间覆盖。

Result: 在受控响应空间中，基准通道共形覆盖率94.98%在未测部署通道仅10.07%，而响应-秩区间达94.91%。零基准误差仅能在最大残差尺度下认证45.4%候选。公开审计发现Tox21有97.9%混合纤维，Matbench与JARVIS主要审计的认证分数中位数为零。在保留重放中，认证-获取将Tox21错误决策从1.19%降至0.027%，JARVIS从20.3%降至0.128%，同时改变模型选择并识别部署相关探针。

Conclusion: 部署可用基准应报告证据、可支持的行动、歧义和完成成本，而不仅是分数。部署完备基准测试为量化并缓解证据不足提供了原则性方法，有助于更可靠地指导部署、采购和科学筛选。

Abstract: Benchmarks increasingly guide deployment, procurement and scientific screening, yet a score supports only the response it records, not necessarily the deployment action. We introduce deployment-complete benchmarking, which tests whether benchmark evidence determines a deployment action. A benchmark is complete for a claim exactly when the action is constant on each evidence fiber; mixed fibers expose missing deployment information, and completion curves quantify the evidence required to resolve ambiguity. In controlled response spaces, benchmark-channel conformal coverage of 94.98% transferred poorly to an unmeasured deployment channel (10.07%), whereas response-rank intervals achieved 94.91% coverage; even zero benchmark error certified only 45.4% of candidates at the largest residual size. Public audits revealed incompleteness, including 97.9% mixed Tox21 fibers and zero median certifiable fraction in main Matbench and JARVIS audits. In held-out replays, certify-then-acquire reduced false decisions from 1.19% to 0.027% in Tox21 and from 20.3% to 0.128% in JARVIS, while changing model choice and identifying deployment-relevant probes. Deployment-ready benchmarks should report evidence, supported actions, ambiguity and completion cost rather than scores alone.

</details>


### [420] [Causal methods for LLM development and evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25998)
*Dennis Frauen,Marie Brockschmidt,Konstantin Hess,Haorui Ma,Yuchen Ma,Abdurahman Maarouf,Maresa Schröder,Jonas Schweisthal,Yuxin Wang,Athiya Deviyani,Sonali Parbhoo,Rahul G. Krishnan,Stefan Feuerriegel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文主张将因果推断方法系统性地引入大语言模型（LLM）的开发与评估流程中，以解决当前LLM开发中的关键问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM开发严重依赖大规模经验性迭代，而许多核心问题本质上是因果问题（如数据域添加的效果、标注者偏好变化、模型路由决策等）。尽管因果方法适合处理干预改变结果的场景，但在LLM开发中却严重未被充分利用。LLM开发面临混淆因素和分布偏移的日志数据、使用可能存在偏差的评判模型、非平稳的部署环境等挑战，这使得纯预测方法变得脆弱，为因果推断方法提供了应用机会。

Method: 作者通过三方面的分析来阐述因果方法的价值：（1）解释因果方法如何帮助现代LLM开发和评估，针对日志数据的混淆问题、评估中的偏差评判者、以及非平稳部署环境等挑战；（2）绘制因果方法在整个LLM开发管道中的应用机会图谱，包括预训练、对齐、路由、智能体工作流和评估等环节；（3）讨论利用因果方法进行LLM开发和评估的新研究机会。

Result: 研究识别出因果方法在LLM开发全流程中的多个应用机会，证明了因果推断方法能够为LLM开发中的关键决策提供原则性的识别和估计方法，弥补纯预测方法的不足。

Conclusion: 因果方法在LLM开发和评估管道中潜力巨大但目前未被充分利用。引入因果方法能够确保LLM设计更加可靠和科学化，为未来LLM开发提供了重要的研究方向和方法论支撑。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) development is currently driven by large-scale empirical iteration over data mixtures, reward models, routing strategies, and evaluation pipelines. Here, we argue that many central questions in LLM development and evaluation are inherently causal: What is the effect of adding a data domain during pretraining? How do annotator preferences change when LLMs generate text in a different style? Should a prompt be routed to a larger or smaller model given inference cost constraints? In general, causal methods are well-suited to such settings where interventions change outcomes but, surprisingly, are underrepresented in LLM development. Our contribution is threefold: (1) We explain how causal methods can help develop modern LLM development and evaluation: LLM development relies heavily on logged data, which are often subject to confounding and distribution shifts; evaluation uses learned but potentially biased judges; and deployment environments are non-stationary. These conditions make purely predictive approaches fragile and create opportunities for principled identification and estimation methods from causal inference. (2) We further map opportunities for causal methods in the entire LLM development pipeline, including pretraining, alignment, routing, agentic workflows, and evaluation. (3) We discuss new research opportunities around leveraging causal methods for LLM development and evaluation. Overall, we argue that causal methods are potentially underutilized for the LLM development and evaluation pipeline, despite the fact that such methods can ensure a reliable and scientifically grounded design.

</details>


### [421] [Learning in Low-Dimensional Subspaces: Orthogonal Bottlenecks for Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26012)
*Aleksandar Todorov,Matthia Sabatelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出正交瓶颈投影方法，通过固定正交投影将编码器特征约束到低维子空间，在保持性能的同时实现RL表示压缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度强化学习智能体通常依赖高维神经表示，但有证据表明任务相关的价值和策略结构本质上是低维的。现有的RL表示可能存在冗余，需要一种简单有效的方法来约束表示维度。

Method: 插入固定正交投影作为表示级先验，将编码器特征约束到低维子空间。该方法无需辅助目标、预训练或修改底层RL算法，通过瓶颈维度控制表示维度。

Result: 理论证明：当瓶颈维度超过最优价值函数在特征空间的内在秩时，瓶颈保持表达能力且梯度动力学不变。实验发现：单任务和多任务基准测试中，瓶颈维度超过小阈值后性能匹配或超越基线；价值表示可压缩到极低维度；最小充分维度更依赖环境复杂度而非编码器宽度；正交瓶颈稳定特征范数并提高有效秩。

Conclusion: 支持强化学习中流形假设的表示空间解释，正交瓶颈作为一种轻量级、架构无关的机制，可有效塑造RL表示，实现表示压缩和性能提升。

Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) agents commonly rely on high-dimensional neural representations, despite growing evidence that task-relevant value and policy structure may be intrinsically low-dimensional. In this work, we present a simple yet effective representation-level prior that inserts a fixed orthonormal projection to constrain encoder features to a low-dimensional subspace, requiring no auxiliary objectives, pretraining, or changes to the underlying RL algorithm. Under a linear realizability assumption, we prove that when the bottleneck dimension exceeds the intrinsic rank of the optimal value function in feature space, the bottleneck preserves expressivity and leaves the induced gradient dynamics unchanged up to an equivalent low-dimensional parameterization. Empirically, we find that across both single and multi-task benchmarks, baseline performance is either matched or improved once the bottleneck dimension exceeds a small task-dependent threshold; in many cases, value representations can be compressed to extremely low dimensions without loss, and the minimal sufficient dimension depends far more on environment complexity than encoder width. In addition, we analyze representation geometry and find that orthogonal bottlenecks stabilize feature norms and are associated with higher effective rank. Together, these results support a representation-space interpretation of the manifold hypothesis in reinforcement learning and position orthogonal bottlenecks as a lightweight, architecture-agnostic mechanism for shaping RL representations.

</details>


### [422] [AdvantageFlow: Advantage-Weighted Least Squares for RL in Flow Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26013)
*Branislav Kveton,Anup Rao,Subhojyoti Mukherjee,Krishna Kumar Singh,Viet Dac Lai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出AdvantageFlow，一种用于矫正流模型的前向过程强化学习算法，在Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium上的图像生成任务中优于Flow-GRPO和基于负感知微调的基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Flow-GRPO优化反向过程，而本文旨在探索前向过程强化学习的优化方法，解决优势加权预测损失在负优势下的不稳定性问题。

Method: 提出AdvantageFlow算法，通过优势加权的前向过程预测损失进行优化；引入推演策略正则化来稳定训练，该方法通过拟合局部奖励改善目标分布来降低方差。

Result: 在基于Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium的图像生成任务上，AdvantageFlow性能优于Flow-GRPO以及基于负感知微调的最先进前向过程强化学习基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过策略正则化有效解决了前向过程强化学习中的不稳定性问题，证明了前向过程优化在矫正流模型中的可行性和优越性。

Abstract: We introduce AdvantageFlow, a forward-process reinforcement learning algorithm for rectified flow models. Unlike Flow-GRPO, which optimizes the reverse process, we optimize an advantage-weighted forward-process prediction loss. This optimization problem is unstable when advantages are negative and the loss becomes non-convex. We stabilize it by rollout policy regularization, which reduces variance and arises from fitting a local reward-improving target distribution. We evaluate AdvantageFlow on image generation tasks with Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium. It outperforms both Flow-GRPO and a state-of-the-art forward-process RL baseline based on negative-aware fine-tuning.

</details>


### [423] [Retrieval-Augmented Detection of Potentially Abusive Clauses in Chilean Terms of Service](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26019)
*Christoffer Loeffler,Tomás Rey Pizarro,Daniel Ignacio Miranda Vásquez,Andrea Martínez Freile*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个面向智利服务条款的检索增强生成(RAG)框架，用于自动检测和分类潜在滥用条款，并发布了包含10,029条标注条款的Chilean Abusive Terms of Service Extended语料库。实验表明该方法能显著提升中等规模开源模型性能，使其接近大型云端系统水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线服务条款常作为附合合同存在，可能包含对消费者不利的滥用条款。在智利法律环境下，评估此类条款具有挑战性：部分条款明显违反强制性消费者法律，而其他条款则依赖于诚信原则和合同平衡等更广泛的法律标准，需要专业法律判断。

Method: 提出了一个检索增强生成框架，支持本地执行。该方法结合了：1)高效的条款检测；2)混合稠密-稀疏检索；3)重排序机制；4)提示增强技术。该框架专为支持中等规模开源权重语言模型而设计，降低了计算和token成本。同时构建了包含100份合同、10,029条标注条款的语料库，涵盖非法条款、黑暗条款和灰色条款三大类共24个法律分类。

Result: 通过对比商业模型、开源模型、微调编码器和传统基线方法的实验，发现检索增强提示技术显著提升了性能，使本地模型能够以较低的计算和token成本接近大型云端系统的表现。研究还贡献了改进的法律标注方案。

Conclusion: 本研究为AI辅助消费者合同审查提供了实用的设计方案，证明了检索增强生成技术在法律文本分析中的有效性，同时为资源受限环境下的法律AI应用提供了可行路径，具有重要的实践价值和法律合规意义。

Abstract: Online Terms of Service often function as contracts of adhesion, creating asymmetries that may expose consumers to potentially abusive clauses. In Chile, assessing such clauses is legally challenging because some provisions clearly violate mandatory consumer law, whereas others depend on broader standards such as good faith and contractual imbalance. We present a retrieval-augmented generation framework for the automated detection and classification of potentially abusive clauses in Chilean Terms of Service. Designed for local execution, it combines efficient clause detection, hybrid dense--sparse retrieval, reranking, and prompt augmentation to support medium-sized open-weight language models. We also introduce the Chilean Abusive Terms of Service Extended corpus, comprising 100 contracts and 10,029 annotated clauses in 24 legally grounded categories spanning illegal, dark, and gray clauses. Experiments comparing commercial and open-weight language models, fine-tuned encoders, and traditional baselines show that retrieval-augmented prompting substantially improves performance and enables local models to approach larger cloud-based systems at lower computational and token cost. The study also contributes a refined legal annotation scheme and a practical design for AI-assisted consumer contract review.

</details>


### [424] [Length Generalization with Log-Depth Recurrent Units](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26035)
*Charles Pert,Dalal Alrajeh,Alessandra Russo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MLP-LDRU（一种对数深度循环单元），在21个正则语言任务的长度泛化测试中表现优异，其中18个任务达到100%分布外准确率，在ListOps和NLP分类任务上表现同样具有竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长度泛化是神经网络的持续挑战：循环模型受位置偏差影响，Transformer受限于固定计算深度。正则语言为评估长度泛化提供了理想测试平台，因为标签预测可以在任意序列长度上进行验证。

Method: 提出MLP-LDRU，属于对数深度循环单元类型，通过并行归约捕获一类结合性偏置算子来近似循环机制。在21个正则语言任务（包含标准基准测试和新的前缀语言）、ListOps及NLP分类基准上进行评估。

Result: 在21个正则语言任务中，18个任务达到100%分布外准确率；增加最大训练长度后，剩余3个任务准确率至少达99.9%，表现优于可比较的循环模型和注意力模型。在ListOps和NLP分类任务上表现具有竞争力。

Conclusion: MLP-LDRU成功解决了神经网络在长度泛化方面的关键挑战，通过结合性偏置算子有效近似循环机制，在保持计算效率的同时显著提升了分布外泛化能力，为序列建模提供了新的有效方法。

Abstract: Length generalization remains a persistent challenge for neural networks: recurrent models tend to suffer from positional biases, while transformers are constrained by fixed computational depth. Regular languages provide a frequently used testbed for evaluating length generalization, as label prediction can be checked for any sequence length. We propose MLP-LDRU, a type of Log-Depth Recurrent Unit, which captures a class of associativity-biased operators designed to approximate recurrence through parallel reduction. We evaluate MLP-LDRU on 21 regular-language tasks, consisting of standard benchmarks and new prefix languages, where it achieves 100% out-of-distribution accuracy on 18 tasks and at least 99.9% on the remaining 3 when increasing max training length, outperforming comparable recurrent and attention-based models. We further evaluate MLP-LDRU beyond regular languages on ListOps and NLP classification benchmarks, where it performs competitively.

</details>


### [425] [Neuronal Stochastic Attention Circuit (NSAC) for Probabilistic Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26061)
*Waleed Razzaq,Yun-Bo Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了神经元随机注意力电路(NSAC)，一种生物启发的连续时间注意力架构，通过Ornstein-Uhlenbeck随机微分方程计算注意力logits，实现了原则性的不确定性量化，在多种学习任务中保持竞争力的同时产生良好校准的不确定性估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续时间表示学习中的不确定性量化研究仍处于起步阶段，特别是在连续时间注意力架构中缺乏可靠的不确定性估计方法。现有方法无法提供原则性的随机性传播和不确定性分解。

Method: 1. 将注意力logit计算重新表述为Ornstein-Uhlenbeck随机微分方程的解；
2. 采用输入依赖的非线性互连门控机制，源自秀丽隐杆线虫神经元电路策略(NCPs)的布线机制；
3. 在logits上诱导高斯分布，通过logistic-normal分布在注意力权重上传播原则性随机性；
4. 设计双项目标函数：结合高斯负对数似然和认知分离正则化器，实现偶然不确定性和认知不确定性的联合量化。

Result: 在五类学习任务上验证：(i)不规则连续时间函数逼近；(ii)多元回归；(iii)长程预测；(iv)工业4.0；(v)自动驾驶车辆车道保持。NSAC在精度上与多个基线保持竞争力，同时产生合理校准的不确定性估计，并在神经元细胞级别具有可解释性。

Conclusion: NSAC成功填补了连续时间注意力架构中不确定性量化的空白，通过生物启发的随机注意力机制实现了原则性的不确定性传播和分解，在保持预测精度的同时提供了可靠的不确定性估计和神经元级别的可解释性。

Abstract: Reliable quantification of uncertainty estimates in continuous-time (CT) representation learning remains nascent, particularly within CT attention architectures. We introduce the Neuronal Stochastic Attention Circuit (NSAC), a novel biologically-inspired CT attention architecture that reformulates attention logit computation as the solution of an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck stochastic differential equation modulated by input-dependent, nonlinear interlinked gates derived from repurposed C.elegans Neuronal Circuit Policies (NCPs) wiring mechanism. It induces Gaussian distribution over logits that propagates principled stochasticity through logistic-normal distribution over attention weights to yield probabilistic output. A two-term objective function combining Gaussian negative log-likelihood with an epistemic-separation regularizer enforces higher predictive variance and enables joint quantification of aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty. Empirically, we implement NSAC in a diverse set of learning tasks including: (i) irregular CT function approximation; (ii) multivariate regression; (iii) long-range forecasting; (iv) Industry 4.0; and (v) the lane-keeping of autonomous vehicles. We observe that the NSAC remains competitive against several baselines in terms of accuracy and produces reasonably well-calibrated uncertainty estimates while being interpretable at the neuronal cell level.

</details>


### [426] [Conditional KRR: Injecting Unpenalized Features into Kernel Methods with Applications to Kernel Thresholding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26067)
*Rustem Takhanov,Zhenisbek Assylbekov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了条件核岭回归的统计性质，证明了其可归结为使用残差核的标准KRR，额外风险项为O(1/√N)。理论与实验表明，当回归函数的$\mathcal{F}$分量占主导时，条件KRR优于标准KRR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 条件正定核相对于函数类$\mathcal{F}$定义，其原生空间引出的条件KRR方法可视为先用$\mathcal{F}$做线性回归，再对残差应用标准KRR。这类方法近期受到关注，但其统计性质尚需深入研究。

Method: 通过引入残差核的概念，将条件KRR的行为归结为使用该固定核的标准KRR，证明了这种归约是可行的，代价是期望测试风险中增加一个O(1/√N)的额外项。分析了两种情形：$\mathcal{F}$为K的Mercer分解的前k个主特征函数，以及$\mathcal{F}$为K的随机特征表示中的k个随机特征。

Result: 主要理论结果表明，条件KRR可归结为使用残差核的标准KRR，风险增加项为O(1/√N)。证明了两种设置（主特征函数和随机特征）密切相关。理论和实验均验证：当回归函数的$\mathcal{F}$分量比残差部分更显著时，条件KRR优于标准KRR。

Conclusion: 条件KRR提供了一种有效的学习框架，通过残差核的归约，可以用成熟的KRR理论分析其性质。当目标函数的主要成分可由函数类$\mathcal{F}$捕捉时，该方法相比标准KRR具有性能优势。

Abstract: Conditionally positive definite (CPD) kernels are defined with respect to a function class $\mathcal{F}$. It is well known that such a kernel $K$ is associated with its native space (defined analogously to an RKHS), which in turn gives rise to a learning method -- called conditional kernel ridge regression (conditional KRR) due to its analogy with KRR -- where the estimated regression function is penalized by the square of its native space norm. This method is of interest because it can be viewed as classical linear regression, with features specified by $\mathcal{F}$, followed by the application of standard KRR to the residual (unexplained) component of the target variable. Methods of this type have recently attracted increasing attention.
  We study the statistical properties of this method by reducing its behavior to that of KRR with another fixed kernel, called the residual kernel. Our main theoretical result shows that such a reduction is indeed possible, at the cost of an additional term in the expected test risk, bounded by $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{N})$, where $N$ is the sample size and the hidden constant depends on the class $\mathcal{F}$ and the input distribution.
  This reduction enables us to analyze conditional KRR in the case where $K$ is positive definite and $\mathcal{F}$ is given by the first $k$ principal eigenfunctions in the Mercer decomposition of $K$. We also consider the setting where $\mathcal{F}$ consists of $k$ random features from a random feature representation of $K$. It turns out that these two settings are closely related. Both our theoretical analysis and experiments confirm that conditional KRR outperforms standard KRR in these cases whenever the $\mathcal{F}$-component of the regression function is more pronounced than the residual part.

</details>


### [427] [Rethinking Weak Supervision in Anomaly Detection: A Comprehensive Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26068)
*Xu Yao,Siyuan Zhou,Wu Zhenbo,Chaochuan Hou,Shuang Liang,Shiping wang,Hailiang Huang,Songqiao Han,Minqi Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了WSADBench，首个统一评估不完整、不精确、不准确三种弱监督异常检测场景的基准。基于70万+实验，发现：（1）不同弱监督场景间存在强相关性；（2）专用WSAD算法仅在极端标签稀缺情况下表现优异，随着监督增加或分布外场景下被表格基础模型和通用分类方法超越；（3）无标签数据在各设置中效用不一致，标签精炼收益更显著；（4）模型对不同类型标签噪声呈现非对称敏感性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有弱监督异常检测研究在 incomplete、inexact、inaccurate 三个方向上相互孤立，缺乏统一框架来评估这些方向是处理独特挑战还是共享基础机制，需要构建统一基准来揭示各方法的性能边界和内在联系。

Method: 构建WSADBench基准，建立标准化协议，系统性地变化标签数量、粒度和质量，在4种模态上评估36种算法，涵盖专用WSAD方法和先进的表格基础模型等多样化方法。

Result: 通过70万+实验发现：（1）弱监督场景间存在强内在相关性，挑战当前研究方向的隔离；（2）专用WSAD算法仅在极端标签稀缺下表现优异，随着监督增加或OOD场景下被表格基础模型和通用分类方法超越；（3）无标签数据效用不一致，相比标签精炼仅有边际收益；（4）模型对不同类型标签噪声表现出非对称敏感性。

Conclusion: WSADBench作为开源基准发布，包含代码和数据集，为未来WSAD研究提供了统一评估框架和重要发现，揭示了当前研究方向的局限性并指引了未来发展方向。

Abstract: Weakly supervised anomaly detection (WSAD) has developed in three primary directions: incomplete, inexact, and inaccurate supervision. However, these directions remain isolated, lacking a unified framework to assess whether they address unique challenges or share fundamental mechanics. This paper introduces WSADBench, the first benchmark that unifies evaluation across distinct weakly supervised scenarios, benchmarking diverse approaches from specialized WSAD methods to advanced tabular foundation models. WSADBench establishes standardized protocols to evaluate 36 algorithms across 4 modalities by systematically varying label quantity, granularity, and quality, revealing the performance boundaries of various methods. Based on over 700K experiments, WSADBench reveals four critical insights: (i) Strong intrinsic correlations exist between these weak supervision scenarios, challenging the isolation of current research directions. (ii) Specialized WSAD algorithms excel only in extreme label-scarcity regimes but are quickly dominated by tabular foundation models and general classification methods as supervision increases or in OOD scenarios. (iii) Unlabeled data shows inconsistent utility across settings, with marginal gains compared to label refinement. (iv) Models exhibit asymmetric sensitivity to different types of label noise. We release WSADBench as an open-source benchmark with code and datasets to facilitate future WSAD research: https://github.com/SUFE-AILAB/WSADBench.

</details>


### [428] [Active Query Synthesis for Preference Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26072)
*Namrata Nadagouda,Nauman Ahad,Maegan Tucker,Mark A. Davenport*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Info-Synth框架，通过置信度感知模型和主动查询合成解决偏好学习中的反馈可靠性低和计算开销大问题，在多个任务中验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有主动学习方法存在两大局限：1）基于池的评估计算成本高昂；2）忽略查询反馈的可靠性差异，当比较项过于相似或完全不同时会产生模糊、低置信度的响应。

Method: 提出置信度感知响应模型显式处理模糊比较；设计Info-Synth框架通过最大化互信息目标在连续空间合成最优查询；提出Pair M-dist和Pair Opt-dist两种策略将框架扩展至有限查询池场景。

Result: 在合成偏好学习、约束文本摘要数据集和移动机器人控制器增益调节三个任务中验证了框架的通用性和性能优势。

Conclusion: 所提框架有效解决了偏好学习中反馈可靠性和计算效率的双重挑战，为主动学习在复杂决策系统中的应用提供了新思路。

Abstract: Efficient learning of user preferences is crucial for many modern decision making systems but typically requires costly labeled data. Active learning reduces this cost, yet standard methods are computationally expensive due to pool-based evaluation. Further, most methods assume all query feedback is equally reliable, ignoring that pairwise queries between nearly identical or entirely dissimilar items yield ambiguous, low-confidence responses. To address the issue of feedback reliability, we introduce a novel confidence aware response model that explicitly accounts for these ambiguous comparisons. To overcome the computational bottleneck of pool-based evaluation, we propose an active query synthesis framework, Info-Synth that generates optimal queries by maximizing a mutual information-based objective within a continuous space. Moreover, we propose two strategies, Pair M-dist and Pair Opt-dist, that extend Info-Synth to select effective queries even when restricted to finite query pools. We demonstrate our framework's versatility and performance across synthetic preference learning, constrained text summary datasets, and subjective, continuous-space controller gain tuning for a simulated mobile robot.

</details>


### [429] [Global Convergence of Wasserstein Policy Gradient for Entropy-Regularized Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26078)
*Zhaoyu Zhu,Rui Gao,Shuang Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文建立了Wasserstein策略梯度（WPG）方法在熵正则化强化学习中的全局收敛理论，证明虽然目标函数非凸，但Bellman递归结构诱导了Polyak-Łojasiewicz型几何，支持WPG的全局收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: WPG方法虽然适用于连续控制问题，但其全局收敛性质长期未被充分理解。标准Langevin分析无法直接应用，因为强化学习目标通过Bellman递归（而非静态凸泛函）依赖于策略，且Langevin漂移由软Q函数决定，其正则性需在策略迭代过程中加以控制。

Method: 利用熵正则化强化学习的Bellman结构：通过软Bellman残差的逐状态KL表示、Bellman收缩性关联残差与全局最优性间隙、Bellman预解恒等式连接价值改进与相对Fisher信息；结合演化Gibbs族的统一对数Sobolev不等式，推导分布型Polyak-Łojasiewicz条件；进一步建立控制离散化误差所需的正则性和一致界。

Result: 证明了WPG满足分布型Polyak-Łojasiewicz条件，建立了几何收缩速率（直至离散化偏差），为WPG提供了全局收敛保证。

Conclusion: 熵正则化强化学习在传统平坦意义上虽非凸，但Bellman递归诱导了有利的Polyak-Łojasiewicz型几何，从而支持WPG的全局收敛。

Abstract: Wasserstein policy gradient (WPG) is a policy optimization method for reinforcement learning (RL) that exploits the optimal-transport geometry of action distributions. For the entropy-regularized RL objective, WPG evolves each state-conditional policy by transporting it along the action gradient of the soft Q-function together with a Langevin-type diffusion. Despite its appeal for continuous-control problems, its global convergence properties remain poorly understood. Standard Langevin analyses do not directly apply, because the RL objective depends on the policy through the Bellman recursion rather than through a static convex functional, and the Langevin drift is determined by the soft Q-function, whose regularity must be controlled along the policy iterates.
  In this paper, we develop a global convergence theory for WPG by exploiting the Bellman structure of entropy-regularized RL. We show that the role usually played by convexity can be replaced by a Bellman-based argument: the soft Bellman residual admits a statewise KL representation with respect to a Gibbs policy; Bellman contraction relates this residual to the global optimality gap; and a Bellman resolvent identity connects value improvement to relative Fisher information. Combined with a uniform log-Sobolev inequality (LSI) for the evolving Gibbs family, these ingredients yield a distributional Polyak--Łojasiewicz condition. We further establish the regularity and uniform bounds needed to control the discretization error, thereby obtaining geometric contraction up to a discretization bias. Conceptually, our analysis shows that although entropy-regularized RL is not convex in the usual flat sense, the Bellman recursion induces a favorable Polyak--Lojasiewicz-type (PL) geometry that supports global convergence of WPG.

</details>


### [430] [OrpQuant: Geometric Orthogonal Residual Projection for Multiplier-Free Power-of-Two Transformer Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26092)
*Maoyang Xiang,Bo Wang,Tao Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出正交残差投影(ORP)框架，通过双基几何投影解决超低位宽(如3-bit)下幂次量化(PoT)的低角分辨率问题，在LLaMA-2-7B上实现6.10困惑度且仅需15分钟校准，同时消除硬件乘法瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型(LLM)和视觉Transformer(ViT)在边缘设备部署时受限于内存和密集乘累加(MAC)阵列的时序瓶颈。超低位宽(如<4-bit)下，幂次量化(PoT)虽能用移位替代MAC运算，但其非均匀指数网格存在低角分辨率区域的结构性缺陷，导致高维特征流形严重退化。

Method: 提出正交残差投影(ORP)算法-硬件协同设计框架：(1)将量化建模为双基几何投影问题；(2)自适应合成高分辨率残差网格，仅使用移位加法操作；(3)提供解析求解器替代计算密集的梯度优化。硬件层面基于标准单元RTL综合实现。

Result: 在3-bit(W3/A16)约束下，LLaMA-2-7B困惑度达6.10，与AWQ等MAC密集基线相当且无需非对称缩放；4-bit场景保持竞争性精度；全模型校准时间约15分钟；28nm工艺RTL综合验证有效缓解密集乘法树的时序瓶颈。

Conclusion: ORP成功克服了超低位宽PoT量化的几何局限性，在跨模态适用性和硬件效率方面展现优势，为边缘设备部署LLM/ViT提供了无需乘法器的高效量化方案。

Abstract: The deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision Transformers (ViTs) on edge devices is significantly constrained by memory limitations and the critical timing bottlenecks introduced by dense Multiply-Accumulate (MAC) arrays. In the ultra-low bit regime, logarithmic Power-of-Two (PoT) quantization provides a hardware-efficient alternative by replacing MAC operations with bit-shifts. However, the non-uniform exponential lattice is inherently limited by a \textbf{Low Angular Resolution Regime}, a structural flaw that becomes particularly pronounced at sub-4-bit thresholds, leading to a notable degradation of high-dimensional feature manifolds.
  To address this geometric limitation, we propose Orthogonal Residual Projection (ORP), an algorithm-hardware co-design framework. By formulating quantization as a dual-basis geometric projection, ORP adaptively synthesizes a higher-resolution residual lattice using strictly shift-and-add operations. Furthermore, ORP's analytical solver offers a practical alternative to computationally intensive gradient-based optimization, reducing the full-model calibration time for LLaMA-2-7B to approximately \textbf{15 minutes}.
  Extensive evaluations demonstrate ORP's applicability across modalities and its hardware efficiency. Under the 3-bit (W3/A16) constraint, ORP achieves a perplexity of 6.10 on LLaMA-2-7B, comparing favorably to conventional MAC-intensive baselines like AWQ without relying on asymmetric scaling, while maintaining competitive accuracy in 4-bit scenarios. At the silicon level, standard-cell RTL synthesis at a 28nm node indicates that ORP effectively mitigates the timing bottlenecks associated with dense multiplier trees.

</details>


### [431] [Goal-driven Bayesian Optimal Experimental Design for Robust Decision-Making Under Model Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26093)
*Jinwoo Go,Xiaoning Qian,Byung-Jun Yoon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了GoBOED框架，通过直接优化实验设计以服务下游决策目标，而非传统的最大化信息增益，在多个应用中实现了更好的决策对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的贝叶斯最优实验设计（BOED）旨在最大化关于模型参数的信息增益，但在决策关键场景中，减少参数不确定性并不必然改善下游决策，因为只有与目标相关的特定参数方向才真正重要。

Method: 提出GoBOED框架，结合摊销变分后验代理与可微分凸决策层，实现完全聚焦决策的基于梯度的设计优化；理论上证明了GoBOED梯度对与决策目标无关的参数方向不敏感。

Result: 在源定位、流行病管理和药代动力学控制等任务上，GoBOED识别出的设计与下游决策目标更一致；发现近最优设计窗口比目标无关的BOED方法预测的范围显著更宽。

Conclusion: 目标驱动的实验设计能够实现对决策目标等效的设计质量，且相比信息增益最大化方法具有更广泛的最优设计空间，为决策导向的实验设计提供了理论支撑和实证验证。

Abstract: Bayesian optimal experimental design (BOED) selects experiments to maximize information gain about model parameters. However, in decision-critical settings, reducing parameter uncertainty does not necessarily improve downstream decisions, as only specific parameter directions relevant to the objective truly matter. We propose GoBOED, a goal-driven BOED framework that directly optimizes experimental designs for a specified decision-making objective. GoBOED combines an amortized variational posterior surrogate with a differentiable convex decision layer, enabling gradient-based design optimization that is fully decision-focused. We theoretically show that GoBOED gradients are insensitive to parameter directions irrelevant to the decision objective, providing a formal justification for why goal-driven design achieves equivalent decision quality over a wider set of experimental designs than information-gain maximization. Empirically, across source localization, epidemic management, and pharmacokinetic control, GoBOED identifies designs that better align with downstream decision objectives and reveals that near-optimal design windows are substantially wider than those predicted by goal-agnostic BOED approaches.

</details>


### [432] [Forgetting in Language Models: Capacity, Optimization, and Self-Generated Replay](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26097)
*Martin Marek,Dongkyu Cho,Shikai Qiu,Rumi Chunara,Pavel Izmailov,Andrew Gordon Wilson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 语言模型可通过自生成样本进行有效回放来缓解遗忘；当模型容量不足时遗忘仍存在；回放机制打破了学习率与遗忘之间的权衡，实现了快速且无遗忘的微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统缓解灾难性遗忘的方法需要存储并回放旧任务的样本，这在实际应用中往往不可行。本文旨在探索一种无需外部存储样本的新方法来缓解语言模型在学习新任务时的遗忘问题。

Method: 利用语言模型自身从训练分布中采样的能力，生成自样本（self-generated samples）作为回放数据。通过实验分析模型容量、学习率与遗忘之间的关系，以及回放机制对这些因素的影响调节作用。

Result: 自生成的样本能够作为有效的回放数据，几乎消除了遗忘现象；但当模型预训练接近饱和（容量不足）时，遗忘仍然存在，因为模型难以在不覆盖旧知识的情况下吸收新信息。在容量充足时，低学习率可减少遗忘但需要更多训练步数；而回放机制打破了这一权衡，允许使用高学习率进行快速微调而不会发生遗忘。

Conclusion: 语言模型的自生成样本是一种有效的无存储回放机制，能够在容量允许的情况下有效缓解遗忘，并解决学习率与训练效率之间的权衡问题，为持续学习和模型微调提供了新思路。

Abstract: Models trained on a new task typically degrade on prior tasks, a phenomenon known as forgetting. Traditionally, mitigating forgetting has required replaying stored exemplars from prior tasks, which is often impractical. By contrast, language models can sample from their own training distribution, and we show that these self-generated samples serve as effective replay data, nearly eliminating forgetting. We find that forgetting nonetheless persists when the model has little remaining capacity: models pretrained close to saturation cannot absorb new information without overwriting prior knowledge. When capacity is not the limiting factor, low learning rates reduce forgetting but require substantially more training steps. Replay breaks this tradeoff, enabling fast, high-learning-rate finetuning without forgetting.

</details>


### [433] [Looped Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26106)
*Sanghyun Lee,Chunsan Hong,Seungryong Kim,Jonghyun Lee,Jongho Park,Dongmin Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LoopMDM，通过选择性地循环早期-中间Transformer层，在不增加参数的情况下显著提升掩码扩散模型（MDMs）的训练效率与性能，并支持推理时的灵活计算扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 掩码扩散模型（MDMs）作为自回归模型的语言建模替代方案前景广阔，但其Transformer架构的有效设计仍未被充分探索。研究旨在通过层循环机制提升MDMs的训练效率与模型性能。

Method: 提出LoopMDM方法，选择性地循环MDMs中的早期-中间Transformer层。训练时循环产生深度缩放效果但不增加参数；推理时通过改变循环次数实现灵活的计算缩放，并可自适应调整采样过程中的循环次数。

Result: LoopMDM在多个预训练语料上以最多3.3倍更少的训练FLOPs达到同规模MDMs的性能，最终性能在多项推理基准上超越基线（GSM8K上提升高达8.5分），甚至优于使用相当每步计算量训练的更深非循环MDMs。推理时可通过增加循环次数扩展计算，自适应调整循环次数进一步提升计算效率。注意力分析表明循环通过促进掩码位置间的交互发挥作用。

Conclusion: 选择性层循环是一种简单而有效的MDMs架构设计策略，能够同时提升训练效率与模型性能，实现计算资源的高效利用，为MDMs的架构设计提供了新的方向。代码和权重将公开发布。

Abstract: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive models for language modeling, yet the effective design of transformer architectures for MDMs remains underexplored. In this paper, we show that selectively looping the early-middle transformer layers significantly improves both training efficiency and model performance in MDMs. We call this approach LoopMDM(Looped Masked Diffusion Model), which brings two key benefits: looping layers at training-time yields a depth-scaling effect without adding parameters, while varying the number of loops at inference-time enables flexible compute scaling. Despite the simplicity, the results are striking: across multiple pre-training corpora, LoopMDM matches the performance of same-size MDMs with up to 3.3 fewer training FLOPs, while its final performance outperforms them on various reasoning benchmarks, including up to 8.5 points on GSM8K. It even surpasses deeper non-looped MDMs trained with comparable per-step compute, indicating that selective looping is more effective than naive depth scaling. Furthermore, LoopMDM can scale inference-time compute by increasing the number of loops. Adaptively adjusting the number of loops throughout the sampling process further yields additional gains in compute efficiency while maintaining performance. Lastly, with attention analysis, we provide evidence that looping is effective in MDMs by promoting interactions among masked positions. Our code and weights will be publicly released.

</details>


### [434] [Prism: A Plug-in Reproducible Infrastructure for Scalable Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26110)
*Jun-Tao Tang,Yu-Cheng Shi,Zhen-Hao Xie,Da-Wei Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了Prism，一个专为多模态持续指令调优（MCIT）研究设计的可插拔、可复现代码库，通过轻量级插件注册机制将算法开发与底层MLLM实现解耦，解决了现有方法需要直接修改基座代码导致的工程开销大、代码复用难和公平对比受限等问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多模态持续指令调优（MCIT）研究面临严重的工程瓶颈：现有方法通常需要直接修改基座MLLM代码库来实现，这带来了巨大的实现开销，并产生方法特定的架构，严重限制了代码复用和公平对比。实际部署需要持续适应新兴任务，但当前MCIT研究受限于这些工程瓶颈而难以高效发展。

Method: 提出Prism代码库，通过轻量级插件注册机制将算法开发与骨干网络实现分离。新策略可以作为独立插件集成，无需修改底层MLLM代码库，从而消除结构碎片化并加速方法开发。Prism原生支持广泛使用的大规模训练流水线，实现可复现和可扩展的MCIT实验。

Result: Prism成功实现了将算法开发与骨干网络实现解耦，通过插件注册机制使得新策略能够作为独立插件集成，无需修改底层MLLM代码库，消除了结构碎片化，加速了方法开发，并支持可复现和可扩展的MCIT实验。代码已在GitHub开源。

Conclusion: Prism为MCIT研究提供了一个可扩展、可复现的研究平台，通过插件化设计解决了现有方法的工程瓶颈问题，促进了该领域的快速发展和公平对比，代码已开源供研究社区使用。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve versatility by reformulating diverse tasks into a unified instruction-following framework via instruction tuning. However, real-world deployment requires continuous adaptation to emerging tasks, motivating Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning (MCIT). Despite its growing importance, current MCIT research is hindered by severe engineering bottlenecks. Existing methods are typically implemented by directly modifying the base MLLM codebase, which imposes substantial implementation overhead and yields method-specific architectures that severely limit code reuse and fair comparison. To address this, we introduce Prism, a plug-in reproducible codebase specifically designed for scalable MCIT research.
