It separates algorithmic development from the backbone implementation via a lightweight plugin registration mechanism, enabling new strategies to be integrated as independent plugins without modifying the underlying MLLM codebase, thereby eliminating structural fragmentation and accelerating method development. Prism natively supports widely used large-scale training pipeline, thereby enabling reproducible and scalable MCIT experimentation. Code is available at https://github.com/LAMDA-CL/Prism.

</details>

# cs.AR [[Back]](#toc)

### [435] [A Per-Access Upper Bound for Shared-Resource Interference in Direct-Mapped Multicore Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24026)
*Felipe T. Pedroni*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文在特定架构约束下证明了多核处理器中关键访问的干扰存在严格上界(N-1)Lmem，并提供了符合DO-178C/CAST-32A认证要求的可追溯分析方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了满足航空软件DO-178C/CAST-32A认证目标，需要在多核处理器中确定性地界定核心间干扰，从而将干扰分析与最坏情况执行时间(WCET)预算分离，确保时序分析的可靠性和可认证性。

Method: 在直接映射L2缓存、禁用MSHR、单bank主存、确定性固定内存映射任务以及悲观仲裁策略等严格架构不变量下，采用逐访问的直接分析方法，通过构造同步对抗性工作负载（N-1个同索引不同标签的内存请求与目标任务关键访问同相位发出）来证明干扰上界，避免使用非形式的乘性干扰函数。

Result: 证明了在给定架构约束下，目标任务T的每次关键访问所遭受的干扰存在严格上界(N-1)Lmem，且该界可被同步对抗工作负载达到；推导完全分析性，逐访问进行，无需引入启发式或经验性干扰函数。

Conclusion: 本文提供了一种在固定架构约束下可追溯的多核干扰分析方法，为WCET预算中分离干扰成分提供了理论依据，满足航空软件认证要求；同时明确指出了方法的适用条件和局限性。

Abstract: We present a formal bounding analysis for maximum credible interference in multicore processors under strict architectural invariants: direct-mapped L2 cache (1-way associativity), disabled Miss Status Handling Registers (MSHRs), single-bank main memory, deterministic pinned tasks with fixed physical memory mapping, and a pessimistic L2/memory arbitration policy. We prove that, under these invariants, the per-critical-access stall imposed on a target task T is bounded above by (N-1)Lmem, and that this bound is attained by a synchronized adversarial workload of N-1 congruent-different-tag memory requests issued in phase with T's critical accesses. The argument is per-access and direct, requiring no informal multiplicative interference function. The derivation is purely analytical and discussed in the context of DO-178C/CAST-32A certification objectives for airborne software. Limitations and conditions for applicability are explicitly stated. This work provides a traceable method for separating multicore interference from Worst-Case Execution Time (WCET) budgets under fixed architectural constraints.

</details>


### [436] [Decompose, Optimize, and Reconstruct: Very Large Constant Multiplication at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23998)
*Théo Cantaloube,Nicolai Fiege,Anastasia Volkova,Christine Solnon*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文针对超大常量乘法(VLCM)问题提出了改进的优化流程，通过允许模式重叠和使用约束规划与SAT方法实现了全局最优解，在实验中显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 资源受限硬件中的算术电路设计涉及复杂的组合优化问题，其中多常量乘法(MCM)是典型例子。现有最优MCM方法仅适用于中等大小常量(如12位)，而实际应用需要处理更大精度的超大常量乘法(VLCM)。现有VLCM方法采用启发式流程，存在优化空间。

Method: 提出多个改进：(1)允许模式重叠的新声明式优化模型用于模式选择；(2)最优重建模型替代启发式重建；(3)应用最新最优MCM模型；(4)提出全局最优VLCM方法并刻画其限制。采用约束规划和SAT混合方法求解每个步骤。

Result: 在合成基准测试和真实信号处理、密码学基准测试上进行实验，系数字长从几十位到数千位。实验结果表明所提方法能够扩展到非常大精度，并持续优于现有基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过允许模式重叠最小化MCM步骤的唯一目标常量数量，以及执行最优重建而非启发式重建，实现了VLCM问题的显著改进。所提方法具有良好的可扩展性，为资源受限硬件中的算术电路设计提供了更优解决方案。

Abstract: Efficient arithmetic circuit design for resourceconstrained hardware involves challenging combinatorial optimization problems, among which Multiple Constant Multiplication (MCM) is a prominent example. MCM aims at implementing multiplications by fixed integer constants using bit-shifts and additions/subtractions but optimal methods are typically limited to moderately-sized constants, e.g. 12 bits. For practical applications targeting larger precision, Very large Constant Multiplication (VLCM) is solved instead. Existing approaches typically address VLCM through a heuristic flow that decomposes large constants into patterns, applies MCM optimization techniques on moderately-sized targets, and reconstructs the final result. This paper proposes multiple improvements to this flow: new declarative optimization models for the pattern selection and for the reconstruction, as well as applying recent optimal MCM models. The cornerstones of the obtained improvements are (i) allowing the patterns to overlap, minimising the number of unique target constants for the MCM step and (ii) performing the reconstruction step optimally, instead of heuristically. In addition, we propose a globally-optimal VLCM approach and characterize its limits. We employ a mix of constraint programming and SAT to solve each step. Experimental results on synthetic and real-life signal processing and cryptographic benchmarks, with coefficient word lengths ranging from tens to thousands of bits, demonstrate that the proposed approach scales to very large precisions and consistently outperforms existing baselines.

</details>


### [437] [SA-Kura: An Energy-Efficient Systolic Array Accelerator for Locally-Coupled Kuramoto Drift in Diffusion Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24016)
*Jeongmin Jin,Kyeongwon Lee,Mundo Jeong,Jongin Choi,Woojoo Lee*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: SA-Kura是首个针对Kuramoto取向扩散中局部耦合漂移的专用脉动阵列加速器，通过重构计算流程消除PE内的超越函数单元，相比同平台软件执行实现193倍延迟降低和69.4倍能耗降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型推理在边缘部署中成本高昂，现有加速器仅关注分数网络；Kuramoto取向扩散虽能提升采样效率，但其中心依赖的非线性5×5模板计算在传统CNN加速器和矩阵引擎上映射效率极低，形成了新的硬件瓶颈。

Method: 将成对正弦耦合重构为与中心相位无关的邻居累加，随后进行单次中心依赖的乘减组合，从而消除脉动阵列处理单元内的超越函数单元，实现规则化的脉动执行和寄存器级数据复用。

Result: 在45nm CMOS工艺下综合评估，仅漂移内核部分，相比同SoC平台上的软件执行，SA-Kura将延迟和能耗分别降低193倍和69.4倍；相比Jetson Orin Nano CUDA实现，速度提升6.57倍，每像素能耗降低约46.0倍。

Conclusion: SA-Kura成功证明了通过算法-硬件协同设计，可以将Kuramoto取向扩散中复杂的非线性耦合计算高效映射到脉动阵列架构，为扩散模型的高效边缘部署提供了新的硬件加速方案。

Abstract: Diffusion inference remains costly for edge deployment, yet existing accelerators focus almost exclusively on score networks because standard drift is merely a trivial linear scaling. Kuramoto orientation diffusion replaces this trivial drift with locally coupled phase interactions, improving sampling efficiency but introducing a new hardware bottleneck: a center-dependent nonlinear 5 x 5 stencil evaluated at every reverse step. This kernel maps poorly to conventional CNN accelerators and matrix-oriented engines. We present SA-Kura, to our knowledge the first digital systolic-array accelerator dedicated to locally coupled Kuramoto drift. By reformulating pair-wise sinusoidal coupling into neighbor accumulation independent of the center phase followed by a single center-dependent multiply-subtract combination, SA-Kura eliminates in-PE transcendental units and enables regular systolic execution with register-level reuse. SA-Kura was implemented in synthesizable RTL, integrated into a lightweight RISC-V-based SoC, prototyped on FPGA, and evaluated through 45 nm CMOS synthesis and power analysis. For the drift kernel only, compared with software execution of the same kernel on the processor core in the same SoC platform, SA-Kura reduces latency and energy by 193x and 69.4x, respectively. Compared with a standalone Jetson Orin Nano CUDA implementation of the same kernel, it is 6.57x faster and achieves approximately 46.0x lower energy per pixel.

</details>


### [438] [CMAX-CAMEL: A Coarse-to-Fine Adaptive, Memory-Efficient, and Low-Power Edge Processor for Contrast Maximization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24017)
*Kyeongpil Min,Jongin Choi,Kyeongwon Lee,Woojoo Lee*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出了CMAX-CAMEL，一种面向事件相机运动估计的软硬件协同设计处理器。通过运行时自适应的由粗到精执行策略与存储优化架构，在FPGA上实现了最高19%的精度提升、53.3%的延迟降低以及52.2%的系统能耗节省。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对比度最大化（CMAX）是事件相机运动估计的主流几何框架，但其迭代式的“变形-累加”流程存在输入依赖的计算开销和频繁的存储访问，难以满足边缘端实时、低功耗的应用需求。

Method: 提出CMAX-CAMEL处理器，采用软硬件协同设计：1）运行时自适应执行策略，根据事件分布动态调整由粗到精的执行阶段，优先处理有助于提升精度的阶段，抑制低价值迭代；2）存储中心架构，采用分块并行存储组织维持实时吞吐，并结合子采样耦合累加结构减少数据流中的存储访问。

Result: 在200MHz的Virtex FPGA原型上，相比固定由粗到精策略：估计精度提升最高19%，处理延迟降低53.3%，有效存储访问减少42%，总系统能耗降低52.2%（已包含自适应开销）。

Conclusion: CMAX-CAMEL证明了通过协同优化执行策略与数据移动，能够在边缘端实现实时、低功耗的事件相机运动估计，为事件视觉系统部署提供了高效解决方案。

Abstract: Contrast maximization (CMAX) is a direct geometric framework for event-based motion estimation, but its iterative warp-and-accumulate pipeline incurs input-dependent computation and frequent memory accesses, challenging real-time, low-power edge deployment. We present CMAX-CAMEL, a coarse-to-fine adaptive, memory-efficient, low-power edge processor for CMAX. CMAX-CAMEL combines a runtime-adaptive execution strategy with a memory-centric processor architecture. It adjusts coarse-to-fine execution according to the observed event distribution, prioritizing stages likely to improve estimation accuracy while suppressing low-value iterations and unnecessary stage transitions. Architecturally, a banked parallel memory organization sustains real-time throughput while reducing latency, and a subsampling-coupled accumulation structure lowers memory-access activity along the warp-and-accumulate dataflow. On a Virtex FPGA prototype operating at 200 MHz, CMAX-CAMEL improves estimation accuracy by up to 19% over fixed coarse-to-fine schedules, reduces processing latency by 53.3%, lowers effective memory accesses by 42%, and cuts total system energy by 52.2%, including adaptation overheads. These results show that CMAX-CAMEL is an HW-SW co-design that co-optimizes execution policy and data movement for real-time, low-power event-based motion estimation at the edge.

</details>


### [439] [Adaptive KV Cache Reuse for Fast Long-Context LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24022)
*Fei li,Song Liu,Yan Liu,Jinhua Cui,Shiqiang Nie,Jinyu Wang,Weiguo Wu*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: CacheTune通过频率引导的KV Cache选择性重计算和硬件感知的异构缓存协同优化，在长上下文LLM推理中实现了非前缀场景下的高效KV Cache复用，显著降低了TTFT延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文LLM推理中，预填充阶段的TTFT延迟成为主要瓶颈。传统前缀缓存仅适用于严格前缀场景，而非前缀场景下直接复用KV Cache会破坏跨块全局注意力关系导致生成质量下降。同时，异构硬件层级间的I/O开销成为新的TTFT瓶颈，因此需要同时解决语义一致性恢复和计算-I/O协同优化问题。

Method: CacheTune采用频率引导和硬件感知的KV Cache复用策略：(1)离线通过频域分析识别对跨注意力恢复最关键的KV对；(2)在线选择性重计算这些语义关键token，复用剩余KV；(3)结合稀疏KV传输、多流异步重叠、延迟位置编码恢复和硬件感知自适应重计算比例调优，在异构缓存池间平衡计算与数据移动。

Result: 在主流LLM和长上下文任务上评估：实现3.72x-4.86x的TTFT加速，吞吐量提升3.93x-6.21x，生成质量接近完全重计算。当缓存卸载到I/O受限的SSD/HDD存储时，通过自适应重计算仍可保持2.34x-2.36x的TTFT加速。

Conclusion: CacheTune成功解决了非前缀场景下的KV Cache复用挑战，通过语义关键性选择和异构硬件协同优化，在保持生成质量的同时显著提升了长上下文LLM服务的推理性能，为降低部署成本和提升交互性能提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: In long-context Large Language Model (LLM) inference, the Time-To-First-Token (TTFT) latency incurred by the prefill stage has become the foremost bottleneck limiting interactive performance and deployment cost. KV Cache reuse offers a direct path to reduce redundant prefill, yet traditional prefix caching applies only to strict-prefix scenarios; directly reusing KV Cache in non-prefix settings breaks the cross-chunk global attention relationships and causes significant degradation in generation quality. When reusable KV Cache is offloaded to GPU-external cache pools, I/O overheads across heterogeneous hardware tiers further emerge as a new TTFT bottleneck. Efficient non-prefix KV Cache reuse therefore requires both semantic-consistency recovery and compute-I/O co-optimization.
  This paper presents CacheTune, a frequency-guided and hardware-aware KV Cache reuse system for long-context LLM serving. CacheTune first identifies, offline, the KV pairs most critical to cross-attention recovery through frequency-domain analysis, and then selectively recomputes only these semantic-critical tokens online while reusing the remaining KVs. To turn this semantic selection into end-to-end latency reduction, CacheTune further combines sparse KV transfer, multi-stream asynchronous overlap, deferred positional-encoding recovery, and hardware-aware adaptive recomputation-ratio tuning to balance computation and data movement across heterogeneous cache pools. Evaluations on mainstream LLMs and long-context tasks show that CacheTune achieves 3.72x-4.86x TTFT speedup and 3.93x-6.21x higher throughput while maintaining generation quality close to full recompute. Even when caches are offloaded to I/O-bound SSD/HDD storage, CacheTune sustains 2.34x-2.36x TTFT speedup through adaptive recomputation.

</details>


### [440] [EVA: Accelerating LLM Decoding via an Efficient Vector Quantization Architecture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24144)
*Bowen Duan,Cong Guo,Chiyue Wei,Haoxuan Shan,Yuzhe Fu,Xinhua Chen,Yifan Xu,Ziyue Zhang,Changchun Zhou,Hai Li,Yiran Chen*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出EVA架构，通过将LLM解码从GEMV计算转换为GEMM计算，并消除码本查找的内存冲突，实现了最高11.17倍加速和7.17倍能效提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型(LLM)在自回归解码阶段效率低下。与采用计算密集型GEMM操作的prefill阶段不同，解码阶段执行一系列小型GEMV类计算，这些计算是内存受限的，无法充分利用现代加速器。虽然权重量化(VQ)技术可以压缩模型大小并减少内存带宽需求，但仍存在两个关键低效问题：GEMV计算利用率低和码本查找期间的频繁内存冲突。

Method: 提出EVA架构，基于输入-码本计算与无冲突内存访问相结合的思路。该方法不通过索引重建量化权重，而是直接在输入向量和权重码本之间执行点积运算，将LLM解码从GEMV计算转换为GEMM计算。然后从中间输出缓冲区执行结构化查找，消除内存bank冲突。同时设计了与常规prefill执行兼容的软硬件协同优化架构。

Result: 与最先进的基于查找的架构相比，EVA实现了最高11.17倍加速和7.17倍更高能效，同时在向量量化后保持算术精度。

Conclusion: EVA成功解决了LLM解码阶段的计算和内存瓶颈，通过创新的计算转换和内存访问策略，显著提升了解码效率，为LLM的高效部署提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved impressive performance across diverse domains but remain inefficient during the autoregressive decoding phase. Unlike the prefill stage, which employs compute-bound GEMM operations, decoding executes a sequence of small GEMV-like computations that are memory-bound and underutilize modern accelerators. Weight-only vector quantization (VQ) has emerged as an effective compression technique that clusters model weights into a shared codebook and replaces the original weight matrix with low-precision indices, enabling 2-bit-level weight compression. While this approach substantially reduces model size and memory bandwidth, it still suffers from two critical inefficiencies: the low utilization of GEMV computation and frequent memory conflicts during codebook lookups.
  This paper presents EVA, an efficient vector-quantization-based architecture that addresses both computational and memory bottlenecks in LLM decoding. EVA builds on a simple yet effective insight that combines input-codebook computation with conflict-free memory access. Instead of reconstructing quantized weights from indices, EVA directly performs dot products between input vectors and the weight codebook, transforming LLM decoding from GEMV to GEMM computation. It then performs structured lookups from an intermediate output buffer, eliminating memory bank conflicts. We further design a hardware-software co-optimized architecture specialized for LLM decoding while remaining compatible with conventional prefill execution. Evaluations show that EVA achieves up to 11.17$\times$ speedup and 7.17$\times$ higher energy efficiency compared with the SOTA lookup-based architecture, while preserving arithmetic precision after vector quantization. Our code is available at https://github.com/dbw6/Eva.git.

</details>


### [441] [MX-SAFE: Versatile Inference- and Training-Proof Microscaling Format with On-the-Fly Exponent and Mantissa Bit Allocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24391)
*Dahoon Park,Jahyun Koo,Sangwoo Hwang,Jaeha Kung*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出了MX-SAFE (MXSF)格式，这是一种通用的MXFP格式，通过自适应使用两种模式（FP8 E2M5和FP5 E3M2）来同时支持训练和直接转换推理，在降低能耗的同时保持精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着深度学习需求增长，通过量化降低成本变得至关重要。OCP联盟标准化的MX格式虽然有效，但现有的MXINT和MXFP各有优劣：MXINT精度高但动态范围有限，MXFP动态范围宽但精度受限。需要一种能同时满足训练和推理需求的统一格式。

Method: 提出MX-SAFE (MXSF)格式，自适应使用两种模式：更宽尾数模式(FP8 E2M5)和次正常FP模式(FP5 E3M2)。同时提出基于分块(Tile-based)的块设计，通过减少MXSF格式训练过程中的重量化负担来提高硬件效率。

Result: 相比MXFP8 E2M5，推理/全训练精度平均提升0.05%/11.1%；相比MXFP8 E4M3，精度提升3.55%/3.57%。训练-推理加速器在达到与BF16基线相似精度的同时，总能耗降低24.9%。

Conclusion: MX-SAFE格式成功实现了训练和推理的统一支持，在保持精度的同时显著降低了能耗，为深度学习量化提供了一种高效的硬件友好解决方案。

Abstract: As the demand for deep learning grows, cost reduction through quantization has become essential for both training and inference. In 2022, the Open Compute Project (OCP) consortium standardized narrow precision formats for deep learning, called the microscaling (MX) format. The MX format is a hardware-friendly dynamic quantization scheme that effectively reduces the data size by sharing an 8-bit exponent across multiple operands. The MX format can be categorized into two types with their own strengths: (i) MXINT which focuses on a high precision consisting only of mantissa bits and (ii) MXFP which focuses on a wider dynamic range by allowing local exponent bits. In this work, we present a versatile MXFP format, called MX-SAFE (MXSF in short), that adaptively uses two modes, i.e., a wider mantissa mode (FP8 E2M5) and a subnormal FP mode (FP5 E3M2), to support both training and direct-cast inference. Furthermore, we propose a tile-based block design to increase hardware efficiency by reducing the burden of re-quantization process during the training with the MXSF format. Owing to the use of the proposed MXSF format, 0.05%/11.1% and 3.55%/3.57% improvements in accuracy, on average, for inference/full-training compared to MXFP8 E2M5 and MXFP8 E4M3 are observed, respectively. Moreover, we present a training-inference accelerator that supports the MXSF format and it achieves similar accuracy to the BF16 baseline while using 24.9% less total energy consumption.

</details>


### [442] [Provisioning to Runtime Optimization of a +100 MW AI Cluster](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24461)
*Ehsan K. Ardestani,Leonardo Piga,Jovan Stojkovic,Pavan Balaji,Mustafa Ozdal,Mikel Jimenez Fernandez,Mihaela Dimovska,Luka Tadic,Hao Shen,Devika Vishwanath,Richa Mishra,Melaku Mihret,Valentin Andrei,Mauricio Cespedes,Julien Prigent,James Monahan,Tyler Graf,Bin Li,Charles Marquez,Shobhit Kanaujia,Kaushik Veeraraghavan,Chunqiang Tang*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文首次系统性地描述了超大规模AI数据中心端到端的电力管理全流程，并以一个配备83K GB200 GPU的150兆瓦数据中心为案例分享了详细测量数据与实践经验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对AI数据中心的电力供应已成为实现通用人工智能（AGI）的最主要瓶颈，且其限制已超过AI加速器的可用性，本文旨在填补关于超大规模AI数据中心电力管理全流程的研究空白。

Method: 本文详细描述了从下一代加速器正式发布前6-12个月的早期电力规划、大规模部署后的电力参数调优，到应对动态工作负载的运行时电力管理的全流程，并以实际运营的150 MW数据中心（83K GB200 GPU集群）为例进行分析。

Result: 提供了150 MW数据中心在建设与运营过程中的详细电力测量数据，并分享了构建该先进AI集群过程中获得的实际经验与见解。

Conclusion: 本文希望鼓励行业从业者分享自身的AI数据中心电力管理经验，推动领域内的知识共享与最佳实践的形成。

Abstract: The electric power supply for AI data centers is now the most significant bottleneck in the race toward Artificial General Intelligence, surpassing even the constraint of AI accelerator availability. To our knowledge, this paper is the first to describe the end-to-end power management process for a hyper-scale AI datacenter; from early power planning to accommodate next-generation accelerators 6--12 months before their general availability, to tuning power settings after large scale deployment, and finally to dynamic, runtime power management for evolving workloads. We present detailed power measurements for a 150 MW datacenter hosting a cluster of 83K GB200 GPUs. We share insights from building this state-of-the-art AI cluster. We hope this work encourages practitioners across the industry to share their own experiences as well.

</details>


### [443] [An Energy-Efficient Approximate Posit Multiply-Divide Unit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24665)
*Rishi Thotli,Aditya Anirudh Jonnalagadda,Rishabh Hulsurkar,Anil Kumar Uppugunduru,Sreehari Veeramachaneni,Syed Ershad Ahmed,John Gustafson*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向posit数系统的低精度除法方法，通过LUT和单次减法实现近似倒数值计算，并设计了乘除法融合的硬件架构。在TSMC 90nm工艺下，相比精确除法设计，功耗延迟积降低78.8%，面积仅需46.33%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在现代计算单元中，除法运算相比其他算术运算速度更慢、资源消耗更大。传统快速除法算法通过迭代逼近倒数值来减少延迟，但硬件架构和算法选择会显著影响除法单元的整体性能。针对这一瓶颈，研究者希望利用posit数系统的数学对称性，设计一种高效、低资源消耗的近似除法方案。

Method: 提出了一种面向posit数系统的降精度除法方法：利用posit数系统的数学对称性，采用查找表（LUT）和单次减法操作完成除数倒数的近似计算；将倒数计算逻辑嵌入posit解码器中，并设计了乘法与除法融合的硬件架构，从而减少运算步骤和硬件开销。

Result: 所提架构在TSMC 90nm工艺节点下使用Cadence RTL v7.1 E2编译器仿真，相比现有精确除法设计，功耗延迟积（PDP）降低78.8%，面积仅需46.33%。实验还证明了该系统在提升posit系统乘法效率方面的有效性。该方法以牺牲完美舍入精度为代价，大幅降低了硬件开销。

Conclusion: 该研究证明了在posit数系统中，通过LUT和单次减法实现近似倒数计算，可以在极低的硬件成本和功耗延迟积下完成除法运算。乘除法融合架构进一步提升了硬件利用效率，为资源受限和能效优先的应用场景提供了有效的解决方案。

Abstract: In modern computing units, division operations are generally slower than other arithmetic operations and require more resources, such as area and power, than multiplication. To reduce the delay, fast division algorithms use an initial approximation of the reciprocal of the divisor and iteratively approach the correct value, followed by multiplication with the dividend. The hardware architecture and choice of algorithm can significantly alter the overall performance of the division unit. This paper proposes a reduced-accuracy division method for the posit number system, which is an alternative to the traditional floating-point system. The proposed design uses a Look-Up Table (LUT) and a single subtraction operation to perform approximate divisor reciprocation by leveragingthemathematicalsymmetriesofthepositnumbersystem.The paper also presents a hardware architecture that combines multiplication and division units. The reciprocal calculation has been incorporated into the posit Decoder, a common unit required to perform any hardware operation with posits. Compared to existing hardware implementations of division, the proposed method requires significantly fewer operations at the cost of perfect rounding for division. The proposed architecture was simulated using the Cadence RTL v7.1 E2 compiler at the TSMC 90 nm process node and achieves a Power Delay Product (PDP) reduction of 78.8% compared to an existing design that performs exact division, while only 46.33% of the area is required. The experimental results also demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed system in improving the efficiency of multiplication in posit-based systems.

</details>


### [444] [XL-HD: Extended Learning in Hyperdimensional Computing via Deterministic Projections for In-Memory Accelerators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24788)
*Sabrina Hassan Moon,Abu Kaisar Mohammad Masum,Sercan Aygun,Dayane Reis*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出XL-HD，一种确定性的、基于投影的、完全可学习的超维计算框架，专为边缘计算系统的存内计算加速设计，在保持竞争力的准确率同时实现了极低的能耗和面积开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统超维计算（HDC）依赖于符号绑定和伪随机高维向量，需要大维度和启发式更新才能达到竞争性准确率，这限制了其在边缘硬件上的部署。边缘机器学习对低延迟、低功耗和紧凑内存预算有严格要求，传统HDC方法难以满足这些需求。

Method: XL-HD使用固定的Sobol序列投影二进制输入，将学习扩展到传统HDC之外。在训练过程中，类别原型在实值空间中进行优化，随后进行二值化处理，从而实现完全的二值化点积推理流程，非常适合ReRAM交叉开关等存内计算（IMC）硬件。

Result: 在MNIST、UCIHAR和ISOLET数据集上实现了具有竞争力的准确率。推理引擎面积仅为0.395 mm²，单次单周期推理能耗仅0.40 μJ，展现出极高的能效和紧凑的硬件实现。

Conclusion: XL-HD成功地将超维计算与存内计算硬件相结合，通过确定性投影和完全可学习的框架克服了传统HDC的局限性，为边缘设备上的机器学习推理提供了一个高效、节能的解决方案，具有重要的实际应用价值。

Abstract: Hyperdimensional computing (HDC) is a promising approach for energy-efficient edge machine learning (ML), where low latency, low power, and tight memory budgets are essential. However, traditional HDC relies on symbolic binding and pseudo-random high-dimensional vectors, which require large dimensionality and heuristic updates to reach competitive accuracy, limiting deployment on edge hardware. We introduce XL-HD, a deterministic, projection-based, fully learnable HDC framework tailored for in-memory acceleration within edge computing systems. The method uses a fixed Sobol sequence to project binary inputs, extending learning beyond conventional HDC. During training, class prototypes are optimized in real-valued space and later binarized, enabling an entirely binary dot-product inference pipeline ideal for IMC hardware such as ReRAM crossbars. XL-HD achieves competitive accuracy on MNIST, UCIHAR, and ISOLET while maintaining a compact IMC-based inference engine with $0.395 \ \text{mm}^2$ area and only $0.40 \ μ\text{J}$ per single-cycle inference.

</details>


### [445] [Architectural Limits of Cloud TPUs in Finite-Field Cryptography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25367)
*Hung Dang,Xuan Phu Dang,Tue Nguyen*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文实证量化了云TPU在有限域密码学计算上相比A100 GPU存在高达数千倍的成本效率差距，揭示了AI优化的脉动阵列结构在精确高吞吐量域运算上的根本不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着云TPU等AI专用加速器的普及，研究者希望探索这些硬件在有限域密码学（如零知识证明）场景下的适用性。然而，TPU原本为AI工作负载优化，缺乏宽整数ALU，其在精确域运算上的性能表现缺乏系统性的实证研究。本文旨在量化和分析TPU在该领域的性能缺陷及其根本原因。

Method: 1. 开发测量工具codename作为实验载体，通过将低次多项式映射为矩阵形式的数论变换（NTT），调度器将异构多项式堆叠为密集2D矩阵，实现K维度的高列占用率。
2. 在v4和v5p架构上，以FP32尾数暂存和原生int32累加器两种方式进行实测，并与A100 GPU上的cuZK基准进行对比。
3. 使用事后HLO验证器确保测量结果不受XLA融合引擎的结构性干扰，保证测量的隔离性和准确性。
4. 对多租户部署场景进行建模，分析严格隔离约束导致的急切Montgomery归约对性能的影响。

Result: 1. 在FP32尾数暂存模式下，v5p和v4架构相对于A100 GPU的性能差距分别为5,558倍和6,908倍；使用v5p原生int32累加器时差距约为4,693倍。
2. 分析表明性能差距可分解为算术惩罚（缺乏宽整数ALU）和空间惩罚。
3. 多租户严格隔离场景下，急切Montgomery归约导致约5.19倍的空间性能崩塌；即使放松隔离约束恢复空间周期，底层算术惩罚依然存在。
4. 尽管K维度包装接近最优，M维度利用率严重不足（如v4上仅6.25%），结合VPU绑定的Montgomery归约瓶颈，导致脉动阵列在数学层面处于饥饿状态。

Conclusion: 实验结论表明，针对AI工作负载优化的脉动阵列结构在精确、高吞吐量的域运算中存在根本性的不足。TPU缺乏宽整数ALU的架构限制、严重的水洗维度利用率问题以及Montgomery归约的计算瓶颈共同导致了巨大的性能差距，这为未来专用加速器在密码学应用上的设计提供了重要的实证参考。

Abstract: We empirically characterise the cost-efficiency deficit between cloud Tensor Processing Units and GPUs for finite-field cryptography. Against A100 GPU baselines (cuZK), we measure a $[5{,}558\times, 6{,}908\times]$ deficit across v5p and v4 architectures under an FP32-mantissa staging discipline, and a $\sim$$4{,}693\times$ deficit using v5p's native \texttt{int32} accumulator. We analytically project this deficit into a fundamental arithmetic penalty (lacking wide-integer ALUs) and a spatial penalty. We demonstrate that evaluating concurrent multi-tenant deployments, where strict separation forces eager Montgomery reduction, yields a projected $5.19\times$ spatial collapse; relaxing this constraint theoretically recovers these spatial cycles, yet the underlying arithmetic penalty remains. To facilitate this characterisation, we deploy \codename as a measurement vehicle. By mapping low-degree polynomials onto matrix-form Number Theoretic Transforms, the scheduler stacks heterogeneous polynomials into dense 2D matrices, achieving $\sim$$100\%$ K-dimension column occupancy on uniform workloads ($>$$92\%$ on mixed-degree traces). However, despite optimal K-dimension packing, severe M-dimension under-utilisation (e.g., $6.25\%$ on v4) combined with overwhelming VPU-bound Montgomery reduction stalls mathematically starve the systolic arrays. A post-hoc HLO validator ensures these measurements remain structurally isolated against the XLA fusion engine. Our findings empirically demonstrate the structural inadequacy of AI-optimised systolic arrays for exact, high-throughput field arithmetic.

</details>


### [446] [ZK-Tracer: A High-Performance Heterogeneous Accelerator for Zero-Knowledge VM Trace Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25493)
*Jieran Cui,Zhengkai Wen,Haowen Fang,Yinan Zhu,Jia Xiong,Cheng Ni,Mingchi Zhang,Nan Guan,Xi Wang*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出了ZK-Tracer，这是首个专为zkVM前端设计的硬件加速架构，通过异构设计实现了高达1829倍的追踪生成加速和963倍的端到端系统性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有零知识虚拟机(zkVM)硬件加速研究仅关注后端证明阶段，但随着技术发展，前端执行和追踪生成阶段已成为新的系统性能瓶颈，严重限制了zkVM的实用性。

Method: 提出ZK-Tracer硬件加速器架构，采用异构设计包含主追踪单元和并行置换追踪单元，通过轻量级指令集扩展暴露细粒度接口，实现高效的任务卸载。

Result: ASIC实现结果表明，ZK-Tracer在高性能多核CPU基础上实现了高达1829倍的追踪生成加速；与现有后端证明加速器集成后，整个ZKP系统获得963倍的端到端性能提升。

Conclusion: ZK-Tracer成功解决了zkVM前端性能瓶颈问题，证明了前端硬件加速的必要性和有效性，为零知识证明技术的大规模应用铺平了道路。

Abstract: Zero-knowledge virtual machines (zkVMs) are a key technology for driving the large-scale adoption of zero-knowledge proofs (ZKP), but their performance bottlenecks severely limit their practicality. While current hardware acceleration research has exclusively focused on backend proving, we identify that the frontend execution and trace generation phase is rapidly emerging as the new system bottleneck. To address this challenge, we propose ZK-Tracer, the first hardware accelerator architecture specifically designed for the zkVM frontend. ZK-Tracer features a novel heterogeneous design comprising a Main Trace Unit and parallel Permutation Trace Units. It exposes a fine-grained interface to the host software through a lightweight instruction set extension, enabling efficient task offloading. Our ASIC implementation results demonstrate that ZK-Tracer achieves up to 1829x speedup in trace generation over a high-performance multi-core CPU. When integrated with existing backend proving accelerators, it delivers a remarkable 963x end-to-end performance improvement for the entire ZKP system.

</details>


### [447] [Co-Designing Graph-based Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search at Billion Scale for Processing-in-Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25522)
*Sitian Chen,Yusen Li,Yao Chen,Minwen Deng,Jintao Meng,Amelie Chi Zhou*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向PIM的图搜索算法-架构协同设计，通过压缩索引布局、异步流水线调度器和免乘法距离计算核，在十亿规模数据集上实现高达20倍于CPU、17.1倍于GPU的吞吐量提升，并在高召回率区域比现有PIM加速器快129倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近似最近邻搜索（ANNS）是现代AI系统的核心原语。现有图方法在大规模下精度-效率权衡最优，但属于内存受限型负载：CPU受限于内存带宽，GPU缺乏足够的高带宽内存容量。PIM技术通过将计算置于数据旁可释放充足内部带宽，但图搜索映射到PIM存在架构不匹配问题：处理单元本地存储小、单元间通信开销大、主机协调存在额外开销、片内计算单元较弱。

Method: 提出算法-架构协同设计，包含三个核心组件：(1)压缩索引布局，使PIM驻留内存占用减少14.5倍；(2)异步流水线调度器，保持主机-PIM互联链路饱和；(3)免乘法距离计算核，召回率损失低于0.08%。

Result: 在三个十亿规模基准测试中，所提设计吞吐量分别比CPU和GPU基线高20倍和17.1倍；在高召回率区域比现有PIM加速器快129倍；能优雅扩展至多节点部署及新兴PIM架构。

Conclusion: 通过算法-架构协同设计，成功克服了图搜索在PIM上的映射障碍，充分发挥PIM的带宽优势，为大规模近似最近邻搜索提供了高效的解决方案，展示了PIM在此类内存受限负载中的巨大潜力。

Abstract: Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search (ANNS) is a core primitive in modern AI systems, and graph-based methods currently offer the best accuracy-efficiency trade-off at scale. The workload is fundamentally memory-bound: graph traversal produces frequent, irregular memory accesses that cap CPU throughput at main-memory bandwidth, while GPUs lack the high-bandwidth memory capacity to host billion-scale indexes. Processing-in-Memory (PIM) is a natural candidate, as placing computation next to data unlocks the abundant internal bandwidth that such bandwidth-starved workloads demand. Porting graph-based ANNS to PIM, however, exposes several architectural mismatches: each processing unit has only a small local memory, inter-unit communication is costly, host coordination adds overhead, and in-memory compute units are relatively weak -- limitations that have forced prior PIM-based ANNS designs to fall back on cluster-based indexing, whose recall ceiling is far below that of graph methods. This paper presents an algorithm-architecture co-design that overcomes these obstacles through three components: a compacted index layout that shrinks the PIM-resident memory footprint by 14.5x; an asynchronous pipelined scheduler that keeps the host-to-PIM interconnect saturated; and a multiplication-free distance kernel that loses under 0.08% recall. Across three billion-scale benchmarks, the proposed design achieves up to 20x and 17.1x higher throughput than CPU and GPU baselines, respectively, outperforms prior PIM accelerators by 129x in the high-recall regime, and scales gracefully across multi-node deployments and emerging PIM architecture.

</details>


### [448] [Code size reduction by advanced near addressing modes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25602)
*Kajetan Nuernberger,Thomas Roecker,Gergely Fueto,Gabor Spaits,Horst Lehser*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文研究了如何为RISC-V指令集架构添加近地址寻址模式，以解决实时系统中大量全局变量导致的代码膨胀问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实时控制系统软件中存在大量全局变量，导致变量地址超出全局指针可寻址范围，需要两条指令进行寻址，而其他CPU架构通过近地址寻址模式实现了代码尺寸缩减和性能提升。

Method: 提出了多种在RISC-V ISA中添加近地址寻址特性的方案，并使用不同的代表性工作负载进行代码尺寸影响评估。

Result: 通过对不同工作负载的评估，分析了近地址寻址特性对代码尺寸的影响，验证了该方案的有效性。

Conclusion: 为RISC-V ISA添加近地址寻址模式可以有效减少代码尺寸并提升性能，为实时控制系统的调试和校准提供了架构级优化方案。

Abstract: To enable debugging and calibration of real time systems, which are in interaction with the real plant, the software used on those systems often has a huge number of global variables. The huge number of global variables exceed the range addressable relative to the global pointer. Therefore, addressing these variables normally needs two instructions. Other CPU architectures commonly used in the real time control systems domain address these by various near addressing modes. This results in significant code size reductions and performance boost. This paper discusses different variants to add such near addressing features to the RISC-V ISA. The impact on the code size is evaluated with different representative workloads.

</details>


### [449] [DiSC: Resolution-Scalable Acceleration of Diffusion Models by Exploiting Sparsity and Cached Token Reuse with Hash-based Distribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25798)
*Jieon Yoon,Hangyeol Lee,Jaehoon Heo,Joo-Young Kim*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出了DiSC，一种面向Transformer扩散模型的可扩展稀疏感知硬件加速器。通过软件层面的缓存令牌复用（CTR）和带掩码复用的Softmax阈值化（ST）算法，结合专用的硬件架构设计，在A100和H100 GPU上分别实现了3.47-4.74倍和2.48-3.50倍加速，并节省46.4%-68.1%的能耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于Transformer的扩散模型具有优越的可扩展性和性能，但由于其迭代特性以及高分辨率下自注意力机制的二次复杂度，存在高昂的计算开销问题，亟需高效的加速方案。

Method: 提出DiSC加速器，在软件层面引入两种算法：(1) 缓存令牌复用（CTR），将跨步输入潜在差异的空间变化转化为令牌级复用决策，消除冗余令牌计算；(2) 带稀疏掩码复用的Softmax阈值化（ST），利用时序相似性复用生成的稀疏模式，诱导注意力操作的稀疏性。在硬件层面，设计了专用架构和统一数据流，采用基于哈希的片上存储分组分布机制，复用现有计算引擎处理稀疏操作，避免了专用的稀疏处理组件。

Result: 在DiT和PixArt-Sigma模型上进行评估，相比NVIDIA A100 GPU实现3.47-4.74倍加速，相比H100 GPU实现2.48-3.50倍加速，能耗节省范围为46.4%至68.1%。

Conclusion: DiSC通过软硬件协同设计有效解决了Transformer扩散模型的计算瓶颈，以最小的硬件开销实现了显著的性能提升和能耗节省，为高分辨率生成模型的部署提供了高效解决方案。

Abstract: Transformer-based diffusion models offer superior scalability and performance but suffer from high computational overhead due to the iterative nature and quadratic complexity of self-attention at high resolutions. In this paper, we propose DiSC, a resolution-scalable, sparsity-aware hardware accelerator. At the software level, DiSC introduces two algorithms: Cached Token Reuse (CTR), and Softmax Thresholding with Sparsity Mask Reuse (ST). CTR introduces a mechanism that translates spatial variations in the input latent difference across steps into a token-level reuse decision, effectively eliminating redundant token computation. ST induces sparsity in attention operations by reusing a generated sparsity pattern, leveraging temporal similarity to bypass costly prediction overhead. Together, these algorithms provide resolution-scalable computational benefits and yield a moderate sparsity and hybrid dense-sparse workload.
  To exploit this efficiently, we design a specialized hardware architecture and unified dataflow. This architecture avoids dedicated sparsity-handling components; instead, a hash-based distribution over on-chip memory banks allows DiSC to reuse its existing compute engines for sparse operations, efficiently exploiting the induced sparsity with minimal hardware overhead. Evaluated on DiT and PixArt-Sigma, DiSC achieves 3.47-4.74x and 2.48-3.50x speedups over NVIDIA A100 and H100 GPUs, respectively, with energy savings ranging from 46.4% to 68.1%.

</details>


<div id='cs.NI'></div>

# cs.NI [[Back]](#toc)

### [450] [FLUID: Slack-based Low-latency Delivery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23947)
*Michael Luby*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 提出FLUID协议，通过引入slack参数放宽全包接收要求，利用喷泉编码和接收端反馈在丢包网络中实现低延迟数据块传输。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理想化ARQ协议虽在单路径场景下达到带宽最优，但必须接收数据块中的每一个数据包，丢包时需要额外的传输轮次，导致延迟增加。

Method: 采用喷泉编码与接收端反馈，引入受控的slack参数ε。在Loss-Product Rule下，当各轮次丢包率乘积低于ε时即完成传输，而非要求收到所有原始数据包。

Result: FLUID能在每轮都存在丢包的情况下以少量轮次完成传输，延迟显著降低，同时保证传输效率与带宽最优ARQ之间的差距由ε确定性控制。

Conclusion: 通过可控参数ε权衡延迟与带宽效率，FLUID在保持接近带宽最优的前提下实现了更紧密的传输延迟保证。

Abstract: We introduce FLUID (Fountain LiqUId Delivery), a protocol that uses fountain coding and receiver feedback for low-latency delivery of data blocks over lossy networks. Idealized Automatic Repeat reQuest (ARQ) protocols are bandwidth-optimal in the single-path setting, but must deliver every packet in a block and therefore can require additional rounds under packet loss. FLUID uses a controlled amount of slack to relax this all-packets requirement, allowing delivery to finish once enough encoded packets have been received. This yields substantially tighter delivery latency while remaining deterministically close to the ARQ bandwidth optimum.
  FLUID is controlled by a slack parameter $ε$. Under the Loss-Product Rule, delivery finishes once the product of packet loss fractions across transmission rounds falls below $ε$. Thus, FLUID can finish delivery in a small number of rounds even when every round experiences packet loss, while $ε$ controls the gap between FLUID and bandwidth-optimal ARQ.

</details>


### [451] [BShare: Packet Queueing Delay-Driven Buffer Sharing for Datacenter Switches](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24178)
*Krishna Agarwal,Muhamad Rizka Maulana,Vamsi Addanki,Habib Mostafaei*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种简单高效的缓冲区共享机制BShare，通过利用排队延迟实现高性能，在突发负载场景下将流完成时间性能提升高达45.07%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代数据中心交换机跨端口共享数据包缓冲区以提升吞吐量并减少丢包。然而，随着每端口每带宽单位的缓冲区可用性持续下降，现有缓冲区共享策略面临日益严峻的性能挑战。尽管近期尝试将缓冲区管理（BM）与主动队列管理（AQM）集成的混合方案展现出潜力，但其动态计算多因素进行集成的复杂性阻碍了通用化和效率。

Method: 提出BShare机制，这是一种基于数据包排队延迟的简单缓冲区共享机制。该机制仅需一个操作员可配置的参数，避免了复杂的多因素动态计算。

Result: 仿真结果表明，BShare相比ABM机制能够将PowerTCP等先进传输协议的流完成时间（FCT）性能提升高达45.07%，特别是在突发性强的数据中心工作负载场景下表现优异。

Conclusion: BShare证明了通过简单的单参数设计即可实现高效的缓冲区共享管理，为数据中心网络提供了既简单又高性能的解决方案，具有较好的实用价值和推广前景。

Abstract: Modern datacenter switches share packet buffers across ports to boost overall throughput and reduce packet loss. However, as buffer availability per-port-per-bandwidth unit continues to decrease, existing buffer-sharing strategies face increasing performance challenges. Recent efforts have attempted to integrate Buffer Management (BM) with Active Queue Management (AQM) to harness the advantages of both BM and AQM approaches to improve performance. While these hybrid solutions show promise, their complexity of dynamically calculating multiple factors for integration hinders generalization and efficiency. This paper presents BShare, a simple buffer sharing mechanism that uses packet queueing delay. BShare requires only a single operator-configurable parameter. Our simulation results show that BSHARE improves the flow completion time (FCT) performance of advanced transport protocols, such as PowerTCP, by up to 45.07% compared to ABM, particularly under burst-heavy datacenter workloads.

</details>


### [452] [Ant Backpressure Routing for Dynamic Wireless Multi-hop Networks with Mixed Traffic Patterns](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24235)
*Negar Erfaniantaghvayi,Zhongyuan Zhao,Kevin Chan,Ananthram Swami,Santiago Segarra*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 提出Ant-BP路由方案，通过虚拟SP-BP构建基于信息素的转发概率，解耦路由学习与数据包转发，解决了传统BP路由实现复杂和短流饥饿问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统Backpressure路由及其最短路径偏置变体(SP-BP)依赖逐商品排队和逐时隙控制，在传统转发架构下难以实现；同时现有SP-BP存在短生命周期流与流媒体流共存时的最后数据包问题，导致短流饥饿。

Method: 提出蚁群背压路由(Ant-BP)，采用周期性全分布式架构，解耦路由学习与数据包转发。利用虚拟SP-BP构建基于信息素的转发概率，实际数据包通过逐邻居FIFO队列配合概率性下一跳选择进行转发，实现跨商品链路容量共享。通过周期性虚拟更新适应瞬态链路故障和移动性导致的拓扑变化。

Result: 相比传统蚁群优化(ACO)路由，虚拟SP-BP使Ant-BP能以更低开销建立更高质量转发策略。在中低流量负载下吞吐量与SP-BP相当，在混合流媒体和突发流量场景下相比SP-BP和ACO基准方案改善了延迟和投递率，对虚拟流量假设失配、瞬态链路故障和节点移动性具有鲁棒性。

Conclusion: Ant-BP成功将SP-BP的优势扩展到基于逐邻居FIFO转发的网络架构，缓解了短生命周期流量的饥饿问题，在保持性能的同时提高了实用性和部署灵活性。

Abstract: Backpressure (BP) routing and its shortest-path biased variant (SP-BP) provide powerful congestion-aware multipath resource allocation for wireless multi-hop networks, but they rely on per-commodity queueing and slot-by-slot control that may be difficult to realize under practical or legacy forwarding architectures. Moreover, even state-of-the-art SP-BP still suffers from the last-packet problem when short-lived traffic coexists with streaming flows. To address these limitations, we propose Ant Backpressure (Ant-BP), a periodic and fully distributed routing scheme that decouples route learning from packet forwarding. Ant-BP uses virtual SP-BP to construct pheromone-based forwarding probabilities, while actual packets are forwarded through per-neighbor first-in-first-out (FIFO) queues with probabilistic next-hop selection. This architecture enables link-capacity sharing across commodities, mitigates starvation of short-lived traffic, and extends the benefits of SP-BP to network architectures based on per-neighbor FIFO forwarding. Through periodic virtual updates, Ant-BP also adapts to transient link failures and mobility-induced topology changes. Our theoretical analysis and simulations show that, compared with conventional ant colony optimization (ACO) routing, virtual SP-BP enables Ant-BP to establish higher-quality forwarding policies with lower overhead. As a result, Ant-BP improves latency and delivery ratio over SP-BP and ACO-based baselines under mixed streaming and bursty traffic, achieves throughput comparable to SP-BP at low and medium traffic load, and remains robust to mismatched virtual-traffic assumptions, transient link failures, and node mobility.

</details>


### [453] [RxGS: Receiver-Generalizable 3D Gaussian Splatting for Radio-Frequency Data Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24290)
*Kang Yang,Mani Srivastava*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: RxGS提出了一种接收端可泛化的RF数据合成方法，通过解耦场景几何与方向辐射，使用单一统一模型即可支持任意接收端预测，显著降低了计算和存储成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于3D高斯泼溅的方法虽然能高效合成RF数据，但每个模型仅支持固定接收端。要支持N个接收端需要训练N个独立模型，且无法预测训练时未见过的接收端位置，这导致了高昂的训练、推理和存储成本。

Method: RxGS采用两阶段策略：第一阶段学习接收端无关的共享3D高斯几何；第二阶段冻结几何，学习以接收端位置为条件的方向辐射。模型包含全局条件分支（捕获场景中共享的接收端相关效应）和局部分支（建模来自接收端几何和遮挡的每个散射体变化），并设计了多接收端CUDA光栅化器实现批量渲染。

Result: 在多个RF数据集上的实验表明，RxGS使用单一共享模型即可达到或超越逐接收端基线方法的性能，并能泛化到训练时未见过的接收端位置。训练成本降低最多45倍，推理成本降低7.6倍，存储成本降低N倍。

Conclusion: 通过将场景几何与方向辐射解耦，RxGS成功实现了接收端可泛化的RF数据合成，为无线应用提供了一种高效、统一的解决方案，大幅降低了多接收端场景的资源消耗。

Abstract: Radio-frequency (RF) data synthesis predicts the received signal given transmitter and receiver positions, and is essential for wireless applications. Recent 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)-based methods achieve efficient synthesis at any transmitter but only for a fixed receiver. Therefore, supporting $N$ receivers in one scene requires $N$ independent models and precludes prediction at unseen receivers. We present RxGS, which achieves receiver-generalizable synthesis within a single unified model. Our key insight is that scene geometry is receiver-independent while directional radiance is not: a first stage learns shared 3D Gaussian geometry, and a second stage freezes it and learns directional radiance conditioned on receiver position. A global conditioning branch captures shared receiver-dependent effects across the scene, while a local branch models per-scatterer variations from the receiver's geometry and occlusion. A multi-receiver CUDA rasterizer further batches rendering across all $N$ receivers. Evaluated across various RF datasets, RxGS matches or improves over per-receiver baselines with a single shared model and generalizes to receivers unseen during training within the scene, cutting training cost by up to $45\times$, inference cost by $7.6\times$, and storage by $N\times$.

</details>


### [454] [Network Digital Twin for Congestion-Aware Predictive Traffic Routing using Graph MPNNs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24318)
*Umer Iqbal,Ashiq Anjum,Anthony S Conway,Mathias Kern,Anasol Pena Rios*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出了基于消息传递神经网络(MPNN)的网络数字孪生(NDT)框架，通过实时反馈和策略路由(PBR)实现电信网络的拥塞感知流量优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电信网络随用户增长和数据密集型应用扩展产生大量流量，导致拥塞、吞吐量下降、延迟增加和计算成本上升。传统路由协议仅在性能下降后采取行动，无法适应动态流量和拓扑变化，因此需要一种能够实时适应、可扩展、不中断服务且提供连续反馈的路由方法。

Method: 构建网络数字孪生(NDT)使用消息传递神经网络(MPNN)镜像全局网络行为，通过双向通信与物理网络交互。使用Erdos-Renyi、Barabasi-Albert和Watts-Strogatz图生成模型创建具有顶点度限制的拓扑结构，生成递增负载的合成流量。NDT收集路由器和链路的性能指标，MPNN基于局部顶点和全局网络行为对边缘进行分类，并将分类结果作为策略路由(PBR)协议命令反馈给各路由器。

Result: NDT能够收集网络性能指标，MPNN成功实现对边缘的分类，通过PBR协议命令向路由器提供反馈，实现了物理网络链路上的最优流量分配。

Conclusion: 所提出的基于NDT和MPNN的方法能够实时适应网络变化，随网络增长扩展，在不中断活动服务的情况下运行，并通过连续反馈实现拥塞感知的流量优化，有效解决了传统路由协议的局限性。

Abstract: Telecom networks scale with growing users and data-intensive applications, generating heavy traffic that causes congestion, reducing throughput, increasing delay, and raising computational costs. Traditional routing protocols act only after performance degradation, making them unsuitable for dynamic traffic and topological changes. Addressing these challenges requires a routing approach that adapts in real time, scales with network growth, operates without disrupting active services, and provides continuous feedback for congestion-aware traffic optimisation. The Network Digital Twin (NDT) addresses these needs by mirroring global network behaviour using Message Passing Neural Networks (MPNNs) through bidirectional communication with the physical network. To align the NDT with physical network behaviour, synthetic traffic is generated with increasing load across topological structures that incrementally scale as routers are added. These topologies are created by graph-generating models such as Erdos-Renyi, Barabasi-Albert, and Watts-Strogatz, customised with vertex degree limitations. The NDT collects performance metrics from routers and links, and MPNNs classify edges based on local vertex and global network behaviours. Based on these classifications, feedback is sent as Policy-Based Routing (PBR) protocol commands to each router, enabling optimal traffic distribution across links of the physical network.

</details>


### [455] [Low-Altitude Wireless Networks: The Next Horizon of Wireless Infrastructure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24368)
*Yuanhao Cui,Jiali Nie,Weijie Yuan,Fan Liu,Ziye Jia,Jie Xu,Zhiyong Feng,Mohamed-Slim Alouini*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出了低空无线网络（LAWN）概念，将网络范式从地面通信网络转变为三维多功能网络，通过建立空域容量与无线信道容量的耦合关系，揭示了低空空域管理的基本限制与挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低空空域（地面以上约3000米）被视为人类与机器活动的新空间领域，需要建立新型的网络架构来支持该高度动态的空域环境中通信、感知与控制的紧密集成。

Method: 分析LAWN的关键驱动力、网络架构和限制因素，重点关注通信、感知与控制在高动态空域环境中的紧密集成，建立空域容量与无线信道容量之间的耦合关系。

Result: 揭示了空域管理的内在限制，识别了LAWN演进过程中的基本挑战和机遇，阐明了空域容量与无线信道容量之间的耦合关系。

Conclusion: LAWN代表了从地面通信网络向三维多功能网络的重要范式转变，为低空空域的有效管理提供了理论基础和技术指导。

Abstract: Low-altitude airspace, roughly defined as the region up to 3000 meters above ground level, is envisioned as a new spatial domain for daily human and machine activities. This article introduces the concept of the Low-Altitude Wireless Network (LAWN), which represents a paradigm shift from the current ground-based communication-only network to a three-dimensional (3D) multifunctional network. We analyze the key driving forces, network architecture, and limiting factors of LAWN, with a particular focus on the tight integration of communication, sensing, and control in highly dynamic airspace environments. By establishing the coupling between airspace capacity and wireless channel capacity, we reveal the intrinsic limits of airspace management and identify the fundamental challenges and opportunities associated with its evolution.

</details>


### [456] [Analysis of Altitude-Dependent Electronic Conspicuity in Cellular-Connected UAVs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24656)
*Md Sharif Hossen,Vijay K. Shah,Ismail Guvenc*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文分析了无人机高度对蜂窝网络中电子 conspicuity (EC) 可靠性的影响，发现高度增加导致多小区干扰增强、关联区域碎片化以及链路性能变异性增加，为设计高度感知和干扰感知的蜂窝系统提供了实用见解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无人机(UAV)越来越多地集成到蜂窝网络中支持物联网(IoT)应用，可靠的通信对于电子 conspicuity (EC) 至关重要，它使共享空域中的无人机检测和跟踪成为可能。然而，无人机在高海拔运行时，增强的视距(LOS)可见性导致同时暴露于多个基站，产生强烈的跨小区干扰。因此，需要分析无人机高度如何影响无线电环境并影响 EC 可靠性。

Method: 采用系统级分析方法，使用空间和网络级指标，包括服务距离、关联行为和总接收功率。研究得到了基于高空系留气球(helikite)的频谱监测活动的测量数据以及相应的仿真结果支持。

Result: 高度增加导致更强的多小区交互，降低了附近扇区的主导地位，并形成干扰主导的连接性。这些效应导致关联区域碎片化和链路性能变异性增加。尽管实验条件存在差异，但测量数据和仿真结果都表现出一致的高度依赖性趋势。

Conclusion: 研究结果为设计高度感知和干扰感知的蜂窝系统提供了实用见解，以支持可靠的无人机运行。这些发现对于确保共享空域中无人机的可靠通信和电子 conspicuity 具有重要意义。

Abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are increasingly integrated into cellular networks to support emerging Internet of Things (IoT) applications. In such settings, reliable communication is critical for electronic conspicuity (EC), enabling UAV detection and tracking in shared airspace. However, UAVs operate at elevated altitudes where enhanced line-of-sight (LOS) visibility leads to simultaneous exposure to multiple base stations, resulting in strong inter-cell interference. This article presents a system-level analysis of how UAV altitude influences the radio environment and affects EC reliability. Using spatial and network-level metrics, including serving distance, association behavior, and aggregate received power, we show that increasing altitude leads to stronger multi-cell interaction, reduced dominance of nearby sectors, and interference-dominated connectivity. These effects result in fragmented association regions and increased variability in link performance. The analysis is supported by measurement data from a helikite-based spectrum monitoring campaign and corresponding simulation results. Despite differences in experimental conditions, both approaches exhibit consistent altitude-dependent trends. These findings provide practical insights for designing altitude-aware and interference-aware cellular systems to support reliable UAV operation.

</details>


### [457] [OpenTwin: Digital Twin Driven Closed Loop KPM Inference and Control for Open RAN](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24662)
*Md Sharif Hossen,Zifan Zhang,Dara Ron,Yuchen Liu,Vijay K. Shah*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出了OpenTwin，一个基于O-RAN的数字孪生框架，通过两阶段机器学习方法解决KPM数据稀缺和网络中断风险问题，实现96%的KPM准确率，并成功应用于节能xApp验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: O-RAN RIC中ML驱动的xApp/rApp开发面临两大挑战：(i)接口延迟导致的关键性能指标(KPM)数据稀缺，(ii)在现网直接测试AI模型存在网络中断风险。需要一种安全、高效的方法来开发和验证ML模型。

Method: 开发了OpenTwin数字孪生框架，基于开源O-RAN模拟器(ns-O-RAN-flexRIC)，通过O1接口在非实时RIC中部署KPM流。采用两阶段ML方法：首先使用XGBoost模型学习时变网络行为生成模拟器配置参数，然后通过时间感知递归最小二乘(RLS)调谐器持续校正孪生与真实测量之间的KPM偏差。引入偏差感知评分机制监控孪生保真度，检测到网络漂移时自动触发重同步。

Result: OpenTwin能够以高达96%的准确率镜像真实世界的KPM，使xApp能够在虚拟空间验证控制策略后再应用于物理网络，显著降低能耗而不中断现网运行。通过节能xApp案例验证了框架的有效性。

Conclusion: OpenTwin成功解决了O-RAN智能控制器中ML驱动应用开发的关键挑战，为网络运营商提供了一种安全可靠的方法来开发和验证AI驱动的控制策略，在保证网络稳定性的同时实现性能优化。

Abstract: The open radio access network (O-RAN) RAN intelligent controller (RIC) hosts data-driven xApps and rApps to optimize network performance. However, two challenges hinder ML-driven xApp/rApp development: (i) key performance metric (KPM) data scarcity caused by interface latency, and (ii) network disruption risks when testing and validating AI models directly on live networks. We develop OpenTwin, a digital twin framework built on an open-source O-RAN simulator (ns-O-RAN-flexRIC) and KPM streaming via the O1 interface, deployed within the non-RT RIC. OpenTwin uses a two-step ML approach: an XGBoost model that learns time-varying network behavior to generate simulator configuration parameters, followed by a time-aware recursive least squares (RLS) tuner that continuously corrects KPM deviations between the twin and real-world measurements. A deviation-aware scoring mechanism monitors twin fidelity and automatically triggers resynchronization upon detecting network drift. We demonstrate OpenTwin with an energy-saving xApp that validates control policies in the virtual space before applying reconfigurations to the physical network. Experimental results show that OpenTwin mirrors real-world KPMs with up to 96% accuracy and enables the xApp to significantly reduce energy consumption without disrupting live operations.

</details>


### [458] [Altitude-Dependent RSRP and RSRQ Trade-offs in 5G NR UAV Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24669)
*Md Sharif Hossen,Vijay K. Shah,Ismail Guvenc*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文开发了符合3GPP标准的系统级框架，用于表征蜂窝连接无人机在5G NR网络中的关键性能指标，发现无人机在高空会经历从覆盖受限到干扰受限的关键转变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蜂窝连接无人机在5G NR网络中经历的传播和干扰条件随高度显著变化，与地面用户差异巨大。这主要由5G NR网络中下倾天线扇区导致，使无人机由旁瓣服务和干扰，需要系统性地分析这种特殊场景的性能特征。

Method: 开发了符合3GPP标准的系统级框架，在多站点三扇区部署场景下，结合真实天线方向图和视距/非视距条件的概率模型，对参考信号接收功率(RSRP)、参考信号接收质量(RSRQ)和信干噪比(SINR)等关键性能指标进行一致性表征。

Result: 仿真结果表明，空中用户在更高高度经历从覆盖受限到干扰受限的关键转变。RSRP受大尺度传播特性影响，随高度和站间距离(ISD)增加逐渐恶化；而SINR由于LOS条件导致的干扰增加而恶化更快。相反，增加ISD虽然降低了接收功率，但能改善SINR和RSRQ，因为干扰更低。

Conclusion: 无人机在5G NR网络中的性能表现出与地面用户截然不同的特征：高度增加导致从覆盖受限转向干扰受限，RSRP逐渐恶化而SINR快速恶化，增加站间距离可改善干扰相关的性能指标但会降低接收功率，这为蜂窝连接无人机的网络规划提供了重要指导。

Abstract: Cellular-connected unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in 5G NR networks experience propagation and interference conditions that vary significantly with altitude and differ substantially from those experienced by terrestrial users. This is primarily caused by the down-tilted antenna sectors in 5G NR networks, which cause UAVs to be served (and interfered with) by the sidelobes. In this paper, we develop a 3GPP-compliant system-level framework for the consistent characterization of key performance indicators (KPIs) such as reference signal received power (RSRP), reference signal received quality (RSRQ), and signal-to-interference-and-noise ratio (SINR) in a multi-site tri-sector deployment with realistic antenna patterns and probabilistic models for line-of-sight (LOS) and non-LOS (NLOS) conditions. Simulation results demonstrate that a critical transition for aerial users is experienced when going from coverage-limited to interference-limited conditions at higher altitudes. Although RSRP is affected by large-scale propagation characteristics and degrades gradually with increasing altitude and inter-site distance (ISD), SINR degrades much faster due to increased interference caused by LOS conditions. On the contrary, increasing ISD improves SINR and RSRQ due to lower interference, even as received power is reduced.

</details>


### [459] [B.O.D.Y.: Beyond-Overlay Deterministic topologY -- A Layer-2 Declarative Ground Truth for AIOps Pipelines under Fragmented Administrative Boundaries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24683)
*Matheus Marques,Carlos Alberto Malcher,Cledson de Sousa*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出了B.O.D.Y.框架，一种用于多园区异构基础设施的确定性结构化拓扑发现层，通过多模态数据融合在无管理权限的情况下重建非托管物理网络段，为AIOps推理系统提供可审计的物理层真相来源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代多园区机构的AIOps环境面临严重的拓扑漂移和非托管物理网络段黑盒问题。传统的二层发现管道依赖统一的管理协作和SNMP轮询，在异构、多厂商、多租户的覆盖网络基础设施中经常失效。这导致下游AIOps推理系统进行因果推断时与物理现实脱节，产生关键故障模式。

Method: 提出B.O.D.Y.（Beyond-Overlay Deterministic topologY）框架，通过多模态数据融合管道绕过NP难的不完整地址转发表（AFT）解析困境。该管道编排四种数据源：1）通过非特权终端会话收集的瞬时MAC地址转发表；2）被动OUI指纹识别；3）PoE遥测数据；4）声明式状态存储。该方法无需网络管理权限即可重建非托管物理网段并映射逻辑资产语义。

Result: 在Universidade Federal Fluminense五个校区的评估中，成功解析了541个已注册边缘设备中的530个。实验证明确定性拓扑发现消除了概率性AIOps推理中的一个关键故障模式，即与物理现实脱节的置信因果推断问题。

Conclusion: B.O.D.Y.为碎片化管理边界下的AIOps生态系统提供了一个确定性、不可变、可审计的物理层真相来源，有效解决了异构基础设施中的拓扑发现难题，使下游推理系统能够基于准确的物理现实进行因果推断。

Abstract: Modern AIOps environments operating within multi-campus institutional infrastructures suffer acutely from topological drift and black-box unmanaged physical network segments. Classical layer-2 discovery pipelines rely on uniform administrative cooperation and ubiquitous SNMP polling, which routinely fail in heterogeneous, multi-vendor, and multi-tenant overlay infrastructures. This paper introduces B.O.D.Y. (Beyond-Overlay Deterministic topologY), a deterministic structural grounding layer for AIOps ecosystems operating under fragmented administrative boundaries. B.O.D.Y. bypasses the NP-hard incomplete Address Forwarding Table (AFT) resolution dilemma by formalizing a multi-modal data fusion pipeline that orchestrates ephemeral MAC address forwarding tables collected via non-privileged terminal sessions, passive OUI fingerprinting, PoE telemetry, and declarative state storage. The resulting topology graph reconstructs unmanaged physical segments and maps logical asset semantics without administrative network privileges, providing downstream reasoning systems with an immutable, auditable source of physical ground truth. Evaluation across five campuses of the Universidade Federal Fluminense, resolving 530 of 541 registered edge devices, demonstrates that deterministic topological grounding eliminates a critical failure mode in prob bilistic AIOps reasoning: confident causal inference decoupled from physical reality.

</details>


### [460] [Scaling up Energy-Aware Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Mission-Oriented Drone Networks with Individual Reward](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24992)
*Changling Li,Ying Li*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于个体奖励函数的能量感知多智能体强化学习模型，用于无人机网络轨迹规划，在环境规模扩展时相比共享奖励模型表现出更高的鲁棒性和能效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体强化学习在协作系统（如自动驾驶、智慧城市）中应用广泛，也被用于无人机网络的轨迹规划问题。然而，动态环境和无人机有限的电池容量仍然对MARL实现高效协作任务执行构成挑战，需要解决这些限制以提升无人机协作效率。

Method: 提出一种能量感知MARL模型，采用深度Q网络（DQN）架构，设计了基于任务执行进度和无人机剩余电量的个体奖励函数。通过仿真实验与共享奖励MARL模型进行对比，探究信用分配对MARL性能的影响。

Result: 实验结果表明：1）该模型在不同任务位置和长度下均能达到至少80%的成功率；2）在高任务密度场景下，个体奖励模式与共享奖励模式均表现优异，任务密度接近40%时成功率接近100%；3）环境规模扩展时，个体奖励模型相比共享奖励模型展现出明显优势，对环境尺寸和智能体数量变化更具鲁棒性，能在更少步数内实现更高成功率，能量效率更优。

Conclusion: 个体奖励函数的引入明确了各智能体的目标，有效解决了信用分配问题，使模型在环境规模扩展时保持高效稳定的性能。该方法为动态环境中电池受限的无人机协作任务执行提供了一种有效的解决方案，具有更好的可扩展性和能量效率。

Abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) has shown wide applicability in collaborative systems such as autonomous driving and smart cities for its ability of learning through interaction. With the recent development of drone networks, researchers have also applied MARL to address the trajectory planning problems. However, the dynamic environment and the limited battery capacity are still challenging for using MARL to achieve efficient collaborative task execution. In this paper, we propose an energy-aware MARL model as an attempt to tackle these challenges, leveraging Deep Q-Networks (DQN) with \emph{individual reward functions} driven by the task execution progress and the remaining battery of drones. We conduct a set of simulation studies for the proposed mode and compare it with the shared reward MARL~\cite{Li2022MARL} to explore the impact of credit assignment in MARL. The results indicate that our proposed model can achieve at least 80\% success rate regardless of the task locations and lengths. Similar to the shared reward mode, the individual reward mode can achieve a better success rate when the task density is high, and it can hit nearly a 100\% success rate when task density gets close to 40\%. The true advantage of our proposed model with individual reward is revealed when scaling up the environment. The comparison to the shared reward MARL shows that the our proposed model is more robust towards the change of the environment size and agent numbers. It can achieve higher success rate with fewer steps due to the clarity of the goal which improves energy efficiency even better.

</details>


### [461] [K8S Power Irrigation: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Performance-Aware Power Efficiency of Kubernetes Cloud-Native Microservices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25218)
*Zouhir Bellal,Laaziz Lahlou,Nadjia Kara,Timothy Murphy,Tan Phat Nguyen*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出了K8SPI，一种面向云原生延迟敏感微服务的层次化强化学习控制器，通过联合优化CPU核心和Uncore频率，在保证性能约束的前提下实现了23-30%的节点级功耗降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代云平台因AI应用激增面临严峻的功耗压力，但延迟敏感微服务的功耗优化极具挑战性：性能违规直接影响用户体验，且多租户环境下共享Uncore资源（末级缓存、内存带宽）的竞争会导致性能下降。现有电源管理器忽略应用级性能需求和Uncore干扰，导致系统性能模式下严重的功耗过度配置。

Method: 提出K8SPI层次化强化学习控制器，采用两阶段架构：(1)粗粒度智能体快速缓解性能违规；(2)细粒度智能体在满足性能需求后最小化功耗。系统融合硬件、Kubernetes和应用层遥测数据，联合优化CPU核心和Uncore频率，以适应工作负载异构性和跨微服务干扰。

Result: 在Kubernetes测试平台上评估表明：与Linux性能调度器相比，K8SPI在严重Uncore竞争和动态负载波动场景下，实现节点级功耗降低23-30%，同时将性能需求违规率控制在2-3%以下。

Conclusion: K8SPI成功解决了云原生延迟敏感微服务的功耗优化难题，证明了层次化强化学习在联合优化核心与Uncore频率方面的有效性，为数据中心实现可持续发展目标提供了实用解决方案。

Abstract: Modern cloud platforms are facing a sharp increase in power demand driven by the rapid adoption of AI-powered applications, making power optimization urgent under net-zero commitments and sustainability goals. Yet, reducing power in production remains challenging for latency-sensitive microservices, where performance violations directly affect user experience and operational risk. Such services exhibit heterogeneous workload characteristics and dynamic load patterns. In multi-tenant environments, contention on shared uncore resources, including last-level cache and memory bandwidth, can degrade performance, especially for memory-intensive workloads. As a safeguard, providers often run servers in performance mode, fixing core and uncore frequencies at high levels. Existing power governors largely ignore application-level performance requirements and uncore interference, leading to systematic power over-provisioning. To address this, we introduce K8SPI, a hierarchical reinforcement learning controller that jointly optimizes CPU core and uncore frequencies for cloud-native deployments. K8SPI uses a two-stage architecture: a coarse-grained agent rapidly mitigates performance violations, while a fine-grained agent minimizes power once requirements are satisfied. Using telemetry from hardware, Kubernetes, and application layers, K8SPI adapts to workload heterogeneity and cross-microservice interference. We evaluate K8SPI on a Kubernetes testbed across multiple scenarios. Results show that K8SPI reduces node-level power by 23--30\% compared with the Linux performance governor while keeping performance requirement violations below 2--3\%, even under severe uncore contention and dynamic load fluctuations.

</details>


### [462] [TIP: A Decentralized Intent-Based Protocol for Declarative IoT Interoperability and Sandboxed Schema Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25332)
*Yeison David Mejia Mosquera*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出了TIP（意图协议），一种去中心化、声明式的网络协议，通过抽象意图而非物理地址来连接异构IoT设备，解决了现有标准在硬件架构、网络协议和数据格式上的碎片化问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有IoT系统存在硬件架构、网络协议栈和数据序列化格式的碎片化问题。当前标准（如MQTT、CoAP、DDS）依赖基于地址绑定的命令式路由模型，需要硬编码配置，缺乏运行时模式转换的灵活性。

Method: 提出TIP协议，节点提交指定能力、模式和QoS约束的抽象意图。采用混合发现机制（本地mDNS与Kademlia DHT）解析匹配节点，通过多标准评分算法（网络延迟、历史信誉、合约合规性）优化选择。利用WebAssembly沙箱动态编译TOML规范实现数据表示的实时转换。安全机制包括Ed25519签名、X25519密钥交换和ChaCha20-Poly1305加密。

Result: Rust和C++参考实现评估显示，翻译开销低于1毫秒，在工业环境下表现出稳健的弹性。

Conclusion: TIP协议成功实现了异构IoT系统的统一通信，通过声明式意图驱动的方式解决了传统协议的局限性，具有低延迟和高可靠性的特点。

Abstract: Heterogeneous Internet of Things (IoT) systems suffer from fragmentation across hardware architectures, networking stacks, and data serialization formats. Existing standards (such as MQTT, COAP, and DDS) rely on address-bound, imperative routing models that require hardcoded configurations and leave no flexibility for runtime schema translation. This paper presents TIP (The Intent Protocol), a decentralized, declarative network protocol. Instead of addressing specific physical endpoints, nodes submit abstract intents specifying desired capabilities, schemas, and Quality of Service (QoS) constraints. The TIP Engine resolves matching nodes using a hybrid discovery mechanism combining local multicast DNS (mDNS) with Kademlia Distributed Hash Tables (DHT). Selection is optimized via a multi-criteria scoring algorithm incorporating network latency, historical reputation, and contract compliance. Mismatched data representations are reconciled on-the-fly inside isolated WebAssembly (WASM) sandboxes compiled dynamically from TOML specifications. Security is enforced through Ed25519 signatures, X25519 key exchanges, and ChaCha20-Poly 1305 payload encryption. Evaluation of our reference implementation in Rust and C++ shows sub-millisecond translation overhead and robust resilience under industrial conditions.

</details>


### [463] [Mode 0: A New 3GPP V2X Resource Allocation Category for Roadside Computing Unit-Assisted Safety Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25431)
*Dewei Jiang,Xiang Gu*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 论文揭示3GPP V2X现有二元实体分类（基站与车辆UE）结构不完整，提出以路侧计算单元(RCU)为核心的新类别Mode 0，通过MAPPO仿真验证其在高密度交通场景下显著改善时延尾部故障问题，满足安全时延要求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3GPP V2X资源分配框架中的二元实体分类存在结构性缺陷：基站主导调度在高密度交通节点下饱和，导致时延尾部故障持续存在；UE自主模式无法为遮挡交通参与者提供预警，且不足以应对大范围级联环境风险。这些缺陷在平均包交付率接近服务等级目标时仍然存在。

Method: 提出Mode 0这一新的3GPP V2X类别，其核心实体是路侧计算单元(RCU)，集成了高架感知、旁链通信和本地计算评估三种能力，由交通管理部门拥有。定义Mode 0的子族谱系：从Mode 0a（全被动UE，保证最小值）到Mode 0c（全主动UE，最优目标）。通过十五轮多智能体近端策略优化(MAPPO)仿真验证架构族的性能。

Result: 中国国家标准(DB11/T 2329.1-2024, T/ITS 0224.1-2025)、中国联通RS-MEC基础设施以及欧美C-V2X项目的收敛部署证据表明，机构双方正收敛于路侧交通节点但缺乏协调标准。MAPPO仿真结果：Mode 0a在共享池基线处于分析对称纳什协调底限；Mode 0c通过需求分离实现两类交通流的严格帕累托改进(M0 PDR 0.999, M1 PDR 0.998，ρ_pool≤1)，并将最差TTI交付比从接近零提升至0.601——唯一满足时延安全要求的配置。

Conclusion: 研究表明现有3GPP V2X分类存在结构性缺陷，Mode 0提供了解决方案。建议在NR-V2X旁链增强工作计划中启动Mode 0的3GPP研究项目，以推动路侧计算单元标准化，解决当前框架在高密度交通场景下的时延和安全预警问题。

Abstract: The 3GPP V2X resource allocation framework defines two entity classes -- the base station and the vehicle UE -- and four modes across LTE and NR generations. We demonstrate that this binary taxonomy is structurally incomplete. Base station-led scheduling saturates at high-density traffic nodes, producing latency-tail failures that persist even when mean packet delivery ratios approach the service-class target. UE autonomy is categorically incapable of pre-emergence warning for occluded traffic participants and insufficient for large-scope cascading environmental hazards. We propose Mode 0, a new 3GPP V2X category whose defining entity is the Roadside Computing Unit (RCU) -- an infrastructure ensemble integrating elevated sensing (Seeing), sidelink communication (Speaking), and local computational evaluation (Thinking), owned by traffic management authorities. Mode 0 defines a subfamily spectrum from Mode 0a (all-passive UEs, the guaranteed minimum) through Mode 0c (all-active UEs, the optimal target). Convergent deployment evidence from Chinese national standards (DB11/T 2329.1-2024, T/ITS 0224.1-2025), China Unicom RS-MEC infrastructure, and European and US C-V2X programs confirms that both institutional sides are converging on the roadside traffic node without a coordination standard. A fifteen-run Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization (MAPPO) simulation validates the architectural family: Mode 0a in shared-pool baseline sits at the analytical symmetric-Nash coordination floor; Mode 0c with demand separation achieves strict Pareto improvement for both traffic classes (M0 PDR 0.999, M1 PDR 0.998 at $ρ_{\rm pool} \leq 1$) and lifts the worst-TTI delivery ratio from near-zero to 0.601 -- the only configuration satisfying the latency safety requirement structurally. We call for a 3GPP study item on Mode 0 within the NR-V2X sidelink enhancement work programme.

</details>


### [464] [Leveraging Multi-Step Traffic Forecasts for Multi-Period Planning Optical Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25573)
*Giannis Savva,Hafsa Maryam,Venkatesh Chebolu,Tania Panayiotou,Georgios Ellinas*

Main category: cs.NI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种利用多步流量预测实现可重构光网络多周期规划的框架，通过深度学习模型预测流量，并结合ILP和启发式算法主动优化网络配置，在保证QoS的前提下平衡频谱节省与服务中断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在可重构光网络中，网络需要适应时变的流量条件以节省频谱资源。然而，频繁的网络重配置可能导致服务中断，影响服务质量。因此，如何在频谱节省与服务中断之间取得平衡成为关键挑战。

Method: 采用编码器-解码器深度学习模型进行多步流量预测，分析真实流量轨迹。基于预测结果，开发整数线性规划(ILP)模型和启发式算法，主动优化未来的网络配置，以提高频谱效率并最小化服务中断。

Result: ILP方法总体上获得更优的解决方案，而启发式算法在显著降低运行时间的同时，能够获得接近ILP的解。预测时域的选择对服务中断、过度配置和配置不足有显著影响，其选择依赖于网络运营商在性能和服务级别协议方面的目标。

Conclusion: 所提框架能够有效利用多步流量预测实现网络的多周期规划，通过合理选择预测时域，可在频谱节省与服务中断之间实现有效平衡，为网络运营商提供灵活的决策依据。

Abstract: In this work, multi-step traffic predictions are leveraged to enable multi-period planning in reconfigurable optical networks. The proposed framework aims to achieve spectrum savings by adapting the network to predicted time-varying conditions while ensuring the necessary quality-of-service (QoS) levels. Since frequent network (re)configurations may lead to undesired service disruptions, traffic predictions spanning various prediction horizons are exploited to balance the trade-off between spectrum savings and service disruptions. For multi-step-ahead prediction, an encoder-decoder deep learning model is employed to analyze real traffic traces. Subsequently, an Integer Linear Programming (ILP) formulation and heuristic algorithms are developed that use the predictions to proactively (re)optimize future network configurations, enhancing spectrum efficiency while minimizing service disruptions. The approaches are utilized under different scenarios, with the ILP achieving better solutions overall, and the heuristics achieving solutions close to the ILP at significantly lower running times. Further, the results present the effect of the prediction horizon on disruptions and over- and under- provisioning, showcasing that the prediction horizon selection greatly depends on the network operator targets in both network performance and predefined service level agreements.
